entries.translation: 你已经交过我的推荐信了！你不需要另一封。
entries.sampleRaw: You've already handed in my §6recommendation letter§f! You don't need another one.

entries.source: Hey it's me, the raffle box.
entries.translation: 嘿，是我，抽奖箱。
entries.sampleRaw: §rHey it's me, the raffle box.

entries.source: The event hasn't started yet.
entries.translation: 活动还没开始呢。
entries.sampleRaw: §rThe event hasn't started yet.

entries.source: Don't tell anyone I can talk.
entries.translation: 别告诉任何人我会说话。
entries.sampleRaw: §rDon't tell anyone I can talk.

entries.source: Hey I'm just a box, I can't explain the event!
entries.translation: 嘿，我只是个箱子，我解释不了这个活动！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey I'm just a box, I can't explain the event!

entries.source: Talk with Simon or Rezzus first!
entries.translation: 先和Simon或Rezzus谈谈!
entries.sampleRaw: Talk with Simon or §aRezzus §rfirst!

entries.source: Hey there! Happy SkyBlock Year [year]!
entries.translation: 嘿，你好！SkyBlock [year] 年快乐！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there! Happy §bSkyBlock Year [year]§f!

entries.source: To celebrate this EPIC milestone, we are organizing a set of CRAZY raffles!
entries.translation: 为了庆祝这个史诗里程碑，我们正在组织一系列疯狂的抽奖活动！
entries.sampleRaw: To celebrate this §5§lEPIC §fmilestone, we are organizing a set of §d§l§oCRAZY §fraffles!

entries.source: But first, you need a TEAM!
entries.translation: 但首先，你需要一个队伍！
entries.sampleRaw: But first, you need a §bTEAM§f!

entries.source: Oh... did you mean to close that?
entries.translation: 哦……你是想关掉那个吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh... did you mean to close that?

entries.source: It's fine, click me again!
entries.translation: 没关系，再点我一次！
entries.sampleRaw: It's fine, click me again!

entries.source: Sweet, the [COLOR] team.
entries.translation: 太好了，[COLOR] 队。
entries.sampleRaw: Sweet, the §l[COLOR] §fteam.

entries.source: I hear it might be the best one!
entries.translation: 我听说它可能是最好的一队！
entries.sampleRaw: I hear it might be the best one!

entries.source: Anyway... there are 3 kinds of raffles going on.
entries.translation: 总之……目前有 3 种抽奖活动正在进行。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway... there are §63 §fkinds of raffles going on.
entries.numericSource: Anyway... there are {{N0}} kinds of raffles going on.
entries.numericTranslation: 总之……目前有 {{N0}} 种抽奖活动正在进行。

entries.source: Speed Raffles are drawn every 2 hours.
entries.translation: 极速抽奖每 2 小时开奖一次。
entries.sampleRaw: §6Speed Raffles §fare drawn every §92 §fhours.
entries.numericSource: Speed Raffles are drawn every {{N0}} hours.
entries.numericTranslation: 极速抽奖每 {{N0}} 小时开奖一次。

entries.source: Daily Raffles, they happen every 24 hours.
entries.translation: 每日抽奖，每 24 小时举行一次。
entries.sampleRaw: §bDaily Raffles§f, they happen every §624 §fhours.
entries.numericSource: Daily Raffles, they happen every {{N0}} hours.
entries.numericTranslation: 每日抽奖，每 {{N0}} 小时举行一次。

entries.source: The Big One, which is going to be drawn at the end of Year [year]!
entries.translation: 大奖，将在第 [year] 年结束时开奖！
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lThe Big One§f, which is going to be drawn at the end of §bYear [year]§f!

entries.source: To participate, collect Raffle Tickets and slices of cake by simply playing SkyBlock during the event.
entries.translation: 要参与，只需在活动期间游玩 SkyBlock 即可收集抽奖券和蛋糕切片。
entries.sampleRaw: To participate, collect §bRaffle Tickets §fand §dslices of cake §fby simply playing §aSkyBlock §fduring the event.

entries.source: All tickets you gain are automatically entered into the next raffle of each type.
entries.translation: 你获得的所有抽奖券都会自动投入下一场各类型的抽奖。
entries.sampleRaw: All tickets you gain are automatically entered into the next raffle of each type.

entries.source: When you receive a slice of cake, it will be a certain color, which corresponds to a certain team.
entries.translation: 当你收到一块蛋糕切片时，它会是某种颜色，对应某个特定的队伍。
entries.sampleRaw: When you receive a §dslice of cake§f, it will be a certain §cc§6o§el§ao§9r§f, which corresponds to a certain team.

entries.source: There are slices of Red Velvet, Blueberry, Lemon Cheesecake, Matcha, and Strawberry Shortcake!
entries.translation: 有红丝绒、蓝莓、柠檬芝士蛋糕、抹茶和草莓奶油蛋糕切片！
entries.sampleRaw: There are slices of §cRed Velvet§f, §9Blueberry§f, §eLemon Cheesecake§f, §aMatcha§f, and §dStrawberry Shortcake§f!

entries.source: If you take your slice of cake and feed it to a member of that team, you'll both get some rewards, in addition to bonus Raffle Tickets!
entries.translation: 如果你拿着蛋糕切片喂给该队伍的一名成员，你们双方都会获得一些奖励，外加额外抽奖券！
entries.sampleRaw: If you take your slice of cake and feed it to a member of that team, you'll both get some §6rewards§f, in addition to §9bonus Raffle Tickets§f!

entries.source: Here, I'll give you 3 Raffle Tickets to get you started.
entries.translation: 来,我给你 3 张抽奖券作为起步.
entries.sampleRaw: Here, I'll give you §b3 Raffle Tickets §fto get you started.
entries.numericSource: Here, I'll give you {{N0}} Raffle Tickets to get you started.
entries.numericTranslation: 来,我给你 {{N0}} 张抽奖券作为起步.

entries.source: You can get more tickets by eating cake and completing Raffle Tasks. Check out the Raffle Box for more info on those!
entries.translation: 你可以通过吃蛋糕和完成抽奖任务获得更多抽奖券.查看抽奖箱了解更多信息!
entries.sampleRaw: You can get more tickets by eating cake and completing §bRaffle Tasks§f. Check out the §6Raffle Box §ffor more info on those!

entries.source: Tada!
entries.translation: 当当！
entries.sampleRaw: Tada!

entries.source: You can click on the Raffle Box next to me or in your SkyBlock Menu to view your event progress.
entries.translation: 你可以点击我旁边的抽奖箱或 SkyBlock 菜单中的抽奖箱来查看活动进度.
entries.sampleRaw: You can click on the §6Raffle Box §fnext to me or in your §aSkyBlock Menu §fto view your event progress.

entries.source: Oh, one last thing! The team that enters the most tickets into The Big One will receive a special memento at the end of the event!
entries.translation: 哦，最后一件事！向大奖投入最多抽奖券的队伍将在活动结束时获得一份特殊纪念品！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, one last thing! The team that enters the most tickets into §c§lThe Big One §fwill receive a special §cmemento §fat the end of the event!

entries.source: Have fun! You can come speak to me again if you have any questions!
entries.translation: 玩得开心！如果你有任何问题，可以再来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Have fun! You can come speak to me again if you have any questions!

entries.source: Hello again! Happy Century Celebration!
entries.translation: 又见面了！百年庆典快乐！
entries.sampleRaw: Hello again! §dHappy Century Celebration§f!

entries.source: What would you like to know about the event?
entries.translation: 你想了解关于活动的什么信息？
entries.sampleRaw: What would you like to know about the event?

entries.source: To enter a raffle, you need to collect Raffle Tickets.
entries.translation: 要参加抽奖，你需要收集抽奖券。
entries.sampleRaw: To enter a §6raffle§f, you need to collect §bRaffle Tickets§f.

entries.source: You will gain tickets just for being online during the event.
entries.translation: 活动期间只要在线就能获得抽奖券。
entries.sampleRaw: You will gain tickets just for §ebeing online §fduring the event§f.

entries.source: However, you will gain a bit more if you're actively playing, especially from doing Raffle Tasks.
entries.translation: 不过，如果你积极游玩，尤其是完成抽奖任务，你会获得更多一些。
entries.sampleRaw: However, you will gain a bit more if you're actively playing, especially from doing §bRaffle Tasks§f.

entries.source: Tickets are not physical items, so don't worry about losing them!
entries.translation: 抽奖券不是实体物品，所以不用担心丢失！
entries.sampleRaw: Tickets are not physical items, so don't worry about losing them!

entries.source: Each time you find a ticket, it will be entered into EVERY upcoming raffle.
entries.translation: 每当你找到一张抽奖券，它都会被投入每一场即将到来的抽奖。
entries.sampleRaw: Each time you find a §bticket§f, it will be entered into §lEVERY§f upcoming raffle.

entries.source: For this event, you are on the [COLOR] team!
entries.translation: 本次活动中，你属于[COLOR]队！
entries.sampleRaw: For this event, you are on the §7§l[COLOR]§f team!

entries.source: You can tell what team someone is by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in chat.
entries.translation: 你可以通过查看聊天栏中名字旁边的蛋糕徽章颜色来判断某人属于哪一队。
entries.sampleRaw: You can tell what team someone is by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in chat.

entries.source: Or, by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in the TAB list.
entries.translation: 或者，查看 TAB 列表中名字旁边的蛋糕徽章颜色。
entries.sampleRaw: Or, by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in the TAB list.

entries.source: If they don't have a cake emblem, then they haven't gotten involved in the event yet...
entries.translation: 如果他们没有蛋糕徽章，那说明他们还没有参与活动……
entries.sampleRaw: If they don't have a cake emblem, then they haven't gotten involved in the event yet...

entries.source: Which means more cake for the rest of us!
entries.translation: 这意味着我们剩下的人能分到更多蛋糕！
entries.sampleRaw: Which means more cake for the rest of us!

entries.source: Hi!
entries.translation: 你好！
entries.sampleRaw: Hi!

entries.source: There was a big event in celebration of the SkyBlock Year [year].
entries.translation: 曾举办过一场盛大的活动，庆祝 SkyBlock 第 [year] 年。
entries.sampleRaw: There was a big event in celebration of the §bSkyBlock Year [year]§f.

entries.source: It looks like you missed it, but maybe you'll catch the next event!
entries.translation: 看来你错过了，不过也许你能赶上下一场活动！
entries.sampleRaw: It looks like you missed it, but maybe you'll catch the next event!

entries.source: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) SkyBlock Year 300!
entries.translation: 你好!提前祝你 SkyBlock 第 300 年快乐!
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) §bSkyBlock Year 300§f!
entries.numericSource: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) SkyBlock Year {{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 你好!提前祝你 SkyBlock 第 {{N0}} 年快乐!

entries.source: We're organizing a huge raffle!
entries.translation: 我们正在组织一场盛大的抽奖！
entries.sampleRaw: We're organizing a huge raffle!

entries.source: Come talk to me once the event starts!
entries.translation: 活动开始后来找我吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Come talk to me once the event starts!

entries.source: The Century Celebration event is over, but you can still interact with the Raffle Box to claim rewards you might have missed.
entries.translation: 世纪庆典活动已经结束，但你仍然可以与 Raffle Box 互动，领取你可能错过的奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: The §dCentury Celebration §fevent is over, but you can still interact with the §6Raffle Box §fto claim rewards you might have missed.

entries.source: See you next time!
entries.translation: 下次见！
entries.sampleRaw: See you next time!

entries.source: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) SkyBlock Year 500!
entries.translation: 你好!提前祝你 SkyBlock 第 500 年快乐!
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) §bSkyBlock Year 500§f!
entries.numericSource: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) SkyBlock Year {{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 你好!提前祝你 SkyBlock 第 {{N0}} 年快乐!

entries.source: As part of the Century Celebration, we're organizing a huge raffle!
entries.translation: 作为世纪庆典的一部分，我们正在组织一场盛大的抽奖！
entries.sampleRaw: As part of the §dCentury Celebration§f, we're organizing a §c§lhuge §fraffle!

entries.source: Hey there!
entries.translation: 嘿，你好！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there!

entries.source: You cannot claim prizes or even view the raffle box on bingo, but you can earn tickets!
entries.translation: 在 Bingo 中你无法领取奖品，甚至无法查看抽奖箱，但你可以赚取奖券！
entries.sampleRaw: You cannot claim prizes or even view the raffle box on bingo, but you can earn tickets!

entries.source: Unsurprisingly, you've been assigned to the [COLOR] team!
entries.translation: 不出所料,你被分配到了[COLOR]队!
entries.sampleRaw: Unsurprisingly, you've been assigned to the §7§l[COLOR]§f §rteam!

entries.source: A great warrior is nothing without their armor!
entries.translation: 伟大的战士没有盔甲就一无是处！
entries.sampleRaw: A great warrior is nothing without their armor!

entries.source: Click me again to open the Armorsmith Shop!
entries.translation: 再次点击我以打开 Armorsmith 商店！
entries.sampleRaw: Click me again to open the Armorsmith Shop!

entries.source: Oh wait, you already have Redstone Collection II!
entries.translation: 哦等等，你已经有红石收藏 II 了！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh wait, you already have §aRedstone Collection II§f!

entries.source: In that case, would you like to help me out with something? In return, I can give you some more slots for your Accessory Bag.
entries.translation: 既然这样，你愿意帮我个忙吗？作为回报，我可以给你的饰品袋增加一些槽位。
entries.sampleRaw: In that case, would you like to help me out with something? In return, I can give you some §dmore slots §ffor your §aAccessory Bag§f.

entries.source: Understandable, have a nice day. Please speak to me again if you ever change your mind.
entries.translation: 可以理解，祝你今天愉快。如果你改变主意，请再来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: Understandable, have a nice day. Please speak to me again if you ever change your mind.

entries.source: Come back with the right amount of items!
entries.translation: 带对数量的物品再来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back with the right amount of items!

entries.source: The Pigmen around here are actually quite passive. They'll only attack if you or someone nearby mines too much Redstone.
entries.translation: 这里的猪人其实相当温和。只有当你或附近的人挖了太多红石时，它们才会攻击。
entries.sampleRaw: The Pigmen around here are actually quite passive. They'll only attack if you or someone nearby mines too much §cRedstone§f.

entries.source: Ah, nice to meet you.
entries.translation: 啊，很高兴见到你。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, nice to meet you.

entries.source: Rogier’s the name, and I have some intriguing news to share with you.
entries.translation: 我叫 Rogier，有一些有趣的消息要和你分享。
entries.sampleRaw: §6Rogier§f’s the name, and I have some intriguing news to share with you.

entries.source: I'm a researcher of sorts, specializing in the art of Transfusion.
entries.translation: 我算是个研究者，专攻输血之术。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a §cresearcher§f of sorts, specializing in the art of §dTransfusion§f.

entries.source: I'm currently seeking a particular artifact that is rumored to possess great power when paired with certain weapons.
entries.translation: 我目前正在寻找一件特定的神器，据传它与某些武器搭配时能发挥出强大的力量。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm currently seeking a particular §5artifact§f that is rumored to possess great power when paired with certain weapons.

entries.source: As you might expect, the journey has been fraught with danger.
entries.translation: 正如你所料，这段旅程充满了危险。
entries.sampleRaw: As you might expect, the journey has been fraught with §cdanger§f.

entries.source: Perhaps adventurer, we can join forces in our quests, for safety in numbers, if nothing else.
entries.translation: 也许，冒险家，我们可以在任务中联手，至少人多安全些。
entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps adventurer, we can join forces in our quests, for safety in numbers, if nothing else.

entries.source: So, what do you say?
entries.translation: 那么，你怎么说？
entries.sampleRaw: So, what do you say?

entries.source: Ah, you are not ready I presume. I respect your decision. I'll continue my search for the artifact on my own.
entries.translation: 啊，我猜你还没准备好。我尊重你的决定。我会独自继续寻找那件神器。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, you are not ready I presume. I respect your decision. I'll continue my search for the artifact on my own.

entries.source: But do keep in mind that this place is fraught with danger, and it's always better to have a partner by your side.
entries.translation: 但请记住，这个地方充满了危险，身边有个伙伴总是更好。
entries.sampleRaw: But do keep in mind that this place is fraught with danger, and it's always better to have a partner by your side.

entries.source: If you change your mind, I'll be around. Best of luck on your own quest.
entries.translation: 如果你改变主意，我会在附近。祝你在自己的任务中好运。
entries.sampleRaw: If you change your mind, I'll be around. Best of luck on your own quest.

entries.source: Excellent, adventurer!
entries.translation: 太好了，冒险家！
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent, adventurer!

entries.source: Together we'll be a force to be reckoned with. I'll share with you all that I've learned about the artifact and its potential.
entries.translation: 我们联手将是一股不可小觑的力量。我会把我所了解到的关于那件神器及其潜力的一切都分享给你。
entries.sampleRaw: Together we'll be a force to be reckoned with. I'll share with you all that I've learned about the artifact and its potential.

entries.source: With your skills and my expertise, I'm confident that we'll find it in no time.
entries.translation: 凭借你的技巧和我的专长，我相信我们很快就能找到它。
entries.sampleRaw: With your skills and my expertise, I'm confident that we'll find it in no time.

entries.source: Meet me in the Hub at once! We will then discuss our plans forward. I will seek shelter in the home of an old friend of mine.
entries.translation: 立刻到中心岛与我会合！然后我们再讨论接下来的计划。我会在我一位老朋友的家中暂避。
entries.sampleRaw: Meet me in the Hub at once! We will then discuss our plans forward. I will seek shelter in the home of an old friend of mine.

entries.source: I've had a recent conversation with an old acquaintance of mine, the Wizard.
entries.translation: 我最近和我的一位老相识——巫师——谈过。
entries.sampleRaw: I've had a recent conversation with an old acquaintance of mine, the §dWizard§f.

entries.source: Apparently, there's a possibility of reconstructing the artifact we need by extracting the essence of certain weapons.
entries.translation: 显然，通过提取某些武器的精华，有可能重建我们所需的神器。
entries.sampleRaw: Apparently, there's a possibility of §ereconstructing §fthe §5artifact §fwe need by §6extracting §fthe essence of certain weapons.

entries.source: And here's the exciting part - if we go through with this plan, I'll be able to transfuse any ability of the weapons you extract onto another weapon.
entries.translation: 而激动人心的部分来了——如果我们实施这个计划，我就能将你提取的武器上的任何能力灌注到另一把武器上。
entries.sampleRaw: And here's the exciting part - if we go through with this plan, I'll be able to §dtransfuse §fany ability of the weapons you extract onto another weapon.

entries.source: This means you'll have a more versatile and adaptable build for your adventures.
entries.translation: 这意味着你的冒险配装将更加多样灵活。
entries.sampleRaw: This means you'll have a more versatile and adaptable build for your adventures.

entries.source: So, what do you say, adventurer?
entries.translation: 那么，你怎么说，冒险家？
entries.sampleRaw: So, what do you say, adventurer?

entries.source: Wonderful, let’s shall try to extract the ability of a fairly basic weapon at first so I can enhance my craft, perhaps a Rogue Sword could do.
entries.translation: 太好了，我们先试着提取一把相当基础的武器的能力，好让我提升我的手艺，也许一把游侠剑就行。
entries.sampleRaw: Wonderful, let’s shall try to extract the ability of a fairly basic weapon at first so I can enhance my craft, perhaps a Rogue Sword could do.

entries.source: Return to me at once when you acquire one, and be swift.
entries.translation: 拿到后立刻回来找我，动作要快。
entries.sampleRaw: Return to me at once when you acquire one, and be swift.

entries.source: I understand your concern.
entries.translation: 我理解你的顾虑。
entries.sampleRaw: I understand your concern.

entries.source: It's never easy to take on a risky endeavor, especially one with an uncertain outcome.
entries.translation: 承担有风险的事业从来都不容易，尤其是结果不确定的那种。
entries.sampleRaw: It's never easy to take on a risky endeavor, especially one with an uncertain outcome.

entries.source: However, I believe that the potential reward far outweighs the risk.
entries.translation: 不过，我相信潜在的回报远远超过风险。
entries.sampleRaw: However, I believe that the potential reward far outweighs the risk.

entries.source: And with your skills and my expertise, we stand a good chance of success.
entries.translation: 凭借你的技巧和我的专长，我们成功的机会很大。
entries.sampleRaw: And with your skills and my expertise, we stand a good chance of success.

entries.source: But I also respect your decision
entries.translation: 但我也尊重你的决定
entries.sampleRaw: But I also respect your decision

entries.source: If you ever change your mind, know that I'll be ready and willing to embark on this journey with you.
entries.translation: 如果你改变主意，要知道我随时准备并愿意与你一同踏上这段旅程。
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever change your mind, know that I'll be ready and willing to embark on this journey with you.

entries.source: Great! I see you brought me the basic weapon.
entries.translation: 太好了！我看你带来了那把基础武器。
entries.sampleRaw: Great! I see you brought me the basic weapon.

entries.source: Let me try to extract its essence.
entries.translation: 让我试着提取它的精华。
entries.sampleRaw: Let me try to extract its essence.

entries.source: Hand me the weapon.
entries.translation: 把武器交给我。
entries.sampleRaw: Hand me the weapon.

entries.source: Ah, welcome back, adventurer. I knew you'd see the wisdom in partnering up.
entries.translation: 啊，欢迎回来，冒险家。我就知道你会明白结伴同行的明智之处。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, welcome back, adventurer. I knew you'd see the wisdom in partnering up.

entries.source: Will you join me in my adventures?
entries.translation: 你愿意加入我的冒险吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Will you join me in my adventures?

entries.source: Shall we take this risk and attempt to extract the essence of these weapons?
entries.translation: 我们要不要冒这个险，尝试提取这些武器的精华？
entries.sampleRaw: Shall we take this risk and attempt to extract the essence of these weapons?

entries.source: The reward could be tremendous, and I'm confident that with your skills and my expertise, we'll make it happen.
entries.translation: 回报可能极其丰厚，而且我相信凭你的技巧和我的专业知识，我们一定能成功。
entries.sampleRaw: The reward could be tremendous, and I'm confident that with your skills and my expertise, we'll make it happen.

entries.source: Hello! ♪
entries.translation: 你好！♪
entries.sampleRaw: Hello! §d♪

entries.source: Yes, I'm fine, though my beloved Harp was broken to pieces by the storm.
entries.translation: 是的，我没事，只是我心爱的竖琴被暴风雨打成了碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: Yes, I'm fine, though my beloved §dHarp §fwas broken to pieces by the storm.

entries.source: If you would be so willing, could you bring me the materials so that I may make another?
entries.translation: 如果你愿意的话，能帮我带些材料来，好让我再做一把吗？
entries.sampleRaw: If you would be so willing, could you bring me the materials so that I may make another?

entries.source: My brother was on his way to help, but you got here first.
entries.translation: 我兄弟本来正在赶来帮忙，但你比他先到了。
entries.sampleRaw: My brother was on his way to help, but you got here first.

entries.source: If you'd be so kind as to bring me 512 Acacia Logs, I'll be able to do the rest.
entries.translation: 如果你能好心带给我 512 个金合欢原木,剩下的我就能搞定.
entries.sampleRaw: If you'd be so kind as to bring me §a512 Acacia Logs§f, I'll be able to do the rest.
entries.numericSource: If you'd be so kind as to bring me {{N0}} Acacia Logs, I'll be able to do the rest.
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你能好心带给我 {{N0}} 个金合欢原木,剩下的我就能搞定.

entries.source: If you could bring me 512 Acacia Logs, I could craft another Harp!
entries.translation: 如果你能带给我 512 个金合欢原木,我就能再做一把竖琴!
entries.sampleRaw: If you could bring me §a512 Acacia Logs§f, I could craft another §dHarp§f!
entries.numericSource: If you could bring me {{N0}} Acacia Logs, I could craft another Harp!
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你能带给我 {{N0}} 个金合欢原木,我就能再做一把竖琴!

entries.source: Thank you so much! ❤
entries.translation: 太感谢你了！❤
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you so much! §d❤

entries.source: I already have some string, so I can just use this wood to fashion the base of the harp.
entries.translation: 我已经有一些线了，所以我可以直接用这些木头来做竖琴的底座。
entries.sampleRaw: I already have some string, so I can just use this wood to fashion the base of the harp.

entries.source: Now, if I'm doing this right, this goes here, and...
entries.translation: 现在，如果我做得没错的话，这个放这里，然后……
entries.sampleRaw: Now, if I'm doing this right, this goes here, and...

entries.source: It worked! This harp looks and sounds even more beautiful than the last! ♪
entries.translation: 成功了！这把竖琴看起来和听起来都比上一把更美！♪
entries.sampleRaw: It worked! This harp looks and sounds even more beautiful than the last! §d♪

entries.source: Thank you for your help - please take this as a reward.
entries.translation: 谢谢你的帮助——请收下这个作为奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for your help - please take this as a reward.

entries.source: Talk to me again if you ever want to give my Harp a try!
entries.translation: 如果你以后想试试我的竖琴，再来找我吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me again if you ever want to give my §dHarp §fa try!

entries.source: Hello! ♫
entries.translation: 你好!♫
entries.sampleRaw: Hello! §d♫

entries.source: Want to learn the harp?
entries.translation: 想学竖琴吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Want to learn the harp?

entries.source: I'll teach you! ❤
entries.translation: 我来教你！❤
entries.sampleRaw: I'll teach you! §d❤

entries.source: Pick a song to get started!
entries.translation: 选一首歌开始吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Pick a song to get started!

entries.source: Wow! ❤
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! §d❤

entries.source: You perfected every Song!
entries.translation: 你把每一首歌都完美演奏了！
entries.sampleRaw: You perfected every Song!

entries.source: Maybe you should teach me now!
entries.translation: 也许现在该你来教我了！
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe you should teach me now!

entries.source: Here's a gift so you always remember me! ♪
entries.translation: 这是一份礼物，让你永远记得我！♪
entries.sampleRaw: Here's a gift so you always remember me! §d♪

entries.source: You mastered every song with over 90%!
entries.translation: 你以超过 90% 的成绩精通了每一首歌!
entries.sampleRaw: §rYou mastered every song with over §d90%§f!
entries.numericSource: You mastered every song with over {{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 你以超过 {{N0}} 的成绩精通了每一首歌!

entries.source: Welcome! Feel free to browse my fishing wares!
entries.translation: 欢迎！随便看看我的钓鱼商品吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome! Feel free to browse my fishing wares!

entries.source: Good choice! You can equip that beauty by right-clicking it while it's in your hand.
entries.translation: 好眼光！你可以手持它并右键点击来装备这件好东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Good choice! You can equip that beauty by right-clicking it while it's in your hand.

entries.source: Or, you can type \/equipment to access your equipment menu.
entries.translation: 或者，你可以输入 /equipment 来打开你的装备菜单。
entries.sampleRaw: Or, you can type \/equipment §fto access your equipment menu.

entries.source: Sometimes, Dark Candy is not enough to satiate a gnawing hunger. Something...more, is needed.
entries.translation: 有时候，暗黑糖果不足以填饱那啃噬般的饥饿。还需要……更多的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes, §9Dark Candy §fis not enough to satiate a gnawing hunger. Something...more, is needed.

entries.source: Your offering is appreciated.
entries.translation: 感谢你的供奉。
entries.sampleRaw: Your offering is appreciated.

entries.source: Howdy, Player!
entries.translation: 你好啊，Player！
entries.sampleRaw: Howdy, Player!

entries.source: Sorry for the intrusion, but I got a report of a Pest outbreak around here?
entries.translation: 抱歉打扰了，不过我接到报告说这附近有害虫爆发？
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry for the intrusion, but I got a report of a §6Pest §foutbreak around here?

entries.source: Err...vermin? Swine? Buggers? Y'know...Pests!
entries.translation: 呃……害人虫？猪猡？小虫子？你懂的……害虫！
entries.sampleRaw: Err...vermin? Swine? Buggers? Y'know...§6Pests§f!

entries.source: They seem to pop up when you're breaking crops on your Garden!
entries.translation: 它们似乎会在你在花园里破坏作物时冒出来！
entries.sampleRaw: They seem to pop up when you're §ebreaking crops §fon your §bGarden§f!

entries.source: Okay, feller. Take this SkyMart Vacuum!
entries.translation: 好了，伙计。拿着这个天空商城吸尘器！
entries.sampleRaw: Okay, feller. Take this SkyMart Vacuum§f!

entries.source: There's a Pest out there somewhere, I'm certain of it.
entries.translation: 外面某处有只害虫，我敢肯定。
entries.sampleRaw: There's a §6Pest §fout there somewhere, I'm certain of it.

entries.source: When you find one, simply aim the vacuum, hold down the button, and you can suck them buggers up real quick!
entries.translation: 找到一只后，只要把吸尘器对准它，按住按钮，就能很快把这些小虫子吸进去！
entries.sampleRaw: When you find one, simply aim the §avacuum§f, hold down the button, and you can suck them buggers up real quick!

entries.source: When you've done that, come back and tell me all about how much fun you had!
entries.translation: 做完之后，回来告诉我你玩得有多开心！
entries.sampleRaw: When you've done that, come back and tell me all about how much fun you had!

entries.source: Go out there and vacuum a Pest!
entries.translation: 去外面吸一只害虫吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Go out there and §avacuum §fa Pest!

entries.source: It's not hard. Just aim, hold down the button, and don't stop until the bug's been squashed!
entries.translation: 这不难。只要瞄准、按住按钮，别停手，直到那只虫子被吸住为止！
entries.sampleRaw: It's not hard. Just aim, hold down the button, and don't stop until the bug's been squashed!

entries.source: Wow! Look at that ugly thing. Bet you had a blast trying to wrangle it into your vacuum!
entries.translation: 哇！看看那丑东西。我打赌你把它弄进吸尘器时肯定玩得很开心！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! Look at that ugly thing. Bet you had a blast trying to wrangle it into your vacuum!

entries.source: To each their own. I'm fascinated by these little fellers!
entries.translation: 人各有好。我对这些小东西可是着迷得很！
entries.sampleRaw: To each their own. I'm fascinated by these little fellers!

entries.source: Bring some back for me to, uh...study...and I'll reward you with ☘ Farming Fortune for your troubles!
entries.translation: 带一些回来给我,呃……研究……作为回报,我会奖励你 ☘ 点耕种幸运!
entries.sampleRaw: Bring some back for me to, uh...study...and I'll reward you with §6☘ Farming Fortune for your troubles!

entries.source: Thanks for the Pest, Player!
entries.translation: 谢谢你带来的害虫，Player！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for the §6Pest§f, Player!

entries.source: In exchange for # Pest, I've given you +#☘ Farming Fortune for 30m!
entries.translation: 作为 # 只害虫的交换，我给了你 +#☘ 点耕种幸运，持续 30m！
entries.sampleRaw: In exchange for §6# Pest§f, I've given you §6+#☘ Farming Fortune §ffor §a30m§f!
entries.numericSource: In exchange for # Pest, I've given you +#☘ Farming Fortune for {{N0}}m!
entries.numericTranslation: 作为 # 只害虫的交换，我给了你 +#☘ 点耕种幸运，持续 {{N0}}m！

entries.source: Vacuum more Pests and exchange them with me to gain even more ☘ Farming Fortune!
entries.translation: 多吸一些害虫来和我交换，就能获得更多 ☘ 点耕种幸运！
entries.sampleRaw: Vacuum more Pests and exchange them with me to gain even more §6☘ Farming Fortune§f!

entries.source: ✆ Howdy, Player!
entries.translation: ✆ 你好啊，Player！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHowdy, Player!

entries.source: ✆ Yer know, standing 'ere all day with nothing to do gets pretty borin' at times.
entries.translation: ✆ 你知道的，整天站在这儿无所事事，有时候还挺无聊的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYer know, standing 'ere all day with nothing to do gets pretty borin' at times.

entries.source: ✆ If you want my contact, how about you bring me somethin' to keep me occupied, eh?
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你想要我的联系方式，不如带点东西来让我打发时间，怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you want my contact, how about you bring me somethin' to keep me occupied, eh?

entries.source: ✆ A Squeaky Toy would do the trick.
entries.translation: ✆ 一个吱吱玩具就能搞定。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fA §9Squeaky Toy §fwould do the trick.

entries.source: ✆ You hearin' me? Bring me one of those and you can have my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 听见了吗？给我带一个来，我的联系方式就归你了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou hearin' me? Bring me one of those and you can have my contact.

entries.source: ✆ What's all this about, eh?
entries.translation: ✆ 这到底是怎么回事，嗯？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWhat's all this about, eh?

entries.source: ✆ Quit yer playin' and bring me a Squeaky Toy or you ain't getting my contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 别耍花样了，给我带个吱吱玩具来，不然你休想拿到我的联系方式！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fQuit yer playin' and bring me a §9Squeaky Toy §for you ain't getting my contact!

entries.source: ✆ You can sometimes find 'em after vacuuming up a Field Mouse. You can only catch those rare little guys in Pest Traps.
entries.translation: ✆ 你有时能在吸起一只田鼠后找到它们。你只能在害虫陷阱里抓到这些稀有的小家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou can sometimes find 'em after vacuuming up a §5Field Mouse§f. You can only catch those rare little guys in §9Pest Traps§f.

entries.source: ✆ I heard somebody 'round here sells them. Oh - it's me!
entries.translation: ✆ 我听说这附近有人卖它们。哦——就是我！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI heard somebody 'round here sells them. Oh - it's me!

entries.source: ✆ Cheers mate, that works!
entries.translation: ✆ 谢了伙计，这就行了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCheers mate, that works!

entries.source: ✆ To be honest with ya, though, I have no use for this toy.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过说实话，这玩具对我来说没什么用。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fTo be honest with ya, though, I have no use for this toy.

entries.source: ✆ I just ask for it because it gets people buying a bunch of Pest Traps from me in order to go about getting it.
entries.translation: ✆ 我之所以要它，只是因为这能让人为了拿到它而从我这儿买一堆害虫陷阱。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI just ask for it because it gets people buying a bunch of §9Pest Traps §ffrom me in order to go about getting it.

entries.source: ✆ Waddya call that, a pyramid scheme? Ponzi scheme? I don't know... I just call it bein' me.
entries.translation: ✆ 你管那叫什么，金字塔骗局？庞氏骗局？我不知道……我就管它叫做我自己。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWaddya call that, a pyramid scheme? Ponzi scheme? I don't know... I just call it bein' me.

entries.source: ✆ Anyways, here's that contact you was after.
entries.translation: ✆ 总之，这就是你之前要的那个联系人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAnyways, here's that contact you was after.

entries.source: ✆ See ya around, my partner in pesthuntin'!
entries.translation: ✆ 回头见，我的灭虫搭档！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSee ya around, my partner in pesthuntin'!

entries.source: ✆ Don't tell my wife I said that.
entries.translation: ✆ 别告诉我老婆我说过这话。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDon't tell my wife I said that.

entries.source: Howdy! I'm looking to hunt some Mosquitoes and Earthworms today, I could use some bait for my Sprayonator.
entries.translation: 你好啊！我今天想猎些蚊子和蚯蚓，我的喷雾器正缺些诱饵。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHowdy! I'm looking to hunt some §2Mosquitoes §fand §2Earthworms §ftoday, I could use some bait for my §aSprayonator§f.

entries.source: Thanks for the help! I'm gonna go catch one of those little fellers now!
entries.translation: 谢谢帮忙！我现在要去抓一只那种小家伙了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThanks for the help! I'm gonna go catch one of those little fellers now!

entries.source: Unfortunate. The  Pests aren't gonna hunt themselves!
entries.translation: 真不幸。 害虫可不会自己猎自己！
entries.sampleRaw: §fUnfortunate. The §2 Pests §faren't gonna hunt themselves!

entries.source: Ah, so the Garden isn't just full of weeds, huh?
entries.translation: 啊，看来花园里不只有杂草，是吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, so the Garden isn't just full of weeds, huh?

entries.source: Finally, someone worth talking to. You look like you know the difference between a Cropie and a lump of dirt.
entries.translation: 终于有个值得说话的人了。你看起来分得清作物和一块泥土的区别。
entries.sampleRaw: Finally, someone worth talking to. You look like you know the difference between a §9Cropie§f and a lump of dirt.

entries.source: I'm in the market for some rare materials. Maybe you're familiar?
entries.translation: 我正在找一些稀有材料。也许你熟悉？
entries.sampleRaw: I'm in the market for some rare materials. Maybe you're familiar?

entries.source: In exchange, I might have something 'special' for you.
entries.translation: 作为交换，我可能有些“特别”的东西给你。
entries.sampleRaw: In exchange, I might have something 'special' for you.

entries.source: I must say, this Garden is starting to grow on me. Figuratively, of course.
entries.translation: 我得说，这座花园开始让我喜欢上了。当然是比喻意义上的。
entries.sampleRaw: I must say, this §aGarden §fis starting to grow on me. Figuratively, of course.

entries.source: Miss me? Don't answer that, I know you did.
entries.translation: 想我了吗？别回答，我知道你想了。
entries.sampleRaw: Miss me? Don't answer that, I know you did.

entries.source: Ah, The Garden. Where dreams wither and weeds thrive. What do you have for me today?
entries.translation: 啊，花园。梦想枯萎、杂草丛生的地方。你今天给我带了什么？
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, §aThe Garden§f. Where dreams wither and weeds thrive. What do you have for me today?

entries.source: Ah, Cropie! Nature's little mystery. Got any?
entries.translation: 啊，作物！大自然的小谜团。你有吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, §9Cropie§f! Nature's little mystery. Got any?

entries.source: Squash? Not the sport, darling. The vegetable. I'll make it worth your while.
entries.translation: 西葫芦？不是那种运动，亲爱的。是蔬菜。我会让你觉得值得的。
entries.sampleRaw: §5Squash§f? Not the sport, darling. The vegetable. I'll make it worth your while.

entries.source: Got any Fermento? Trust me, it's not for a fruit salad.
entries.translation: 有酵母菌吗？相信我，不是用来做水果沙拉的。
entries.sampleRaw: Got any §6Fermento§f? Trust me, it's not for a fruit salad.

entries.source: Ah, a trade well made. A potion for you, brewed by yours truly.
entries.translation: 啊，一笔好交易。给你的药水，由我亲手酿造。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, a trade well made. A potion for you, brewed by yours truly.

entries.source: Good deal. Here, this potion isn't found on any old store shelf. Don't waste it.
entries.translation: 成交。给，这药水可不是随便哪家商店货架上都能找到的。别浪费了。
entries.sampleRaw: Good deal. Here, this potion isn't found on any old store shelf. Don't waste it.

entries.source: You're not here on Seth's behalf, are you? I mean, he's cute but he could never afford me.
entries.translation: 你不是替 Seth 来的吧？我是说，他挺可爱，但他可付不起我的价。
entries.sampleRaw: You're not here on Seth's behalf, are you? I mean, he's cute but he could never afford me.

entries.source: Ah, you think this potion is strong? You have no idea what power really tastes like.
entries.translation: 啊，你觉得这药水很强？你根本不知道真正的力量尝起来是什么滋味。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, you think this potion is strong? You have no idea what power really tastes like.

entries.source: Rare materials are just the tip of the iceberg. But then, you're not ready for what's beneath.
entries.translation: 稀有材料只是冰山一角。不过，你还没准备好面对下面的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Rare materials are just the tip of the iceberg. But then, you're not ready for what's beneath.

entries.source: I've seen things that would make your health bar drop to zero. But don't worry, your little Cropies are safe with me.
entries.translation: 我见过能让你的生命条直接归零的东西。但别担心，你的那些小作物在我这儿很安全。
entries.sampleRaw: I've seen things that would make your health bar drop to zero. But don't worry, your little Cropies are safe with me.

entries.source: Who needs friends when you have powerful enemies? Oh wait, I have both!
entries.translation: 有了强大的敌人，谁还需要朋友？哦等等，我两样都有！
entries.sampleRaw: Who needs friends when you have powerful enemies? Oh wait, I have both!

entries.source: What's my secret to eternal youth? That's for me to know and for you to find out...maybe.
entries.translation: 我永葆青春的秘密是什么？那是我知道、而你要去发现的……也许吧。
entries.sampleRaw: What's my secret to eternal youth? That's for me to know and for you to find out...maybe.

entries.source: These potions are child's play. The real stuff? Well, that's not on the menu for rookies.
entries.translation: 这些药水只是小儿科。真正的好东西？嗯，那可不是给新手准备的。
entries.sampleRaw: These potions are child's play. The real stuff? Well, that's not on the menu for rookies.

entries.source: Ah, you want to know my secrets? Even if I told you, you wouldn't believe me.
entries.translation: 啊，你想知道我的秘密？就算我告诉你，你也不会信的。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, you want to know my secrets? Even if I told you, you wouldn't believe me.

entries.source: Don't bother asking why I need these materials. Let's just say it's...above your clearance level.
entries.translation: 别费心问我为什么需要这些材料。这么说吧，这……超出了你的权限级别。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't bother asking why I need these materials. Let's just say it's...above your clearance level.

entries.source: Seth understands the value of my potions. Do you?
entries.translation: Seth 懂得我药水的价值。你懂吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Seth understands the value of my potions. Do you?

entries.source: Let's just say these materials aren't the only rare commodities I'm interested in.
entries.translation: 这么说吧，这些材料并不是我唯一感兴趣的稀有商品。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's just say these materials aren't the only rare commodities I'm interested in.

entries.source: No materials? Huh, I guess your adventures are as empty as your inventory.
entries.translation: 没有材料？呵，我猜你的冒险和你的背包一样空空如也。
entries.sampleRaw: No materials? Huh, I guess your adventures are as empty as your inventory.

entries.source: You know, having dealt with Pests for so long, I'm starting to find them kinda cute!
entries.translation: 你知道吗，和害虫打了这么久交道，我开始觉得它们有点可爱了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou know, having dealt with §6Pests §ffor so long, I'm starting to find them kinda §dcute§f!

entries.source: I've even developed a way to attract certain Pests to my plots.
entries.translation: 我甚至研究出了一种方法，能把某些害虫吸引到我的地块上。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've even developed a way to attract certain Pests to my plots.

entries.source: BEHOLD! The Sprayonator!
entries.translation: 看好了！这就是喷雾器！
entries.sampleRaw: §fBEHOLD! The §aSprayonator§f!

entries.source: Its patented technology transforms organic matter into aromas that only Pests can smell.
entries.translation: 它那项专利技术能把有机物转化成只有害虫才闻得到的香气。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIts patented technology transforms §aorganic matter §finto aromas that only Pests can smell.

entries.source: Go see for yourself. Take this Tasty Cheese and use the Sprayonator to spray a plot.
entries.translation: 自己去看看吧。拿着这块美味奶酪，用喷雾器喷一块地块。
entries.sampleRaw: §fGo see for yourself. Take this §aTasty Cheese §fand use the §aSprayonator §fto spray a plot.

entries.source: Then use your vacuum to catch a Rat Pest in that plot!
entries.translation: 然后用你的吸尘器在那块地块上抓一只老鼠害虫！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen use your vacuum to catch a §6Rat Pest §fin that plot!

entries.source: Take the Sprayonator and get to spraying!
entries.translation: 拿上喷雾器，开始喷吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Take the §aSprayonator§f and get to spraying!

entries.source: Hi! I want to reforge my SkyMart Hyper Vacuum to Beady. Would you happen to have a Beady Eyes?
entries.translation: 嗨!我想把我的天空商城超级吸尘器洗练成珠眼.你身上正好有珠眼吗?
entries.sampleRaw: §fHi! I want to reforge my §9SkyMart Hyper Vacuum §fto §9Beady§f. Would you happen to have a §9Beady Eyes§f?

entries.source: Hi! I want to reforge my Peony Necklace to Rooted. Would you happen to have a Burrowing Spores?
