entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know, §cBat the Fish§f only swims at night?

entries.source: ✆ Alright, you've earned it.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，这是你应得的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAlright, you've earned it.

entries.source: ✆ I'll add you to my Abiphone contacts!
entries.translation: ✆ 我会把你加入我的 Abiphone 联系人！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'll add you to my Abiphone contacts!

entries.source: ✆ Hey [player]!
entries.translation: ✆ 嘿,[player]!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHey §b[player]§f!

entries.source: ✆ [#[Slot Number]] [Training Type] [Pet] has concluded and is now [Lvl #]
entries.translation: ✆ [#[Slot Number]] [Training Type] [Pet] 已完成训练,现在为 [Lvl #]

styleMappings.[Training Type] [Pet] has concluded and: [Training Type] [Pet] 已完成训练,现在为

entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §e[#[Slot Number]] §f[Training Type] [Pet] has concluded and is now §7[Lvl #]

entries.source: This pet I'm looking after is super hungry! You got anything?
entries.translation: 我照看的这只宠物超级饿！你有什么吃的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: This pet I'm looking after is super hungry! You got anything?

entries.source: That should work! Hopefully they'll be all tired from eating and finally have a nap.
entries.translation: 这应该管用！希望它们吃饱后会累得终于睡上一觉。
entries.sampleRaw: That should work! Hopefully they'll be all tired from eating and finally have a nap.

entries.source: Oh my feathers, these little ones are not going to be happy!
entries.translation: 我的羽毛啊，这些小家伙可不会高兴！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh my feathers, these little ones are not going to be happy!

entries.source: ✆ Ready for a fun fact? Owls have asymmetrical ears, helping them pinpoint sounds from different directions. Talk about surround sound!
entries.translation: ✆ 想听个趣闻吗？猫头鹰的耳朵不对称，这有助于它们精确定位来自不同方向的声音。真是环绕立体声！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fReady for a fun fact? Owls have asymmetrical ears, helping them pinpoint sounds from different directions. Talk about surround sound!

entries.source: ✆ Hoo's ready for some owl wisdom? Owls have been symbols of wisdom in various cultures. Makes me wonder what Hootie's pondering!
entries.translation: ✆ 谁准备好听点猫头鹰智慧了？猫头鹰在许多文化中都是智慧的象征。真想知道 Hootie 在琢磨什么！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHoo's ready for some owl wisdom? Owls have been symbols of wisdom in various cultures. Makes me wonder what Hootie's pondering!

entries.source: ✆ Whoo's up for some owl trivia? Did you know owls don't have teeth? They swallow their prey whole. A bit gruesome, but efficient!
entries.translation: ✆ 谁想来点猫头鹰冷知识？你知道吗，猫头鹰没有牙齿？它们会把猎物整个吞下。有点恶心，但很高效！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWhoo's up for some owl trivia? Did you know owls don't have teeth? They swallow their prey whole. A bit gruesome, but efficient!

entries.source: ✆ Did you know some owls like to take baths? Hootie here loves a good splash now and then!
entries.translation: ✆ 你知道吗，有些猫头鹰喜欢洗澡？这里的 Hootie 就喜欢时不时痛快地扑腾一下！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know some owls like to take baths? Hootie here loves a good splash now and then!

entries.source: ✆ Listen to this: The Eurasian Eagle-Owl can live up to 60 years in captivity. Imagine all the wisdom they gather!
entries.translation: ✆ 听听这个：雕鸮在圈养环境下能活到 60 岁。想象一下它们积累了多少智慧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fListen to this: The Eurasian Eagle-Owl can live up to 60 years in captivity. Imagine all the wisdom they gather!
entries.numericSource: ✆ Listen to this: The Eurasian Eagle-Owl can live up to {{N0}} years in captivity. Imagine all the wisdom they gather!
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 听听这个：雕鸮在圈养环境下能活到 {{N0}} 岁。想象一下它们积累了多少智慧！

entries.source: ✆ Listen to this: Some owls have special feathers for silent flight. Perfect for sneaking up on snacks, or in Hootie's case, a cheeky cuddle!
entries.translation: ✆ 听听这个：有些猫头鹰拥有特殊的羽毛，可以无声飞行。非常适合悄悄接近零食，或者对 Hootie 来说，来个调皮的拥抱！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fListen to this: Some owls have special feathers for silent flight. Perfect for sneaking up on snacks, or in Hootie's case, a cheeky cuddle!

entries.source: ✆ Did you know that owls can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees? Hootie's quite the head-turner!
entries.translation: ✆ 你知道吗，猫头鹰的头部可以旋转多达 270 度？Hootie 可真会转头！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know that owls can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees? Hootie's quite the head-turner!
entries.numericSource: ✆ Did you know that owls can rotate their heads up to {{N0}} degrees? Hootie's quite the head-turner!
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 你知道吗，猫头鹰的头部可以旋转多达 {{N0}} 度？Hootie 可真会转头！

entries.source: ✆ Owls have a third eyelid! It's transparent and helps protect their eyes while they hunt.
entries.translation: ✆ 猫头鹰有第三眼睑！它是透明的，能在它们捕猎时保护眼睛。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOwls have a third eyelid! It's transparent and helps protect their eyes while they hunt.

entries.source: ✆ Hoo's up for a flight lesson? Unlike most birds, owls make nearly silent flight possible by the structure of their wing feathers!
entries.translation: ✆ 谁想来上一堂飞行课？与大多数鸟类不同，猫头鹰凭借其翅膀羽毛的结构，几乎能实现无声飞行！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHoo's up for a flight lesson? Unlike most birds, owls make nearly silent flight possible by the structure of their wing feathers!

entries.source: ✆ Fancy some trivia? The Barn Owl has the most extensive range of any owl species. They're world travelers, just like you!
entries.translation: ✆ 想来点冷知识吗？仓鸮的分布范围是所有猫头鹰物种中最广的。它们是环游世界的旅行家，就像你一样！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fFancy some trivia? The Barn Owl has the most extensive range of any owl species. They're world travelers, just like you!

entries.source: ✆ Fancy this: The smallest owl in the world is the Elf Owl, about the size of a sparrow. Hootie here thinks they're adorable!
entries.translation: ✆ 想想这个：世界上最小的猫头鹰是精灵鸮，大约只有麻雀那么大。这里的胡蒂觉得它们可爱极了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fFancy this: The smallest owl in the world is the Elf Owl, about the size of a sparrow. Hootie here thinks they're adorable!

entries.source: ✆ Did you know that owls can't chew? That's why they regurgitate pellets with the parts they can't digest!
entries.translation: ✆ 你知道猫头鹰不会咀嚼吗？所以它们会把无法消化的部分以食团的形式吐出来！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know that owls can't chew? That's why they regurgitate pellets with the parts they can't digest!

entries.source: ✆ Hoo knew? Owls can actually swim! Though Hootie prefers to keep his feathers dry, thank you very much!
entries.translation: ✆ 谁知道呢？猫头鹰其实会游泳！不过胡蒂更喜欢让羽毛保持干燥，非常感谢！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHoo knew? Owls can actually swim! Though Hootie prefers to keep his feathers dry, thank you very much!

entries.source: ✆ Brace yourself: Some owls have what's called a ‘facial disc,' a feather arrangement that helps funnel sound to their ears. It's like their own personal satellite dish!
entries.translation: ✆ 做好准备：有些猫头鹰拥有所谓的“面盘”，这是一种羽毛排列结构，有助于将声音汇聚到它们的耳朵里。就像它们自带的卫星天线！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBrace yourself: Some owls have what's called a ‘facial disc,' a feather arrangement that helps funnel sound to their ears. It's like their own personal satellite dish!

entries.source: ✆ You'll love this: Owls have zygodactyl feet, meaning two toes face forward and two face backward. Perfect for gripping prey!
entries.translation: ✆ 你会喜欢这个的：猫头鹰拥有对趾型足，也就是两趾朝前、两趾朝后。非常适合抓握猎物！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou'll love this: Owls have zygodactyl feet, meaning two toes face forward and two face backward. Perfect for gripping prey!

entries.source: ✆ Here's a tidbit: Owls have hollow bones, which helps them stay lightweight for flying. It's like nature's own aviation engineering!
entries.translation: ✆ 告诉你个小知识：猫头鹰的骨骼是中空的，这有助于它们保持轻盈以便飞行。这就像大自然自己的航空工程！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere's a tidbit: Owls have hollow bones, which helps them stay lightweight for flying. It's like nature's own aviation engineering!

entries.source: ✆ Hold onto your feathers! Some owls have a wingspan that's nearly twice their body length. Talk about aerodynamics!
entries.translation: ✆ 抓紧你的羽毛！有些猫头鹰的翼展几乎达到体长的两倍。这才叫空气动力学！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHold onto your feathers! Some owls have a wingspan that's nearly twice their body length. Talk about aerodynamics!

entries.source: ✆ Here's a beak-blowing stat: The Great Gray Owl can locate prey under two feet of snow and snatch it up without a sound!
entries.translation: ✆ 来个令人咋舌的数据：乌林鸮能定位两英尺厚积雪下的猎物，并悄无声息地将其抓走！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere's a beak-blowing stat: The Great Gray Owl can locate prey under two feet of snow and snatch it up without a sound!

entries.source: ✆ Have you heard? The Northern Hawk Owl can spot prey from up to half a mile away! That's some keen eyesight!
entries.translation: ✆ 你听说了吗？猛鸮能在半英里外发现猎物！这视力可真敏锐！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHave you heard? The Northern Hawk Owl can spot prey from up to half a mile away! That's some keen eyesight!

entries.source: ✆ Here's something: Owls don't have crops, those pouches some birds have for storing food. They're all about that direct-to-stomach service!
entries.translation: ✆ 还有这个：猫头鹰没有嗉囊，也就是某些鸟类用来储存食物的囊袋。它们讲究的是直达胃部服务！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere's something: Owls don't have crops, those pouches some birds have for storing food. They're all about that direct-to-stomach service!

entries.source: ✆ Did you know the largest owl is the Blakiston's Fish Owl? Its wingspan can reach up to 6.6 feet! Hootie's a bit envious.
entries.translation: ✆ 你知道最大的猫头鹰是毛腿渔鸮吗？它的翼展可达 6.6 英尺！胡蒂有点羡慕。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know the largest owl is the Blakiston's Fish Owl? Its wingspan can reach up to 6.6 feet! Hootie's a bit envious.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Did you know the largest owl is the Blakiston's Fish Owl? Its wingspan can reach up to {{N0}} feet! Hootie's a bit envious.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 你知道最大的猫头鹰是毛腿渔鸮吗？它的翼展可达 {{N0}} 英尺！胡蒂有点羡慕。

entries.source: See that giant cliff with the giant crystal?
entries.translation: 看到那座有着巨大水晶的巨大悬崖了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: See that giant cliff with the §dgiant crystal§f?

entries.source: At night, my friends host a secret meeting in a nearby secret cave.
entries.translation: 到了晚上，我的朋友们会在附近一个秘密洞穴里举行秘密会议。
entries.sampleRaw: §bAt night§f, my friends host a §5secret meeting§f in a nearby §5secret cave§f.

entries.source: Drop by some time, out secret club is open!
entries.translation: 有空来坐坐，我们的秘密俱乐部随时开放！
entries.sampleRaw: Drop by some time, out §5secret club§f is open!

entries.source: If my friends approve of you, they'll give you a special item.
entries.translation: 如果我的朋友们认可你，他们会给你一件特殊物品。
entries.sampleRaw: If my friends approve of you, they'll give you a special item.

entries.source: Come back to me then and show it to me!
entries.translation: 到时候回来找我，把它给我看看！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back to me then and show it to me!

entries.source: Hurrah! A fellow member of the Cult of the Fallen Star!
entries.translation: 万岁！陨星教团的同袍！
entries.sampleRaw: Hurrah! A fellow member of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f!

entries.source: Hey, I've crafted new tech to let us locate Fallen Stars easily.
entries.translation: 嘿，我造出了新装置，能让我们轻松定位陨星。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, I've crafted new tech to let us locate §5Fallen Stars§f easily.

entries.source: Check it out!
entries.translation: 来看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Check it out!

entries.source: With the Fallen Star Lozenge, you can find Fallen Stars much easier!
entries.translation: 有了陨星含片，你就能更轻松地找到陨星了！
entries.sampleRaw: With the §5Fallen Star Lozenge§f, you can find §5Fallen Stars§f much easier!

entries.source: Now go find some stars, but don't forget about the next meeting of the Cult!
entries.translation: 现在去找些星星吧，但别忘了教团的下一次聚会！
entries.sampleRaw: Now go find some stars, but don't forget about the next meeting of the §5Cult§f!

entries.source: I expect to see you there!
entries.translation: 我期待在那里见到你！
entries.sampleRaw: I expect to see you there!

entries.source: Do not think I am sleeping, thief.
entries.translation: 别以为我在睡觉，小偷。
entries.sampleRaw: Do not think I am sleeping, thief.

entries.source: Those eggs are mine, but I would be willing to sell them against pure gold and gemstones.
entries.translation: 那些蛋是我的，但我愿意用纯金和宝石来换。
entries.sampleRaw: Those eggs are mine, but I would be willing to sell them against pure gold and gemstones.

entries.source: But are you rich enough?
entries.translation: 但你够富有吗？
entries.sampleRaw: But are you rich enough?

entries.source: This is all that remains...
entries.translation: 这就是仅存的一切了……
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis is all that remains...

entries.source: Hello, {player}. Thank you for coming.
entries.translation: 你好，{player}。感谢你前来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHello, §6{player}§f. Thank you for coming.

entries.source: I have heard of your triumphs in the Crystal Hollows, and thought we should meet.
entries.translation: 我听闻你在水晶洞窟的壮举，觉得我们应该见一面。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI have heard of your triumphs in the §5Crystal Hollows§f, and thought we should meet.

entries.source: I am Dulin, descendant of Divan and rightful King of the Dwarven Mines. Those imbeciles in the palace took up their positions in my absence.
entries.translation: 我是Dulin,迪万的后裔,矮人矿坑的合法国王.宫里那些蠢货趁我不在时窃据了他们的位置.
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am §6Dulin§f, descendant of Divan and rightful §6King of the Dwarven Mines§f. Those imbeciles in the palace took up their positions in my absence.

entries.source: I am preparing an expedition into the area beyond the Great Ice Wall, and need some adventurers to scout out the area for me.
entries.translation: 我正在筹备一支前往巨冰之墙以外区域的远征队，需要一些冒险者替我侦察那片区域。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am preparing an expedition into the area beyond the §bGreat Ice Wall§f, and need some adventurers to scout out the area for me.

entries.source: If I could sneak you in, would you be willing to help?
entries.translation: 如果我能把你偷偷带进去，你愿意帮忙吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf I could §7sneak §fyou in, would you be willing to help?

entries.source: Thank you. My people will remember your name for eons.
entries.translation: 谢谢你。我的人民会铭记你的名字千万年。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThank you. My people will remember your name for eons.

entries.source: I am glad that I have your trust, but I will need you to prove yourself before entering the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.translation: 我很高兴能得到你的信任，但在进入冰川矿道之前，我需要你证明自己。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am glad that I have your trust, but I will need you to prove yourself before entering the §bGlacite Tunnels§f.

entries.source: The Ticket Master will only let you in if you have a Secret Railroad Pass to show him.
entries.translation: 只有当你持有秘密铁路通行证并出示给他时，Ticket Master才会放你进去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §aTicket Master §fwill only let you in if you have a §c§cSecret Railroad Pass §fto show him.

entries.source: You can put one together in the Dwarven Forge, if you can get the right materials.
entries.translation: 如果你能弄到合适的材料，就可以在矮人锻造台把它组装出来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can put one together in the §6Dwarven Forge§f, if you can get the right materials.

entries.source: Very well. But you and I, our fates are entwined. You'll come back, and I'll welcome you with open arms when you do.
entries.translation: 好吧。但你和我，我们的命运交织在一起。你会回来的，等你回来时我会张开双臂欢迎你。
entries.sampleRaw: Very well. But you and I, our fates are entwined. You'll come back, and I'll welcome you with open arms when you do.

entries.source: A Secret Railroad Pass! Very well.
entries.translation: 一张秘密铁路通行证！很好。
entries.sampleRaw: §fA §cSecret Railroad Pass§f! Very well.

entries.source: Go show that to the Ticket Master, and he'll let you travel to the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.translation: 去把它拿给Ticket Master看,他就会让你前往冰川矿道.
entries.sampleRaw: §fGo show that to the Ticket Master, and he'll let you travel to the §bGlacite Tunnels.

entries.source: I'll see you down there!
entries.translation: 我们下面见！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'll see you down there!

entries.source: Nice to see you here, {player}.
entries.translation: 很高兴在这里见到你，{player}。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNice to see you here, §6{player}§f.

entries.source: Feel free to go on ahead, but don't stray too far into the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.translation: 尽管往前走吧，但别在冰川矿道里走得太远。
entries.sampleRaw: §fFeel free to go on ahead, but don't stray too far into the §bGlacite Tunnels§f.

entries.source: From what I've heard, they go very deep down. The legends speak of some dwarves finding Mineshafts when mining!
entries.translation: 据我所知，它们向下延伸得非常深。传说有些矮人在挖矿时发现了矿井！
entries.sampleRaw: §fFrom what I've heard, they go very deep down. The legends speak of some dwarves finding §bMineshafts §fwhen mining!

entries.source: Anyways, if you need me I'll be here, waiting for my Expedition Team to arrive.
entries.translation: 总之，如果你需要我，我会在这里等着我的远征队到来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnyways, if you need me I'll be here, waiting for my §6Expedition Team §fto arrive.

entries.source: They should be here within 3-5 business days, then we can set out!
entries.translation: 他们应该会在3-5个工作日内到达,然后我们就可以出发了!
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey should be here within §d3-5 business days§f, then we can set out!
entries.numericSource: They should be here within {{N0}}-{{N1}} business days, then we can set out!
entries.numericTranslation: 他们应该会在{{N0}}-{{N1}}个工作日内到达,然后我们就可以出发了!

entries.source: Hey {player}! Have you found time to explore the Glacite Tunnels yet?
entries.translation: 嘿,{player}!你找到时间去探索冰川矿道了吗?
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey §6{player}§f! Have you found time to explore the §bGlacite Tunnels yet?

entries.source: The team should arrive shortly! They should be here within 3-5 business days, then we can set out!
entries.translation: 队伍应该很快就到!他们应该会在3-5个工作日内到达,然后我们就可以出发了!
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe team should arrive shortly! They should be here within §d3-5 business days§f, then we can set out!
entries.numericSource: The team should arrive shortly! They should be here within {{N0}}-{{N1}} business days, then we can set out!
entries.numericTranslation: 队伍应该很快就到!他们应该会在{{N0}}-{{N1}}个工作日内到达,然后我们就可以出发了!

entries.source: I suppose this is your very own kingdom in a sense, [player]? Splendid.
entries.translation: 我想从某种意义上说,这就是你自己的王国吧,[player]?太棒了.
entries.sampleRaw: I suppose this is your very own kingdom in a sense, §7[player]§f? Splendid.

entries.source: Potatoes are a dwarf's favorite food. They are like us in many ways, springing to life from the soil under even the harshest conditions.
entries.translation: 马铃薯是矮人最爱的食物。它们在很多方面都像我们，即使在最严酷的环境下也能从土壤中焕发生机。
entries.sampleRaw: Potatoes are a dwarf's favorite food. They are like us in many ways, springing to life from the soil under even the harshest conditions.

entries.source: That resolve is what makes us who we are and keeps our flame alight.
entries.translation: 正是那份决心造就了我们，并让我们的火焰长明。
entries.sampleRaw: That resolve is what makes us who we are and keeps our flame alight.

entries.source: We will push beyond the tunnels and retake what is ours, no matter the cost.
entries.translation: 我们将越过矿道，夺回属于我们的一切，无论代价如何。
entries.sampleRaw: We will push beyond the tunnels and retake what is ours, no matter the cost.

entries.source: This doesn't change things between us - you are still needed as a member of the Expedition Team.
entries.translation: 这不会改变我们之间的关系——你仍然需要作为远征队的一员。
entries.sampleRaw: This doesn't change things between us - you are still needed as a member of the Expedition Team.

entries.source: Scout or not, I'm never leaving the safety of the Campfire again!
entries.translation: 不管是不是侦察兵，我再也不会离开营火的安全范围了！
entries.sampleRaw: Scout or not, I'm never leaving the safety of the §6Campfire §fagain!

entries.source: When I started mining in the tunnels, I fell deep down into a Glacite Mineshaft.
entries.translation: 当我开始在矿道里挖矿时,我深深坠入了一座冰川石矿井.
entries.sampleRaw: When I started mining in the tunnels, I fell deep down into a §bGlacite Mineshaft§7.

entries.source: Down there, I got attacked by all sorts of creatures, and my sword did like no damage to them!
entries.translation: 在下面，我遭到了各种生物的袭击，而我的剑对它们几乎没有造成伤害！
entries.sampleRaw: Down there, I got attacked by all sorts of creatures, and my sword did like §cno damage §fto them!

entries.source: I thought I was done for, so I pulled out my pickaxe and started swinging.
entries.translation: 我以为我死定了，所以我掏出我的镐子开始挥舞。
entries.sampleRaw: I thought I was done for, so I pulled out my §6pickaxe §fand started swinging.

entries.source: It actually seemed to be quite effective!
entries.translation: 它似乎相当有效！
entries.sampleRaw: It actually seemed to be quite effective!

entries.source: So, if you're ever in the Glacite Mineshafts and get attacked, try using your pickaxe or drill as a weapon!
entries.translation: 所以，如果你在冰晶矿井里遭到袭击，试着把你的镐子或钻头当作武器使用！
entries.sampleRaw: So, if you're ever in the §bGlacite Mineshafts §fand get attacked, try using your §6pickaxe §for §6drill §fas a weapon!

entries.source: The higher your Ⓟ Breaking Power, the more damage it seems to do to those creatures...
entries.translation: 你的Ⓟ 破坏力越高，它对这些生物造成的伤害似乎就越大……
entries.sampleRaw: The higher your §2Ⓟ Breaking Power§f, the more damage it seems to do to those creatures...

entries.source: Do you have any pumpkins I can wear as a mask while down in the Glacite Tunnels?
entries.translation: 你有没有什么南瓜，可以让我在冰川矿道下面当面具戴？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you have any pumpkins I can wear as a mask while down in the §bGlacite Tunnels§f?

entries.source: Thanks, hopefully I'll be safe with this to hide behind!
entries.translation: 谢谢，希望有这东西挡着，我会安全些！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks, hopefully I'll be safe with this to hide behind!

entries.source: You want me to go back down there with nothing to hide behind? Bro...
entries.translation: 你想让我毫无遮挡地回到下面去？兄弟……
entries.sampleRaw: You want me to go back down there with nothing to hide behind? Bro...

entries.source: Ah, a fresh face in these parts!
entries.translation: 啊，这一带的新面孔！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, a fresh face in these parts!

entries.source: Ye've got the look of someone who ain't afraid to delve deep into the earth's belly.
entries.translation: 你看起来像是个不怕深入大地腹地的人。
entries.sampleRaw: Ye've got the look of someone who ain't afraid to delve deep into the earth's belly.

entries.source: Name's Sor'Hen, and before ye ask, no, I'm not here for the camaraderie.
entries.translation: 我叫Sor'Hen，先别问，不，我不是来这儿交朋友的。
entries.sampleRaw: Name's §6Sor'Hen§f, and before ye ask, no, I'm not here for the camaraderie.

entries.source: I've got me eyes on the prize - ancient artifacts and the truth behind the lost king, Divan.
entries.translation: 我盯上的是大奖——远古神器，以及失落国王迪万背后的真相。
entries.sampleRaw: I've got me eyes on the prize - §eancient artifacts §fand the truth behind the lost king, §6Divan§f.

entries.source: Now, what's yer business here?
entries.translation: 那么，你来这儿有何贵干？
entries.sampleRaw: Now, what's yer business here?

entries.source: Rare items, ye say?
entries.translation: 稀有物品，你是说？
entries.sampleRaw: §dRare items§f, ye say?

entries.source: Well, ye've got the spirit of a true miner then.
entries.translation: 那么，你有着真正矿工的精神。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, ye've got the spirit of a true miner then.

entries.source: In these lands, the earth hides secrets and treasures older than any of us.
entries.translation: 在这片土地上，大地隐藏着比我们任何人都古老的秘密和宝藏。
entries.sampleRaw: In these lands, the earth hides §asecrets §fand treasures older than any of us.

entries.source: Here, take this.
entries.translation: 来，拿着这个。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this.

entries.source: Found that beauty myself, deep in the shadows of those mines.
entries.translation: 那宝贝是我自己找到的，就在那些矿井深处的阴影里。
entries.sampleRaw: Found that beauty myself, deep in the shadows of those mines.

entries.source: It's but a glimpse of what's buried beneath.
entries.translation: 这不过是埋藏于下方之物的一瞥。
entries.sampleRaw: It's but a glimpse of what's buried beneath.

entries.source: Suspicious Scrap are always surprising, may this one guide ye to riches and revelations.
entries.translation: 可疑的碎片总是令人惊喜，愿这一块能指引你走向财富与真相。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Suspicious Scrap §fare always surprising, may this one guide ye to riches and revelations.

entries.source: We'll cross paths again, I'm sure.
entries.translation: 我们还会再见的，我确定。
entries.sampleRaw: We'll cross paths again, I'm sure.

entries.source: The mines have a way of bringing like-minded souls together.
entries.translation: 矿井总有办法让志同道合的灵魂聚在一起。
entries.sampleRaw: The mines have a way of bringing like-minded souls together.

entries.source: Hello!!!
entries.translation: 你好！！！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHello!!!

entries.source: I'm the proud owner of the Chocolate Factory!
entries.translation: 我是巧克力工厂的骄傲主人！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm the proud owner of the §6Chocolate Factory§f!

entries.source: My Chocolate is the finest chocolate in the entire world.
entries.translation: 我的巧克力是全世界最上等的.
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy §6Chocolate §fis the finest chocolate in the entire §9world§f.

entries.source: I have a brand new marketing strategy, and every Spring season I will spread various Rabbit Eggs across the islands.
entries.translation: 我有一个全新的营销策略，每个春季我都会在各个岛屿上散布各种兔子蛋。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI have a brand new §dmarketing strategy§f, and every §aSpring §fseason I will spread various §aRabbit Eggs §facross the islands.

entries.source: Collect all the Rabbits I left in those eggs and I will let you use my factory!
entries.translation: 收集我在那些蛋里留下的所有兔子，我就让你使用我的工厂！
entries.sampleRaw: §fCollect all the Rabbits I left in those eggs and I will let you use my factory!

entries.source: Happy egg hunting!
entries.translation: 祝你寻蛋愉快！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHappy egg hunting!

entries.source: ✆ What? You want my Abiphone contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 什么？你想要我的 Abiphone 联系方式？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWhat? You want my Abiphone contact?

entries.source: ✆ Well, tell you what. Help me out with a little something and I'll hook you up.
entries.translation: ✆ 这样吧，听我说。帮我个小忙，我就给你联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWell, tell you what. Help me out with a little something and I'll hook you up.

entries.source: ✆ There's this one Fish that keeps munching on my chocolate stash.
entries.translation: ✆ 有条鱼老是偷吃我的巧克力存货。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThere's this one Fish that keeps munching on my chocolate stash.

entries.source: ✆ He's a clever one, that fish. I can never catch him.
entries.translation: ✆ 那条鱼可机灵了，我怎么都抓不到它。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHe's a clever one, that fish. I can never catch him.

entries.source: ✆ If I ever get him, I'm making a meal out of him - a little payback for all that chocolate.
entries.translation: ✆ 要是让我逮到它，我就把它做成一道菜——算是为那些巧克力报仇。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf I ever get him, I'm making a meal out of him - a little payback for all that chocolate.

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Fish Chocolat à la Vapeur and I'll give you my contact. Deal?
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一份清蒸巧克力鱼来，我就把我的联系方式给你。成交？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me a §5Fish Chocolat à la Vapeur §fand I'll give you my contact. Deal?

entries.source: ✆ Thank you so much, here is my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 太感谢你了，这是我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThank you so much, here is my contact.

entries.source: ✆ If I have new rabbit arrivals, I'll let you know!
entries.translation: ✆ 要是有新的兔子到来，我会通知你的！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf I have new rabbit arrivals, I'll let you know!

entries.source: ✆ Bring me that Fish...but in steamed form!
entries.translation: ✆ 把那条鱼给我带来……不过要清蒸的！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me that Fish...but in §csteamed §fform!

entries.source: ✆ What's up, [PLAYER]?
entries.translation: ✆ 怎么了,[PLAYER]?
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§rWhat's up, §b[PLAYER]§f?

entries.source: ✆ I just got a new Chocolate Rabbit and was wondering if you wanted to buy it.
entries.translation: ✆ 我刚得到一只新的巧克力兔，想问问你要不要买。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§rI just got a new Chocolate Rabbit and was wondering if you wanted to buy it.

entries.source: ✆ Nice doing business with you.
entries.translation: ✆ 和你做生意很愉快。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§rNice doing business with you.

entries.source: ✆ See you around!
entries.translation: ✆ 回头见！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSee you around!

entries.source: ✆ Alright, maybe next time.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，那就下次再说。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§rAlright, maybe next time.

entries.source: Hoppity's Hunt is on, and I need a break! Got something sweet?
entries.translation: Hoppity的狩猎开始了，我需要休息一下！有什么甜的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §dHoppity's Hunt §fis on, and I need a break! Got something sweet?

entries.source: Simply exquisite! I don't think I'll ever get tired of chocolate.
entries.translation: 简直太美味了！我想我永远都不会吃腻巧克力。
entries.sampleRaw: Simply exquisite! I don't think I'll ever get tired of chocolate.

entries.source: Oh...stingy, aren't we?
entries.translation: 哦……这么小气啊？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh...stingy, aren't we?

entries.source: Hello! I am Dr. Stone, a prominent Paleontologist from lands afar.
entries.translation: 你好！我是 Dr. Stone，一位来自远方的著名古生物学家。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello! I am §dDr. Stone§f, a prominent §6Paleontologist §ffrom lands afar.

entries.source: I've been able to set myself up down here for a short while in search of rare Fossils. I know the risks of doing so, but I just love research!
entries.translation: 为了寻找稀有的化石，我得以在这里暂住一段时间。我知道这么做的风险，但我就是热爱研究！
entries.sampleRaw: I've been able to set myself up down here for a short while in search of rare §6Fossils§f. I know the risks of doing so, but I just §clove §fresearch!

entries.source: I'm always on the lookout for Suspicious Scraps when I'm mining around in Glacite Mineshafts, which I sometimes find when in the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.translation: 我在冰晶矿井里挖矿时总是留意着可疑的碎片，有时在冰川矿道里也能找到。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm always on the lookout for §9Suspicious Scrap§fs when I'm mining around in §bGlacite Mineshafts§f, which I sometimes find when in the §bGlacite Tunnels§f.

entries.source: If you ever find a scrap when mining in a mineshaft, simply put it in the Fossil Excavator over there!
entries.translation: 如果你在矿井里挖矿时找到了碎片，直接把它放进那边的化石挖掘机里就行！
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever find a scrap when mining in a mineshaft, simply put it in the §6Fossil Excavator §fover there!

entries.source: Sometimes you'll find little treasures, and sometimes you'll find an entire fossil! If you do find a fossil, show it to me!
entries.translation: 有时你会找到些小宝物,有时你会找到一整块化石!如果你真的找到了化石,拿来给我看看!

styleMappings.If you do find a fossil: 如果你真的找到了化石

entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes you'll find little treasures, and sometimes you'll find an entire §6fossil§f! If you do find a fossil, §ashow it to me§f!

entries.source: If you donate a fossil to me, I'll show you how to turn it into a pet! That way, if you ever find another, you can keep it!
entries.translation: 如果你把化石捐给我，我会教你如何把它变成宠物！这样，如果你以后再找到一块，就能自己留着了！
entries.sampleRaw: If you donate a fossil to me, I'll show you how to turn it into a §dpet§f! That way, if you ever find another, you can keep it!

entries.source: Here, take this Chisel. Now you just need a Suspicious Scrap!
entries.translation: 来，拿着这把凿子。现在你只差一块可疑的碎片了！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this §aChisel§f. Now you just need a §9Suspicious Scrap§f!

entries.source: Looks like that odd fellow over by the campfire might know a thing or two about getting them...
entries.translation: 看来篝火旁那个古怪的家伙可能知道些获取它们的方法……
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like that odd fellow over by the campfire might know a thing or two about getting them...

entries.source: I've been after that one for ages.
entries.translation: 我找那东西已经找了好久了。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been after that one for ages.

entries.source: I've never seen one of these before!
entries.translation: 我以前从没见过这种东西！
entries.sampleRaw: I've never seen one of these before!

entries.source: This one is a rare find!
entries.translation: 这可是个罕见的发现！
entries.sampleRaw: This one is a rare find!

entries.source: What a beauty!
entries.translation: 真是件美物！
entries.sampleRaw: What a beauty!

entries.source: What a remarkable discovery!
entries.translation: 多么了不起的发现！
entries.sampleRaw: What a remarkable discovery!

entries.source: I can't believe you found this!
entries.translation: 我简直不敢相信你找到了这个！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't believe you found this!

entries.source: This display case is empty. If you bring me a fossil, I'd be happy to display it and tell you about it.
entries.translation: 这个展示柜是空的。如果你带给我一块化石，我很乐意把它展示出来，并给你讲讲它的故事。
entries.sampleRaw: This display case is empty. If you bring me a fossil, I'd be happy to display it and tell you about it.

entries.source: It's so small, but it's a Helix Fossil!
entries.translation: 它虽然很小，但这是一块螺旋化石！
entries.sampleRaw: It's so small, but it's a §6Helix Fossil§f!

entries.source: That thing is 100% Ammonite!
entries.translation: 那东西是100%块菊石！
entries.sampleRaw: That thing is 100% §aAmmonite§f!
entries.numericSource: That thing is {{N0}} Ammonite!
entries.numericTranslation: 那东西是{{N0}}块菊石！

entries.source: Don't let their cute looks fool you, those things were predators!
entries.translation: 别被它们可爱的外表骗了，那些家伙可是掠食者！
entries.sampleRaw: Don't let their cute looks fool you, those things were predators!

entries.source: If you're a slow-moving animal on the sea floor, these guys would have been your enemies.
entries.translation: 如果你是海床上行动缓慢的动物，这些家伙就会是你的敌人。
entries.sampleRaw: If you're a slow-moving animal on the sea floor, these guys would have been your enemies.

entries.source: Ooh, you like the look of the Helix Fossil?
entries.translation: 哦，你喜欢螺旋化石的样子？
entries.sampleRaw: Ooh, you like the look of the §6Helix Fossil§f?

entries.source: That's a very fossilized Ammonite, still completely intact!
entries.translation: 那是一块高度石化的菊石，仍然完好无损！
entries.sampleRaw: That's a very fossilized §aAmmonite§f, still completely intact!

entries.source: Once upon a time, there were thousands of different species of Ammonite, and they were plentiful in numbers.
entries.translation: 从前，菊石有成千上万个不同的物种，数量非常丰富。
entries.sampleRaw: Once upon a time, there were thousands of different species of Ammonite, and they were plentiful in numbers.

entries.source: Today... not so much.
entries.translation: 如今……就没那么多了。
entries.sampleRaw: Today... not so much.

entries.source: Something just feels special about the Helix Fossil.
entries.translation: 螺旋化石总给人一种特别的感觉。
entries.sampleRaw: Something just feels special about the §6Helix Fossil§f.

entries.source: It's actually a well-preserved Ammonite from long ago.
entries.translation: 它其实是一块保存完好的远古菊石。
entries.sampleRaw: It's actually a well-preserved §aAmmonite §ffrom long ago.

entries.source: While this one is pretty small, the largest known fossils of this variety are massive!
entries.translation: 虽然这一块相当小，但这一品种已知最大的化石可是非常巨大的！
entries.sampleRaw: While this one is pretty small, the largest known fossils of this variety are massive!

entries.source: That thing looks gross. It's surely an Ugly Fossil!
entries.translation: 那东西看起来真恶心。这肯定是一块丑陋化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That thing looks gross. It's surely an §6Ugly Fossil§f!

entries.source: Whatever Goblin that belonged to was pretty nasty-looking, even for a Goblin.
entries.translation: 不管它属于哪个哥布林,那家伙的长相即便以同族的标准来看也相当丑陋.

即便以同族的标准来看也相当丑陋.

entries.sampleRaw: Whatever §aGoblin §fthat belonged to was pretty nasty-looking, even for a Goblin.

entries.source: Goblins don't really think for themselves most of the time, and prefer to blindly follow the herd.
entries.translation: 哥布林大多数时候并不真正独立思考，更喜欢盲目随大流。
entries.sampleRaw: Goblins don't really think for themselves most of the time, and prefer to blindly follow the herd.

entries.source: Kind of like the people over in the Hub when it comes to voting for a Mayor...
entries.translation: 有点像中心岛那边的人在投票选市长时的样子……
entries.sampleRaw: Kind of like the people over in the Hub when it comes to voting for a Mayor...

entries.source: Ew! That's definitely an Ugly Fossil!
entries.translation: 呃！这绝对是一块丑陋化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Ew! That's definitely an §6Ugly Fossil§f!

entries.source: Looks like it belonged to an especially ugly Goblin.
entries.translation: 看起来它属于一个特别丑陋的哥布林。
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like it belonged to an especially ugly §aGoblin§f.

entries.source: Goblins are plentiful in other areas of the mines, but I'm yet to find any down here.
entries.translation: 哥布林在矿洞的其他区域很常见，但我在这里还没找到过任何一只。
entries.sampleRaw: Goblins are plentiful in other areas of the mines, but I'm yet to find any down here.

entries.source: Maybe it got lost many years ago and ended up down here?
entries.translation: 也许它很多年前迷了路，最后来到了这里？
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe it got lost many years ago and ended up down here?

entries.source: That in front of you is an Ugly Fossil!
entries.translation: 你面前的那块就是丑陋化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That in front of you is an §6Ugly Fossil§f!

entries.source: Yeah, that name was the best we could come up with...
entries.translation: 是啊，那个名字已经是我们能想出来的最好的了……
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah, that name was the best we could come up with...

entries.source: It's a skull that once belonged to a particularly deformed-looking Goblin.
entries.translation: 这是一颗头骨，曾经属于一个长相特别畸形的哥布林。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a skull that once belonged to a particularly deformed-looking §aGoblin§f.

entries.source: Just looking at it is giving me the heebie-jeebies, let's move on!
entries.translation: 光是看着它就让我毛骨悚然，我们继续吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Just looking at it is giving me the heebie-jeebies, let's move on!

entries.source: That Claw Fossil looks pretty daunting...
entries.translation: 那块爪化石看起来相当吓人……
entries.sampleRaw: That §6Claw Fossil §flooks pretty daunting...

entries.source: That was once attached to a Mole.
entries.translation: 那东西曾经长在一只Mole身上。
entries.sampleRaw: That was once attached to a §aMole§f.

entries.source: Those guys are solitary creatures and quite territorial, so you don't normally see them about.
entries.translation: 那些家伙是独居生物，领地意识很强，所以你平时不太容易见到它们。
entries.sampleRaw: Those guys are solitary creatures and quite territorial, so you don't normally see them about.

entries.source: That Claw Fossil looks real menacing with those sharp claws...
entries.translation: 那块爪化石配上那些锋利的爪子，看起来真是相当吓人……
entries.sampleRaw: That §6Claw Fossil §flooks real menacing with those sharp claws...

entries.source: But it becomes a bit less scary when you realize it came from a Mole.
entries.translation: 但当你意识到它来自一只Mole时，就没那么可怕了。
entries.sampleRaw: But it becomes a bit less scary when you realize it came from a §aMole§f.

entries.source: Those little guys actually only live for a few years, which is kinda sad...
entries.translation: 那些小家伙其实只能活几年，有点让人难过……
entries.sampleRaw: Those little guys actually only live for a few years, which is kinda sad...

entries.source: Pretty sharp, huh? That's the Claw Fossil for you.
entries.translation: 挺锋利的，对吧？这就是爪化石。
entries.sampleRaw: Pretty sharp, huh? That's the §6Claw Fossil §ffor you.

entries.source: Those things are actually insectivores and love digging tunnels.
entries.translation: 那些东西其实是食虫动物，还特别喜欢挖隧道。
entries.sampleRaw: Those things are actually insectivores and love digging tunnels.

entries.source: When they dig, they move their arms in an outward motion, like a human swimming in breaststroke!
entries.translation: 它们挖掘时会把手臂向外摆动，就像人类游蛙泳一样！
entries.sampleRaw: When they dig, they move their arms in an outward motion, like a human swimming in breaststroke!

entries.source: That Tusk Fossil looks absolutely amazing.
entries.translation: 那块獠牙化石看起来真是令人惊叹。
entries.sampleRaw: That §6Tusk Fossil §flooks absolutely amazing.

entries.source: Mammoths had two of these, and used them to fend off predators.
entries.translation: 猛犸象长着两根这样的獠牙，用来抵御掠食者。
entries.sampleRaw: §aMammoths §fhad two of these, and used them to fend off predators.

entries.source: They also used them to fight each other over territory and gather food!
entries.translation: 它们也会用獠牙为了领地互相争斗，以及采集食物！
entries.sampleRaw: They also used them to fight each other over territory and gather food!

entries.source: That thing there is a Tusk Fossil!
entries.translation: 那边那个东西是一块獠牙化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That thing there is a §6Tusk Fossil§f!

entries.source: That thing was once attached to a Mammoth , believe or not.
entries.translation: 信不信由你，那东西曾经长在一只猛犸象身上。
entries.sampleRaw: That thing was once attached to a §aMammoth §f, believe or not.

entries.source: While people often think Mammoths were huge, they were actually around the size of your average modern-day elephant.
entries.translation: 虽然人们常以为猛犸象体型巨大，但它们其实和现代普通大象差不多大。
entries.sampleRaw: While people often think Mammoths were huge, they were actually around the size of your average modern-day elephant.

entries.source: Though it's not like that fact makes their tusks any less intimidating...
entries.translation: 不过这个事实并不会让它们的獠牙显得没那么吓人……
entries.sampleRaw: Though it's not like that fact makes their tusks any less intimidating...

entries.source: Look how awesome! The Tusk Fossil!
entries.translation: 看这多棒啊！獠牙化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Look how awesome! The §6Tusk Fossil§f!

entries.source: I wish I could see the Mammoth it belonged to.
entries.translation: 我真希望能亲眼看看它所属的那只猛犸象。
entries.sampleRaw: I wish I could see the §aMammoth §fit belonged to.

entries.source: Though they look pretty scary, these guys mostly ate vegetation.
entries.translation: 虽然它们看起来挺吓人，但这些家伙主要吃植物。
entries.sampleRaw: Though they look pretty scary, these guys mostly ate vegetation.

entries.source: Still, if you ever saw one you'd probably want to keep out of its way...
entries.translation: 不过，如果你真见到一只，大概还是会想离它远点……
entries.sampleRaw: Still, if you ever saw one you'd probably want to keep out of its way...

entries.source: That in front of you is a Webbed Fossil!
entries.translation: 你面前那个是一块带蹼化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That in front of you is a §6Webbed Fossil§f!

entries.source: It belonged to a particularly resilient Penguin.
entries.translation: 它属于一只特别顽强的企鹅。
entries.sampleRaw: It belonged to a particularly resilient §aPenguin§f.

entries.source: While on land, a group of penguins is called a waddle.
entries.translation: 在陆地上时，一群企鹅被称为“waddle”。
entries.sampleRaw: While on land, a group of penguins is called a waddle.

entries.source: But, if they're in the water, they're instead referred to by researchers as a raft!
entries.translation: 但如果它们在水里，研究人员则会称它们为“raft”！
entries.sampleRaw: But, if they're in the water, they're instead referred to by researchers as a raft!

entries.source: Which one do you like more?
entries.translation: 你更喜欢哪一个？
entries.sampleRaw: Which one do you like more?

entries.source: Aw! That little fella is a Webbed Fossil!
entries.translation: 哇！那个小家伙是一块带蹼化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Aw! That little fella is a §6Webbed Fossil§f!

entries.source: It's all that remains of whatever little Penguin once lived around here.
entries.translation: 这就是曾经生活在这附近的那只小企鹅留下的全部痕迹了。
entries.sampleRaw: It's all that remains of whatever little §aPenguin §fonce lived around here.

entries.source: The black-and-white look of most penguins is actually a form of camouflage.
entries.translation: 大多数企鹅黑白相间的外表其实是一种伪装。
entries.sampleRaw: The black-and-white look of most penguins is actually a form of camouflage.

entries.source: When they're swimming, predators looking from above see the black on their backs, which camouflages with the water.
entries.translation: 当它们游泳时，从上方观察的掠食者会看到它们背上的黑色，与水融为一体。
entries.sampleRaw: When they're swimming, predators looking from above see the black on their backs, which camouflages with the water.

entries.source: And, to predators below, their white underbelly blends in with the light shining down on the water from above!
entries.translation: 而且，对于下方的捕食者来说，它们白色的腹部会与从上方照射到水面的光线融为一体！
entries.sampleRaw: And, to predators below, their white underbelly blends in with the light shining down on the water from above!

entries.source: Ooh! One of my favorites! The Webbed Fossil!
entries.translation: 哦！我最喜欢的化石之一！带蹼化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Ooh! One of my favorites! The §6Webbed Fossil§f!

entries.source: Believe it or not, that once belonged to a Penguin!
entries.translation: 信不信由你，那曾经属于一只企鹅！
entries.sampleRaw: Believe it or not, that once belonged to a §aPenguin§f!

entries.source: Most bird species evolve with hollow bones, to help them stay light when flying.
entries.translation: 大多数鸟类物种进化出中空的骨骼，以帮助它们在飞行时保持轻盈。
entries.sampleRaw: Most bird species evolve with hollow bones, to help them stay light when flying.

entries.source: Penguins, however, have solid bones, which help them float when in the water.
entries.translation: 然而，企鹅拥有实心的骨骼，这有助于它们在水中漂浮。
entries.sampleRaw: Penguins, however, have solid bones, which help them float when in the water.

entries.source: The Clubbed Fossil is quite majestic, I've never seen another tail like it.
entries.translation: 棍棒化石相当雄伟，我从未见过像它这样的尾巴。
entries.sampleRaw: The §6Clubbed Fossil §fis quite majestic, I've never seen another tail like it.

entries.source: It belonged to an Ankylosaurus.
entries.translation: 它属于一只甲龙。
entries.sampleRaw: It belonged to an §aAnkylosaurus§f.

entries.source: Though this dino was covered in strong plating that would usually make it impervious to predators, it had a soft underbelly.
entries.translation: 虽然这只恐龙全身覆盖着坚固的甲板，通常能让它免受捕食者的侵害，但它有一个柔软的腹部。
entries.sampleRaw: Though this dino was covered in strong plating that would usually make it impervious to predators, it had a soft underbelly.

entries.source: So, it was an easy meal... if you could roll it over first, and that thing weighed more than a dwarven forge!
entries.translation: 所以，它是一顿轻易到手的饭……前提是你能先把它翻过来，而那东西比矮人锻炉还要重！
entries.sampleRaw: So, it was an easy meal... if you could roll it over first, and that thing weighed more than a dwarven forge!

entries.source: This one here looks a little strange, but is the Clubbed Fossil!
entries.translation: 这一个看起来有点奇怪，但它是棍棒化石！
entries.sampleRaw: This one here looks a little strange, but is the §6Clubbed Fossil§f!

entries.source: It was once a tail belonging to an Ankylosaurus.
entries.translation: 它曾经是一只甲龙的尾巴。
entries.sampleRaw: It was once a tail belonging to an §aAnkylosaurus§f.

entries.source: The Ankylosaurus was a herbivore, but it lived at the same time as the T-Rex.
entries.translation: 甲龙是食草动物，但它与霸王龙生活在同一时期。
entries.sampleRaw: The Ankylosaurus was a herbivore, but it lived at the same time as the T-Rex.

entries.source: Though, if you have to live at the same time as a bloodthirsty predator like the T-Rex, it probably would help to have an armored body and bone-shatteringly strong tail.
entries.translation: 不过，如果你必须与霸王龙这样嗜血的捕食者生活在同一时期，拥有装甲般的身体和能击碎骨头的强壮尾巴大概会很有帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: Though, if you have to live at the same time as a bloodthirsty predator like the T-Rex, it probably would help to have an armored body and bone-shatteringly strong tail.

entries.source: Ah, the Clubbed Fossil!
entries.translation: 啊，棍棒化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, the §6Clubbed Fossil§f!

entries.source: That thing was once attached to the rear of an Ankylosaurus.
entries.translation: 那东西曾经连接在一只甲龙的后部。
entries.sampleRaw: That thing was once attached to the rear of an §aAnkylosaurus§f.

entries.source: Those things were pretty much walking fortresses - completely covered in bony deposits known as osteoderms that protected them from predators.
entries.translation: 那些家伙几乎就是行走的堡垒——全身覆盖着被称为骨皮沉积的骨质沉积物，保护它们免受捕食者的侵害。
entries.sampleRaw: Those things were pretty much walking fortresses - completely covered in bony deposits known as osteoderms that protected them from predators.

entries.source: Today, you'll see similar armor-like osteoderms on Crocodiles and Armadillos.
entries.translation: 如今，你会在鳄鱼和穿山甲身上看到类似的装甲状骨皮沉积。
entries.sampleRaw: Today, you'll see similar armor-like osteoderms on Crocodiles and Armadillos.

entries.source: That there is a Footprint Fossil!
entries.translation: 那是一个足迹化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That there is a §6Footprint Fossil§f!

entries.source: Once upon a time, it belonged to a ferocious T-Rex!
entries.translation: 很久以前，它属于一只凶猛的霸王龙！
entries.sampleRaw: Once upon a time, it belonged to a ferocious §aT-Rex§f!

entries.source: Those boys were bad news - they would take a bite out of anything!
entries.translation: 那些家伙可不是好惹的——它们会咬任何东西！
entries.sampleRaw: Those boys were bad news - they would take a bite out of anything!

entries.source: There's even evidence to suggest that they would sometimes eat each other!
entries.translation: 甚至有证据表明它们有时会互相残食！
entries.sampleRaw: There's even evidence to suggest that they would sometimes eat each other!

entries.source: Believe it or not, but that's a Footprint Fossil!
entries.translation: 信不信由你，但那是一个足迹化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Believe it or not, but that's a §6Footprint Fossil§f!

entries.source: It looks to have belonged to the legendary T-Rex!
entries.translation: 它看起来曾属于传说中的霸王龙！
entries.sampleRaw: It looks to have belonged to the legendary §aT-Rex§f!

entries.source: The T-Rex is made fun of for its comparatively small arms, but they were still over three feet long!
entries.translation: 霸王龙因其相对较小的手臂而被取笑，但它们仍然有三英尺多长！
entries.sampleRaw: The T-Rex is made fun of for its comparatively small arms, but they were still over three feet long!

entries.source: Some other carnivores also had even stubbier little arms, so I guess there's that...
entries.translation: 其他一些食肉动物还有更短粗的小手臂，所以我想至少还有这一点……
entries.sampleRaw: Some other carnivores also had even stubbier little arms, so I guess there's that...

entries.source: That looks like a Footprint Fossil!
entries.translation: 那看起来像是一个足迹化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That looks like a §6Footprint Fossil§f!

entries.source: That bad boy once belonged to the T-Rex!
entries.translation: 那个坏家伙曾经属于霸王龙！
entries.sampleRaw: That bad boy once belonged to the §aT-Rex§f!

entries.source: The T-Rex actually had a brain twice as large as most other carnivores.
entries.translation: 霸王龙的大脑实际上比大多数其他食肉动物大两倍。
entries.sampleRaw: The T-Rex actually had a brain twice as large as most other carnivores.

entries.source: Some researchers believe it was smart enough to set traps for its prey, and actually functioned as an ambush predator.
entries.translation: 一些研究人员认为它足够聪明，会为猎物设置陷阱，实际上是一种伏击型掠食者。
entries.sampleRaw: Some researchers believe it was smart enough to set traps for its prey, and actually functioned as an ambush predator.

entries.source: A Spine Fossil! This one's pretty rare.
entries.translation: 一块脊椎化石！这一块相当稀有。
entries.sampleRaw: A §6Spine Fossil§f! This one's pretty rare.

entries.source: It was once part of a particularly interesting creature called the Spinosaurus.
entries.translation: 它曾经属于一种特别有趣的生物，叫做棘龙。
entries.sampleRaw: It was once part of a particularly interesting creature called the §aSpinosaurus§f.

entries.source: This dinosaur is actually really controversial, as fossils make it hard to tell how it truly behaved.
entries.translation: 这种恐龙其实颇具争议，因为化石很难让人判断它真正的行为方式。
entries.sampleRaw: This dinosaur is actually really controversial, as fossils make it hard to tell how it truly behaved.

entries.source: Did it spend most of its time hunting on land, or was it more of an aquatic forager?
entries.translation: 它大部分时间是在陆地上捕猎，还是更偏向于在水里觅食？
entries.sampleRaw: Did it spend most of its time hunting on land, or was it more of an aquatic forager?

entries.source: Either way, it's pretty funny. With every new discovery, the Spinosaurus loses a bit more of its mystique.
entries.translation: 不管怎样，这都挺有意思的。每有一项新发现，棘龙就多失去一分神秘感。
entries.sampleRaw: Either way, it's pretty funny. With every new discovery, the Spinosaurus loses a bit more of its mystique.

entries.source: I can't believe Paleontologists are nerfing dinosaurs now.
entries.translation: 真不敢相信古生物学家现在都在削弱恐龙了。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't believe Paleontologists are nerfing dinosaurs now.

entries.source: The Spine Fossil! Now, this one is really cool!
entries.translation: 脊椎化石！这一块可真是太酷了！
entries.sampleRaw: The §6Spine Fossil§f! Now, this one is really cool!

entries.source: This was once attached to the back of the Spinosaurus.
entries.translation: 它曾经附着在棘龙的背上。
entries.sampleRaw: This was once attached to the back of the §aSpinosaurus§f.

entries.source: The Spinosaurus was not only a carnivore, but also one of the few dinosaurs to be an adept swimmer.
entries.translation: 棘龙不仅是食肉动物，还是少数擅长游泳的恐龙之一。
entries.sampleRaw: The Spinosaurus was not only a carnivore, but also one of the few dinosaurs to be an adept swimmer.

entries.source: What I'm saying is that, no matter where you ran, it would probably follow. Nice.
entries.translation: 我的意思是，不管你跑到哪里，它大概都会跟上来。不错。
entries.sampleRaw: What I'm saying is that, no matter where you ran, it would probably follow. Nice.

entries.source: That in front of you is a Spine Fossil!
entries.translation: 你面前的就是一块脊椎化石！
entries.sampleRaw: That in front of you is a §6Spine Fossil§f!

entries.source: Many, many, many years ago, it would have belonged to one Spinosaurus.
entries.translation: 很久很久很久以前，它曾属于一只棘龙。
entries.sampleRaw: Many, many, many years ago, it would have belonged to one §aSpinosaurus§f.

entries.source: Fun fact, the T-Rex isn't actually the heaviest carnivorous dinosaur known to researchers!
entries.translation: 有趣的是，霸王龙其实并不是研究人员已知最重的食肉恐龙！
entries.sampleRaw: Fun fact, the T-Rex isn't actually the heaviest carnivorous dinosaur known to researchers!

entries.source: That title actually goes to this fella, who was one BIG BOY!
entries.translation: 那个头衔其实属于这位老兄，它可是个大家伙！
entries.sampleRaw: That title actually goes to this fella, who was one BIG BOY!

entries.source: Wow! Looks like you've found every type of fossil around!
entries.translation: 哇！看来你已经找到了周围所有类型的化石！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! Looks like you've found every type of §6fossil §faround!

entries.source: Maybe we'll find more together in the future, but for now my work here is done!
entries.translation: 也许将来我们还能一起找到更多，但现在我在这里的工作已经完成了！
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe we'll find more together in the future, but for now my work here is done!

entries.source: Please, take these rewards. It's the least I can do!
entries.translation: 请收下这些奖励吧。这是我至少能做的！
entries.sampleRaw: Please, take these rewards. It's the least I can do!

entries.source: I think I'll stick around for a little longer, and then it's onto my next adventure!
entries.translation: 我想我会再待一小会儿，然后就该踏上我的下一次冒险了！
entries.sampleRaw: I think I'll stick around for a little longer, and then it's onto my next adventure!

entries.source: The Chocolate Factory is opening soon!
entries.translation: 巧克力工厂马上就要开业了！
entries.sampleRaw: The §6Chocolate Factory §fis opening soon!

entries.source: I sure hope I get hired when it opens!
entries.translation: 我真希望它开业时我能被录用！
entries.sampleRaw: I sure hope I get hired when it opens!

entries.source: Get me a job at your factory, bro!
entries.translation: 兄弟，在你的工厂里给我找份工作吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Get me a job at your factory, bro!

entries.source: Hire me, bro!
entries.translation: 雇我吧，兄弟！
entries.sampleRaw: Hire me, bro!

entries.source: You should hire me! I can help you boost your Chocolate Factory production tenfold by next quarter!
entries.translation: 你应该雇我！到下一季度，我能帮你把巧克力工厂的产量提升十倍！
entries.sampleRaw: You should hire me! I can help you boost your §6Chocolate Factory §fproduction §dtenfold §fby next quarter!

entries.source: Hoppity's living the sweet life now, but who's the one who taught him to dodge those garden gnomes? Bro knows best.
entries.translation: Hoppity现在过着甜蜜的生活,但当初是谁教他躲开那些花园地精的?还是兄弟最懂.
entries.sampleRaw: §aHoppity's §fliving the sweet life now, but who's the one who taught him to dodge those garden gnomes? Bro knows best.

entries.source: Working out before dawn has its perks; you get to see Hoppity's 'inspirational' morning pep talks.
entries.translation: 天亮前锻炼自有好处;你能看到Hoppity那番“鼓舞人心”的晨间打气.
entries.sampleRaw: Working out before dawn has its perks; you get to see §aHoppity's §f'inspirational' morning pep talks.

entries.source: It's like a shot of espresso, but with more hopping and less coffee.
entries.translation: 这就像一杯浓缩咖啡，只不过蹦跳更多，咖啡更少。
entries.sampleRaw: It's like a shot of espresso, but with more hopping and less coffee.

entries.source: Rise and grind, as I say. The early rabbit gets the cocoa beans.
entries.translation: 就像我常说的，起床奋斗吧。早起的兔子有可可豆吃。
entries.sampleRaw: Rise and grind, as I say. The early rabbit gets the cocoa beans.

entries.source: Hoppity may run the factory, but who do you think inspires the work ethic?
entries.translation: Hoppity也许管理着工厂，但你觉得是谁在激励大家的工作热情？
entries.sampleRaw: §aHoppity §fmay run the factory, but who do you think inspires the work ethic?

entries.source: What represents a sigma grindset for me? It's about being powered by my own ambitions, not the expectations laid out by others.
entries.translation: 对我来说，什么才是西格玛奋斗心态？那就是被自己的雄心驱动，而不是被他人设定的期望所驱动。
entries.sampleRaw: What represents a sigma grindset for me? It's about being powered by my own ambitions, not the expectations laid out by others.

entries.source: Each day I commit to the hard work, the relentless pursuit of my personal goals.
entries.translation: 每一天我都致力于辛勤工作，不懈追求我的个人目标。
entries.sampleRaw: Each day I commit to the hard work, the relentless pursuit of my personal goals.

entries.source: It's not about what the world thinks I should achieve; it's about what I know I can accomplish with dedication and effort.
entries.translation: 重要的不是世界认为我应该达成什么，而是我知道凭借专注和努力我能成就什么。
entries.sampleRaw: It's not about what the world thinks I should achieve; it's about what I know I can accomplish with dedication and effort.

entries.source: My grindset is my commitment to never settling for less than what I know I can achieve.
entries.translation: 我的奋斗心态就是我的承诺：绝不满足于低于我知道自己能达到的水平。
entries.sampleRaw: My grindset is my commitment to never settling for less than what I know I can achieve.

entries.source: It's not about being the best among others, but being the best version of myself.
entries.translation: 重要的不是成为众人中最强的，而是成为最好的自己。
entries.sampleRaw: It's not about being the best among others, but being the best version of myself.

entries.source: If you need a rundown of Uncle's high school football stats, just stick around for five minutes.
entries.translation: 如果你想听叔叔高中橄榄球数据的详细回顾，待上五分钟就行。
entries.sampleRaw: If you need a rundown of Uncle's high school football stats, just stick around for five minutes.

entries.source: That dog works harder than any of us, I swear. It's that dogged determination, you know?
entries.translation: 那条狗比我们谁都更努力，我发誓。就是那种执着的决心，你懂吧？
entries.sampleRaw: That dog works harder than any of us, I swear. It's that dogged determination, you know?

entries.source: Just built differently, always fetching, always carrying. Must be nice not needing a coffee break.
entries.translation: 就是天生不一样，总是去叼东西，总是搬运。不用喝咖啡休息一定很棒。
entries.sampleRaw: Just built differently, always fetching, always carrying. Must be nice not needing a coffee break.

entries.source: Let's be honest, Rabbit Dog outpaces us all, but hey, he's a dog and we're just rabbits.
entries.translation: 说实话，Rabbit Dog比我们所有人都快，但嘿，他是狗，我们只是兔子。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's be honest, Rabbit Dog outpaces us all, but hey, he's a dog and we're just rabbits.

entries.source: It's in his nature to run circles around us, literally. While we strategize, he's already on his third lap. Just born for the hustle, I guess!
entries.translation: 绕着我们跑圈是他的天性，字面意义上的。我们还在制定策略，他已经跑完第三圈了。大概天生就是干这行的料！
entries.sampleRaw: It's in his nature to run circles around us, literally. While we strategize, he's already on his third lap. Just born for the hustle, I guess!

entries.source: Coach is the only rabbit I know whose biceps have biceps.
entries.translation: 教练是我认识的唯一一个肱二头肌上还长着肱二头肌的兔子。
entries.sampleRaw: §dCoach §fis the only rabbit I know whose biceps have biceps.

entries.source: For every 1  Cold Resistance you have, Cold builds up 1% slower.
entries.translation: 你每拥有1 寒冷抗性，寒冷积累速度就减慢1%。
entries.sampleRaw: For every §b1  Cold Resistance §fyou have, §bCold §fbuilds up §a1% §fslower.
entries.numericSource: For every {{N0}}  Cold Resistance you have, Cold builds up {{N1}} slower.
entries.numericTranslation: 你每拥有{{N0}} 寒冷抗性，寒冷积累速度就减慢{{N1}}。

entries.source: So, if you have 100  Cold Resistance, Cold will take 2x as long to build up!
entries.translation: 所以,如果你有100 寒冷抗性,寒冷积累所需时间将变为2倍!
entries.sampleRaw: So, if you have §b100  Cold Resistance§f, §bCold §fwill take §a2x §fas long to build up!
entries.numericSource: So, if you have {{N0}}  Cold Resistance, Cold will take {{N1}}x as long to build up!
entries.numericTranslation: 所以,如果你有{{N0}} 寒冷抗性,寒冷积累所需时间将变为{{N1}}倍!

entries.source: You can get  Cold Resistance from some Heart of the Mountain perks, and from certain items.
entries.translation: 你可以从某些山峰之心技能以及特定物品中获得寒冷抗性。
entries.sampleRaw: You can get §b Cold Resistance §ffrom some §5Heart of the Mountain §fperks, and from certain items.

entries.source: Your  Mining Speed is reduced by 0.5% for every Cold you have.
entries.translation: 你每拥有一点寒冷，你的挖掘速度就会降低0.5%。
entries.sampleRaw: Your §6 Mining Speed §fis reduced by §c0.5% §ffor every §bCold §fyou have.
entries.numericSource: Your  Mining Speed is reduced by {{N0}} for every Cold you have.
entries.numericTranslation: 你每拥有一点寒冷，你的挖掘速度就会降低{{N0}}。

entries.source: The formula is: ( Current Cold -  Cold Resistance ) \/ 2 = Mining Speed Penalty
entries.translation: 公式为：( 当前寒冷 - 寒冷抗性 ) \/ 2 =挖掘速度惩罚
entries.sampleRaw: The formula is: §a( §bCurrent Cold §a- §b Cold Resistance §a) \/ §e2 §a= §cMining Speed Penalty
entries.numericSource: The formula is: ( Current Cold -  Cold Resistance ) \/ {{N0}} = Mining Speed Penalty
entries.numericTranslation: 公式为：( 当前寒冷 - 寒冷抗性 ) \/ {{N0}} =挖掘速度惩罚

entries.source: So, if you have 70 Cold and 5  Cold Resistance, your  Mining Speed will be reduced by 7.5%.
entries.translation: 所以，如果你有70点寒冷和5 寒冷抗性，你的挖掘速度将降低7.5%。
entries.sampleRaw: So, if you have §b70 Cold §fand §b5  Cold Resistance§f, your §6 Mining Speed §fwill be reduced by §c7.5%§f.
entries.numericSource: So, if you have {{N0}} Cold and {{N1}}  Cold Resistance, your  Mining Speed will be reduced by {{N2}}.
entries.numericTranslation: 所以，如果你有{{N0}}点寒冷和{{N1}} 寒冷抗性，你的挖掘速度将降低{{N2}}。

entries.source: If your  Cold Resistance is greater than the amount of Cold you have, you won't receive a  Mining Speed reduction!
entries.translation: 如果你的寒冷抗性高于你拥有的寒冷量，你就不会受到挖掘速度降低！
entries.sampleRaw: If your §b Cold Resistance §fis greater than the amount of §bCold §fyou have, you won't receive a §6 Mining Speed §freduction!

entries.source: Since 99 Cold is the most you can have before dying, a  Cold Resistance stat of 99 or more will be enough to ensure you never receive a Mining Speed Penalty.
entries.translation: 由于99点寒冷是你在死亡前能积累的最大值,寒冷抗性达到99或更高就足以确保你永远不会受到挖掘速度惩罚.
entries.sampleRaw: Since §b99 Cold §fis the most you can have before dying, a §b Cold Resistance §fstat of §a99 §for more will be enough to ensure you §onever §freceive a §cMining Speed Penalty§f.
entries.numericSource: Since {{N0}} Cold is the most you can have before dying, a  Cold Resistance stat of {{N1}} or more will be enough to ensure you never receive a Mining Speed Penalty.
