entries.source: I am not a [player] enjoyer.
entries.translation: 我不是[player]的爱好者.
entries.sampleRaw: I am not a §7[player] §fenjoyer.

entries.source: I need a job soon, or my parents will kick me out of the warren.
entries.translation: 我很快得找份工作，不然我父母会把我赶出兔窝。
entries.sampleRaw: I need a job soon, or my parents will kick me out of the warren.

entries.source: My parents have been hounding me to get a job! Please hire me!
entries.translation: 我父母一直催我找工作！请雇用我吧！
entries.sampleRaw: My parents have been hounding me to get a job! Please hire me!

entries.source: I suggested chocolate-covered carrots to Hoppity once. He laughed until he tried it. Now, who's laughing?
entries.translation: 我曾向Hoppity推荐过巧克力裹胡萝卜。他笑了，直到他尝了一口。现在，谁在笑？
entries.sampleRaw: I suggested chocolate-covered carrots to §aHoppity §fonce. He laughed until he tried it. Now, who's laughing?

entries.source: Still him, because it was a terrible idea.
entries.translation: 还是他，因为那是个糟糕的主意。
entries.sampleRaw: Still him, because it was a terrible idea.

entries.source: Working hard or hardly working? With chocolate, it's both. I might drift in past noon, but when I'm on, I'm on fire.
entries.translation: 努力工作还是几乎不工作？配上巧克力，两者皆是。我可能过了中午才晃悠过来，但一旦开工，我就火力全开。
entries.sampleRaw: Working hard or hardly working? With chocolate, it's both. I might drift in past noon, but when I'm on, I'm on fire.

entries.source: Hoppity knows the score.
entries.translation: Hoppity心里有数。
entries.sampleRaw: §aHoppity §fknows the score.

entries.source: They say genius looks like laziness. Guess I'm living proof.
entries.translation: 他们说天才看起来像懒惰。我猜我就是活生生的证明。
entries.sampleRaw: They say genius looks like laziness. Guess I'm living proof.

entries.source: When I finally get to it, even Granny's impressed with the flavors I whip up.
entries.translation: 等我终于动手做的时候，连奶奶都对我调出的风味赞不绝口。
entries.sampleRaw: When I finally get to it, even §aGranny's §fimpressed with the flavors I whip up.

entries.source: Uncle is an inspiration, really.
entries.translation: 叔叔真是我的灵感来源，真的。
entries.sampleRaw: Uncle is an inspiration, really.

entries.source: Coach wants us to push to our limits. I asked if that includes pushing the snooze button. He wasn't amused.
entries.translation: 教练想让我们突破极限。我问他这包不包括按贪睡键。他一点也没觉得好笑。
entries.sampleRaw: §dCoach §fwants us to push to our limits. I asked if that includes pushing the snooze button. He wasn't amused.

entries.source: Down with Big Chocolate!
entries.translation: 打倒巧克力巨头！
entries.sampleRaw: Down with Big Chocolate!

entries.source: Regulate! Regulate! Regulate!
entries.translation: 监管！监管！监管！
entries.sampleRaw: Regulate! Regulate! Regulate!

entries.source: Hire me, player!
entries.translation: 雇我吧，player！
entries.sampleRaw: Hire me, §7player§f!

entries.source: Together we can abolish the patriarchy, and ensure clean chocolate for all rabbits!
entries.translation: 我们可以一起废除父权制，确保所有兔子都能吃上干净的巧克力！
entries.sampleRaw: Together we can abolish the patriarchy, and ensure clean chocolate for all rabbits!

entries.source: Bro's always talking about his 'sigma grindset'. Tried to get me to read a book on it.
entries.translation: 老哥总在念叨他的“西格玛奋斗心态”。还想让我读一本讲这个的书。
entries.sampleRaw: Bro's always talking about his 'sigma grindset'. Tried to get me to read a book on it.

entries.source: Cousin might be the laziest bunny I know, but he's onto something.
entries.translation: 表哥可能是我认识的最懒的兔子，但他确实有点道理。
entries.sampleRaw: Cousin might be the laziest bunny I know, but he's onto something.

entries.source: Why protest when you can just 'be the change'? By napping, apparently.
entries.translation: 既然你可以直接“成为改变”，为什么还要抗议呢？显然，靠打盹就行。
entries.sampleRaw: Why protest when you can just 'be the change'? By napping, apparently.

entries.source: Hoppity actually listens to my protests.
entries.translation: Hoppity确实会听我的抗议。
entries.sampleRaw: §aHoppity §factually listens to my protests.

entries.source: Well, more like he can't avoid them since I do it in the lobby. But it's a start, right?
entries.translation: 嗯，更准确地说，他躲不开，因为我是在大厅里抗议的。但这是个开始，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Well, more like he can't avoid them since I do it in the lobby. But it's a start, right?

entries.source: They say I'm disrupting the peace, but I'm just trying to sprinkle a little truth on our chocolate-covered lies.
entries.translation: 他们说我破坏了和平，但我只是想在我们那层巧克力外衣的谎言上撒一点真相。
entries.sampleRaw: They say I'm disrupting the peace, but I'm just trying to sprinkle a little truth on our chocolate-covered lies.

entries.source: The factory needs a new recipe...for justice.
entries.translation: 工厂需要一份新配方……为了正义.
entries.sampleRaw: The factory needs a new recipe...§ofor justice.

entries.source: A protest a day keeps the unethical practices away.
entries.translation: 每天一场抗议，不道德行为远离你。
entries.sampleRaw: A protest a day keeps the unethical practices away.

entries.source: Dad might not see it now, but I'm doing this for the future of all chocolate bunnies.
entries.translation: 爸爸现在可能看不明白，但我这么做是为了所有巧克力兔子的未来。
entries.sampleRaw: Dad might not see it now, but I'm doing this for the future of all chocolate bunnies.

entries.source: Uncle treats every little decision around here like it's the state championship game.
entries.translation: 叔叔把这里每一个小决定都当成州冠军赛来对待。
entries.sampleRaw: Uncle treats every little decision around here like it's the state championship game.

entries.source: 'What would coach have done?' He mutters to himself.
entries.translation: “教练会怎么做？”他自言自语道。
entries.sampleRaw: 'What would coach have done?' He mutters to himself.

entries.source: Close the yearbook, pal.
entries.translation: 合上那本年鉴吧，伙计。
entries.sampleRaw: Close the yearbook, pal.

entries.source: Uncle has this ritual of watching old high school games every weekend.
entries.translation: 叔叔有个习惯，每个周末都要看旧的高中比赛。
entries.sampleRaw: Uncle has this ritual of watching old high school games every weekend.

entries.source: It's like sacred sports hour, but it's just him yelling at the players on screen to 'watch the defense!'
entries.translation: 就像神圣的体育时间，只不过全程都是他在冲屏幕里的球员大喊“注意防守！”
entries.sampleRaw: It's like sacred sports hour, but it's just him yelling at the players on screen to 'watch the defense!'

entries.source: I asked Uncle for some life advice, but all I got were football X's and O's.
entries.translation: 我向叔叔请教人生建议，结果只得到一堆橄榄球战术图。
entries.sampleRaw: I asked Uncle for some life advice, but all I got were football X's and O's.

entries.source: Apparently 'anticipating your opponent's moves' applies to everything from dating to business deals.
entries.translation: 显然，“预判对手的动作”适用于从约会到商业交易的一切事情。
entries.sampleRaw: Apparently 'anticipating your opponent's moves' applies to everything from dating to business deals.

entries.source: Rabbit Dog is my best friend.
entries.translation: Rabbit Dog是我最好的朋友。
entries.sampleRaw: Rabbit Dog is my best friend.

entries.source: He is as loyal as they come, and doesn't look at me funny when I am speaking like everyone else.
entries.translation: 他忠诚得没话说，而且我像大家一样说话时，他不会用奇怪的眼神看我。
entries.sampleRaw: He is as loyal as they come, and doesn't look at me funny when I am speaking like everyone else.

entries.source: I think Coach is all brawn and no brains.
entries.translation: 我觉得教练四肢发达，头脑简单。
entries.sampleRaw: I think §dCoach §fis all brawn and no brains.

entries.source: I am the heir to the chocolate throne.
entries.translation: 我是巧克力王位的继承人。
entries.sampleRaw: I am the heir to the §6chocolate throne§f.

entries.source: The only thing in my way? You. Please hire me, boss.
entries.translation: 我唯一的阻碍？就是你。请雇我吧，老板。
entries.sampleRaw: The only thing in my way? You. Please hire me, boss.

entries.source: In life there are sharks and there are sheep.
entries.translation: 人生中既有鲨鱼，也有绵羊。
entries.sampleRaw: In life there are §csharks §fand there are §asheep§f.

entries.source: I'm a shark.
entries.translation: 我是一头鲨鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a §cshark§f.

entries.source: Well, I'm a rabbit. But you get the idea.
entries.translation: 嗯，我是只兔子。但你懂我的意思。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, I'm a rabbit. But you get the idea.

entries.source: Every day, it's a new challenge. If it's not the market, it's Sis with her picket signs.
entries.translation: 每天都是新的挑战。不是市场的事，就是西丝举着她的抗议牌。
entries.sampleRaw: Every day, it's a new challenge. If it's not the market, it's Sis with her picket signs.

entries.source: Still, we're making the world sweeter, one chocolate bar at a time.
entries.translation: 不过，我们正一块巧克力一块巧克力地让世界变得更甜蜜。
entries.sampleRaw: Still, we're making the world sweeter, one chocolate bar at a time.

entries.source: Every family has its ups and downs, but ours?
entries.translation: 每个家庭都有起起落落，但我们家呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Every family has its ups and downs, but ours?

entries.source: We've got a whole soap opera thanks to Sis.
entries.translation: 多亏了西丝，我们简直在演一整部肥皂剧。
entries.sampleRaw: We've got a whole soap opera thanks to Sis.

entries.source: Heir to the chocolate throne, they say.
entries.translation: 他们说，他是巧克力王位的继承人。
entries.sampleRaw: Heir to the §6chocolate throne§f, they say.

entries.source: More like heir to a bunch of headaches, courtesy of my own daughter's protests.
entries.translation: 更像是继承了一堆头疼事，全拜我亲生女儿的抗议所赐。
entries.sampleRaw: More like heir to a bunch of headaches, courtesy of my own daughter's protests.

entries.source: Between Bro's grindset, Cousin's relaxed approach, and Granny's wisdom, we've got all the ingredients for success.
entries.translation: 有哥哥的拼搏劲头、表弟的随性作风，还有奶奶的智慧，我们具备了成功所需的一切要素。
entries.sampleRaw: Between Bro's grindset, Cousin's relaxed approach, and Granny's wisdom, we've got all the ingredients for success.

entries.source: Now, if only Sis would see that.
entries.translation: 要是西丝能明白这一点就好了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now, if only Sis would see that.

entries.source: Bro's dedication is what this company needs more of. And Cousin, well, he brings...creativity.
entries.translation: 哥哥的敬业精神正是这家公司更需要的。至于表弟嘛，他带来了……创造力。
entries.sampleRaw: Bro's dedication is what this company needs more of. And Cousin, well, he brings...§dcreativity§f.

entries.source: Granny? She's the glue holding us all together.
entries.translation: 奶奶？她是把我们所有人凝聚在一起的粘合剂。
entries.sampleRaw: Granny? She's the glue holding us all together.

entries.source: Uncle's advice for any problem: 'Think like it's the final game, down to the last second.'
entries.translation: 叔叔对任何问题的建议都是：'就当这是最后一场比赛，坚持到最后一秒。'
entries.sampleRaw: Uncle's advice for any problem: 'Think like it's the final game, down to the last second.'

entries.source: Useful? Sometimes. Relevant? Rarely.
entries.translation: 有用吗？有时。相关吗？很少。
entries.sampleRaw: Useful? Sometimes. Relevant? Rarely.

entries.source: Trying to get through a meal without Uncle mentioning the semifinals is like trying to find a needle in a haystack.
entries.translation: 想在一顿饭里不让叔叔提起半决赛，就像大海捞针一样。
entries.sampleRaw: Trying to get through a meal without Uncle mentioning the semifinals is like trying to find a needle in a haystack.

entries.source: Impossible, but you never stop hoping.
entries.translation: 不可能，但你永远不会停止希望。
entries.sampleRaw: Impossible, but you never stop hoping.

entries.source: He might just be fetching tools or delivering messages, but Rabbit Dog's got a work ethic we could all learn from.
entries.translation: 他也许只是取工具或送信，但 Rabbit Dog 的敬业精神值得我们所有人学习。
entries.sampleRaw: He might just be fetching tools or delivering messages, but Rabbit Dog's got a work ethic we could all learn from.

entries.source: Pure, unthinking, relentless energy. Guess that's just how dogs are wired.
entries.translation: 纯粹、不加思索、不知疲倦的精力。大概狗天生就是这样吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Pure, unthinking, relentless energy. Guess that's just how dogs are wired.

entries.source: Coach could motivate a snail to enter a sprint. It's exhausting, but you've got to admire that kind of energy.
entries.translation: 教练能让蜗牛都想参加短跑。这很累人，但那种精力不得不让人佩服。
entries.sampleRaw: §dCoach §fcould motivate a snail to enter a sprint. It's exhausting, but you've got to admire that kind of energy.

entries.source: I'm looking to come out of retirement for one last job.
entries.translation: 我想结束退休生活，再接最后一单活。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm looking to come out of retirement for §done last job§f.

entries.source: Plus, I decided I don't think I could ever give up chocolate.
entries.translation: 再说，我决定了，我觉得自己永远也戒不掉巧克力。
entries.sampleRaw: Plus, I decided I don't think I could ever give up chocolate.

entries.source: The Chocolate Factory used to be different before Hoppity arrived.
entries.translation: 在 Hoppity 到来之前，巧克力工厂可不是现在这样。
entries.sampleRaw: The §6Chocolate Factory §fused to be different before §aHoppity §farrived.

entries.source: You never know that you're in the glory days until it's too late.
entries.translation: 你永远不知道身处辉煌岁月，直到为时已晚。
entries.sampleRaw: You never know that you're in the glory days until it's too late.

entries.source: Every time Hoppity talks about 'expanding the business', I remind him: 'Don't forget to expand your heart too.'
entries.translation: 每次 Hoppity 谈起'拓展业务'，我都会提醒他：'别忘了也拓展你的心。'
entries.sampleRaw: Every time §aHoppity §ftalks about 'expanding the business', I remind him: 'Don't forget to expand your heart too.'

entries.source: He's a good boy, he listens.
entries.translation: 他是个好孩子，他听得进去。
entries.sampleRaw: He's a good boy, he listens.

entries.source: In my days, we settled disputes over a hot cup of cocoa.
entries.translation: 在我那个年代，我们靠一杯热可可解决争端。
entries.sampleRaw: In my days, we settled disputes over a hot cup of cocoa.

entries.source: Maybe that's what Sis and my son need - a reminder of what binds us.
entries.translation: 也许这正是西丝和我儿子需要的——提醒他们是什么把我们联系在一起。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe that's what Sis and my son need - a reminder of what binds us.

entries.source: In my day, we made sweets from whatever was in the garden. Hoppity just added cocoa.
entries.translation: 在我那个年代，我们用花园里有什么就做什么甜点。Hoppity只是加了可可粉。
entries.sampleRaw: In my day, we made sweets from whatever was in the garden. §aHoppity §fjust added cocoa.

entries.source: Kids these days think they've invented sugar.
entries.translation: 现在的孩子还以为糖是他们发明的。
entries.sampleRaw: Kids these days think they've invented sugar.

entries.source: I've watched this family business grow from a single carrot patch to rows of cocoa trees.
entries.translation: 我看着这份家族生意从一小块胡萝卜地，长成了一排排可可树。
entries.sampleRaw: I've watched this family business grow from a single carrot patch to rows of cocoa trees.

entries.source: Each bar we produce carries that legacy. Makes an old bunny proud.
entries.translation: 我们做出的每一块巧克力都承载着这份传承。让一只老兔子倍感骄傲。
entries.sampleRaw: Each bar we produce carries that legacy. Makes an old bunny proud.

entries.source: They say you can't choose your family. But if I could, I'd choose this chocolate-crazed bunch every time.
entries.translation: 人们说家人无法选择。但如果可以，我每次都会选这群痴迷巧克力的家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: They say you can't choose your family. But if I could, I'd choose this chocolate-crazed bunch every time.

entries.source: From Dust Bowl to chocolate empire, we've come a long way.
entries.translation: 从Dust碗到巧克力帝国，我们一路走来可真不容易。
entries.sampleRaw: From Dust Bowl to chocolate empire, we've come a long way.

entries.source: Uncle insists on playing the high school fight song during our morning stretches.
entries.translation: 叔叔非要每天早上拉伸时放那首高中校队战歌。
entries.sampleRaw: Uncle insists on playing the high school fight song during our morning stretches.

entries.source: He says that it 'sets the tone'. It's charming until it's you tenth listen for the week.
entries.translation: 他说那能“定下基调”。一开始还挺有意思，直到你一周内第十次听到它。
entries.sampleRaw: He says that it 'sets the tone'. It's charming until it's you tenth listen for the week.

entries.source: That coach could talk a carrot into growing faster. It's a talent, but sometimes I just want him to turn the volume down.
entries.translation: 那位教练能把胡萝卜说得长得更快。这是种天赋，但有时候我只想让他把音量调小点。
entries.sampleRaw: That coach could talk a carrot into growing faster. It's a talent, but sometimes I just want him to turn the volume down.

entries.source: Visualize the win, then chase it down like it's the last carrot on Earth. You've got this!
entries.translation: 想象胜利的画面，然后像追逐世上最后一根胡萝卜一样去追它。你能行！
entries.sampleRaw: Visualize the win, then chase it down like it's the last carrot on Earth. You've got this!

entries.source: Sis' spirit is so fiery, I keep a bucket of water handy. Just in case her passion for change sets the place ablaze!
entries.translation: 妹妹的精神太火热了，我总备着一桶水。以防她对变革的热情把这里点着了！
entries.sampleRaw: Sis' spirit is so fiery, I keep a bucket of water handy. Just in case her passion for change sets the place ablaze!

entries.source: Legacy isn't just passing on what you've accomplished. It's inspiring the next generation to hop even further. That's what we're doing here every day!
entries.translation: 传承不只是把你取得的成就传下去。而是激励下一代跳得更远。这就是我们每天在做的事！
entries.sampleRaw: Legacy isn't just passing on what you've accomplished. It's inspiring the next generation to hop even further. That's what we're doing here every day!

entries.source: I tell Hoppity - A dream without a plan is just a wish.
entries.translation: 我告诉Hoppity——没有计划的梦想只是愿望。

没有计划的梦想只是愿望。

entries.sampleRaw: I tell §aHoppity §f- §oA dream without a plan is just a wish.

entries.source: No bunny gets left behind in productivity! Remember, every hop is a step towards success!
entries.translation: 在效率上，一只兔子都不能掉队！记住，每一次跳跃都是迈向成功的一步！
entries.sampleRaw: No bunny gets left behind in productivity! Remember, every hop is a step towards success!

entries.source: I tried showing Granny how to build muscle mass.
entries.translation: 我试着教奶奶怎么增肌。
entries.sampleRaw: I tried showing §aGranny §fhow to build muscle mass.

entries.source: Wake up! It's another glorious day to excel. If you're not moving, you're not improving. Now, hop to it!
entries.translation: 醒醒！又是出类拔萃的光辉一天。不动起来，就不会进步。现在，跳起来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Wake up! It's another glorious day to excel. If you're not moving, you're not improving. Now, hop to it!

entries.source: Rabbits, remember, the only time you should ever look back is to see how far you've hopped!
entries.translation: 兔子们，记住，你唯一该回头的时候，就是看看自己已经跳了多远！
entries.sampleRaw: Rabbits, remember, the only time you should ever look back is to see how far you've hopped!

entries.source: When it comes to keeping calm, Daddy's cooler than a cucumber in a freezer.
entries.translation: 要说保持冷静，爸爸比冰箱里的黄瓜还冷静。
entries.sampleRaw: When it comes to keeping calm, Daddy's cooler than a cucumber in a freezer.

entries.source: Sometimes I check if he's still breathing!
entries.translation: 有时候我还得确认他是不是还在呼吸！
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes I check if he's still breathing!

entries.source: Daddy's the kind of steady you need in a storm. If he was any more laid back, he'd be horizontal. But that's why we never tilt!
entries.translation: 爸爸是那种在风暴中你需要的稳重。他要是再放松点，就快躺平了。但正因如此，我们从不倾斜！
entries.sampleRaw: Daddy's the kind of steady you need in a storm. If he was any more laid back, he'd be horizontal. But that's why we never tilt!

entries.source: I start my mornings with a protein shake, then I have a mid-morning protein shake, followed by an after-lunch shake, and finish with a pre-bed shake.
entries.translation: 我早上先喝一杯蛋白奶昔，然后上午中段再来一杯，午饭后一杯，睡前再喝一杯收尾。
entries.sampleRaw: I start my mornings with a protein shake, then I have a mid-morning protein shake, followed by an after-lunch shake, and finish with a pre-bed shake.

entries.source: It's not just a routine; it's a ritual.
entries.translation: 这不只是日常安排；这是一种仪式。

entries.sampleRaw: I used to be like him, then I tore my ACL.

entries.source: My knee has never been the same since, man.
entries.translation: 从那以后我的膝盖就再也没好过，兄弟。
entries.sampleRaw: My knee has never been the same since, man.

entries.source: Cuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
entries.translation: 表弟可能没有典型运动员的自律，但他关键时刻靠得住。
entries.sampleRaw: Cuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.

entries.source: Cuz showing up to work is like a trick play.
entries.translation: 表弟来上班就像一次花式战术。
entries.sampleRaw: Cuz showing up to work is like a trick play.

entries.source: You never see it coming, and when it happens, you can't help but wonder if it was a fluke.
entries.translation: 你永远料不到，而当它发生时，你忍不住怀疑那是不是侥幸。
entries.sampleRaw: You never see it coming, and when it happens, you can't help but wonder if it was a fluke.

entries.source: Sis has that fire, like the team captains back in my day.
entries.translation: 妹妹有那股劲头，就像我当年的队长们一样。
entries.sampleRaw: Sis has that fire, like the team captains back in my day.

entries.source: She doesn't just play - she changes the game.
entries.translation: 她不只是参与比赛——她改变了比赛。
entries.sampleRaw: She doesn't just play - she changes the game.

entries.source: Always rallying the troops for her cause, much like a good quarterback does in the fourth quarter.
entries.translation: 总是为她的目标召集人马，就像优秀的四分卫在第四节所做的那样。
entries.sampleRaw: Always rallying the troops for her cause, much like a good quarterback does in the fourth quarter.

entries.source: Even the Dog's got team spirit.
entries.translation: 就连那只狗也有团队精神。
entries.sampleRaw: Even the Dog's got team spirit.

entries.source: He reminds me of our mascot back in the day. Always on the sidelines, ready to cheer us on.
entries.translation: 他让我想起我们当年的吉祥物。总是在场边，随时准备为我们加油。
entries.sampleRaw: He reminds me of our mascot back in the day. Always on the sidelines, ready to cheer us on.

entries.source: Every team needs a loyal supporter like that.
entries.translation: 每支队伍都需要这样一位忠实的支持者。
entries.sampleRaw: Every team needs a loyal supporter like that.

entries.source: I like Coach's style. My family could learn a thing or two from him.
entries.translation: 我喜欢教练的作风。我们一家人都能从他身上学到一两招。
entries.sampleRaw: I like §dCoach's §fstyle. My family could learn a thing or two from him.

entries.source: Grr...
entries.translation: 咕噜……
entries.sampleRaw: Grr...

entries.source: Ah-woo!
entries.translation: 嗷呜！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah-woo!

entries.source: Ah, Rabbit Bro, tirelessly toiling from the break of dawn, clinging to his routines with the desperation of a shipwreck survivor to a life raft.
entries.translation: 啊，Rabbit Bro，从破晓起就不辞辛劳地忙碌，像海难幸存者死死抓住救生筏一样，拼命抓住自己的日常作息。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, Rabbit Bro, tirelessly toiling from the break of dawn, clinging to his routines with the desperation of a shipwreck survivor to a life raft.

entries.source: One wonders if he runs from failure or merely jogs alongside it.
entries.translation: 不禁让人怀疑，他是在逃避失败，还是仅仅与失败并肩慢跑。
entries.sampleRaw: One wonders if he runs from failure or merely jogs alongside it.

entries.source: Observe the tranquil Rabbit Cuz, philosopher of sloth, whose profound punctuality issues suggest a man deeply at peace with life's ephemeral nature, or perhaps just deeply asleep.
entries.translation: 看看那安详的兔子表哥，懒惰的哲学家，他那严重的守时问题表明，他是个对人生短暂本质深怀平和的人，又或者只是睡得很沉。
entries.sampleRaw: Observe the tranquil Rabbit Cuz, philosopher of sloth, whose profound punctuality issues suggest a man deeply at peace with life's ephemeral nature, or perhaps just deeply asleep.

entries.source: And there strides Rabbit Sis, torchbearer of tumult, whose fervent protests might one day change the world, if they don't first incite her to single-handedly dismantle it, piece by bureaucratic piece.
entries.translation: 再看那边大步走过的Rabbit Sis，动乱的擎炬者，她那激烈的抗议有朝一日或许能改变世界——前提是它们没有先煽动她单枪匹马地把世界拆掉，一片官僚主义地拆。
entries.sampleRaw: And there strides Rabbit Sis, torchbearer of tumult, whose fervent protests might one day change the world, if they don't first incite her to single-handedly dismantle it, piece by bureaucratic piece.

entries.source: Ever observant Rabbit Daddy, guardian of the gold, manages finances with a paranoia that would make a conspiracy theorist blush.
entries.translation: 永远警觉的Rabbit Daddy，黄金的守护者，管理财务时那份多疑，足以让阴谋论者都自愧不如。
entries.sampleRaw: Ever observant Rabbit Daddy, guardian of the gold, manages finances with a paranoia that would make a conspiracy theorist blush.

entries.source: His ledger is tighter than a drum, his brow perpetually furrowed in fiscal fear.
entries.translation: 他的账本比鼓面还紧，眉头永远因财政恐惧而紧锁。
entries.sampleRaw: His ledger is tighter than a drum, his brow perpetually furrowed in fiscal fear.

entries.source: Granny, with anecdotes as endless as eternity, dispenses wisdom like a vending machine stuck on dispense, whether you requested it or not.
entries.translation: 奶奶的轶事多得如永恒般无尽，她像一台卡在出货档的自动售货机一样分发智慧，不管你需不需要。
entries.sampleRaw: Granny, with anecdotes as endless as eternity, dispenses wisdom like a vending machine stuck on dispense, whether you requested it or not.

entries.source: Each story a subtle reminder that history repeats itself, especially at family gatherings.
entries.translation: 每个故事都在微妙地提醒我们，历史会重演，尤其是在家庭聚会上。
entries.sampleRaw: Each story a subtle reminder that history repeats itself, especially at family gatherings.

entries.source: Rabbit Uncle, our nostalgic knight, battles valiantly against the inexorable march of time, jousting with memories of glory days that the rest of us suspect were rather less glorious than recounted.
entries.translation: Rabbit Uncle，我们怀旧的骑士，勇敢地与时间无情的步伐搏斗，与往昔荣光的记忆比武——而我们其余人都怀疑，那些日子远没有他讲述的那般辉煌。
entries.sampleRaw: Rabbit Uncle, our nostalgic knight, battles valiantly against the inexorable march of time, jousting with memories of glory days that the rest of us suspect were rather less glorious than recounted.

entries.source: Rabbit Coach, the relentless fountain of fervor, whose motivational speeches soar so high they often escape the grasp of practical application.
entries.translation: 兔子教练，那不知疲倦的热情喷泉，他的励志演讲飞得如此之高，往往脱离了实际应用的掌握。
entries.sampleRaw: Rabbit Coach, the relentless fountain of fervor, whose motivational speeches soar so high they often escape the grasp of practical application.

entries.source: One imagines his dreams fly similarly, unburdened by the gravity of reality.
entries.translation: 可以想象，他的梦想也同样飞翔，不受现实重力的束缚。
entries.sampleRaw: One imagines his dreams fly similarly, unburdened by the gravity of reality.

entries.source: In the pursuit of excellence, one must remember that the journey is as significant as the destination.
entries.translation: 在追求卓越的过程中，必须记住，旅程与目的地同样重要。
entries.sampleRaw: In the pursuit of excellence, one must remember that the journey is as significant as the destination.

entries.source: True success lies not in the accolades, but in the lessons learned along the way.
entries.translation: 真正的成功不在于荣誉，而在于沿途学到的教训。
entries.sampleRaw: True success lies not in the accolades, but in the lessons learned along the way.

entries.source: Empathy is the silent language of the soul, spoken through actions rather than words.
entries.translation: 共情是灵魂的无声语言，通过行动而非言语来表达。
entries.sampleRaw: Empathy is the silent language of the soul, spoken through actions rather than words.

entries.source: To truly understand another, one must listen not only with ears but with the heart.
entries.translation: 要真正理解他人，不仅要用心耳倾听，还要用心去听。
entries.sampleRaw: To truly understand another, one must listen not only with ears but with the heart.

entries.source: In every moment of decision, we stand at the crossroads of countless possibilities.
entries.translation: 在每一个抉择的时刻，我们都站在无数可能性的十字路口。
entries.sampleRaw: In every moment of decision, we stand at the crossroads of countless possibilities.

entries.source: The paths we choose not only define our destiny but also reflect the essence of our being.
entries.translation: 我们所选择的道路不仅决定了我们的命运，也映照出我们存在的本质。
entries.sampleRaw: The paths we choose not only define our destiny but also reflect the essence of our being.

entries.source: Wisdom often comes to us in whispers, through the leaves of the trees or the ripple of the waters.
entries.translation: 智慧常常以低语来到我们身边，透过树叶，或透过水面的涟漪。
entries.sampleRaw: Wisdom often comes to us in whispers, through the leaves of the trees or the ripple of the waters.

entries.source: It teaches us that every voice, no matter how small, has something of value to say.
entries.translation: 它教导我们，每一个声音，无论多么微小，都有值得倾听的价值。
entries.sampleRaw: It teaches us that every voice, no matter how small, has something of value to say.

entries.source: Solitude is not the absence of company, but the moment when our soul is free to speak to us, unencumbered by the chaos of the world.
entries.translation: 独处并非无人相伴，而是我们的灵魂得以自由地与我们对话、不受世间喧嚣牵绊的时刻。
entries.sampleRaw: Solitude is not the absence of company, but the moment when our soul is free to speak to us, unencumbered by the chaos of the world.

entries.source: The greatest paradox of life is that in seeking control, we often surrender it.
entries.translation: 人生最大的悖论在于，我们追求掌控，却往往因此交出掌控。
entries.sampleRaw: The greatest paradox of life is that in seeking control, we often surrender it.

entries.source: True power comes not from dominion over others, but from mastery over oneself.
entries.translation: 真正的力量并非来自对他人的支配，而是来自对自己的掌控。
entries.sampleRaw: True power comes not from dominion over others, but from mastery over oneself.

entries.source: Consider the possibility that limitations are merely figments of our imagination, crafted by our fears and insecurities.
entries.translation: 不妨想一想，限制也许只是我们想象的产物，由我们的恐惧与不安所塑造。
entries.sampleRaw: Consider the possibility that limitations are merely figments of our imagination, crafted by our fears and insecurities.

entries.source: To break free, one must first believe in the boundlessness of their own potential.
entries.translation: 要挣脱束缚，首先必须相信自己潜力的无限。
entries.sampleRaw: To break free, one must first believe in the boundlessness of their own potential.

entries.source: My specialites are ores, stone, and mining equipment!
entries.translation: 我的专长是矿石、石头和采矿装备！
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy specialites are ores, stone, and mining equipment!

entries.source: Hey! Come talk to me over here! I'll tell you all about racing!
entries.translation: 嘿！过来这边跟我聊聊！我会把赛跑的事全都告诉你！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey! Come talk to me over here! I'll tell you all about racing!

entries.source: There's nothing like island racing!
entries.translation: 没有什么比在岛上赛跑更棒的了！
entries.sampleRaw: There's nothing like island racing!

entries.source: Come back when you have unlocked the rest of The Park if you want to give it a try!
entries.translation: 如果你想试试，等你解锁了公园的其余部分再回来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you have unlocked the rest of §aThe Park §fif you want to give it a try!

entries.source: I've traveled many islands and this is my favorite to race on. Want to try?
entries.translation: 我去过很多岛屿，这是我最喜欢赛跑的地方。想试试吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I've traveled many islands and this is my favorite to race on. Want to try?

entries.source: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island AND come back all the way back.
entries.translation: 要完成比赛，你需要到达岛屿的另一端，然后再一路跑回来。
entries.sampleRaw: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the §eopposite side of the island §fAND come back all the way back.

entries.source: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 2 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.translation: 踩上压力板即可开始比赛。如果你能在 2 分钟内完成，我会给你奖励！祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 2 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!

entries.translation: 给你一块抛光鹅卵石。我是在附近捡到的……

entries.source: You're getting much faster!
entries.translation: 你越来越快了！
entries.sampleRaw: You're getting much faster!

entries.source: Use my Hunter Knife. Holding it somehow makes me go faster.
entries.translation: 用我的猎人小刀吧。拿着它不知怎的就能让我跑得更快。
entries.sampleRaw: Use my §aHunter Knife§f. Holding it somehow makes me go faster.

entries.source: See if you can beat 32 seconds!
entries.translation: 看看你能不能跑进 32 秒！
entries.sampleRaw: See if you can beat 32 seconds!

entries.numericTranslation: 看看你能不能跑进 {{N0}} 秒！

entries.source: Now we're cooking! You're getting close to my record!
entries.translation: 渐入佳境！你快要接近我的纪录了！
entries.sampleRaw: Now we're cooking! You're getting close to my record!

entries.source: Here's an trinket I've found in the caverns behind the waterfall.
entries.translation: 这是我在瀑布后面的洞穴里找到的一件小饰品。
entries.sampleRaw: Here's an trinket I've found in the caverns behind the waterfall.

entries.source: Finish the race in under 18 seconds and come talk to me!
entries.translation: 在 18 秒内完成比赛，然后来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Finish the race in under 18 seconds and come talk to me!
entries.numericSource: Finish the race in under {{N0}} seconds and come talk to me!

entries.sampleRaw: Real challenge! Can you finish the race in 18 seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.numericSource: Real challenge! Can you finish the race in {{N0}} seconds or less and beat my personal record?

entries.source: You did it! Congratulations, [player]. You are now faster than Gustave!
entries.translation: 你做到了!恭喜你,[player].你现在比 Gustave 还快了!
entries.sampleRaw: You did it! Congratulations, §7[player]§f. You are now faster than §aGustave§f!

entries.source: I've been racing this island so fast that some bark from the trees snatched right off!
entries.translation: 我在这个岛上跑得太快了，连树皮都被蹭下来了！
entries.sampleRaw: I've been racing this island so fast that some bark from the trees snatched right off!

entries.source: Here's a rare piece of Silky Lichen. Maybe you can do something with it.
entries.translation: 这是一块稀有的丝滑地衣。也许你能用它做点什么。
entries.sampleRaw: Here's a rare piece of §9Silky Lichen§f. Maybe you can do something with it.

entries.source: I heard this lichen could improve some weapons!
entries.translation: 我听说这种地衣能强化一些武器！
entries.sampleRaw: I heard this lichen could improve some weapons!

entries.source: There is all sorts of strange magic in this world.
entries.translation: 这个世界上有各种各样的奇异魔法.
entries.sampleRaw: There is all sorts of strange §dmagic§r in this world.

entries.source: Sometimes, experiments go wrong.
entries.translation: 有时候，实验会出错。
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes, experiments go wrong.

entries.source: But nothing that can't be repaired!
entries.translation: 但没有什么是修不好的！
entries.sampleRaw: But nothing that can't be repaired!

entries.source: There's pests everywhere. I can smell 'em in the walls!
entries.translation: 到处都是害虫。我都能闻到它们在墙里的味道！
entries.sampleRaw: There's pests everywhere. I can smell 'em in the walls!

entries.source: Thanks mate, this should help me catch 'em!
entries.translation: 谢了伙计，这应该能帮我抓住它们！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks mate, this should help me catch 'em!

entries.source: Hm, how strange.. you smell just like 'em..
entries.translation: 嗯，真奇怪……你闻起来和它们一模一样……
entries.sampleRaw: Hm, how strange.. you smell just like 'em..

entries.source: Welcome to Fruit Digging, matey!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到水果挖掘，伙计！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to §6Fruit Digging§f, matey!

entries.source: The rules of the game are as follows - I give ye a shovel, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer fruit!
entries.translation: 游戏规则如下——我给你一把铲子，你挖开沙子，留意寻找水果！
entries.sampleRaw: The rules of the game are as follows - I give ye a §ashovel§f, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer §6fruit§f!

entries.source: It might all sound a little confusin', but I bet ye'll get the hang of it if ye give it a try.
entries.translation: 听起来可能有点让人困惑，但我打赌你试一试就能上手了。
entries.sampleRaw: It might all sound a little §4confusin'§f, but I bet ye'll get the hang of it if ye give it a try.

entries.source: What do ye say?
entries.translation: 你觉得怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: What do ye say?

entries.source: Sorry lad, but ye don't have 5x Carnival Tickets. Ye gotta pay to play!
entries.translation: 抱歉小伙子，但你没有 5x 嘉年华门票。想玩就得付钱！
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry lad, but ye don't have §85x §aCarnival Tickets§f. Ye gotta pay to play!
entries.numericSource: Sorry lad, but ye don't have {{N0}}x Carnival Tickets. Ye gotta pay to play!
entries.numericTranslation: 抱歉小伙子，但你没有 {{N0}}x 嘉年华门票。想玩就得付钱！

entries.source: Ye'll have to get yer nutrients elsewhere.
entries.translation: 你得去别处获取营养了。
entries.sampleRaw: Ye'll have to get yer nutrients elsewhere.

entries.source: Whenever ye be ready, I'll be waitin'
entries.translation: 你准备好了随时来，我会等着你。
entries.sampleRaw: Whenever ye be ready, I'll be waitin'

entries.source: Blimey! The Carnival is about to close. Ye'll gotta come back next time.
entries.translation: 天哪！嘉年华就要结束了。你得下次再来。
entries.sampleRaw: Blimey! The Carnival is about to close. Ye'll gotta come back next time.

entries.source: Arrr, this server be slower than a sea turtle in a storm! No chance we be playin' this game, matey. Sorry!
entries.translation: 哎呀，这个服务器比暴风雨中的海龟还慢！我们没机会玩这个游戏了，伙计。抱歉！
entries.sampleRaw: Arrr, this server be slower than a sea turtle in a storm! No chance we be playin' this game, matey. Sorry!

entries.source: Hmm. I don't know if you've been here long enough to appreciate my artistry.
entries.translation: 嗯。我不知道你在这里待的时间是否够长，能否欣赏我的艺术。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm. I don't know if you've been here long enough to appreciate my artistry.

entries.source: Maybe come back when you have SkyBlock Level 10!
entries.translation: 也许等你达到 10 级空岛等级后再来吧!
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe come back when you have §aSkyBlock Level 10§f!
entries.numericSource: Maybe come back when you have SkyBlock Level {{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 也许等你达到 {{N0}} 级空岛等级后再来吧!

entries.source: Hello there. My name is Vincent.
entries.translation: 你好。我叫 Vincent。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello there. My name is §bVincent§f.

entries.source: I'm an artist. I believe you may be familiar with others, such as Marco and Pablo.
entries.translation: 我是一名艺术家。我想你可能认识其他几位，比如 Marco 和 Pablo。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm an artist. I believe you may be familiar with others, such as Marco and Pablo.

entries.source: Let me ask you a question - have you ever heard of dyes?
entries.translation: 让我问你一个问题——你听说过染料吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Let me ask you a question - have you ever heard of §cd§6y§ee§as§f?

entries.source: Very good, then I don't need to explain what they're used for.
entries.translation: 很好，那我就不需要解释它们的用途了。
entries.sampleRaw: Very good, then I don't need to explain what they're used for.

entries.source: However, I should probably give you some tips on how to get them...
entries.translation: 不过，我大概应该给你一些获取它们的提示……
entries.sampleRaw: However, I should probably give you some tips on how to get them...

entries.source: As a painter, I prefer to use dyes as part of my work.
entries.translation: 作为一名画家,我更喜欢用染料作为我作品的一部分.
entries.sampleRaw: As a painter, I prefer to use §cd§6y§ee§as §fas part of my work.

entries.source: Dyes drop from a variety of different parts of SkyBlock and are extremely rare, so most artists just go with the flow and work with what they have.
entries.translation: 染料会从 SkyBlock 的各个不同区域掉落，而且极其稀有，所以大多数艺术家都顺其自然，有什么就用什么。
entries.sampleRaw: Dyes drop from a variety of different parts of SkyBlock and are §cextremely rare§f, so most artists just go with the flow and work with what they have.

entries.source: However, I feel like I'm... different. Depending on what I'm painting, I need different types of dyes, but I always find exactly what I need!
entries.translation: 不过,我觉得我……与众不同.根据我在画什么,我需要不同类型的染料,但我总能找到我正好需要的东西!
entries.sampleRaw: However, I feel like I'm... different. Depending on what I'm painting, I need different types of dyes, but I §6§lalways§f find §6§lexactly what I need!

entries.source: It's almost as if the dyes I use become more common for everyone...
entries.translation: 就好像我用的染料对所有人来说都变得更常见了……
entries.sampleRaw: §oIt's almost as if the dyes I use become more common for everyone...

entries.source: Nah, that would be CRAZY.
entries.translation: 不，那也太疯狂了。
entries.sampleRaw: Nah, that would be CRAZY.

entries.source: Anyways, if you ever want to see what I'm currently painting, come speak to me again!
entries.translation: 总之，如果你想看看我目前正在画什么，再来找我吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, if you ever want to see what I'm currently painting, come speak to me again!

entries.source: For someone like you, dyes can be used to turn any kind of armor a certain color.
entries.translation: 对于像你这样的人来说,染料可以用来把任何种类的盔甲染成某种颜色.

styleMappings.can be used to turn any kind of armor a: 可以用来把任何种类的盔甲染成某种颜色.

entries.sampleRaw: For someone like you, §cd§6y§ee§as §fcan be used to turn any kind of armor a certain color.

entries.source: You can apply them in an anvil alongside any piece of armor, and it will recolor it!
entries.translation: 你可以在铁砧中将它们与任意一件盔甲一起使用，它就会重新着色！
entries.sampleRaw: You can apply them in an anvil alongside any piece of armor, and it will recolor it!

entries.source: Though it's worth noting that this will consume the dye, meaning you won't get it back afterwards.
entries.translation: 不过值得注意的是，这会消耗染料，也就是说你之后无法取回它。
entries.sampleRaw: Though it's worth noting that this will consume the dye, meaning you won't get it back afterwards.

entries.source: They don't call it a consumable for nothing!
entries.translation: 他们叫它消耗品可不是白叫的！
entries.sampleRaw: They don't call it a consumable for nothing!

entries.source: Look! I can paint with all the colors of the rainbow!
entries.translation: 看！我能用彩虹的所有颜色作画！
entries.sampleRaw: Look! I can paint with all the colors of the rainbow!

entries.source: ✆ Of all people in the village, you are the first to ask for my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 全村这么多人，你是第一个向我要联系方式的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOf all people in the village, you are the first to ask for my contact.

entries.source: ✆ Truthfully, I have been a lonely man for as long as I can remember.
entries.translation: ✆ 说实话，从我记事起，我一直是个孤独的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fTruthfully, I have been a lonely man for as long as I can remember.

entries.source: ✆ But, when I'm lonely, I make art, and it's great.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过，当我感到孤独时，我就会创作艺术，而且效果很棒。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut, when I'm lonely, I make art, and it's great.

entries.source: ✆ So, sometimes I worry, if I was to stop being lonely, what would happen to the quality of my art?
entries.translation: ✆ 所以，有时我会担心，如果我不再孤独，我的艺术质量会变成什么样？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSo, sometimes I worry, if I was to stop being lonely, what would happen to the quality of my art?

entries.source: ✆ However, I suppose, while people are a bit much, a pet wouldn't hurt.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过我想，虽然和人打交道有点累，但养只宠物应该无妨。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHowever, I suppose, while people are a bit much, a pet wouldn't hurt.

entries.source: ✆ How about a Mole Pet? I've always found them to be positively adorable.
entries.translation: ✆ 来一只Mole宠物怎么样？我一直觉得它们可爱极了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHow about a §6Mole Pet§f? I've always found them to be positively adorable.

entries.source: ✆ If you can bring me one, I'll give you my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你能给我带一只来，我就把我的联系方式给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you can bring me one, I'll give you my contact.

entries.source: ✆ Ah, thank you! Look at his little nose - what a cute fella!
entries.translation: ✆ 啊，谢谢你！看看它的小鼻子——多可爱的小家伙！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAh, thank you! Look at his little nose - what a cute fella!

entries.source: ✆ Inspiration has struck! I should paint him!
entries.translation: ✆ 灵感来了！我应该把它画下来！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fInspiration has struck! I should paint him!

entries.source: ✆ Here is my contact, now please leave me be for a while, for I must paint a masterpiece!
entries.translation: ✆ 这是我的联系方式，现在请让我清静一会儿，我得画一幅杰作！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere is my contact, now please leave me be for a while, for I must paint a §dmasterpiece§f!

entries.source: ✆ You don't have a Mole Pet in your inventory. Are you some sort of scammer?
entries.translation: ✆ 你的物品栏里没有Mole宠物。你该不会是个骗子吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have a §6Mole Pet §fin your inventory. Are you some sort of scammer?

entries.source: ✆ Hello <player>! Vincent here! Happy new year!
entries.translation: ✆ 你好，<player>！我是Vincent！新年快乐！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHello §8<player>§f! §bVincent §fhere! Happy new year!

entries.source: ✆ I just wanted to let you know that I've had a strike of inspiration and have started working on my latest masterpiece!
entries.translation: ✆ 我只是想告诉你，我灵光一闪，已经开始创作我的最新杰作了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI just wanted to let you know that I've had a strike of inspiration and have started working on my latest masterpiece!

entries.source: ✆ Here are the dyes that I will be using throughout SkyBlock Year <year>!
entries.translation: ✆ 这些是我在 SkyBlock 第 <year> 年期间要使用的染料！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere are the §cd§6y§ee§as §fthat I will be using throughout §dSkyBlock Year <year>§f!

entries.source: I decided to take a leisurely stroll in search of inspiration, and as fate would have it - I ended up here!
entries.translation: 我决定悠闲地散散步寻找灵感，结果命运使然——我来到了这里！
entries.sampleRaw: I decided to take a leisurely stroll in search of inspiration, and as fate would have it - I ended up here!

entries.source: These...these speak to me. There's something about them. You have inspired me once again!
entries.translation: 这些……这些在跟我说话。它们身上有种特别的东西。你又一次启发了我！
entries.sampleRaw: These...these speak to me. There's something about them. You have inspired me once again!

entries.source: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere. You, my friend, need to open your eyes.
entries.translation: 如果你真心热爱自然，你就会发现处处皆是美。朋友，你需要睁大眼睛。
entries.sampleRaw: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere. You, my friend, need to open your eyes.

entries.source: Interested in playin' Zombie Shootout, are ya?
entries.translation: 有兴趣玩僵尸射击吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Interested in playin' §cZombie Shootout§f, are ya?

entries.source: Ye'll get more score based on what armor the Zombie.
entries.translation: 僵尸穿的盔甲越好，你得到的分数就越高。
entries.sampleRaw: Ye'll get more score based on what armor the Zombie.

entries.source: That all make sense to ya?
entries.translation: 这些都听明白了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: That all make sense to ya?

entries.source: Sorry pal, but ya need 5x Carnival Tickets to play!
entries.translation: 抱歉伙计，你需要 5x 嘉年华门票才能玩！
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry pal, but ya need §85x §aCarnival Tickets §fto play!
entries.numericSource: Sorry pal, but ya need {{N0}}x Carnival Tickets to play!
entries.numericTranslation: 抱歉伙计，你需要 {{N0}}x 嘉年华门票才能玩！

entries.source: Guess we'll have to save it fer later.
entries.translation: 看来我们只能留到以后再玩了。
entries.sampleRaw: Guess we'll have to save it fer later.

entries.source: Aw shucks, the Carnival is about to close! Hope to see yer next time.
entries.translation: 哎呀，嘉年华就要关门了！希望下次还能见到你。
entries.sampleRaw: Aw shucks, the Carnival is about to close! Hope to see yer next time.

entries.source: This server's draggin' like a tired old mule, can't wrangle this game right now. Sorry, partner!
entries.translation: 这台服务器慢得像头疲惫的老骡子，现在没法驾驭这个游戏。抱歉，搭档！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis server's draggin' like a tired old mule, can't wrangle this game right now. Sorry, partner!

entries.source: Hey man, I just need one more vinyl to complete the full Pest Vinyl collection.
entries.translation: 嘿，老兄，我只差一张唱片就能集齐整套害虫唱片收藏了。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey man, I just need one more vinyl to complete the full Pest Vinyl collection.

entries.source: Finally! Thanks man, now I have another complete set!
entries.translation: 终于！谢了老兄，现在我又有一套完整的了！
entries.sampleRaw: Finally! Thanks man, now I have another complete set!

entries.source: Aw man, guess I'll have to look somewhere else.
entries.translation: 唉，看来我得去别处找找了。
entries.sampleRaw: Aw man, guess I'll have to look somewhere else.

entries.source: Welcome to the tavern!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到酒馆！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the tavern!

entries.source: We're known best for our Powder Pie!
entries.translation: 我们最出名的是粉末派！
entries.sampleRaw: We're known best for our §aPowder Pie§f!

entries.source: Please enjoy yer stay!
entries.translation: 请尽情享受你的时光！
entries.sampleRaw: Please enjoy yer stay!

entries.source: ✆ Eh? My Contact? On my phone?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯？我的联系方式？在我手机上？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fEh? My Contact? On my phone?

entries.source: ✆ I s'pose you could have it, if you can help me out first.
entries.translation: ✆ 我想你可以拿走它，前提是你先帮我个忙。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI s'pose you could have it, if you can help me out first.

entries.source: ✆ One night, one of my regulars got a bit rowdy and took off towards the Abandoned Quarry.
entries.translation: ✆ 有天晚上，我的一位常客喝得有点上头，一路跑向了废弃采石场。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOne night, one of my regulars got a bit rowdy and took off towards the §2Abandoned Quarry§f.

entries.source: ✆ He was carrying my most beloved antique - my Speckled Teacup.
entries.translation: ✆ 他当时带着我最心爱的古董——我的斑点茶杯。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHe was carrying my most beloved antique - my §cSpeckled Teacup§f.

entries.source: ✆ By the time I caught up with him, he had already gone and DROPPED IT into the quarry's lake!
entries.translation: ✆ 等我追上他时,他已经把它掉进采石场的湖里了!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBy the time I caught up with him, he had already gone and §lDROPPED IT §finto the quarry's lake!

entries.source: ✆ I fished about for a while, but didn't find nothin' apart from a bunch of grubbers.
entries.translation: ✆ 我在那儿钓了好一会儿，除了几条小杂鱼，什么也没捞到。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI fished about for a while, but didn't find nothin' apart from a bunch of grubbers.

entries.source: ✆ If you ever have the time, could you go to the Abandoned Quarry and fish around for my Speckled Teacup?
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你有空，能不能去废弃采石场钓一钓，帮我找回斑点茶杯？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you ever have the time, could you go to the §2Abandoned Quarry §fand fish around for my §cSpeckled Teacup§f?

entries.source: ✆ If you manage to find it, bring it back here and I'll be happy to give you my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你能找到它，把它带回来，我很乐意把我的联系方式给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you manage to find it, bring it back here and I'll be happy to give you my contact.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have my beloved Speckled Teacup...
entries.translation: ✆ 你身上没有我心爱的斑点茶杯……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have my beloved §cSpeckled Teacup...

entries.source: It's definitely still floating about in the waters of the Abandoned Quarry somewhere...
entries.translation: 它肯定还漂在废弃采石场的某处水面上……
entries.sampleRaw: It's definitely still floating about in the waters of the §2Abandoned Quarry§f somewhere...

entries.source: ✆ You found it! My Speckled Teacup! How amazing!
entries.translation: ✆ 你找到了！我的斑点茶杯！太棒了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou found it! My §cSpeckled Teacup§f! How amazing!

entries.source: ✆ Lesson learned, I'm never letting anyone borrow it ever again - even my regulars!
entries.translation: ✆ 吸取教训了，我再也不会让任何人借走它——哪怕是常客也不行！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLesson learned, I'm never letting anyone borrow it ever again - even my regulars!

entries.source: ✆ Thanks for the help, here's my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 谢谢你的帮忙，这是我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThanks for the help, here's my contact.

entries.source: ✆ The usual?
entries.translation: ✆ 还是老样子？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe usual?

entries.source: I am Oruo The Almighty. I have lived many lives. I have ascended.
entries.translation: 我是 Oruo The Almighty。我已历经多世。我已飞升。
entries.sampleRaw: I am §cOruo The Almighty§f. I have lived many lives. I have ascended.

entries.source: I have control over the Blessing of Time.
entries.translation: 我掌控着时间祝福。
entries.sampleRaw: I have control over the §9Blessing of Time§f.

entries.source: In this place where time has no meaning, I created a zone where time is everything.
entries.translation: 在这个时间毫无意义的地方,我创造了一个时间就是一切的区域.
entries.sampleRaw: In this place where time §f§ohas no meaning§f, I created a zone where time §6§ois everything§f.

entries.source: It is the only room in The Rift where your body will feel the effects of Time.
entries.translation: 这是裂隙维度中唯一一个你的身体能感受到时间效果的房间。
entries.sampleRaw: It is the only room in §dThe Rift §fwhere your body will feel the effects of §aTime§f.

entries.source: In this Time Chamber, you will be able to train and get stronger.
entries.translation: 在这个时间密室里，你可以进行训练并变得更强。
entries.sampleRaw: In this §aTime Chamber§f, you will be able to train and get stronger.

entries.source: Entry demands 5,000 Motes, a trivial sum for a taste of eternity.
entries.translation: 入场需要 5,000 裂隙尘埃，这点小钱就能让你尝到永恒的滋味。
entries.sampleRaw: Entry demands §d5,000 Motes§f, a trivial sum for a taste of eternity.
entries.numericSource: Entry demands {{N0}} Motes, a trivial sum for a taste of eternity.
entries.numericTranslation: 入场需要 {{N0}} 裂隙尘埃，这点小钱就能让你尝到永恒的滋味。

entries.source: Though beware, for your ф Rift Time shall deplete twice as fast.
entries.translation: 但要当心,你的 ф 裂隙时间会以两倍速度消耗.
entries.sampleRaw: Though beware, for your §aф Rift Time §fshall deplete §ctwice as fast§f.

entries.source: What say you?
entries.translation: 你怎么说？
entries.sampleRaw: What say you?

entries.source: You only delay the inevitable.
entries.translation: 你只是在拖延不可避免之事。
entries.sampleRaw: You only delay the inevitable.

entries.source: A deity, you ponder?
entries.translation: 你在想，我是不是神明？
entries.sampleRaw: A deity, you ponder?

entries.source: I am but a seeker who stumbled upon the Blessing of Time hidden within the veils of this dimension.
entries.translation: 我不过是一名探寻者，偶然发现了隐藏在此维度帷幕之中的时间祝福。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am but a seeker who stumbled upon the §9Blessing of Time §fhidden within the veils of this dimension.

entries.source: My partner, Sun Gecko, and I discovered the Blessing of Time together.
entries.translation: 我的搭档Sun Gecko和我一同发现了时间祝福。
entries.sampleRaw: My partner, §eSun Gecko§f, and I discovered the §9Blessing of Time §ftogether.

entries.source: The fates decreed that only one could wield its power.
entries.translation: 命运注定只有一人能驾驭它的力量。
entries.sampleRaw: The fates decreed that only one could wield its power.

entries.source: It was I who was chosen, and thus I crafted this chamber so he could train against people such as yourself.
entries.translation: 被选中的人是我，因此我建造了这座密室，好让他能与你这样的人切磋训练。
entries.sampleRaw: It was I who was chosen, and thus I crafted this chamber so he could train against people such as yourself.

entries.source: He must become stronger, in preparation for a hardship that has yet to come.
entries.translation: 他必须变得更强，为尚未到来的艰难做好准备。
entries.sampleRaw: He must become stronger, in preparation for a hardship that has yet to come.

entries.source: The Precursors, you inquire?
entries.translation: 你问的是先驱者？
entries.sampleRaw: The §9Precursors§f, you inquire?

entries.source: Through the Blessing of Time I have earned the knowledge and memories of the ancient God of Time.
entries.translation: 借由时间祝福，我获得了古代时间之神的知识与记忆。
entries.sampleRaw: Through the §9Blessing of Time §fI have earned the knowledge and memories of the ancient §9God of Time§f.

entries.source: I have seen what no man has seen.
entries.translation: 我见过无人见过之物。
entries.sampleRaw: I have seen what no man has seen.

entries.source: The shadows of their return soon loom over us; we must stand prepared.
entries.translation: 他们归来的阴影很快将笼罩我们；我们必须做好准备。
entries.sampleRaw: The shadows of their return soon loom over us; we must stand prepared.

entries.source: Julian seeks me, yet he knows not the full scope of the web woven by Shen, his own master.
entries.translation: Julian在找我，但他并不清楚他的主人Shen所织之网的全貌。
entries.sampleRaw: Julian seeks me, yet he knows not the full scope of the web woven by Shen, his own master.

entries.source: If he finds his way through the labyrinth of time to my domain, it will be my duty to enlighten him.
entries.translation: 若他能穿越时间的迷宫来到我的领域，点醒他便是我的职责。
entries.sampleRaw: If he finds his way through the labyrinth of time to my domain, it will be my duty to enlighten him.

entries.source: I will unveil the intricate plots of Shen and his organization.
entries.translation: 我将揭开Shen及其组织的错综阴谋。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI will unveil the intricate plots of Shen and his organization.

entries.source: That knowledge, crucial and potent, may well tilt the scales of Destiny.
entries.translation: 那份至关重要而强大的知识，或许足以扭转命运的秤盘。
entries.sampleRaw: That knowledge, crucial and potent, may well tilt the scales of Destiny.

entries.source: Magnificent. You have vanquished Sun Gecko, not a feat to be understated.
entries.translation: 精彩。你击败了Sun Gecko，这绝非可轻描淡写的壮举。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMagnificent. You have vanquished §eSun Gecko§f, not a feat to be understated.

entries.source: While moments have passed for you, weeks have slipped by for Sun Gecko.
entries.translation: 对你而言不过片刻，对Sun Gecko而言却已过去数周。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhile moments have passed for you, weeks have slipped by for §eSun Gecko§f.

entries.source: He lies in rest, rejuvenated and eager for your return.
entries.translation: 他正在休憩，已恢复元气，并期盼着你的归来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe lies in rest, rejuvenated and eager for your return.

entries.source: The price for reentry remains at 5,000 Motes.
entries.translation: 再次进入的价格仍为5,000裂隙尘埃.
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe price for reentry remains at §d5,000 Motes§f.
entries.numericSource: The price for reentry remains at {{N0}} Motes.
entries.numericTranslation: 再次进入的价格仍为{{N0}}裂隙尘埃.

entries.source: Dare you pay it?
entries.translation: 你敢支付吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fDare you pay it?

entries.source: Your strength prevails, but your journey has only just begun.
entries.translation: 你的力量占了上风，但你的旅程才刚刚开始。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYour strength prevails, but your journey has only just begun.

entries.source: You are now granted access to Time Chamber Modifiers and the Sun Gecko Essence Shop.
entries.translation: 你现在可以使用时间密室修正与太阳壁虎精华商店了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou are now granted access to §aTime Chamber Modifiers§f and the §eSun Gecko Essence Shop§f.

entries.source: The power of Sun Gecko is only limited by your own resolve.
entries.translation: Sun Gecko的力量只受你自己的决心所限。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe power of §eSun Gecko §fis only limited by your own resolve.

entries.source: Work the Modifiers of the Time Chamber, and your strength will know no bounds.
entries.translation: 善用时间密室的修正，你的力量将无可限量。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWork the §aModifiers §fof the §aTime Chamber§f, and your strength will know no bounds.

entries.source: Magnificent, you have vanquished Sun Gecko, not a feat to be understated.
entries.translation: 精彩，你击败了Sun Gecko，这绝非可轻描淡写的壮举。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMagnificent, you have vanquished §eSun Gecko§f, not a feat to be understated.

entries.source: Shall you challenge him again?
entries.translation: 你要再次挑战他吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fShall you challenge him again?

entries.source: Once more you have triumphed over Sun Gecko. Such perseverance is rare, even in Tales of old.
entries.translation: 你再次战胜了Sun Gecko。这般毅力实属罕见，即便在古老的传说中也是如此。
entries.sampleRaw: Once more you have triumphed over §eSun Gecko§f. Such perseverance is rare, even in Tales of old.

entries.source: A third victory! You have surpassed even my expectations.
entries.translation: 第三次胜利！你甚至超越了我的期望。
entries.sampleRaw: A third victory! You have surpassed even my expectations.

entries.source: Though Sun Gecko's power grows more daunting, you have found a way through once again.
entries.translation: 尽管Sun Gecko的力量愈发令人生畏,你又一次找到了取胜之道.
entries.sampleRaw: Though §eSun Gecko§f's power grows more daunting, you have found a way through once again.

entries.source: Sun Gecko's intensity thundered across the battlefield, yet your will stood firm, forging a triumph that whispers of greatness yet untold.
entries.translation: Sun Gecko的威势如雷般席卷战场,但你的意志岿然不动,铸就了一场低语着未传伟大之名的胜利.
entries.sampleRaw: §eSun Gecko§f's intensity thundered across the battlefield, yet your will stood firm, forging a triumph that whispers of greatness yet untold.

entries.source: Sun Gecko pressed against the very limits of mortal endurance, yet today you sculpted a victory from raw chaos.
entries.translation: Sun Gecko已逼近凡人耐力的极限，但今日你从混沌中雕琢出了一场胜利。
entries.sampleRaw: §eSun Gecko §fpressed against the very limits of mortal endurance, yet today you sculpted a victory from raw chaos.

entries.source: As Sun Gecko unleashed deeper reserves of power, you carved a new mark of valor into the shifting sands of time.
entries.translation: 当Sun Gecko释放出更深层的力量时，你在流转的时光沙海中刻下了新的英勇印记。
entries.sampleRaw: As §eSun Gecko §funleashed deeper reserves of power, you carved a new mark of valor into the shifting sands of time.

entries.source: At the apex of Sun Gecko's power, when all seemed unattainable, you forged a moment of legend that will echo through ages.
entries.translation: 在Sun Gecko力量的巅峰,当一切看似遥不可及时,你铸就了一个将回响千古的传奇时刻.
entries.sampleRaw: At the apex of §eSun Gecko§f's power, when all seemed unattainable, you forged a moment of legend that will echo through ages.

entries.source: Your trials here have woven a portion of the Blessing of Time into the very fibers of your being.
entries.translation: 你在此处的试炼已将一部分时间祝福编织进你身体的每一寸纤维。
entries.sampleRaw: Your trials here have woven a portion of the §9Blessing of Time §finto the very fibers of your being.

entries.source: Stronger you stand, bearing the vigor of both this realm and yours.
entries.translation: 你站得更加强大，承载着此界与你自身世界的活力。
entries.sampleRaw: Stronger you stand, bearing the vigor of both §5this realm §fand §ayours§f.

entries.source: Feel the surge of power coursing through your veins, a testament to your enduring spirit and the time spent within these walls.
entries.translation: 感受力量在你血管中奔涌，这是你不屈精神与在这些墙壁内所度时光的见证。
entries.sampleRaw: Feel the surge of power coursing through your veins, a testament to your enduring spirit and the time spent within these walls.

entries.source: You have now absorbed a second measure of the Blessing of Time.
entries.translation: 你现在已吸收了第二份时间祝福。
entries.sampleRaw: You have now absorbed a §asecond §fmeasure of the §9Blessing of Time§f.

entries.source: You have now received the final Blessing of Time.
entries.translation: 你现在已获得最终的时间祝福。
entries.sampleRaw: You have now received the final §9Blessing of Time§f.

entries.source: Congratulations on mastering the trials of my Time Chamber.
entries.translation: 恭喜你掌握了我时间密室的试炼。
entries.sampleRaw: Congratulations on mastering the trials of my §aTime Chamber§f.

entries.source: With the final Blessing, our contract is fulfilled, thrice granted, and thrice received.
entries.translation: 随着最终的祝福，我们的契约已履行，三度赐予，三度领受。
entries.sampleRaw: With the final §9Blessing§f, our contract is fulfilled, thrice granted, and thrice received.

entries.source: Rest now, for you have earned it.
entries.translation: 现在休息吧，这是你应得的。
entries.sampleRaw: Rest now, for you have earned it.

entries.source: With less than 120ф Rift Time remaining, your risk outweighs the reward.
entries.translation: 裂隙时间剩余不足 120ф 时,你的风险会超过收益.
entries.sampleRaw: §fWith less than §a120§aф Rift Time§f remaining, your risk outweighs the reward.
entries.numericSource: With less than {{N0}}ф Rift Time remaining, your risk outweighs the reward.
entries.numericTranslation: 裂隙时间剩余不足 {{N0}}ф 时,你的风险会超过收益.

entries.source: I cannot permit you to enter.
entries.translation: 我不能允许你进入。
entries.sampleRaw: I cannot permit you to enter.

entries.source: Oruo's Time Chamber demands more than just fleeting moments.
entries.translation: 奥鲁的时间密室要求的不仅仅是转瞬即逝的片刻。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Oruo's Time Chamber §fdemands more than just fleeting moments.

entries.source: Your motes purse is not as strong as your will.
entries.translation: 你的裂隙尘埃钱袋可不如你的意志那般雄厚。
entries.sampleRaw: Your motes purse is not as strong as your will.

entries.source: Oruo's Time Chamber demands sacrifice.
entries.translation: 奥鲁的时间密室要求献祭。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Oruo's Time Chamber §fdemands sacrifice.

entries.source: In order to access the Time Chamber, you must be closer to its entrance. Please move closer to the Continuum.
entries.translation: 要进入时间密室，你必须离入口更近。请靠近连续时空。
entries.sampleRaw: In order to access the §aTime Chamber§f, you must be closer to its entrance. Please move closer to the §5Continuum§f.

entries.source: Interesting. The Time Chamber is not currently available.
entries.translation: 有趣。时间密室目前不可用。
entries.sampleRaw: Interesting. The Time Chamber is not currently available.

entries.source: Let us train together, <player>.
entries.translation: 让我们一起训练吧,<player>.
entries.sampleRaw: Let us train together, §7<player>§7.

entries.source: Yes, yes, I know why you're here.
entries.translation: 是的，是的，我知道你为什么来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYes, yes, I know why you're here.

entries.source: You think I'm an Enigma Soul.
entries.translation: 你以为我是恩尼格玛之魂。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou think I'm an §5Enigma Soul§f.

entries.source: Well, in a way I was, but not anymore.
entries.translation: 嗯，某种意义上我曾经是，但现在不是了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell, in a way I was, but not anymore.

entries.source: Many objects around here have become sentient. We're just living our lives now.
entries.translation: 这附近的许多物体都获得了意识。我们现在只是在过自己的生活。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMany objects around here have become sentient. We're just living our lives now.

entries.source: Thanks.
entries.translation: 谢谢。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThanks.

entries.source: I won't give you an Enigma Soul, you know.
entries.translation: 你知道，我不会给你恩尼格玛之魂的。
entries.sampleRaw: I won't give you an §5Enigma Soul§f, you know.

entries.source: There's nothing for you here.
entries.translation: 这里没有你要找的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: There's nothing for you here.

entries.source: I'm really not an Enigma Soul.
entries.translation: 我真的不是恩尼格玛之魂。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm really not an §5Enigma Soul§f.

entries.source: Please leave me alone now.
entries.translation: 现在请别打扰我了。
entries.sampleRaw: Please leave me alone now.

entries.source: Oi! Hands off, treasure hunter!
entries.translation: 喂！别碰，寻宝者！
entries.sampleRaw: §fOi! Hands off, treasure hunter!

entries.source: Brilliant deduction! Next thing you'll tell me water's wet.
entries.translation: 好一个精彩的推理！接下来你是不是要告诉我水是湿的。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBrilliant deduction! Next thing you'll tell me water's wet.

entries.source: Honestly, the nerve of some people. See something shiny and think it's theirs for the taking!
entries.translation: 说真的，有些人真是胆大包天。看到闪闪发光的东西就以为是自己的囊中之物！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHonestly, the nerve of some people. See something shiny and think it's theirs for the taking!

entries.source: Lying there?
entries.translation: 躺在那儿？
entries.sampleRaw: §fLying there?

entries.source: Excuse me, I was enjoying some peace and quiet, contemplating the sedimentary layers.
entries.translation: 打扰一下，我正享受着片刻的宁静，思考着沉积岩层。
entries.sampleRaw: §fExcuse me, I was enjoying some peace and quiet, contemplating the sedimentary layers.

entries.source: But since you've disturbed my geological meditation, perhaps we can make this interruption worthwhile.
entries.translation: 但既然你打扰了我的地质冥想，也许我们可以让这次打扰变得有价值。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut since you've disturbed my geological meditation, perhaps we can make this interruption worthwhile.

entries.source: I happen to run a little business, Care to browse the finest selection of pickaxes this side of the bedrock?
entries.translation: 我正好经营着一家小生意，想不想看看基岩这一侧最精良的镐子精选？
entries.sampleRaw: §fI happen to run a little business, Care to browse the finest selection of pickaxes this side of the bedrock?

entries.source: Who better to trust with your mining needs? Would you buy a sword from a plow?
entries.translation: 在采矿需求上还有谁比我更值得信赖？你会从犁那里买剑吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWho better to trust with your mining needs? Would you buy a sword from a plow?

entries.source: Of course I do! I'm sharp in more ways than one.
entries.translation: 当然会！我可不只在一种意义上很锋利。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOf course I do! I'm sharp in more ways than one.

entries.source: Anyways, if you are done talking to a tool, let's get you geared up.
entries.translation: 总之，如果你跟一件工具聊完了，咱们就来给你置办装备吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnyways, if you are done talking to a tool, let's get you geared up.

entries.source: Welcome to the Woodlands!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到林地！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the Woodlands!

entries.source: I use all sorts of wood types to create strong and useful items!
entries.translation: 我用各种木材制作坚固又实用的物品！
entries.sampleRaw: I use all sorts of wood types to create strong and useful items!

entries.source: Here. Check them out!
entries.translation: 给。看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Here. Check them out!

entries.source: Recruit, please scavenge the island for any food you can find.
entries.translation: 新兵，请在这座岛上搜寻你能找到的任何食物。
entries.sampleRaw: Recruit, please scavenge the island for any food you can find.

entries.source: Satisfactory job, recruit.
entries.translation: 干得不错，新兵。
entries.sampleRaw: Satisfactory job, recruit.

entries.source: If I could demote you any further I would, recruit.
entries.translation: 要是还能再给你降级，我一定会这么做的，新兵。
entries.sampleRaw: If I could demote you any further I would, recruit.

entries.source: I seek a particular miner.
entries.translation: 我在寻找一位特定的矿工。
entries.sampleRaw: I seek a particular §bminer§f.

entries.source: Reflected in this mirror... could that be you?
entries.translation: 映在这面镜子里……那会是你吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Reflected in this mirror... could that be you?

entries.source: Confirm your identity for me.
entries.translation: 向我确认你的身份。
entries.sampleRaw: Confirm your identity for me.

entries.source: From beyond the mirror, wear a similar set of mining gear, or stronger.
entries.translation: 从镜子彼端，穿戴一套相似的采矿装备，或者更强。
entries.sampleRaw: From beyond the mirror, wear a similar set of mining gear, or §ostronger§f.

entries.source: Then, crouch twice.
entries.translation: 然后，蹲下两次。
entries.sampleRaw: Then, §ccrouch twice§f.

entries.source: Very well.
entries.translation: 很好。
entries.sampleRaw: Very well.

entries.source: You've proven your identity.
entries.translation: 你已经证明了你的身份。
entries.sampleRaw: You've proven your identity.

entries.source: Here, accept this offering.
entries.translation: 给，收下这份供品。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, accept this offering.

entries.source: Perhaps you are the one my master seeks.
entries.translation: 也许你就是我主人所寻找的那个人。
entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps you are the one my master seeks.

entries.source: Welcome, [player]!
entries.translation: 欢迎,[player]!
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome, §7[player]§f!

entries.source: We meet across the strands of space and time. I was waiting for you.
entries.translation: 我们跨越时空的丝线相遇。我一直在等你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe meet across the strands of space and time. I was §5waiting §ffor you.

entries.source: You might not know me, Ubik Von Neumann, a moniker that resonates through the echelons of intellect.
entries.translation: 你可能不认识我，Ubik Von Neumann，一个在智慧阶层中回响的名号。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou might not know me, Ubik Von Neumann, a moniker that resonates through the echelons of intellect.

entries.source: I am the smartest man that ever lived.
entries.translation: 我是有史以来最聪明的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am the smartest man that ever lived.

entries.source: My IQ is above 200, my mind is a crucible of infinite possibilities.
entries.translation: 我的智商高于 200，我的头脑是无限可能的熔炉。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy IQ is above §9200§f, my mind is a crucible of infinite possibilities.
entries.numericSource: My IQ is above {{N0}}, my mind is a crucible of infinite possibilities.
entries.numericTranslation: 我的智商高于 {{N0}}，我的头脑是无限可能的熔炉。

entries.source: If you made it this far, it means yours is at least 100, a notable intellect, perhaps not quantum, but commendable nonetheless.
entries.translation: 如果你能走到这一步，说明你的智商至少也有 100，是个值得注意的才智，或许算不上量子级，但依然值得称赞。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you made it this far, it means yours is at least §9100§f, a notable intellect, perhaps not quantum, but commendable nonetheless.
entries.numericSource: If you made it this far, it means yours is at least {{N0}}, a notable intellect, perhaps not quantum, but commendable nonetheless.
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你能走到这一步，说明你的智商至少也有 {{N0}}，是个值得注意的才智，或许算不上量子级，但依然值得称赞。

entries.source: Unless you were guided...
entries.translation: 除非你是被人引导来的……
entries.sampleRaw: §b§oUnless you were guided...

entries.source: But intellect is not merely inherited; it is challenged, honed, and expanded.
entries.translation: 但才智并非仅仅来自遗传；它需要被挑战、被磨砺、被拓展。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut intellect is not merely inherited; it is challenged, honed, and expanded.

entries.source: I need to figure out just how smart you are.
entries.translation: 我需要弄清楚你到底有多聪明。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI need to figure out just how smart you are.

entries.source: Have you yet noticed these 3 boxes next to me?
entries.translation: 你注意到我旁边的这 3 个箱子了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave you yet noticed these 3 boxes next to me?
entries.numericSource: Have you yet noticed these {{N0}} boxes next to me?
entries.numericTranslation: 你注意到我旁边的这 {{N0}} 个箱子了吗？

entries.source: Only one contains something invaluable; an IQ Point, a testament to wisdom.
entries.translation: 只有其中一个装着无价之物;一个智商点,智慧的证明.
entries.sampleRaw: §fOnly §aone §fcontains something invaluable; an §fIQ Point§f, a testament to wisdom.

entries.source: The other two are empty.
entries.translation: 另外两个是空的。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe other §ctwo §fare empty.

entries.source: You desire this IQ Point. It symbolizes an enhancement of your cognitive arsenal.
entries.translation: 你渴望这个智商点。它象征着你认知武库的增强。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou desire this §fIQ Point§f. It symbolizes an enhancement of your cognitive arsenal.

entries.source: But you can only open one of these boxes.
entries.translation: 但你只能打开其中一个箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut you can only open one of these boxes.

entries.source: Please select the one you wish to open.
entries.translation: 请选择你想打开的那个。
entries.sampleRaw: §fPlease select the one you wish to open.

entries.source: Welcome back, [player]. The game awaits your strategic touch.
entries.translation: 欢迎回来,[player].游戏正等待你的策略之举.
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome back, §7[player]§f. The game awaits your strategic touch.

entries.source: Please choose your box.
entries.translation: 请选择你的箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fPlease choose your box.

entries.source: One of the boxes holds an IQ Point.
entries.translation: 其中一个箱子里装着一个智商点.

其中一个箱子里装着一个智商点.

entries.sampleRaw: §aOne §fof the boxes holds an §fIQ Point§f.

entries.source: But the other two are empty.
entries.translation: 但另外两个是空的。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut the other §ctwo §fare empty.

entries.source: You may only open one of the boxes.
entries.translation: 你只能打开其中一个箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou may only open one of the boxes.

entries.source: You selected the [first\/second\/third] box.
entries.translation: 你选择了[first\/second\/third]盒子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou selected the §6[first\/second\/third]§f box.

entries.source: Hopefully you didn't think too much about this choice, as it is quite irrelevant.
entries.translation: 希望你没有在这个选择上想太多，因为它其实无关紧要。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHopefully you didn't think too much about this choice, as it is quite irrelevant.

entries.source: I myself know where the IQ Point is. Watch as I open a box that I know is empty.
entries.translation: 我自己知道智商点在哪里。看好了，我要打开一个我明知是空的箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI myself know where the §eIQ Point §fis. Watch as I open a box that I know is empty.

entries.source: As the empty box stands revealed, consider your next move carefully.
entries.translation: 空箱子已经揭晓，请仔细考虑你的下一步。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAs the empty box stands revealed, consider your next move carefully.

entries.source: Will you keep the box you opened, or will you switch to the other?
entries.translation: 你会保留你打开的箱子，还是换到另一个？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWill you §akeep §fthe box you opened, or will you §cswitch§f to the other?

entries.source: Please choose the box you want to open.
entries.translation: 请选择你想打开的箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fPlease choose the box you want to open.

entries.source: You chose the [first\/second\/third] box. Let's open another box.
entries.translation: 你选择了[first\/second\/third]盒子。我们再开一个盒子吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou chose the §6[first\/second\/third]§f box. Let's open another box.

entries.source: This box is already opened.
entries.translation: 这个箱子已经打开了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis box is already opened.

entries.source: You may not have 100 IQ after all...
entries.translation: 看来你终究没有 100 的智商……
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou may not have 100 IQ after all...
entries.numericSource: You may not have {{N0}} IQ after all...
entries.numericTranslation: 看来你终究没有 {{N0}} 的智商……

entries.source: You have chosen to keep the box you originally selected.
entries.translation: 你选择保留最初选中的箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou have chosen to keep the box you originally selected.

entries.source: Let's open the box.
entries.translation: 我们来打开箱子吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fLet's open the box.

entries.source: You did not find the IQ Point.
entries.translation: 你没有找到智商点。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou did not find the §fIQ Point.

entries.source: After due time, come back to play again.
entries.translation: 过段时间后，再回来玩吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAfter due time, come back to play again.

entries.source: Congratulations, you got the reward.
entries.translation: 恭喜，你获得了奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: §fCongratulations, you got the reward.

entries.source: But did you make the right decision?
entries.translation: 但你做出了正确的决定吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut did you make the right decision?

entries.source: Time will tell.
entries.translation: 时间会证明一切。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTime will tell.

entries.source: But you already beat my game previously.
entries.translation: 但你之前已经赢过我的游戏了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut you already beat my game previously.

entries.source: Why did you decide to keep this time?
entries.translation: 这次你为什么决定保留？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhy did you decide to keep this time?

entries.source: Your curiosity serves you well.
entries.translation: 你的好奇心对你大有裨益。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYour curiosity serves you well.

entries.source: But remember, every choice has consequences.
entries.translation: 但请记住，每个选择都有后果。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut remember, every choice has consequences.

entries.source: When ready, the game will await your return.
entries.translation: 准备好后，游戏将等待你的归来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhen ready, the game will await your return.

entries.source: Then you lied to me.
entries.translation: 那你对我撒了谎。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen you lied to me.

entries.source: Understanding is a journey, not a destination.
entries.translation: 理解是一段旅程，而非终点。
entries.sampleRaw: §fUnderstanding is a journey, not a destination.

entries.source: Rest assured, this game's integrity is as solid as quantum mechanics.
entries.translation: 请放心，这个游戏的公正性如同量子力学一样坚实。
entries.sampleRaw: §fRest assured, this game's integrity is as solid as quantum mechanics.

entries.source: The correct box is decided before you even talk to me.
entries.translation: 正确的箱子在你与我交谈之前就已决定。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe correct box is decided before you even talk to me.

entries.source: Sometimes silence speaks louder than words.
entries.translation: 有时沉默胜过言语。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSometimes silence speaks louder than words.

entries.source: Your reasons are yours alone.
entries.translation: 你的理由只属于你自己。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYour reasons are yours alone.

entries.source: You have chosen to swap to the other box.
entries.translation: 你选择换到另一个箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou have chosen to swap to the other box.

entries.source: Alas, the reward was not within your grasp this time.
entries.translation: 唉，这次奖励与你失之交臂。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAlas, the reward was not within your grasp this time.

entries.source: Yet fret not, for every challenge is but a prelude to your next triumph.
entries.translation: 但不必烦恼，因为每一次挑战都只是你下一次胜利的序曲。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYet fret not, for every challenge is but a prelude to your next triumph.

entries.source: You can always come back and play my game again later.
entries.translation: 你随时可以回来再玩我的游戏。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can always come back and play my game again later.

entries.source: Congratulations, you got the IQ Point.
entries.translation: 恭喜，你获得了智商点。
entries.sampleRaw: §fCongratulations, you got the §fIQ Point.

entries.source: Much like time, the game will always be here, testing the limits of your ingenuity.
entries.translation: 就像时间一样，游戏会一直在这里，考验你智慧的极限。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMuch like time, the game will always be here, testing the limits of your ingenuity.

entries.source: Inquire me this, what prompted your decision to switch boxes?
entries.translation: 我问你，是什么促使你决定换箱子？
entries.sampleRaw: §fInquire me this, what prompted your decision to switch boxes?

entries.source: I see.
entries.translation: 我明白了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI see.

entries.source: Good day to you squire!

entries.source: You alright there, my friend?

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou alright there, my friend?
