entries.sampleRaw: §fI don't see many people 'round these parts. Probably the smell of the place that drives them away, I'd think.

entries.source: Some nasty spill happened a while ago, and ever since people 'ave been dumping their trash in the river.
entries.translation: 前阵子发生了一次严重的泄漏，从那以后人们就一直往河里倒垃圾。

entries.source: Anyways, if you want to help with the cleaning effort, take this Junk Sinker and get fishin'!

entries.translation: 快，帮我对付这个寒冰射手！
entries.sampleRaw: Quick, help me deal with this §cChillshot§f!

entries.source: Weaken it, but do not kill it! Punch it towards my Black Hole!
entries.translation: 削弱它，但别杀死它！把它打向我的黑洞！
entries.sampleRaw: §aWeaken it§f, but §cdo not kill it§f! Punch it towards my §5Black Hole§f!

entries.source: Monsters here only take damage from axes!
entries.translation: 这里的怪物只会受到斧头的伤害！
entries.sampleRaw: Monsters here only take damage from §aaxes§f!

entries.source: Use your Huntaxe on them!
entries.translation: 用你的狩猎斧对付它们！
entries.sampleRaw: §fUse your §aHuntaxe §fon them!

entries.source: You can only damage it using an Huntaxe!
entries.translation: 你只能用狩猎斧伤害它！
entries.sampleRaw: You can only damage it using an §aHuntaxe§f!

entries.source: Great work! You handled that Chillshot like a professional hunter!
entries.translation: 干得好！你对付那只寒冰射手就像个专业猎人！
entries.sampleRaw: Great work! You handled that §cChillshot §flike a professional hunter!

entries.source: As you saw, the best way to deal with monsters here is to use a Black Hole.
entries.translation: 如你所见，对付这里的怪物最好的办法就是使用黑洞。
entries.sampleRaw: As you saw, the best way to deal with monsters here is to use a §5Black Hole§f.

entries.source: If you'd like one, you can purchase a Pocket Black Hole from Albert over in the village.
entries.translation: 如果你想要一个，可以去村庄里找Albert购买便携黑洞。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you'd like one, you can purchase a §5Pocket Black Hole§f from §bAlbert§f over in the village.

entries.source: As you can see, the best way to hunt Combat creatures is with a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.translation: 如你所见，狩猎战斗生物的最佳方式就是使用便携黑洞。
entries.sampleRaw: As you can see, the best way to hunt §cCombat §fcreatures is with a §5Pocket Black Hole§f.

entries.source: If you want one, you should go talk to Albert, in the Village.
entries.translation: 如果你想要一个，应该去村庄找Albert谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want one, you should go talk to §bAlbert§f, in the Village.

entries.source: I'm still trying to hone my Hunting Skills.
entries.translation: 我还在努力磨练我的狩猎技能。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm still trying to hone my Hunting Skills.

entries.source: <player>! Have you talked to Hina at the front of the island to get your hands on a Heart of the Forest?
entries.translation: <player>！你和岛前方的Hina谈过了吗？去弄一个森林之心吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player>§f! Have you talked to §bHina §fat the front of the island to get your hands on a §aHeart of the Forest§f?

entries.source: Hello!
entries.translation: 你好！
entries.sampleRaw: Hello!

entries.source: I was cutting a tree when a Phanpyre suddenly appeared.
entries.translation: 我正在砍树时，一只焰魂突然出现了。
entries.sampleRaw: I was cutting a tree when a §cPhanpyre §fsuddenly appeared.

entries.source: Hunting Forest creatures is very different from Water or Combat creatures.
entries.translation: 狩猎森林生物与狩猎水或战斗生物非常不同。
entries.sampleRaw: Hunting §2Forest §fcreatures is very different from §9Water §for §cCombat §fcreatures.

entries.source: For this one, you need a Lasso.
entries.translation: 对付这一只，你需要一根套索。
entries.sampleRaw: For this one, you need a Lasso.

entries.source: I have a spare one here, take it.
entries.translation: 我这里有一根备用的，拿去吧。
entries.sampleRaw: I have a spare one here, take it.

entries.source: Great! Now throw the Lasso at the Phanpyre!
entries.translation: 很好！现在把套索扔向焰魂！
entries.sampleRaw: Great! Now throw the Lasso at the §cPhanpyre§f!

entries.source: When its stamina bar empties, right-click to reel it in!
entries.translation: 当它的体力条清空时，右键把它拉过来！
entries.sampleRaw: When its stamina bar empties, §aright-click §fto reel it in!

entries.source: Great, now throw the Lasso at the Phanpyre and hold on!
entries.translation: 很好，现在把套索扔向焰魂并坚持住！
entries.sampleRaw: Great, now throw the Lasso at the Phanpyre and hold on!

entries.source: Once their stamina bar is down, RIGHT CLICK your Lasso to Reel!
entries.translation: 一旦它们的体力条耗尽，右键点击你的套索来拉拽！
entries.sampleRaw: Once their stamina bar is down, §e§lRIGHT CLICK §fyour Lasso to Reel!

entries.source: You killed it! That's NOT how you hunt!
entries.translation: 你把它杀了！这可不是狩猎的方式！
entries.sampleRaw: You killed it! That's §cNOT §fhow you hunt!

entries.source: Try again!
entries.translation: 再试一次！
entries.sampleRaw: Try again!

entries.source: Alright alright alright!
entries.translation: 好，好，好！
entries.sampleRaw: Alright alright alright!

entries.source: That's what I'm talking about!
entries.translation: 这才像话！
entries.sampleRaw: That's what I'm talking about!

entries.source: This Lasso isn't the best, but it gets the job done.
entries.translation: 这根套索不是最好的，但足够用了。
entries.sampleRaw: This Lasso isn't the best, but it gets the job done.

entries.source: You should head back to David Hunterborough.
entries.translation: 你应该回到David Hunterborough那里。
entries.sampleRaw: You should head back to §bDavid Hunterborough§f.

entries.source: You should go back to David Hunterborough.
entries.translation: 你应该回到David Hunterborough那里。
entries.sampleRaw: You should go back to §bDavid Hunterborough§f.

entries.source: I keep finding Phanpyres, but what I'm really looking for are Dreadwings.
entries.translation: 我总是遇到焰魂，但我真正在找的是恐翼。
entries.sampleRaw: I keep finding Phanpyres, but what I'm really looking for are Dreadwings.

entries.source: Have you got a better Lasso yet? I'm still looking for a better one myself.
entries.translation: 你找到更好的套索了吗？我自己也还在找更好的。
entries.sampleRaw: Have you got a better Lasso yet? I'm still looking for a better one myself.

entries.source: Before you can sail, you must prove you know how to fish.
entries.translation: 在你出海航行之前，你必须证明你懂得如何钓鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBefore you can §asail§f, you must prove you know how to §bfish§f.

entries.source: Go find Fisherwoman Enid, learn how to fish, and then we'll talk!
entries.translation: 去找渔妇 Enid，学会钓鱼，然后我们再谈！
entries.sampleRaw: §fGo find §9Fisherwoman Enid§f, learn how to §bfish§f, and then we'll talk!

entries.source: These waters are rough, matey!
entries.translation: 这片水域很凶险，伙计！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThese waters are rough, matey!

entries.source: You'll need at least Fishing Skill V before setting sail!
entries.translation: 出海航行前，你至少需要钓鱼技能 V！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou'll need at least §aFishing Skill V §fbefore setting sail!

entries.source: Ahoy, sailor! You must be Fishing Skill V to navigate the seas!
entries.translation: 嗨，水手！你必须达到钓鱼技能 V 才能航行于大海！
entries.sampleRaw: Ahoy, sailor! You must be §aFishing Skill V §fto navigate the seas!

entries.source: This Ship is missing an engine! Fisherman Gerald might have a clue on where to find it.
entries.translation: 这艘船少了一个引擎！Fisherman Gerald 也许知道去哪里找。
entries.sampleRaw: This §6Ship §fis missing an engine! §9Fisherman Gerald §fmight have a clue on where to find it.

entries.source: I was about to set sail, but this Ship is missing its engine!
entries.translation: 我正要出海，但这艘船少了它的引擎！
entries.sampleRaw: I was about to set sail, but this §6Ship §fis missing its §cengine§f!

entries.source: Maybe Fisherman Gerald knows where it is?
entries.translation: 也许 Fisherman Gerald 知道它在哪？
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe §9Fisherman Gerald §fknows where it is?

entries.source: Ahoy, is that the Rusty Ship Engine?
entries.translation: 嗨，那是生锈的船用引擎吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Ahoy, is that the §cRusty Ship Engine§f?

entries.source: Excellent! I'm the Captain of this Ship, which means I oversee everything from repairs to navigation.
entries.translation: 太好了!我担任这艘船只的船长,从维修到航行的一切事务都由我负责.
entries.sampleRaw: §fExcellent! I'm the Captain of this §6Ship§f, which means I oversee everything from repairs to navigation.

entries.source: You can access the Ship Upgrades menu by talking to me.
entries.translation: 你可以通过和我交谈来打开船只升级菜单。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can access the §6Ship Upgrades §fmenu by talking to me.

entries.source: Apply that Rusty Ship Engine in the Engine slot by clicking the engine in your inventory!
entries.translation: 点击你物品栏中的引擎,把那个生锈的船用引擎装到引擎槽位里!
entries.sampleRaw: §fApply that §cRusty Ship Engine §fin the §6Engine §fslot by clicking the engine in your inventory!

entries.source: Apply the Rusty Ship Engine in the Ship Upgrades menu, and then we can set sail!
entries.translation: 在船只升级菜单中装上生锈的船用引擎，然后我们就可以出海了！
entries.sampleRaw: Apply the §cRusty Ship Engine §fin the §6Ship Upgrades §fmenu, and then we can set sail!

entries.source: Amazing! That'll do just the trick!
entries.translation: 太棒了！这正好能派上用场！
entries.sampleRaw: Amazing! That'll do just the trick!

entries.source: It's a pretty weak engine, but it will be just powerful enough to reach the Backwater Bayou.
entries.translation: 这引擎相当弱，但它的动力刚好足够抵达静水河湾。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a pretty weak engine, but it will be just powerful enough to reach the §2Backwater Bayou§f.

entries.source: Now, before we set off, you should make sure you've bought some starter equipment from the Fishing Merchant in the Fishing Outpost.
entries.translation: 现在，在我们出发之前，你应该确保已经从钓鱼前哨的Fishing Merchant那里购买了一些初始装备。
entries.sampleRaw: Now, before we set off, you should make sure you've bought some starter equipment from the §bFishing Merchant §fin the §bFishing Outpost§f.

entries.source: And when you're ready, use the Ship Navigator to travel to the Bayou!
entries.translation: 等你准备好后，使用船只导航员前往河湾！
entries.sampleRaw: And when you're ready, use the §6Ship Navigator §fto travel to the §2Bayou§f!

entries.source: Land ho! We have arrived at the Backwater Bayou!
entries.translation: 陆地！我们已抵达静水河湾！
entries.sampleRaw: Land ho! We have arrived at the §2Backwater Bayou§f!

entries.source: You go on and explore! Come back to the Ship and set sail when you're done!
entries.translation: 你去探索吧！结束后回到船上，然后出海！
entries.sampleRaw: You go on and explore! Come back to the §6Ship §fand set sail when you're done!

entries.source: If you want to conquer the seven seas and be the first sailor to reach World's End, we're going to need a bigger crew!
entries.translation: 如果你想征服七海，成为第一个抵达世界尽头的航海家，我们就需要更大的船员队伍！
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to conquer the seven seas and be the first sailor to reach §5World's End§f, we're going to need a bigger §6crew§f!

entries.source: I've given it some thought, and I think we should recruit some more sailors to help us out.
entries.translation: 我想了想，我觉得我们应该再招募一些水手来帮我们。
entries.sampleRaw: I've given it some thought, and I think we should recruit some more sailors to help us out.

entries.source: You can find the Ship Crew menu by talking to me.
entries.translation: 你可以通过和我交谈来找到船员菜单。
entries.sampleRaw: You can find the §6Ship Crew §fmenu by talking to me.

entries.source: Use it to find NPCs who might want to join us on our adventure!
entries.translation: 用它来寻找可能愿意加入我们冒险的 NPC 吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Use it to find NPCs who might want to join us on our adventure!

entries.source: If you find someone that interests you, persuade them to join the crew!
entries.translation: 如果你找到感兴趣的人，就说服他们加入船员队伍！
entries.sampleRaw: If you find someone that interests you, §apersuade §fthem to join the crew!

entries.source: Land ho! We have landed onto the Lotus Atoll!
entries.translation: 陆地！我们已登陆 Lotus Atoll！
entries.sampleRaw: Land ho! We have landed onto the §3Lotus Atoll§f!

entries.source: Hello, darling!
entries.translation: 你好，亲爱的！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHello, darling!

entries.source: Are you here to fish?
entries.translation: 你是来钓鱼的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fAre you here to §bfish§f?

entries.source: Splendid!
entries.translation: 太棒了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fSplendid!

entries.source: Take my spare Fishing Rod and stand near the water.
entries.translation: 拿上我备用的钓鱼竿，站到水边去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTake my spare §fFishing Rod §fand stand near the water.

entries.source: This rod isn't that special, but it will get the job done for now!
entries.translation: 这根竿子没什么特别的，但眼下足够你用了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis rod isn't that special, but it will get the job done for now!

entries.source: Don't forget your Fishing Rod!
entries.translation: 别忘了你的钓鱼竿！
entries.sampleRaw: §fDon't forget your §aFishing Rod§f!

entries.source: To fish, cast your rod into the water and wait for a fish to bite!
entries.translation: 钓鱼时，把竿抛进水里，等鱼上钩！
entries.sampleRaw: To fish, cast your rod into the water and wait for a fish to §abite§f!

entries.source: And that's really how simple Fishing is!
entries.translation: 钓鱼就是这么简单！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd that's really how simple §aFishing §fis!

entries.source: This part of the Hub is a popular area for fishing because of the Fishing Outpost!
entries.translation: 中心岛的这一带因为钓鱼前哨而成了热门的钓鱼地点！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis part of the Hub is a popular area for fishing because of the §bFishing Outpost§f!

entries.source: If you follow the river that flows under this bridge downstream, you'll find your way to it!
entries.translation: 顺着这座桥下流向下的河水走,你就能找到那里!
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you follow the river that flows under this bridge §bdownstream§f, you'll find your way to it!

entries.source: Fisherman Gerald will be happy to help you on your Fishing journey. Just tell him his wife sent you!
entries.translation: Fisherman Gerald会很乐意在你的钓鱼之旅上帮你一把。就告诉他，是他妻子让你来的！
entries.sampleRaw: §9Fisherman Gerald §fwill be happy to help you on your §aFishing §fjourney. Just tell him his wife sent you!

entries.source: This part of the hub is a popular area for fishing because of the Fishing Outpost!
entries.translation: 中心岛的这一带因为钓鱼前哨而成了热门的钓鱼地点！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis part of the hub is a popular area for fishing because of the §bFishing Outpost§f!

entries.source: If you follow the river that flows under the bridge downstream, you'll find your way to it.
entries.translation: 顺着桥下流向下的河水走,你就能找到那里.
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you follow the river that flows under the bridge §bdownstream§f, you'll find your way to it.

entries.source: And tell Gerald I won't be home for dinner tonight! I'm tired of him making salmon.
entries.translation: 还有，告诉Gerald我今晚不回家吃饭了！我受够了他做的鲑鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd tell §9Gerald §fI won't be home for dinner tonight! I'm tired of him making §f§osalmon§f.

entries.source: If you like fishin', you'll love the Backwater Bayou!
entries.translation: 如果你喜欢钓鱼，你一定会爱上静水河湾！
entries.sampleRaw: If you like fishin', you'll love the §2Backwater Bayou§f!

entries.source: You should go there sometime soon!
entries.translation: 你该找个时间尽快去那儿看看！
entries.sampleRaw: You should go there sometime soon!

entries.source: Using Bait is important to get better results!
entries.translation: 使用鱼饵对获得更好的收获很重要！
entries.sampleRaw: Using §6Bait §fis important to get better results!

entries.source: My favorite kind is Dark Bait because I prefer fishing at night.
entries.translation: 我最喜欢的是黑暗鱼饵，因为我更喜欢在夜里钓鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy favorite kind is §fDark Bait §fbecause I prefer fishing at night.

entries.source: Angler Angus knows a lot more about Bait than I do. I think he's fishing somewhere along this river if you're interested in learning more.
entries.translation: Angler Angus对鱼饵的了解比我多得多。如果你有兴趣多学点，我想他就在这条河边的某个地方钓鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: Angler Angus §fknows a lot more about §6Bait §fthan I do. I think he's fishing somewhere along this river if you're interested in learning more.

entries.source: I know that Gavin uses \/scg instead of looking in his Fishing Skill menu.
entries.translation: 我知道Gavin用的是\/scg，而不是去翻他的钓鱼技能菜单。
entries.sampleRaw: I know that §bGavin §fuses §d\/scg §finstead of looking in his §aFishing §fSkill menu.

entries.source: He thinks he's being sneaky, but everyone knows about it.
entries.translation: 他以为自己偷偷摸摸的，其实大家都知道。
entries.sampleRaw: He thinks he's being sneaky, but everyone knows about it.

entries.source: Little does he know, I use it too!
entries.translation: 他不知道的是，我也在用！
entries.sampleRaw: Little does he know, I use it too!

entries.source: The Backwater Bayou has all sorts of wild Sea Creatures native to the area.
entries.translation: 静水河湾里有各种当地野生的海怪。
entries.sampleRaw: The §2Backwater Bayou §fhas all sorts of wild §3Sea Creatures §fnative to the area.

entries.source: I've heard stories of Frog Man, but I've never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.
entries.translation: 我听过蛙人的传说，但我一直没搞清他到底是只青蛙还是个人。
entries.sampleRaw: I've heard stories of §cFrog Man§f, but I've never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.

entries.source: Perhaps he is both, perhaps neither.
entries.translation: 也许两者都是，也许都不是。
entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps he is both, perhaps neither.

entries.source: Whenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of Bait.
entries.translation: 每次钓鱼时，一定要用上某种鱼饵。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of §6Bait§f.

entries.source: You can store Bait in your inventory or Fishing Bag, which is unlocked at Raw Cod Collection III.
entries.translation: 你可以把鱼饵存放在物品栏或钓鱼袋中,后者在生鳕鱼收藏 III 解锁.
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can store §6Bait§f in your inventory or §9Fishing Bag§f, which is unlocked at §aRaw Cod Collection III§f.

entries.source: Bait is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use!
entries.translation: 每次抛竿时鱼饵都会自动消耗，所以用起来很方便！
entries.sampleRaw: §6Bait§f is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use!

entries.source: I craft Fish Bait all the time because it's so easy to do - just a couple of Raw Cod and a Raw Salmon!
entries.translation: 我一直在合成鱼饵，因为太简单了——只要几条生鳕鱼和一条生鲑鱼！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI craft §fFish Bait §fall the time because it's so easy to do - just a couple of §fRaw Cod §fand a §fRaw Salmon§f!

entries.source: Here, I've got some spare Fish Bait for ya!
entries.translation: 来，我这儿有些多余的鱼饵给你！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, I've got some spare §fFish Bait §ffor ya!

entries.source: Fish Bait seems to give a really effective ☂ Fishing Speed boost!
entries.translation: 鱼饵似乎能提供非常有效的 ☂ 钓鱼速度加成！
entries.sampleRaw: §fFish Bait §fseems to give a really effective §b☂ Fishing Speed §fboost!

entries.source: All Baits serve some specialized purpose, so be sure to keep some on you at all times!
entries.translation: 所有鱼饵都有各自的专门用途，所以一定要随身带一些！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAll §6Baits §fserve some specialized purpose, so be sure to keep some on you at all times!

entries.source: If you have any questions about Bait, you can view my Bait Guide at any time!
entries.translation: 如果你对鱼饵有任何疑问，随时可以查看我的鱼饵指南！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you have any questions about §6Bait§f, you can view my §6Bait Guide §fat any time!

entries.source: You can also use \/bait as a shortcut if you aren't feeling like paying me a visit!
entries.translation: 如果你不想来找我，也可以使用 \/bait 作为快捷方式！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can also use §a\/bait §fas a shortcut if you aren't feeling like paying me a visit!

entries.source: Hey! I'm the leader of the Soul Campfire Cult!
entries.translation: 嘿！我是灵魂营火教派的领袖！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey! I'm the leader of the §3Soul Campfire Cult§f!

entries.source: Survive 10s in the campfire to earn one!
entries.translation: 在营火中存活 10 秒即可获得一个!
entries.sampleRaw: Survive §a10s §fin the §ccampfire §fto earn one!
entries.numericSource: Survive {{N0}}s in the campfire to earn one!
entries.numericTranslation: 在营火中存活 {{N0}} 秒即可获得一个!

entries.source: Wow! You survived the soul campfire!
entries.translation: 哇！你在灵魂营火中活下来了！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! You survived the §3soul campfire§f!

entries.source: The soul campfire isn't quite as strong as a regular campfire. It respects your ❈ Defense!
entries.translation: 灵魂营火没有普通营火那么猛烈.你的 ❈ 防御对它有效!
entries.sampleRaw: The soul campfire isn't quite as strong as a regular §ccampfire§f. It respects your §a❈ Defense§f!

entries.source: Try to survive the Trial of Blue Flames II, and I'll give you the Soul Campfire Initiate Badge I!
entries.translation: 试着在蓝色烈焰试炼 II 中存活下来，我就给你灵魂营火入门徽章 I！
entries.sampleRaw: Try to survive the §3Trial of Blue Flames II§f, and I'll give you the Soul Campfire Initiate Badge I!

entries.source: Wow! That campfire seems to scare off most foragers, but not you!
entries.translation: 哇！那堆营火似乎吓跑了大多数采集者，但没吓跑你！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! That campfire seems to scare off most foragers, but not you!

entries.source: Here's your Soul Campfire Initiate Badge I!
entries.translation: 这是你的灵魂营火入门徽章 I！
entries.sampleRaw: Here's your Soul Campfire Initiate Badge I!

entries.source: Complete the Trial of Blue Flames III, and I'll upgrade your badge!
entries.translation: 完成蓝色烈焰试炼 III，我就升级你的徽章！
entries.sampleRaw: Complete the §3Trial of Blue Flames III§f, and I'll upgrade your badge!

entries.source: Next step is the Trial of Blue Flames III! (500 damage)
entries.translation: 下一步是蓝色烈焰试炼 III!(500 伤害)
entries.sampleRaw: Next step is the §3Trial of Blue Flames III§f! §7(500 damage)
entries.numericSource: Next step is the Trial of Blue Flames III! ({{N0}} damage)
entries.numericTranslation: 下一步是蓝色烈焰试炼 III!({{N0}} 伤害)

entries.source: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for 10s!
entries.translation: 走进营火开始试炼,并存活 10 秒!
entries.sampleRaw: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for §610s!
entries.numericSource: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for {{N0}}s!
entries.numericTranslation: 走进营火开始试炼,并存活 {{N0}} 秒!

entries.source: I need you to hold your (Soul Campfire Badge) so I can upgrade it!
entries.translation: 我需要你手持你的（灵魂营火徽章），这样我才能升级它！
entries.sampleRaw: §cI need you to hold your §f(Soul Campfire Badge) §cso I can upgrade it!

entries.source: Try the Trial of Blue Flames # for a greater challenge!
entries.translation: 试试蓝色烈焰试炼 #,迎接更大的挑战!
entries.sampleRaw: §3Try the Trial of Blue Flames # §ffor a greater challenge!

entries.source: The rarity of your item will be upgraded in # trials!
entries.translation: 你的物品稀有度将在 # 次试炼后升级！
entries.sampleRaw: The rarity of your item will be upgraded in §a# §ftrials!

entries.source: The rarity of your item will be upgraded on the next trial!
entries.translation: 你的物品稀有度将在下一次试炼时升级！
entries.sampleRaw: The rarity of your item will be upgraded on the next trial!

entries.source: Congrats on completing tier #!
entries.translation: 恭喜完成第 # 阶！
entries.sampleRaw: Congrats on completing tier #!

entries.source: You are ready for the next badge rarity!
entries.translation: 你已准备好迎接下一徽章稀有度！
entries.sampleRaw: You are ready for the next badge rarity!

entries.source: To receive it, we require (Materials)!
entries.translation: 要领取它，我们需要（材料）！
entries.sampleRaw: To receive it, we require (Materials)!

entries.source: Try the Trial of Blue Flames Trial # for a greater challenge!
entries.translation: 试试蓝色烈焰试炼 #，迎接更大的挑战！
entries.sampleRaw: Try the §3Trial of Blue Flames Trial # §ffor a greater challenge!

entries.source: Congratulations on beating every single Trial of Blue Flames! You're the real fire guy, hotshot!
entries.translation: 恭喜你击败了每一场蓝色烈焰试炼！你才是真正的玩火高手，伙计！
entries.sampleRaw: Congratulations on beating every single §3Trial of Blue Flames§f! You're the real fire guy, hotshot!

entries.source: Have you got yourself a Huntrap yet?
entries.translation: 你弄到猎捕陷阱了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you got yourself a §cHuntrap §fyet?

entries.source: I love these things.
entries.translation: 我太喜欢这些东西了.
entries.sampleRaw: I §f§olove §fthese things.

entries.source: Just set one up on any island, walk away, and when you come back, something's waiting for you!
entries.translation: 只要在任意岛屿上放置一个，然后走开，等你回来时，就有东西在等着你！
entries.sampleRaw: Just set one up on any island, walk away, and when you come back, something's waiting for you!

entries.source: You can place them where monsters tend to show up, or even dunk one underwater if you're feeling bold.
entries.translation: 你可以把它们放在怪物常出没的地方，如果你胆子够大，甚至可以把一个泡在水下。
entries.sampleRaw: You can place them where monsters tend to show up, or even dunk one underwater if you're feeling bold.

entries.source: I’ve caught creatures I’d never be able to snag on my own.
entries.translation: 我抓到过一些我自己根本抓不到的生物。
entries.sampleRaw: I’ve caught creatures I’d never be able to snag on my own.

entries.source: Ooh! Look! I think I just caught something!
entries.translation: 哦！看！我觉得我刚抓到了什么东西！
entries.sampleRaw: Ooh! Look! I think I just caught something!

entries.source: Anyways, maybe I should give you my spare Huntrap...
entries.translation: 总之，也许我该把我备用的猎捕陷阱给你……
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, maybe I should give you my spare §cHuntrap§f...

entries.source: I’ve been cutting Fig Trees lately to gather more Tender Wood.
entries.translation: 我最近一直在砍无花果树，好收集更多柔韧木材。
entries.sampleRaw: I’ve been cutting Fig Trees lately to gather more Tender Wood.

entries.source: Once I have enough I will craft myself better Huntraps!
entries.translation: 等我攒够了，我就给自己做更好的猎捕陷阱！
entries.sampleRaw: Once I have enough I will craft myself better Huntraps!

entries.source: Hey! That is mine!
entries.translation: 嘿！那是我的！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey! That is mine!

entries.source: Hold on... that was mine.
entries.translation: 等等……那是我的。
entries.sampleRaw: Hold on... that was mine.

entries.source: <player>! Have you talked to Hina at the front of the island to get your hands on a Heart of the Forest?
entries.translation: <player>！你和岛前端的 Hina 谈过了吗？去弄一个森林之心吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player>§f! Have you talked to §bHina §fat the front of the island to get your hands on a §aHeart of the Forest§f?

entries.source: Hello <player>!
entries.translation: 你好，<player>！
entries.sampleRaw: Hello §7<player>§f!

entries.source: Welcome to Galatea!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到加拉蒂亚！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome to §2Galatea§f!

entries.source: I hear you've been busy in The Park. Charlie's a good friend.
entries.translation: 我听说你在公园里一直很忙。Charlie是个好朋友。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI hear you've been busy in §aThe Park§f. Charlie's a good friend.

entries.source: Friends of my friends are my enemies - whoops, my friends I mean!
entries.translation: 我朋友的朋友就是我的敌人——哎呀,我是说我的朋友!
entries.sampleRaw: §fFriends of my friends are my enemies - §owhoops§f, my friends I mean!

entries.source: You might be wondering why I'm on top of this bush?
entries.translation: 你可能想知道我为什么待在这丛灌木上面吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou might be wondering why I'm on top of this bush?

entries.source: I'm camping it to get the berries before someone else.
entries.translation: 我守在这里，是为了赶在别人之前拿到浆果。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm camping it to get the §dberries §fbefore someone else.

entries.source: I'm joking! I would never do such thing, haha!
entries.translation: 开玩笑的！我绝不会做那种事，哈哈！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm joking! I would never do such thing, haha!

entries.source: Never.
entries.translation: 绝不会。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNever.

entries.source: See for yourself! Look, a berry just appeared, simply punch the bush to collect it!
entries.translation: 你自己看吧！瞧，一颗浆果刚冒出来，直接打灌木丛就能采集它！
entries.sampleRaw: §fSee for yourself! Look, a §dberry §fjust appeared, simply §cpunch §fthe bush to collect it!

entries.source: A berry just appeared, simply punch the bush to collect it!
entries.translation: 一颗浆果刚冒出来，直接打灌木丛就能采集它！
entries.sampleRaw: A §dberry §fjust appeared, simply §cpunch §fthe bush to collect it!

entries.source: Great!
entries.translation: 太好了！
entries.sampleRaw: Great!

entries.source: Berries are pretty useful to craft Hunting items.
entries.translation: 浆果对制作狩猎物品相当有用。
entries.sampleRaw: §dBerries §fare pretty useful to craft §aHunting §fitems.

entries.source: If you want to learn more about Hunting, you should talk to David Hunterborough next door.
entries.translation: 如果你想了解更多关于狩猎的事，应该去和隔壁的 David Hunterborough 谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to learn more about §aHunting§f, you should talk to §bDavid Hunterborough §fnext door.

entries.source: I'm more specialized in tree cutting.
entries.translation: 我更擅长砍树。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm more specialized in tree cutting.

entries.source: Have you ever heard about ∮ Sweep?
entries.translation: 你听说过∮横扫吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you ever heard about §2∮ Sweep§f?

entries.source: So you probably know that Sweep allows you to cut multiple logs at once.
entries.translation: 所以你大概知道，横扫能让你一次砍下多根原木。
entries.sampleRaw: So you probably know that Sweep allows you to cut multiple logs at once.

entries.source: For example, 10∮ Sweep should allow you to cut 10 logs.
entries.translation: 比如,10∮横扫应该能让你砍下10根原木.
entries.sampleRaw: For example, §210∮ Sweep §fshould allow you to cut §e10 logs§f.
entries.numericSource: For example, {{N0}}∮ Sweep should allow you to cut {{N1}} logs.
entries.numericTranslation: 比如,{{N0}}∮横扫应该能让你砍下{{N1}}根原木.

entries.source: Except that some Trees are tougher than others!
entries.translation: 只不过有些树比其他树更坚硬！
entries.sampleRaw: Except that some Trees are tougher than others!

entries.source: If a Tree has a high Toughness, you will need more than 10∮ Sweep to cut 10 logs!
entries.translation: 如果一棵树的坚韧度很高,你就需要超过10∮横扫才能砍下10根原木!
entries.sampleRaw: If a Tree has a high §cToughness§f, you will need more than §210∮ Sweep §fto cut 10 logs!
entries.numericSource: If a Tree has a high Toughness, you will need more than {{N0}}∮ Sweep to cut {{N1}} logs!
entries.numericTranslation: 如果一棵树的坚韧度很高,你就需要超过{{N0}}∮横扫才能砍下{{N1}}根原木!

entries.source: This Fig Tree right next to us, has a Toughness of 7.
entries.translation: 我们旁边这棵无花果树，坚韧度为7。
entries.sampleRaw: This §aFig Tree §fright next to us, has a Toughness of §c7§f.
entries.numericSource: This Fig Tree right next to us, has a Toughness of {{N0}}.
entries.numericTranslation: 我们旁边这棵无花果树，坚韧度为{{N0}}。

entries.source: So I suggest you use an axe with at least +7∮ Sweep.
entries.translation: 所以我建议你使用一把至少带有 +7∮ 横扫的斧头.
entries.sampleRaw: So I suggest you use an axe with at least §2+7∮ Sweep§f.
entries.numericSource: So I suggest you use an axe with at least {{N0}}∮ Sweep.
entries.numericTranslation: 所以我建议你使用一把至少带有 {{N0}}∮ 横扫的斧头.

entries.source: Here, let me give you this legendary axe that has been passed down my whole family tree for 12 generations.
entries.translation: 来，让我把这把传家 12 代的传说斧头送给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, let me give you this legendary axe that has been passed down my whole family tree for 12 generations.
entries.numericSource: Here, let me give you this legendary axe that has been passed down my whole family tree for {{N0}} generations.
entries.numericTranslation: 来，让我把这把传家 {{N0}} 代的传说斧头送给你。

entries.source: I see, a complete newbie.
entries.translation: 我明白了，一个彻头彻尾的新手。
entries.sampleRaw: I see, a complete newbie.

entries.source: Well, ∮ Sweep allows you to cut multiple logs at once.
entries.translation: 嗯，∮ 横扫能让你一次砍下多根原木。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, §2∮ Sweep§f allows you to cut multiple logs at once.

entries.source: For example, 10∮ Sweep should allow you to cut 10 logs, you understand?
entries.translation: 比如,10∮ 横扫应该能让你砍下 10 根原木,明白了吗?
entries.sampleRaw: For example, §210∮ Sweep §fshould allow you to cut §e10 logs§f, you understand?
entries.numericSource: For example, {{N0}}∮ Sweep should allow you to cut {{N1}} logs, you understand?
entries.numericTranslation: 比如,{{N0}}∮ 横扫应该能让你砍下 {{N1}} 根原木,明白了吗?

entries.source: Just kidding, this axe is terrible, but it will do for now.
entries.translation: 开玩笑的，这把斧头很糟糕，但暂时够用了。
entries.sampleRaw: Just kidding, this axe is terrible, but it will do for now.

entries.source: But there is more...
entries.translation: 但还有更多……
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut there is more...

entries.source: The trees on this island are even tougher if they are not cut in the proper order.
entries.translation: 这座岛上的树木如果不按正确顺序砍伐，会变得更加坚硬。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe trees on this island are even tougher if they are not cut in the §5proper order§f.

entries.source: For example, you should cut the trunks of the Fig Trees first!
entries.translation: 比如,你应该先砍伐无花果树的树干!
entries.sampleRaw: §fFor example, you should §acut the trunks §fof the Fig Trees first!

entries.source: Otherwise, you won't be that efficient at cutting them down.
entries.translation: 否则，你砍伐它们的效率就不会那么高。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOtherwise, you won't be that efficient at cutting them down.

entries.source: You can also throw some axes into the air by right-clicking with them in your hand.
entries.translation: 你还可以手持斧头右键点击，将它们抛向空中。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can also throw some axes into the air by §aright-clicking §fwith them in your hand.

entries.source: Have a go at cutting down this Fig Tree behind me.
entries.translation: 试着砍倒我身后的这棵无花果树吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave a go at cutting down this Fig Tree behind me.

entries.source: You should cut the trunks of the Fig Trees first!
entries.translation: 你应该先砍伐无花果树的树干！
entries.sampleRaw: You should cut the §atrunks of the Fig Trees first§f!

entries.source: Otherwise you will be much less efficient.
entries.translation: 否则你的效率会低得多。
entries.sampleRaw: Otherwise you will be much less efficient.

entries.source: Don't forget you can RIGHT-CLICK Foraging axes to throw them into the air!
entries.translation: 别忘了你可以右键点击采集斧，将它们抛向空中！
entries.sampleRaw: Don't forget you can §e§lRIGHT-CLICK §fForaging axes to §cthrow them into the air§f!

entries.source: Here, go and cut a Fig Tree.
entries.translation: 来，去砍一棵无花果树吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, go and cut a Fig Tree.

entries.source: Not bad!
entries.translation: 不错！
entries.sampleRaw: §fNot bad!

entries.source: You may have noticed already, but cutting down a tree here will grant you a Tree Gift.
entries.translation: 你可能已经注意到了，在这里砍倒一棵树会给你一份树木礼物。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou may have noticed already, but cutting down a tree here will grant you a §2Tree Gift§f.

entries.source: Tree Gifts are rewarded to everyone who helped to cut down a tree.
entries.translation: 树木礼物会奖励给所有参与砍倒树木的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §2Tree Gifts §fare rewarded to everyone who helped to cut down a tree.

entries.source: Cutting down enough Fig or Mangrove Trees will level up your milestones and grant extra ∮ Sweep.
entries.translation: 砍倒足够多的无花果树或红树会提升你的里程碑等级，并给予额外的 ∮ 横扫。
entries.sampleRaw: §fCutting down enough §aFig §for §aMangrove Trees §fwill level up your milestones and grant extra §2∮ Sweep§f.

entries.source: This means that it's better to group together to cut down trees around here.
entries.translation: 这意味着在这里组队一起砍树会更好。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis means that it's better to §dgroup together §fto cut down trees around here.

entries.source: There is a lot more to know about cutting down trees, so talk to me if you want to learn more.
entries.translation: 关于砍树还有很多知识，如果你想了解更多，就来找我谈谈吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere is a lot more to know about cutting down trees, so talk to me if you want to learn more.

entries.source: The view from here is just so bad.
entries.translation: 这里的景色真是太糟糕了。
entries.sampleRaw: The view from here is just so bad.

entries.source: I mean look at it! Look!
entries.translation: 我是说看看它！看看！
entries.sampleRaw: I mean look at it! Look!

entries.source: It’s hard to even describe how awful this view is.
entries.translation: 这景色有多糟糕，简直难以形容。
entries.sampleRaw: It’s hard to even describe how awful this view is.

entries.source: I come here everyday just to see how terrible this view is.
entries.translation: 我每天都来这里，就为了看看这景色有多糟糕。
entries.sampleRaw: I come here everyday just to see how terrible this view is.

entries.source: Every time I look, it somehow gets worse!
entries.translation: 每次我看的时候，它不知怎么地就变得更糟了！
entries.sampleRaw: Every time I look, it somehow gets worse!

entries.source: I traveled all the way... just to be disappointed again.
entries.translation: 我大老远赶来……结果又一次失望了。
entries.sampleRaw: I traveled all the way... just to be disappointed again.

entries.source: This island somehow managed to have an even worse view.
entries.translation: 这座岛不知怎么的，居然还能有更差的景色。
entries.sampleRaw: This island somehow managed to have an even worse view.

entries.source: Every rock, every tree, perfectly misplaced. It's a masterpiece of disaster.
entries.translation: 每一块石头，每一棵树，都恰到好处地放错了位置。这简直是灾难的杰作。
entries.sampleRaw: Every rock, every tree, perfectly misplaced. It's a masterpiece of disaster.

entries.source: Pure, breathtaking mediocrity.
entries.translation: 纯粹得令人窒息的平庸。
entries.sampleRaw: Pure, breathtaking mediocrity.

entries.source: I could stare at this abomination for hours. Can't wait to come back tomorrow.
entries.translation: 我可以盯着这个丑东西看上好几个小时。等不及明天再来了。
entries.sampleRaw: I could stare at this abomination for hours. Can't wait to come back tomorrow.

entries.source: Greetings, traveler.
entries.translation: 你好，旅行者。
entries.sampleRaw: Greetings, traveler.

entries.source: I'm Loras, a historian dedicated to uncovering the secrets of the Precursors.
entries.translation: 我是Loras，一名致力于揭开先民秘密的历史学家。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm Loras, a historian dedicated to uncovering the secrets of the §5Precursors§f.

entries.source: Sadly, their history is shrouded in mystery, with scarce records surviving.
entries.translation: 可惜，他们的历史笼罩在谜团之中，留存的记录寥寥无几。
entries.sampleRaw: Sadly, their history is shrouded in mystery, with scarce records surviving.

entries.source: I've had to piece together their story through fieldwork and ancient relics.
entries.translation: 我不得不通过实地考察和古代遗物来拼凑他们的故事。
entries.sampleRaw: I've had to piece together their story through fieldwork and ancient relics.

entries.source: My dream? To pen a comprehensive tome about them, but the pieces are still falling into place.
entries.translation: 我的梦想？写一部关于他们的详尽典籍，但线索还在逐渐拼合。
entries.sampleRaw: My dream? To pen a comprehensive tome about them, but the pieces are still falling into place.

entries.source: Interested in what I've uncovered so far?
entries.translation: 对我目前发现的东西感兴趣吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Interested in what I've uncovered so far?

entries.source: Understandable. History has a way of capturing us when we least expect it.
entries.translation: 可以理解。历史总会在我们最意想不到的时候吸引我们。
entries.sampleRaw: Understandable. History has a way of capturing us when we least expect it.

entries.source: Feel free to return if curiosity strikes.
entries.translation: 如果好奇心来了，随时回来。
entries.sampleRaw: Feel free to return if curiosity strikes.

entries.source: Ah, a fellow history enthusiast! Excellent.
entries.translation: 啊，一位同好历史的爱好者！太好了。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, a fellow history enthusiast! Excellent.

entries.source: Through my research, I've deducted that the Precursors were this world's first inhabitants.
entries.translation: 通过我的研究，我推断出先民是这个世界最早的居民。
entries.sampleRaw: Through my research, I've deducted that the Precursors were this world's first inhabitants.

entries.source: Remarkably, they lived under the watch of multiple entities called Starborns!
entries.translation: 值得注意的是，他们生活在多个被称为星裔的实体的注视之下！
entries.sampleRaw: Remarkably, they lived under the watch of multiple entities called §9Starborns§f!

entries.source: I've identified at least eight Starborns, but I suspect there were more.
entries.translation: 我已确认了至少八位星裔，但我怀疑还有更多。
entries.sampleRaw: I've identified at least eight Starborns, but I suspect there were more.

entries.source: Each Starborn had a unique domain and wielded immense power.
entries.translation: 每位星裔都拥有独特的领域，并掌握着强大的力量。
entries.sampleRaw: Each Starborn had a unique domain and wielded immense power.

entries.source: From the Starborn of the Forests or the Sea, even a Starborn of Life!
entries.translation: 从森林星裔、海洋星裔，甚至还有生命星裔！
entries.sampleRaw: From the Starborn of the Forests or the Sea, even a Starborn of Life!

entries.source: It's unclear whether the Precursors were creations of these Starborns, but they certainly revered them.
entries.translation: 目前尚不清楚先民是否是这些星裔的造物，但他们确实崇敬这些星裔。
entries.sampleRaw: It's unclear whether the Precursors were creations of these Starborns, but they certainly revered them.

entries.source: My studies led me to distinguish two categories: Old and New Starborns.
entries.translation: 我的研究让我区分出两个类别：旧星裔与新星裔。
entries.sampleRaw: My studies led me to distinguish two categories: Old and New Starborns.

entries.source: Ah, but the names reflect a theory.
entries.translation: 啊，但这些名称反映的是一种理论。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, but the names reflect a theory.

entries.source: The Old Starborns seemen indifferent to mortal affairs, transcending earthly desires.
entries.translation: 旧星裔似乎对凡间事务漠不关心，超脱于尘世欲望之外。
entries.sampleRaw: The Old Starborns seemen indifferent to mortal affairs, transcending earthly desires.

entries.source: Conversely, the New Starborns engaged actively with the Precursors, reveling in their advancements and guiding their progress.
entries.translation: 相反，新星裔积极与先民互动，为他们的进步而欣喜，并引导他们的发展。
entries.sampleRaw: Conversely, the New Starborns engaged actively with the Precursors, reveling in their advancements and guiding their progress.

entries.source: I believe that immortals who maintain worldly interests and desire could be considered 'young' in a divine sense.
entries.translation: 我相信，那些仍保有世俗兴趣与欲望的永生者，从神性意义上来说可以被视为“年轻”。
entries.sampleRaw: I believe that immortals who maintain worldly interests and desire could be considered 'young' in a divine sense.

entries.source: Much appreciated.
entries.translation: 非常感谢。
entries.sampleRaw: Much appreciated.

entries.source: The New Starborns were particularly invested, almost as proud mentors observing their wards' milestones.
entries.translation: 新星裔投入得尤为深切，几乎就像自豪的导师在见证自己守护对象的里程碑。
entries.sampleRaw: The New Starborns were particularly invested, almost as proud mentors observing their wards' milestones.

entries.source: They even intervened directly at times, teaching essential lessons like substainable living and the imporance of nature's balance.
entries.translation: 他们有时甚至直接介入，传授诸如可持续生活以及自然平衡之重要性等关键课程。
entries.sampleRaw: They even intervened directly at times, teaching essential lessons like substainable living and the imporance of nature's balance.

entries.source: Precisely, but also guiding.
entries.translation: 正是如此，但同时也是在引导。
entries.sampleRaw: Precisely, but also guiding.

entries.source: For instance, they introduced magic to the Precursors, a decision with unforeseen consequences.
entries.translation: 例如，他们向先驱者传授了魔法，这个决定带来了无法预见的后果。
entries.sampleRaw: For instance, they introduced magic to the Precursors, a decision with unforeseen consequences.

entries.source: The Precursors ended up excelling in both magic and science, eventually blending the two to create wonders.
entries.translation: 先驱者最终在魔法和科学两方面都出类拔萃，并最终将两者融合，创造出奇迹。
entries.sampleRaw: The Precursors ended up excelling in both magic and science, eventually blending the two to create wonders.

entries.source: Their ambition grew boundless.
entries.translation: 他们的野心变得无边无际。
entries.sampleRaw: Their ambition grew boundless.

entries.source: They sought more: longer life, greater strength, boundless energy.
entries.translation: 他们追求更多：更长的寿命、更强的力量、无尽的能量。
entries.sampleRaw: They sought more: longer life, greater strength, boundless energy.

entries.source: Later generations of Precursors, born into a world of accomplishments, yearned for purpose and legacy.
entries.translation: 后来几代先驱者出生在一个充满成就的世界里，渴望找到目标和传承。
entries.sampleRaw: Later generations of Precursors, born into a world of accomplishments, yearned for purpose and legacy.

entries.source: For those young generations of Precursors, it became impossible to define their own purpose in the shadow of monumental achievements.
entries.translation: 对那些年轻一代的先驱者来说，在巨大成就的阴影下，已经不可能定义自己的目标。
entries.sampleRaw: For those young generations of Precursors, it became impossible to define their own purpose in the shadow of monumental achievements.

entries.source: Something had to happen, the wheel of progress had to keep turning.
entries.translation: 必须发生些什么，进步的巨轮必须继续转动。
entries.sampleRaw: Something had to happen, the wheel of progress had to keep turning.

entries.source: So one day, a bold claim arose: the Precursors had surpassed the Starborns.
entries.translation: 于是有一天，一个大胆的论断出现了：先驱者已经超越了星裔。
entries.sampleRaw: So one day, a bold claim arose: the Precursors had surpassed the Starborns.

entries.source: They saw the Starborns' teachings as shackles, hindering their true potential.
entries.translation: 他们将星裔的教诲视为枷锁，阻碍了他们真正的潜力。
entries.sampleRaw: They saw the Starborns' teachings as shackles, hindering their true potential.

entries.source: Indeed... But this hubris marked the beginning of the end.
entries.translation: 确实如此……但这种傲慢标志着终结的开始。
entries.sampleRaw: Indeed... But this hubris marked the beginning of the end.

entries.source: The Precursors harnessed their tools and magic to overpower the Starborns.
entries.translation: 先驱者运用他们的工具和魔法压制了星裔。
entries.sampleRaw: The Precursors harnessed their tools and magic to overpower the Starborns.

entries.source: Adding to this, the Starborns' power was intrinsically tied to the belief of their followers.
entries.translation: 此外，星裔的力量本质上与追随者的信仰紧密相连。
entries.sampleRaw: Adding to this, the Starborns' power was intrinsically tied to the belief of their followers.

entries.source: As the Precursors' faith diminished, so too did the might of the Starborns, weakening them in this crucial confrontation.
entries.translation: 随着先驱者的信仰减弱，星裔的威能也随之衰退，在这场关键的对决中削弱了他们。
entries.sampleRaw: As the Precursors' faith diminished, so too did the might of the Starborns, weakening them in this crucial confrontation.

entries.source: That remains a mystery. But it's clear that their influence faded.
entries.translation: 这仍然是个谜。但很明显，他们的影响力消退了。
entries.sampleRaw: That remains a mystery. But it's clear that their influence faded.

entries.source: As for the Precursors, they vanished without a trace, a puzzling paradox.
entries.translation: 至于先驱者，他们消失得无影无踪，一个令人费解的悖论。
entries.sampleRaw: As for the Precursors, they vanished without a trace, a puzzling paradox.

entries.source: Here's my theory: aware of their impending doom, the Starborn of Time, perhaps the most powerful due to universal belief, made a desperate move.
entries.translation: 我的理论是这样的：时间星裔意识到自己即将毁灭，他或许是因普世信仰而最强大的一位，于是做出了孤注一掷的举动。
entries.sampleRaw: Here's my theory: aware of their impending doom, the Starborn of Time, perhaps the most powerful due to universal belief, made a desperate move.

entries.source: He propelled the Precursors far into the future, hoping that by then, others could stand against them.
entries.translation: 他将先驱者推向遥远的未来，希望到那时，其他人能够与他们抗衡。
entries.sampleRaw: He propelled the Precursors far into the future, hoping that by then, others could stand against them.

entries.source: That's the unknown.
entries.translation: 这就是未知之处。
entries.sampleRaw: That's the unknown.

entries.source: But it suggests that the Precursors might reemerge one day, a thought both fascinating and daunting.
entries.translation: 但这暗示先驱者可能有一天会重新出现，这个想法既令人着迷又令人畏惧。
entries.sampleRaw: But it suggests that the Precursors might reemerge one day, a thought both fascinating and daunting.

entries.source: It's a possibility we cannot ignore.
entries.translation: 这是我们无法忽视的可能性。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a possibility we cannot ignore.

entries.source: We must be prepared for whatever comes.
entries.translation: 我们必须为任何可能发生的事做好准备。
entries.sampleRaw: We must be prepared for whatever comes.

entries.source: Thank you for lending an ear to my life's work.
entries.translation: 感谢你倾听我毕生的研究。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for lending an ear to my life's work.

entries.source: Now, I must return to my studies.
entries.translation: 现在，我必须回去继续研究了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now, I must return to my studies.

entries.source: Wassup! We're out here on a camping trip!
entries.translation: 嘿！我们在这儿露营呢！
entries.sampleRaw: Wassup! We're out here on a camping trip!

entries.source: I don't really know why we chose the Spider's Den, though...
entries.translation: 不过我真不知道我们为什么选了蜘蛛巢穴……
entries.sampleRaw: I don't really know why we chose the §cSpider's Den§f, though...

entries.source: Still, I've been playing lots of games to pass the time.
entries.translation: 不过，我一直在玩很多游戏来打发时间。
entries.sampleRaw: Still, I've been playing lots of games to pass the time.

entries.source: Quick! Trivia question! Do you know what Mob Types are?
entries.translation: 快！问答时间！你知道生物类型是什么吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Quick! Trivia question! Do you know what §cMob Types §fare?

entries.source: No problem! Allow me to explain.
entries.translation: 没问题！让我来解释一下。
entries.sampleRaw: No problem! Allow me to explain.

entries.source: So. Mob Types.
entries.translation: 那么。生物类型。
entries.sampleRaw: So. §cMob Types§f.

entries.source: Every mob has at least one type, which you can see next to its name.
entries.translation: 每种生物都至少有一种类型，你可以在它的名字旁边看到。
entries.sampleRaw: Every mob has at least §aone §ftype, which you can see next to its name.

entries.source: For example, Dasher Spiders are classified as  Arthropods, which you can tell because of the symbol next to their name.
entries.translation: 例如，冲刺蜘蛛被归类为节肢动物，你可以通过它们名字旁边的符号看出来。
entries.sampleRaw: For example, §cDasher Spiders §fare classified as §4 Arthropods§f, which you can tell because of the symbol next to their name.

entries.source: Most mobs have one type, but some have more.
entries.translation: 大多数生物只有一种类型，但有些有更多种。
entries.sampleRaw: Most mobs have §aone §ftype, but some have §cmore§f.

entries.source: My mate Ike knows which types all the different symbols represent.
entries.translation: 我的伙伴Ike知道所有不同符号代表哪些类型。
entries.sampleRaw: My mate §6Ike §fknows which types all the different symbols represent.

entries.source: Go talk to him if you want to learn more!
entries.translation: 如果你想了解更多，就去和他谈谈吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Go talk to him if you want to learn more!

entries.source: Cool, cool...
entries.translation: 酷，酷……
entries.sampleRaw: Cool, cool...

entries.source: Well I'm going to explain it anyways, otherwise my entire existence lacks purpose!
entries.translation: 反正我还是要解释一下，否则我整个存在就毫无意义了！
entries.sampleRaw: Well I'm going to explain it anyways, otherwise my entire existence lacks purpose!

entries.source: You heard what Michael said about Mob Types?
entries.translation: 你听到Michael说的关于生物类型的事了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You heard what §6Michael §fsaid about §cMob Types§f?

entries.source: Not to flex, but I've seen enough films to know about every mob type in existence.
entries.translation: 不是想炫耀，但我看过的电影足够多，知道现存的每一种生物类型。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNot to flex, but I've seen enough films to know about §devery mob type §fin existence.

entries.source: I'm bored, so let's play a game, just us two.
entries.translation: 我很无聊，所以咱们来玩个游戏吧，就我们俩。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm bored, so let's play a game, just us two.

entries.source: Then go talk to him, bro.
entries.translation: 那就去和他谈谈吧，兄弟。
entries.sampleRaw: Then go talk to him, bro.

entries.source: You go out and slay some mobs and, every time you kill a mob with a new mob type, I'll add it to my book!
entries.translation: 你出去击杀一些生物，每当你杀死一种拥有新生物类型的生物时，我就把它加到我的书里！
entries.sampleRaw: You go out and slay some mobs and, every time you kill a mob with a §anew mob type§f, I'll add it to my book!

entries.source: I'll give you a reward each time you kill a new mob type, so get busy!
entries.translation: 每当你杀死一种新生物类型，我都会给你一份奖励，所以快去忙吧！
entries.sampleRaw: I'll give you a §6reward §feach time you kill a new mob type, so get busy!

entries.source: Talk to me again if you want to check your progress!
entries.translation: 如果你想查看进度，就再来找我谈谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me again if you want to check your progress!

entries.source: Dude, I'm so bored out here. Mind showing me what you've been up to?
entries.translation: 老兄，我在这儿太无聊了。介意让我看看你都在忙些什么吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Dude, I'm so bored out here. Mind showing me what you've been up to?

entries.source: 'Sup champ! How's that Mob Type collection coming along? Let's take a look!
entries.translation: 你好啊，冠军！生物类型收藏进展如何？咱们来看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: 'Sup champ! How's that §cMob Type §fcollection coming along? Let's take a look!

entries.source: I am Teddy, the legendary hunter. Yes, yes, I know what you're thinking... no need to bow.
entries.translation: 我是Teddy，传奇猎人。是的，是的，我知道你在想什么……不必鞠躬。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am Teddy, the §olegendary §fhunter. Yes, yes, I know what you're thinking... no need to bow.

entries.source: I've walked this earth for 152 years, seen every creature, caught every beast... except... anyways.
entries.translation: 我在这世上活了152年，见过每一种生物，捕获过每一头野兽……除了……算了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've walked this earth for 152 years, seen every creature, caught every beast... except... anyways.
entries.numericSource: I've walked this earth for {{N0}} years, seen every creature, caught every beast... except... anyways.
entries.numericTranslation: 我在这世上活了{{N0}}年，见过每一种生物，捕获过每一头野兽……除了……算了。

entries.source: I can teach you how to catch anything that walks, swims, or slithers on this island...
entries.translation: 我可以教你如何捕获这座岛上任何会走、会游或会爬的东西……
entries.sampleRaw: §fI can teach you how to catch anything that walks, swims, or slithers on this island...

entries.source: ...For a price, of course. Nothing in life is free, kiddo.
entries.translation: ……当然，要付点代价。生活中没有什么是免费的，孩子。
entries.sampleRaw: §f...For a price, of course. Nothing in life is free, kiddo.

entries.source: Struggling with Frogs? Really?
entries.translation: 被青蛙难住了？真的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Struggling with Frogs? Really?

entries.source: Back in my day, hunters would catch 'em blindfolded.
entries.translation: 在我那个年代，猎人蒙着眼睛都能抓住它们。
entries.sampleRaw: Back in my day, hunters would catch 'em blindfolded.

entries.source: Hunters these days... no patience. Go to the lake and look for Mossybits.
entries.translation: 现在的猎人……一点耐心都没有。去湖边找苔藓比特吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Hunters these days... no patience. Go to the lake and look for Mossybits.

entries.source: Just poke at 'em, and they'll jump like they've seen a ghost. Eventually, they'll tire out.
entries.translation: 只要戳戳它们，它们就会像见了鬼一样跳起来。最终，它们会累的。
entries.sampleRaw: Just poke at 'em, and they'll jump like they've seen a ghost. Eventually, they'll tire out.

entries.source: Easy peasy.
entries.translation: 小菜一碟。
entries.sampleRaw: Easy peasy.

entries.source: Mudworms? You've gotta watch the ground closely... and I mean closely.
entries.translation: 泥虫？你得仔细观察地面……我是说非常仔细。
entries.sampleRaw: Mudworms? You've gotta watch the ground closely... and I mean closely.

entries.source: Ever seen a faint glow in the dirt? Could be treasure... or a Mudworm.
entries.translation: 见过泥土里微弱的闪光吗？那可能是宝藏……也可能是泥虫。
entries.sampleRaw: Ever seen a faint glow in the dirt? Could be treasure... or a Mudworm.

entries.source: Either way, you're digging!
entries.translation: 不管怎样，你都得挖！
entries.sampleRaw: Either way, you're digging!

entries.source: Ah, the Axolotl, tricky little devils. But here's a secret...
entries.translation: 啊，美西螈，狡猾的小家伙。但这里有个秘密……
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, the Axolotl, tricky little devils. But here's a secret...

entries.source: Their eyesight is rubbish, they only detect movements. So if you stand still long enough near them, you're golden.
entries.translation: 它们的视力很差，只能察觉到移动。所以只要你在它们附近站得够久不动，你就安全了。
entries.sampleRaw: Their eyesight is rubbish, they only detect movements. So if you stand still long enough near them, you're golden.

entries.source: Shulkers are sneaky. They're like shadows that play tricks on you.
entries.translation: 潜影贝很狡猾。它们就像捉弄你的影子。
entries.sampleRaw: Shulkers are sneaky. They're like shadows that play tricks on you.

entries.source: There are Hideonleafs on the island.
entries.translation: 岛上有藏叶虫。
entries.sampleRaw: There are Hideonleafs on the island.

entries.source: Step on them by mistake, and, well, they can get quite angry.
entries.translation: 不小心踩到它们，嗯，它们会非常生气。
entries.sampleRaw: Step on them by mistake, and, well, they can get quite angry.

entries.source: When they attack, smack their projectiles right back at 'em. That'll teach 'em.
entries.translation: 当它们攻击时，把它们的弹射物直接打回去。这就能给它们点教训。
entries.sampleRaw: When they attack, smack their projectiles right back at 'em. That'll teach 'em.

entries.source: Lumisquids hide in awkward places… but that's half the fun, right?
entries.translation: 荧光鱿鱼藏在刁钻的地方……但这正是乐趣的一半，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Lumisquids hide in awkward places… but that's half the fun, right?

entries.source: Use your net on them until they shrink down.
entries.translation: 用你的网不断套它们，直到它们缩小。
entries.sampleRaw: Use your net on them until they shrink down.

entries.source: They'll poof away like magic, but they never go too far.
entries.translation: 它们会像变魔术一样噗地消失，但绝不会跑太远。
entries.sampleRaw: They'll poof away like magic, but they never go too far.

entries.source: Dolphins... smart and slippery. They'll flee to their dolphin holes if you're not quick enough.
entries.translation: 海豚……聪明又滑溜。如果你不够快，它们就会逃回自己的海豚洞。
entries.sampleRaw: Dolphins... smart and slippery. They'll flee to their dolphin holes if you're not quick enough.

entries.source: Get that net ready, and don't stop until you catch up to them. But hurry, they won't wait around for a chat.
entries.translation: 准备好网，别停下，直到追上它们。但要快，它们可不会等着跟你聊天。
entries.sampleRaw: Get that net ready, and don't stop until you catch up to them. But hurry, they won't wait around for a chat.

entries.source: Cod? Oh, please. The most boring of fish, hands down.
entries.translation: 鳕鱼？哦，拜托。毫无疑问，最无聊的鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: Cod? Oh, please. The most boring of fish, hands down.

entries.source: Spin 'em with a fishing net; they'll twirl like a clumsy dancer.
entries.translation: 用渔网把它们转起来；它们会像笨拙的舞者一样打转。
entries.sampleRaw: Spin 'em with a fishing net; they'll twirl like a clumsy dancer.

entries.source: Spin 'em too much, though, and... well, you'll see.
entries.translation: 不过转得太多的话……嗯，你就知道了。
entries.sampleRaw: Spin 'em too much, though, and... well, you'll see.

entries.source: Pandas? Oh, now we're talking real game!
entries.translation: 熊猫？哦，这才叫真正的猎物！
entries.sampleRaw: Pandas? Oh, now we're talking real game!

entries.source: They're tough to find, but this old hunter knows a trick or two.
entries.translation: 它们很难找，但这位老猎人知道一两招。
entries.sampleRaw: They're tough to find, but this old hunter knows a trick or two.

entries.source: Feed 'em bamboo, and they might just love you for a second.
entries.translation: 喂它们竹子，它们说不定会爱你一秒钟。
entries.sampleRaw: Feed 'em bamboo, and they might just love you for a second.

entries.source: But finding them?
entries.translation: 但怎么找到它们？
entries.sampleRaw: But finding them?

entries.source: That's a secret only a 165-year-old like me can tell you. I won't though.
entries.translation: 那是个只有像我这样 165 岁的老家伙才能告诉你的秘密。不过我不会说的。
entries.sampleRaw: That's a secret only a 165-year-old like me can tell you. I won't though.
entries.numericSource: That's a secret only a {{N0}}-year-old like me can tell you. I won't though.
entries.numericTranslation: 那是个只有像我这样 {{N0}} 岁的老家伙才能告诉你的秘密。不过我不会说的。

entries.source: Salmon? Fast as lightning, those slippery devils.
entries.translation: 鲑鱼？快如闪电，那些滑溜的家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: Salmon? Fast as lightning, those slippery devils.

entries.source: Hit 'em with the net to slow them down. Just don't blink, or you'll be left with water in your boots.
entries.translation: 用网打它们让它们慢下来。千万别眨眼，否则你靴子里就只剩水了。
entries.sampleRaw: Hit 'em with the net to slow them down. Just don't blink, or you'll be left with water in your boots.

entries.source: Ah, the Invisibug, nearly impossible to see... but not to me, of course.
entries.translation: 啊，隐身虫，几乎看不见……但当然，瞒不过我。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, the Invisibug, nearly impossible to see... but not to me, of course.

entries.source: Look for the glow, throw a lasso, and hope your aim's as sharp as mine.
entries.translation: 寻找那道光，扔出套索，然后祈祷你的准头和我一样准。
entries.sampleRaw: Look for the glow, throw a lasso, and hope your aim's as sharp as mine.

entries.source: Shellwise, the ancient ones.
entries.translation: 甲壳兽，那些古老的存在。
entries.sampleRaw: Shellwise, the ancient ones.

entries.source: Well, ancient compared to you, not me, I'm only 178, after all.
entries.translation: 嗯，跟你比起来算古老，跟我可不算，毕竟我才 178 岁。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, ancient compared to you, not me, I'm only 178, after all.
entries.numericSource: Well, ancient compared to you, not me, I'm only {{N0}}, after all.
entries.numericTranslation: 嗯，跟你比起来算古老，跟我可不算，毕竟我才 {{N0}} 岁。

entries.source: No real tricks here. Just chuck your net until they give up.
entries.translation: 这里没什么真正的窍门。就一直扔网，直到它们放弃。
entries.sampleRaw: No real tricks here. Just chuck your net until they give up.

entries.source: It's not pretty, but it works.
entries.translation: 不太好看，但管用。
entries.sampleRaw: It's not pretty, but it works.

entries.source: Pufferfish... Have you tried looking in the Kelpwoven Tunnels?
entries.translation: 河豚……你有没有试过去海带交织隧道里找找？
entries.sampleRaw: Pufferfish... Have you tried looking in the Kelpwoven Tunnels?

entries.source: I've seen a few, Spikes they are called.
entries.translation: 我见过几个，它们叫尖刺。
entries.sampleRaw: I've seen a few, Spikes they are called.

entries.source: You'll need a special Fishing Net with a long range and stand at a distance from them.
entries.translation: 你需要一张射程很远的特殊渔网，并站在离它们有一定距离的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: You'll need a special Fishing Net with a long range and stand at a distance from them.

entries.source: Howdy!
entries.translation: 你好啊！
entries.sampleRaw: Howdy!

entries.source: This Beacon here is incredibly ancient.
entries.translation: 这里的这座信标极其古老.
entries.sampleRaw: This Beacon here is §oincredibly §fancient.

entries.source: Some even believe it's a Precursor relic!
entries.translation: 有些人甚至认为它是先遣者的圣物!
entries.sampleRaw: Some even believe it's a §5Precursor §frelic!

entries.source: It radiates a strange energy that we must stabilize by fine-tuning its frequencies.
entries.translation: 它散发着一种奇特的能量，我们必须通过微调它的频率来使其稳定。
entries.sampleRaw: It radiates a strange energy that we must stabilize by fine-tuning its frequencies.

entries.source: Occasionally the signal falters, and we have to recalibrate it.
entries.translation: 偶尔信号会变得不稳定，我们就得重新校准它。
entries.sampleRaw: Occasionally the signal falters, and we have to recalibrate it.

entries.source: Over, and over, and over again.
entries.translation: 一遍，一遍，又一遍。
entries.sampleRaw: Over, and over, and over again.

entries.source: Why? I wish I knew why...
entries.translation: 为什么？我也想知道为什么……
entries.sampleRaw: Why? I wish I knew why...

entries.source: <player>! Have you talked to Hina at the front of the island to get your hands on a Heart of the Forest?
entries.translation: <player>！你有没有和岛前方的Hina谈过，去弄到一颗森林之心？
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player>§f! Have you talked to §bHina §fat the front of the island to get your hands on a §aHeart of the Forest§f?

entries.source: Hi <player>!
entries.translation: 嗨，<player>！
entries.sampleRaw: Hi §7<player>§f!

entries.source: David Hunterborough says you've completed your training.
entries.translation: David Hunterborough说你已经完成了训练。
entries.sampleRaw: §bDavid Hunterborough §fsays you've completed your training.

entries.source: Now, it's time to teach you the true purpose of hunting.
entries.translation: 现在，是时候教你狩猎的真正目的了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now, it's time to teach you the true purpose of §ahunting§f.

entries.source: Every Shard you collect goes into your Hunting Box, located in the Hunting Skill Menu.
entries.translation: 你收集的每一块碎片都会进入你的狩猎盒，它位于狩猎技能菜单中。
entries.sampleRaw: Every Shard you collect goes into your §aHunting Box§f, located in the §aHunting Skill Menu§f.

entries.source: There are two things you can do with those Shards.
entries.translation: 对于这些碎片，你可以做两件事。
entries.sampleRaw: There are two things you can do with those Shards.

entries.source: Are you following so far?
entries.translation: 你到目前为止都跟上了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you following so far?

entries.source: You can either syphon or fuse them.
entries.translation: 你可以选择吸取它们，或者融合它们。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can either §csyphon §for §5fuse §fthem.

entries.source: Syphoning is key - it lets you permanently gain the attribute of the creature it came from.
entries.translation: 吸取是关键——它能让你永久获得该生物来源的属性。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSyphoning is key - it lets you permanently gain the §cattribute §fof the creature it came from.

entries.source: Attributes are very much like Pet abilities in a way.
entries.translation: 属性在某种程度上非常像宠物能力。
entries.sampleRaw: Attributes are very much like §2Pet §fabilities in a way.

entries.source: But hunting lets you harness those powers independently of the creature.
entries.translation: 但狩猎让你能够脱离该生物本身来驾驭这些力量。
entries.sampleRaw: But hunting lets you harness those powers independently of the creature.

entries.source: Here, take this Phanpyre Shard.
entries.translation: 来，拿着这块焰灵碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, take this Phanpyre Shard.

entries.source: Open your Hunting Box, inside the Hunting Skill Menu, and syphon it.
entries.translation: 打开狩猎技能菜单中的狩猎盒，然后吸取它。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOpen your §aHunting Box§f, inside the §aHunting Skill Menu§f, and §csyphon §fit.

entries.source: Go inside your Hunting Box, inside the Hunting Skill Menu, and Syphon it.
entries.translation: 进入狩猎技能菜单中的狩猎盒，然后吸取它。
entries.sampleRaw: Go inside your §aHunting Box§f, inside the §aHunting Skill Menu§f, and §cSyphon §fit.

entries.source: Congratulations! You permanently unlocked the [Shard Name] attribute!
entries.translation: 恭喜！你永久解锁了[Shard Name]属性！
entries.sampleRaw: §fCongratulations! You permanently unlocked the §7[Shard Name] §fattribute!

entries.source: Every time you syphon more of a Shard, that attribute will grow stronger.
entries.translation: 每当你吸取更多同种碎片，该属性就会变得更强。
entries.sampleRaw: Every time you §csyphon §fmore of a Shard, that §cattribute §fwill grow stronger.

entries.source: You can view it in your Attribute Menu inside the Hunting Skill Menu.
entries.translation: 你可以在狩猎技能菜单中的属性菜单里查看它。
entries.sampleRaw: You can view it in your §cAttribute Menu §finside the §aHunting Skill Menu§f.

entries.source: Yes!
entries.translation: 是的！
entries.sampleRaw: Yes!

entries.source: Like I said earlier, you can also fuse Shards.
entries.translation: 就像我之前说的，你也可以融合碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: Like I said earlier, you can also §5fuse §fShards.

entries.source: The Precursors built a machine that merges the genetic essence of two creatures.
entries.translation: 先驱者建造了一台机器，能融合两种生物基因精华。
entries.sampleRaw: The §5Precursors §fbuilt a machine that merges the genetic essence of two creatures.

entries.source: We call this process fusion.
entries.translation: 我们把这个过程称为融合。
entries.sampleRaw: We call this process §5fusion§f.

entries.source: To fuse, combine 5 Shards of one creature with 5 Shards of another in the Fusion Machine.
entries.translation: 要融合，就在融合机中把一种生物的 5 个碎片与另一种生物的 5 个碎片组合起来。
entries.sampleRaw: To fuse, combine §a5 §fShards of one creature with §a5 §fShards of another in the Fusion Machine.
entries.numericSource: To fuse, combine {{N0}} Shards of one creature with {{N1}} Shards of another in the Fusion Machine.
entries.numericTranslation: 要融合，就在融合机中把一种生物的 {{N0}} 个碎片与另一种生物的 {{N1}} 个碎片组合起来。

entries.source: The fusion process can uncover creatures that haven't been discovered yet!
entries.translation: 融合过程可以揭示尚未被发现的生物！
entries.sampleRaw: The fusion process can uncover creatures that haven't been discovered yet!

entries.source: I've given you 5 Phanpyre Shards and 5 Cod Shards to fuse in the Fusion Machine.
entries.translation: 我给了你 5 个焰灵碎片和 5 个鳕鱼碎片,拿去融合机里融合吧.
entries.sampleRaw: I've given you §a5 Phanpyre Shards §fand §a5 Cod Shards §fto fuse in the Fusion Machine.
entries.numericSource: I've given you {{N0}} Phanpyre Shards and {{N1}} Cod Shards to fuse in the Fusion Machine.
entries.numericTranslation: 我给了你 {{N0}} 个焰灵碎片和 {{N1}} 个鳕鱼碎片,拿去融合机里融合吧.

entries.source: Try it out and see what you can create!
entries.translation: 试试看，看看你能创造出什么！
entries.sampleRaw: Try it out and see what you can create!

entries.source: Go on, try to fuse Shards together in the fusion machine.
entries.translation: 去吧，试着在融合机里把碎片融合在一起。
entries.sampleRaw: Go on, try to fuse Shards together in the fusion machine.

entries.source: You might need to hunt a few more creatures first!
entries.translation: 你可能需要先多猎杀一些生物！
entries.sampleRaw: You might need to hunt a few more creatures first!

entries.source: You fused a [Shard Name] shard!
entries.translation: 你融合了一个[Shard Name]碎片!
entries.sampleRaw: You fused a §7[Shard Name] shard!

entries.source: Interesting...
entries.translation: 有意思……
entries.sampleRaw: Interesting...

entries.source: Fusions can have very peculiar results, I'm sure you will spend a lot of time around here.
entries.translation: 融合可能会产生非常奇特的结果，我相信你会在这里花上不少时间。
entries.sampleRaw: Fusions can have very peculiar results, I'm sure you will spend a lot of time around here.

entries.source: Anyhow, I don't think I have anything left to teach you.
entries.translation: 总之，我觉得我已经没什么可教你的了。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyhow, I don't think I have anything left to teach you.

entries.source: You might want to talk to David Hunterborough next.
entries.translation: 你接下来也许想和David Hunterborough谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: You might want to talk to §bDavid Hunterborough §fnext.

entries.source: We are still discovering Shards every year!
entries.translation: 我们每年都还在发现新的碎片！
entries.sampleRaw: We are still discovering Shards every year!

entries.source: Fusions are infinite!
entries.translation: 融合是无穷无尽的！
entries.sampleRaw: Fusions are infinite!

entries.source: ✆ In my spare time I like to go swimming down in the Murkwater Loch.
entries.translation: ✆ 空闲时我喜欢去浊水湖里游泳。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIn my spare time I like to go swimming down in the §2Murkwater Loch§f.

entries.source: ✆ There are so many beautiful creatures to see down there.
entries.translation: ✆ 那下面有好多美丽的生物可以看。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThere are so many beautiful creatures to see down there.

entries.source: ✆ Verdants, Azures, Shellwise, Joydives, I've seen them all.
entries.translation: ✆ 翠绿、蔚蓝、贝壳、乐潜，我全都见过。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §aVerdants§f, §9Azures§f, §aShellwise§f, §9Joydives§f, I've seen them all.

entries.source: ✆ However, there's one that I've never quite been able to find.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过，有一种我一直没能找到。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHowever, there's one that I've never quite been able to find.

entries.source: ✆ The folk around here call her Nessie.
entries.translation: ✆ 这附近的人都叫她尼斯。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe folk around here call her §dNessie§f.

entries.source: ✆ She's so seldom seen that many don't even believe she truly exists.
entries.translation: ✆ 她极少露面，很多人甚至不相信她真的存在。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fShe's so seldom seen that many don't even believe she truly exists.

entries.source: ✆ But I do. I can sense her down there sometimes, while I'm swimming.
entries.translation: ✆ 但我相信。我游泳时有时能感觉到她在下面。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut I do. I can sense her down there sometimes, while I'm swimming.

entries.source: ✆ So, how about it?
entries.translation: ✆ 那么，怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSo, how about it?

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Nessie Shard and I'll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一个尼斯碎片来，我就把我的Abiphone联系人给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me a §6Nessie Shard §fand I'll give you my §3Abiphone Contact§f.

entries.source: ✆ Looks like you don't have the Nessie Shard I asked for.
entries.translation: ✆ 看来你没有我要的尼斯碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLooks like you don't have the §6Nessie Shard §fI asked for.

entries.source: ✆ I've heard that she's quite a rare catch, so I guess you'll just have to keep trying.
entries.translation: ✆ 我听说她相当难遇到，所以我想你只能继续尝试了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI've heard that she's quite a rare catch, so I guess you'll just have to keep trying.

entries.source: ✆ Wow! You really found her! What was she like?
entries.translation: ✆ 哇！你真的找到她了！她长什么样？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWow! You really found her! What was she like?

entries.source: ✆ I bet!
entries.translation: ✆ 我敢打赌！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI bet!

entries.source: ✆ I can't believe she actually exists... I was beginning to lose hope.
entries.translation: ✆ 我真不敢相信她居然真的存在……我都快开始失去希望了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI can't believe she actually exists... I was beginning to lose hope.

entries.source: ✆ Looks like I need to get down to the Loch as soon as possible.
entries.translation: ✆ 看来我得尽快赶到那片湖泊去。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLooks like I need to get down to the §2Loch §fas soon as possible.

entries.source: ✆ Anyways, as promised, here's my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 总之，按照约定，这是我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAnyways, as promised, here's my contact.

entries.source: ✆ Give me a call if you ever need to use the Fusion Machine!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你需要用融合机，随时给我打电话！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fGive me a call if you ever need to use the §5Fusion Machine§f!

entries.source: I watched the comings and goings in this park and it occurred to me that a very common problem plagues these areas.
entries.translation: 我观察了这座公园里的人来人往，发现这些区域都深受一个非常普遍的问题困扰。
entries.sampleRaw: I watched the comings and goings in this park and it occurred to me that a very common problem plagues these areas.

entries.source: Moles, you see. They have been burrowing everywhere, their tunnels are disrupting the landscape, they ruined the beauty of this place. It's gotten hard to ignore.
entries.translation: 你看，是鼹鼠。它们到处打洞，隧道破坏了地貌，毁掉了这里的美景。这已经让人难以忽视了。
entries.sampleRaw: §6Moles§f, you see. They have been burrowing everywhere, their tunnels are disrupting the landscape, they ruined the §5§obeauty §r§fof this place. It's gotten hard to ignore.

entries.source: You need an experienced person to handle the situation.
entries.translation: 你需要一个经验丰富的人来处理这个情况。
entries.sampleRaw: You need an experienced person to handle the situation.

entries.source: Those troublesome creatures are ruining everything and must be dealt with. Do you understand?
entries.translation: 那些麻烦的家伙正在毁掉一切，必须处理掉。你明白吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Those troublesome creatures are ruining everything and must be dealt with. Do you understand?

entries.source: This park deserves better and I want to see it flourish like it used to be.
entries.translation: 这座公园值得更好的，我想看到它像从前一样繁荣。
entries.sampleRaw: This park deserves better and I want to see it flourish like it used to be.

entries.source: Let us keep this between us, and I will generously reward you for your efforts.
entries.translation: 这件事就我们俩知道，我会为你的努力慷慨地奖励你。
entries.sampleRaw: Let us keep this between us, and I will §agenerously reward §fyou for your efforts.

entries.source: The moles must be dealt with, and I am sure you will do so quickly and quietly.
entries.translation: 必须处理掉那些鼹鼠，我相信你会迅速而安静地完成。
entries.sampleRaw: The moles must be dealt with, and I am sure you will do so quickly and quietly.

entries.source: Ridiculous! How could I be a mole if I am wearing human clothes, huh?
entries.translation: 荒谬！我要是穿着人类的衣服，怎么可能是鼹鼠呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lRidiculous! §r§fHow could I be a mole if I am §bwearing human clothes§f, huh?

entries.source: Have you seen moles wearing human clothes before?
entries.translation: 你见过穿人类衣服的鼹鼠吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you seen moles wearing human clothes before?

entries.source: I don't think so. Now get back to the issue!
entries.translation: 我想没有吧。现在回到正题！
entries.sampleRaw: I don't think so. Now get back to the issue!

entries.source: Great. First thing we need is to build some traps.
entries.translation: 很好。我们首先需要建造一些陷阱。
entries.sampleRaw: Great. First thing we need is to build some §5traps§f.

entries.source: For that however, I need 512 Jungle Logs, should be enough to get things going.
entries.translation: 不过为此,我需要 512 个丛林原木,应该足够让事情运转起来了.
entries.sampleRaw: For that however, I need §a512 Jungle Logs§f, should be enough to get things going.
entries.numericSource: For that however, I need {{N0}} Jungle Logs, should be enough to get things going.
entries.numericTranslation: 不过为此,我需要 {{N0}} 个丛林原木,应该足够让事情运转起来了.

entries.source: Moles loooove carrots, they are just too good to resist.
entries.translation: 鼹鼠超——级喜欢胡萝卜，它们实在太好吃了，根本抵挡不住。
entries.sampleRaw: Moles §6loooove carrots§f, they are just too good to resist.

entries.source: Don't worry, I've got a stash ready.
entries.translation: 别担心，我已经准备好了一批存货。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't worry, I've got a stash ready.

entries.source: Just thinking about them makes me... Uhm, I mean makes them come out of their hiding space.
entries.translation: 光是想想它们就让我……呃，我是说让它们从藏身处出来。
entries.sampleRaw: Just thinking about them §omakes me§f... Uhm, I mean §omakes them §fcome out of their hiding space.

entries.source: If you can bring me 512 Jungle Logs, we can make some traps!
entries.translation: 如果你能带给我 512 个丛林原木,我们就能做一些陷阱!
entries.sampleRaw: If you can bring me §a512 Jungle Logs§f, we can make some §5traps§f!
entries.numericSource: If you can bring me {{N0}} Jungle Logs, we can make some traps!
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你能带给我 {{N0}} 个丛林原木,我们就能做一些陷阱!

entries.source: Fantastic, that's all I needed to build the traps.
entries.translation: 太棒了，这就是我建造陷阱所需的全部材料。
entries.sampleRaw: Fantastic, that's all I needed to build the §5traps§f.

entries.source: It will take me some time to assemble them, so you should come back later.
entries.translation: 组装它们需要一些时间，所以你晚点再来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: It will take me some time to assemble them, so you should §acome back later§f.

entries.source: The traps are ready for use; All that remains is to set them up in the right place. Once you find the ideal spots, go ahead and deploy them.
entries.translation: 陷阱已经可以用了；剩下的就是把它们安置在正确的位置。一旦你找到理想的地点，就去部署它们吧。
entries.sampleRaw: The §5traps §fare ready for use; All that remains is to set them up in the §aright place§f. Once you find the ideal spots, go ahead and deploy them.

entries.source: Good job, partner. Now we only need to wait for the right moment for these pests to show up.
entries.translation: 干得好，搭档。现在我们只需要等待合适的时机，让这些害虫现身。
entries.sampleRaw: Good job, partner. Now we only need to §6wait §ffor the §aright moment §ffor these pests to show up.

entries.source: This might take some time, so you should come back later.
entries.translation: 这可能需要一些时间，所以你晚点再来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: This might take some time, so you should come back later.

entries.source: Hey.. uhm partner! I swear it's not what you think!
entries.translation: 嘿……呃,搭档!我发誓事情不是你想的那样!
entries.sampleRaw: Hey.. §ouhm §rpartner! I §lswear §rit's not what you think!

entries.source: Could you lend me a hand here, I can explain everything!
entries.translation: 你能帮我一把吗，我可以解释一切！
entries.sampleRaw: Could you lend me a hand here, I can §aexplain everything§f!

entries.source: Thank you so much, I was stuck there for at least 3 minutes, I was almost gone for good.
entries.translation: 太感谢你了,我在那儿被困了至少 3 分钟,差点就永远回不来了.
entries.sampleRaw: §aThank you so much§f, I was stuck there for §lat least 3 minutes§f, I was almost gone for good.
entries.numericSource: Thank you so much, I was stuck there for at least {{N0}} minutes, I was almost gone for good.
entries.numericTranslation: 太感谢你了,我在那儿被困了至少 {{N0}} 分钟,差点就永远回不来了.

entries.source: ...and then I ate the carrot because I was almost starving in there!
entries.translation: ……然后我吃了那根胡萝卜，因为我在里面快饿死了！
entries.sampleRaw: §f...and then I ate the §6carrot §fbecause I was almost starving in there!

entries.source: Ok, fine you caught me. But please don't tell the others, they wouldn't want to be my friends anymore if they knew the truth.
entries.translation: 好吧，行吧，你抓到我了。但请别告诉其他人，要是他们知道真相，就不会再想跟我做朋友了。
entries.sampleRaw: Ok, fine you caught me. But §cplease don't tell the others§f, they wouldn't want to be my friends anymore if they knew the truth.

entries.source: Here, take this as compensation for all the trouble I made you go through.
entries.translation: 给，拿着这个，算是对我给你添的所有麻烦的补偿。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this as §acompensation §ffor all the trouble I made you go through.

entries.source: I hope you forgive me after this and we can still be friends.
entries.translation: 希望你能原谅我，我们还能继续做朋友。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you forgive me after this and we can still be §6friends§f.

entries.source: I wish I could be in love just like Romero & Juliette.
entries.translation: 我真希望能像 Romero 和 Juliette 那样坠入爱河.
entries.sampleRaw: I wish I could be in love just like §9Romero §f& §dJuliette.

entries.source: Hello!
entries.translation: 你好！
entries.sampleRaw: Hello!

entries.source: Are you a fan of Reptiles and Amphibians? I can't get enough of them!
entries.translation: 你喜欢爬行动物和两栖动物吗？我对它们简直爱不释手！
entries.sampleRaw: Are you a fan of §aReptiles §fand §bAmphibians§f? I can't get enough of them!
