entries.source: They're so precious and cute!
entries.translation: 它们真是太珍贵、太可爱了！
entries.sampleRaw: They're so precious and cute!

entries.source: They can be very hard to find, but they all have unique abilities.
entries.translation: 它们可能非常难找，但都拥有独特的能力。
entries.sampleRaw: They can be very hard to find, but they all have unique abilities.

entries.source: Their genetics differ from most other creatures.
entries.translation: 它们的基因与大多数其他生物不同。
entries.sampleRaw: Their genetics differ from most other creatures.

entries.source: In the Fusion Machine, fusing shards with a Reptile often yields powerful results.
entries.translation: 在融合机中，将碎片与爬行动物融合往往能产生强大的效果。
entries.sampleRaw: In the §5Fusion Machine§f, fusing shards with a Reptile often yields powerful results.

entries.source: ✆ Oh hey, I've seen you around.
entries.translation: ✆ 哦嘿，我见过你在附近转悠。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOh hey, I've seen you around.

entries.source: ✆ I've been trying to get my Abiphone updated with more local contacts.
entries.translation: ✆ 我一直在想办法给我的 Abiphone 更新更多本地联系人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI've been trying to get my Abiphone updated with more local contacts.

entries.source: ✆ But I don't just hand out my number to anyone. You've got to earn it.
entries.translation: ✆ 但我可不是随便把号码给任何人的。你得靠本事赢得它。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut I don't just hand out my number to anyone. You've got to earn it.

entries.source: ✆ There's this creature I've been dying to track. It shifts colors, blends in, vanishes like mist.
entries.translation: ✆ 我一直特别想追踪一种生物。它会变换颜色、融入环境，像雾一样消失。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThere's this creature I've been dying to track. It shifts colors, blends in, vanishes like mist.

entries.source: ✆ They say if you're lucky, you might find one in Tree Gifts... a Chameleon Shard.
entries.translation: ✆ 据说运气好的话，你可能会在树礼中找到一只……变色龙碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThey say if you're lucky, you might find one in §2Tree Gifts§f... a §6Chameleon Shard§f.

entries.source: ✆ Bring me one. If you can do that, maybe you're worth talking to.
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一只来。如果你能做到，也许你还值得一聊。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me one. If you can do that, maybe you're worth talking to.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.source: ✆ You actually found one? You weren't kidding around.
entries.translation: ✆ 你真的找到了一只？你可不是在开玩笑。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou actually found one? You weren't kidding around.

entries.source: ✆ Look at those colors... even holding it feels like it's trying to disappear.
entries.translation: ✆ 看看这些颜色……就连拿着它都感觉它想消失似的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLook at those colors... even holding it feels like it's trying to disappear.

entries.source: ✆ Alright, fair's fair. I'm adding you to my Abiphone.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，公平交易。我把你加进我的 Abiphone 了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAlright, fair's fair. I'm adding you to my Abiphone.

entries.translation: 你可以通过了。

entries.translation: 啊，你好。

entries.translation: 你一定是 (Player)，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: You must be (Player), correct?

entries.translation: 我以前遇到过你的其他版本。
entries.sampleRaw: I've encountered versions of you before.

entries.translation: 你在寻找天界时间护符，对吧？

entries.translation: 如果你在寻找天界时间护符，你需要召唤 Shen的 Citrinitas。
entries.sampleRaw: If you're searching for the §cCelestial Timecharm§f, you'll need to summon §cShen's Citrinitas§f.

entries.source: Proceed to the next sequence to continue your journey.
entries.translation: 前往下一序列以继续你的旅程。
entries.sampleRaw: Proceed to the next sequence to continue your journey.

entries.source: Hello there.
entries.translation: 你好。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello there.

entries.source: Which dimension do you originate from?
entries.translation: 你来自哪个维度？
entries.sampleRaw: Which dimension do you originate from?

entries.source: I see.
entries.translation: 我明白了。
entries.sampleRaw: I see.

entries.source: Have you met the Shen from your own dimension yet?
entries.translation: 你见过你自己维度里的 Shen 了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you met the Shen from your own dimension yet?

entries.source: Actually, never mind.
entries.translation: 其实，算了。
entries.sampleRaw: Actually, never mind.

entries.source: When you do encounter him, please direct him to us.
entries.translation: 当你遇到他时，请让他来找我们。
entries.sampleRaw: When you do encounter him, please direct him to us.

entries.source: We could benefit from his intellect.
entries.translation: 我们能从他的智慧中获益。
entries.sampleRaw: We could benefit from his intellect.

entries.source: The next Shen will provide you with the Celestial Timecharm.
entries.translation: 下一位 Shen 会给你天界时间护符。
entries.sampleRaw: The next Shen will provide you with the §cCelestial Timecharm§f.

entries.source: You're undertaking a significant responsibility, you know.
entries.translation: 你知道，你正在承担一项重大的责任。
entries.sampleRaw: You're undertaking a significant responsibility, you know.

entries.source: Let's hope you will succeed where others have not.
entries.translation: 希望你能在别人失败的地方取得成功。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's hope you will succeed where others have not.

entries.source: Greetings.
entries.translation: 你好。
entries.sampleRaw: Greetings.

entries.source: Could you please refrain from summoning the other Shens?
entries.translation: 能否请你不要再召唤其他沈了？
entries.sampleRaw: Could you please refrain from summoning the other Shens?

entries.source: We were engaged in an important cognitive construction.
entries.translation: 我们正在进行一项重要的认知构建。
entries.sampleRaw: We were engaged in an important cognitive construction.

entries.source: Understood, here it is.
entries.translation: 明白了，给你。
entries.sampleRaw: Understood, here it is.

entries.source: Time is of the essence.
entries.translation: 时间至关重要。
entries.sampleRaw: Time is of the essence.

entries.source: At this altitude, temporal distortions are most severe.
entries.translation: 在这个高度，时间扭曲最为严重。
entries.sampleRaw: At this altitude, temporal distortions are most severe.

entries.source: It seems you've mastered the sequencing quite well...
entries.translation: 看来你已经很好地掌握了序列……
entries.sampleRaw: It seems you've mastered the sequencing quite well...

entries.translation: 不过不幸的是，你可能会像其他人一样失败。
entries.sampleRaw: Though it's unfortunate you may §cfail §flike the others.

entries.source: Well, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you.
entries.translation: 好吧，我想告诉你也无妨。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you.

entries.source: You're either destined to perish or become invaluable to us.
entries.translation: 你要么注定消亡，要么成为我们不可或缺的存在。
entries.sampleRaw: You're either destined to perish or become invaluable to us.

entries.sampleRaw: The details of our grand project, however, will remain undisclosed.

entries.sampleRaw: §fPerhaps you'll surpass Julian, Maeve, or even Seth in your dimension.

entries.translation: 你可以通过了。

entries.source: Dante wanted order. I want balance.
entries.translation: Dante想要秩序。我想要平衡。

entries.sampleRaw: Dante made you obey. I'll make you §othrive§f.

entries.sampleRaw: No more greed. No more chaos. Only fair progress for all.

entries.translation: 我不信任这个人。你不会投票给他。

entries.source: Voting for yourself...
entries.translation: 给自己投票……
entries.sampleRaw: Voting for yourself...

entries.source: Where greed and narcissism tread, reprimand follows.

entries.sampleRaw: Where greed and narcissism tread, reprimand follows.

entries.source: This will not go unseen.
entries.translation: 此事不会被忽视。
entries.sampleRaw: This will not go unseen.

entries.sampleRaw: Please select someone else.

entries.translation: 这位公民不在我的名册中。

entries.sampleRaw: His crown rests in a place no vote can touch.

entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps give those with fewer influence a chance.

entries.sampleRaw: All I have is spoons. §oRusty §fspoons. Useful spoons.

entries.source: The right tools for breaking out of prison.
entries.translation: 越狱的合适工具。
entries.sampleRaw: The right tools for breaking out of prison.

entries.source: May you loosen the shackles of the imprisoned, comrade.
entries.translation: 愿你能解开被囚者的枷锁，同志。
entries.sampleRaw: May you loosen the shackles of the imprisoned, comrade.

entries.source: Digs fast, rusts even faster.
entries.translation: 挖得快，锈得更快。
entries.sampleRaw: Digs fast, rusts even faster.

entries.source: If Aura asks? Well, that's your problem.
entries.translation: 如果Aura问起？嗯，那是你的问题。
entries.sampleRaw: If Aura asks? Well, that's your problem.

entries.source: What do you want?
entries.translation: 你想要什么？
entries.sampleRaw: What do you want?

entries.source: [YOUTUBE] im_a_squid_kid has betrayed us all by removing Mayor Aura's Minion Union perk.
entries.translation: [YOUTUBE] im_a_squid_kid 移除了Mayor Aura的仆从联盟增益，背叛了我们所有人。
entries.sampleRaw: §c[§fYOUTUBE§c] im_a_squid_kid §fhas betrayed us all by removing Mayor Aura's Minion Union perk.

entries.source: If you want to speak to them, head to the jail...
entries.translation: 如果你想和他们说话，就去监狱……
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to speak to them, head to the jail...

entries.source: Now move along if you do not want to end up in there as well.
entries.translation: 现在走吧，除非你也想被关进去。
entries.sampleRaw: Now move along if you do not want to end up in there as well.

entries.source: [MVP+] Confused_Goon has betrayed us all by removing Mayor Aura's Work Harder perk.
entries.translation: [MVP+] Confused_Goon 移除了 Mayor Aura 的更努力工作增益,背叛了我们所有人.

entries.source: [MVP++] SnowflakeKiwi has betrayed us all by removing Mayor Aura's Work Smarter perk.
entries.translation: [MVP++] SnowflakeKiwi 移除了Mayor Aura的更聪明工作增益，背叛了我们所有人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b[MVP§1++§b] SnowflakeKiwi §fhas betrayed us all by removing Mayor Aura's Work Smarter perk.

entries.source: Dante best!
entries.translation: Dante最棒！
entries.sampleRaw: Dante best!

entries.source: Aura best, I mean...
entries.translation: Aura最棒，我是说……
entries.sampleRaw: Aura best, I mean...

entries.source: Aura... best...
entries.translation: Aura……最棒的……
entries.sampleRaw: Aura... best...

entries.source: Aura best... I guess?
entries.translation: Aura最棒的……大概吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Aura best... I guess?

entries.source: I will never get used to this.
entries.translation: 我永远也习惯不了这个。
entries.sampleRaw: I will never get used to this.

entries.source: What? This isn't a zoo. Keep it moving!
entries.translation: 什么？这可不是动物园。快走开！
entries.sampleRaw: What? This isn't a zoo. Keep it moving!

entries.source: One wrong move and you might end up like one of them.
entries.translation: 走错一步，你可能就会落得和他们一样的下场。
entries.sampleRaw: One wrong move and you might end up like one of them.

entries.source: We're always watching...
entries.translation: 我们一直在盯着……
entries.sampleRaw: We're always watching...

entries.source: Don't get any funny ideas...
entries.translation: 别动什么歪脑筋……
entries.sampleRaw: Don't get any funny ideas...

entries.source: No civilians too close.
entries.translation: 平民不得靠近。
entries.sampleRaw: No civilians too close.

entries.source: Don't test me.
entries.translation: 别来试探我。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't test me.

entries.source: I've got my eye on you
entries.translation: 我可盯着你呢
entries.sampleRaw: I've got my eye on you

entries.source: Ey! Back off!
entries.translation: 喂！退后！
entries.sampleRaw: Ey! Back off!

entries.source: Fine. Just know those perks could have been yours...
entries.translation: 好吧。只是你要知道，那些特权本来可以是你的……
entries.sampleRaw: Fine. Just know those perks could have been yours...

entries.source: Smart choice. Enjoy your perks...
entries.translation: 明智的选择。享受你的特权吧……
entries.sampleRaw: Smart choice. Enjoy your perks...

entries.source: Regretting your choice? Heh heh, no changing now. Come back when that bribe effect expires.
entries.translation: 后悔你的选择了？嘿嘿，现在可改不了。等那个贿赂效果过期了再来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Regretting your choice? Heh heh, no changing now. Come back when that bribe effect expires.

entries.source: Your greed sickens me. Wait until your current effect expires.
entries.translation: 你的贪婪让我恶心。等你当前的效果过期了再说。
entries.sampleRaw: Your greed sickens me. Wait until your current effect expires.

entries.source: You've amassed quite a fortune. I have an antiquity that might interest you. However, I wouldn't sell it to just anybody, you know? I need something in return. So, what do you say?
entries.translation: 你已经积攒了相当可观的财富。我有一件古董或许会让你感兴趣。不过，你知道的，我可不会随便卖给任何人。我需要一些回报。那么，你怎么说？
entries.sampleRaw: You've amassed quite a fortune. I have an antiquity that might interest you. However, I wouldn't sell it to just §oanybody§r§f, you know? I need something in return. So, what do you say?

entries.source: I'm glad we are in agreement, <Player>. Meet me in the Hub, we'll discuss our business then.
entries.translation: 很高兴我们达成了一致，<Player>。到中心岛来找我，我们到时候再谈生意。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm glad we are in agreement, §7<Player>§f. Meet me in the §aHub§f, we'll discuss our business then.

entries.source: Not everyone can afford my lifestyle!
entries.translation: 可不是谁都负担得起我这种生活方式！
entries.sampleRaw: Not everyone can afford my lifestyle!

entries.source: Pleasure seeing you again, <Player>!
entries.translation: 很高兴再次见到你，<Player>！
entries.sampleRaw: Pleasure seeing you again, §7<Player>§f!

entries.source: Pleasure seeing you again, <Player>. I have a fine offer for you...
entries.translation: 很高兴再次见到你，<Player>。我有个不错的提议给你……
entries.sampleRaw: Pleasure seeing you again, §7<Player>§f. I have a fine offer for you...

entries.source: Every rose has its...claws!
entries.translation: 每朵玫瑰都有它的……刺！
entries.sampleRaw: Every rose has its...claws!

entries.source: Aura thanks you for your cooperation. Come back in 30 minutes if you do not want to face the consequences.
entries.translation: Aura感谢你的配合。如果你不想面对后果，请在30分钟后回来。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura thanks you for your cooperation. Come back in 30 minutes if you do not want to face the §f§oconsequences§f.
entries.numericSource: Aura thanks you for your cooperation. Come back in {{N0}} minutes if you do not want to face the consequences.
entries.numericTranslation: Aura感谢你的配合。如果你不想面对后果，请在{{N0}}分钟后回来。

entries.source: You've just checked in a few seconds ago...
entries.translation: 你几秒钟前才刚登记过……
entries.sampleRaw: You've just checked in a few seconds ago...

entries.source: Now go, be a productive citizen for our great society.
entries.translation: 去吧，为我们伟大的社会做个有生产力的公民。
entries.sampleRaw: Now go, be a productive citizen for our great society.

entries.source: Kuudra runs are full of goodies.
entries.translation: 库德拉挑战里满是好东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §cKuudra §fruns are full of goodies.

entries.source: If you don't have time to claim them, I got your back.
entries.translation: 如果你没时间领取，我来帮你。
entries.sampleRaw: If you don't have time to claim them, I got your back.

entries.source: I'm looking for something.
entries.translation: 我在找一样东西。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm looking for something.

entries.source: Something with...reviving capabilities...
entries.translation: 一样具有……复活能力的东西……
entries.sampleRaw: Something with...reviving capabilities...

entries.source: Thank you...thank you...may he return...
entries.translation: 谢谢你……谢谢你……愿他归来……
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you...thank you...may he return...

entries.source: Do you not believe in a better future for SkyBlock?
entries.translation: 你难道不相信 SkyBlock 会有更好的未来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you not believe in a better future for SkyBlock?

entries.source: where am i? oh i am here now.
entries.translation: 我在哪？哦，我现在在这里了。
entries.sampleRaw: where am i? oh i am here now.

entries.source: o7
entries.translation: o7
entries.sampleRaw: o7

entries.source: [player] worst
entries.translation: [player]最差
entries.sampleRaw: §7[player] §fworst

entries.source: We went to school for this.
entries.translation: 我们上学就是为了这个。
entries.sampleRaw: We went to school for this.

entries.source: My neighbor is the most narcissistic guy I have ever seen.
entries.translation: 我的邻居是我见过最自恋的家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: My neighbor is the most narcissistic guy I have ever seen.

entries.source: My neighbor told me to get off his property, but he doesn't even own this place!
entries.translation: 我的邻居叫我离开他的地盘，可这地方根本就不是他的！
entries.sampleRaw: My neighbor told me to get off his property, but he doesn't even own this place!

entries.source: Maybe I have to talk to the King about him. He is going too far. I think the current King is [name].
entries.translation: 也许我得跟国王谈谈他的事。他太过分了。我觉得现任国王是[name]。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I have to talk to the King about him. He is going too far. I think the current King is §7[name]§f.

entries.source: If not, no worries! They each have their own unlock requirements, which you can see inside the SkyMart Shop.
entries.translation: 如果没有，也别担心！它们各有各的解锁要求，你可以在 SkyMart 商店里查看。
entries.sampleRaw: If not, no worries! They each have their own unlock requirements, which you can see inside the §aSkyMart Shop§f.

entries.source: You can get one from SkyMart.
entries.translation: 你可以从 SkyMart 获得一个。
entries.sampleRaw: You can get one from §aSkyMart§f.

entries.source: I'm helping a friend complete her Chip collection, could you spare any?
entries.translation: 我在帮一个朋友完成她的芯片收藏，你能分我一些吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm helping a friend complete her §9Chip §fcollection, could you spare any?

entries.source: Thanks! I'll make sure to give this to her right away.
entries.translation: 谢谢！我保证马上把这个交给她。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThanks! I'll make sure to give this to her right away.

entries.source: This cult is fire.
entries.translation: 这个邪教太火了。
entries.sampleRaw: This cult is fire.

entries.source: Get it?
entries.translation: 懂了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Get it?

entries.source: Sometimes at night we tell spooky stores.
entries.translation: 有时晚上我们会讲些恐怖故事。
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes at night we tell spooky stores.

entries.source: That's good enough, right?
entries.translation: 这就够好了，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: That's good enough, right?

entries.source: Brian told me I would have an important role in his cult.
entries.translation: Brian告诉我，我会在他的邪教中担任重要角色。
entries.sampleRaw: §3Brian §ftold me I would have an important role in his cult.

entries.source: I'm not sure what the point of this cult is, but it's the closest thing I've found to a purpose in life.
entries.translation: 我不确定这个邪教的意义何在，但这是我找到的最接近人生目标的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not sure what the point of this cult is, but it's the closest thing I've found to a purpose in life.

entries.source: I need a sense of belonging.
entries.translation: 我需要一种归属感。
entries.sampleRaw: I need a sense of belonging.

entries.source: Ever heard of Timite?
entries.translation: 听说过时光石吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fEver heard of §9Timite§f?

entries.source: Ah, a fresh face! Timite is an ore in these parts!
entries.translation: 啊，新面孔！时光石是这一带的矿石！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAh, a fresh face! §9Timite§f is an ore in these parts!

entries.source: Timite is a bit of a shape-shifter.
entries.translation: 时光石有点会变形。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Timite§f is a bit of a shape-shifter.

entries.source: When it's young and spry, we call it Youngite. Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!
entries.translation: 当它年轻活泼时，我们叫它幼时石。精力充沛但什么都不懂！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhen it's young and spry, we call it §aYoungite§f. Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!

entries.source: Then Youngite ages into Timite, wise and valuable!
entries.translation: 然后幼时石会老化成时光石，睿智而珍贵！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen §9Youngite§f ages into §aTimite§f, wise and valuable!

entries.source: And with a little extra push, it becomes Obsolite, a grumpy old thing, complains about the 'good old days'.
entries.translation: 再稍微推一把，它就会变成古时石，一个脾气暴躁的老家伙，总抱怨“过去的好日子”。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd with a little extra push, it becomes §5Obsolite§f, a grumpy old thing, complains about the 'good old days'.

entries.source: Glad you asked! You need a Time Gun.
entries.translation: 很高兴你问了！你需要一把时间枪。
entries.sampleRaw: §fGlad you asked! You need a §9Time Gun§f.

entries.source: Craft one using enough Youngite. Point it at an ore, and bam! You've aged it faster than cheese left in the sun.
entries.translation: 用足够的幼时石合成一把。把它对准矿石，砰！你让它老化的速度比太阳下的奶酪还快。
entries.sampleRaw: §fCraft one using enough §aYoungite§f. Point it at an ore, and bam! You've aged it faster than cheese left in the sun.

entries.source: Precisely! And the older the ore, the more valuable it gets. Just like me!
entries.translation: 正是如此！而且矿石越古老就越值钱。就像我一样！
entries.sampleRaw: §fPrecisely! And the older the ore, the more valuable it gets. Just like me!

entries.source: Now go one, make those ores feel their age. Time's a-wastin'!
entries.translation: 现在去吧，让那些矿石感受一下它们的年纪。时间可不等人！
entries.sampleRaw: §fNow go one, make those ores feel their age. Time's a-wastin'!

entries.source: These bones ain't what they used to be.
entries.translation: 这把老骨头可不如从前了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThese bones ain't what they used to be.

entries.source: Maybe I should give myself a zap with the Time Gun... or maybe not.
entries.translation: 也许我该用时间枪电自己一下……也许还是算了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMaybe I should give myself a zap with the §9Time Gun§f... or maybe not.

entries.source: I tried using the Time Gun on my tea once.
entries.translation: 我有一次试着用时间枪对我的茶开了一枪。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI tried using the §9Time Gun §fon my tea once.

entries.source: Ended up with a cup of dust!
entries.translation: 结果得到了一杯灰尘！
entries.sampleRaw: §fEnded up with a cup of dust!

entries.source: Oh, <player>! I'm having a conundrum! There's so many corpses scattered around the Glacite Mineshafts, and so little time!
entries.translation: 哦，<player>！我遇到难题了！冰晶矿井周围散落着那么多尸体，而时间又那么少！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, §7<player>§f! I'm having a conundrum! There's so many corpses scattered around the §bGlacite Mineshafts§f, and so little time!

entries.source: ...So long as I get to keep the corpses.
entries.translation: ……只要尸体归我就行。
entries.sampleRaw: ...So long as I get to keep the corpses.

entries.source: Awesome! Okay, stand still real quick...
entries.translation: 太棒了！好，站着别动，很快就好……
entries.sampleRaw: Awesome! Okay, stand still real quick...

entries.source: *sniff sniff*
entries.translation: *嗅嗅 嗅嗅*
entries.sampleRaw: §f§o*sniff sniff*

entries.source: Okay, now I'm familiar with your scent!
entries.translation: 好了，现在我已经熟悉你的气味了！
entries.sampleRaw: Okay, now I'm familiar with your §ascent§f!

entries.source: Using my amazing power of smell, I'll track you as you move through the Glacite Mineshafts.
entries.translation: 凭借我惊人的嗅觉，你在冰晶矿井中移动时我都能追踪到你。
entries.sampleRaw: Using my amazing power of smell, I'll track you as you move through the §bGlacite Mineshafts§f.

entries.source: You know what the Glacite Mineshafts are, right?
entries.translation: 你知道冰晶矿井是什么吧？
entries.sampleRaw: You know what the §bGlacite Mineshafts §fare, right?

entries.source: Oh, that's okay.
entries.translation: 哦，没关系。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, that's okay.

entries.source: My wife's not gonna be happy.
entries.translation: 我老婆可不会高兴。
entries.sampleRaw: My wife's not gonna be happy.

entries.source: Been out here for months without so much as a scrap to show for it...
entries.translation: 在这儿待了好几个月，连一点收获都没有……
entries.sampleRaw: Been out here for months without so much as a scrap to show for it...

entries.source: You know, you're starting to look kinda tasty...
entries.translation: 你知道吗，你看起来开始有点美味了……
entries.sampleRaw: You know, you're starting to look kinda §f§otasty§f...

entries.source: Great, the look on your face had me worried for a second!
entries.translation: 太好了，你刚才的表情让我担心了一下！
entries.sampleRaw: Great, the look on your face had me worried for a second!

entries.source: Anyways, whenever you loot a Frozen Corpse, I'll come soon after to retrieve it.
entries.translation: 总之，每当你搜刮一具冰冻尸体，我随后就会赶来取走它。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, whenever you loot a §bFrozen Corpse§f, I'll come soon after to retrieve it.

entries.source: Come talk to me and I'll show you how many corpses we, the dream team, have gathered together!
entries.translation: 来找我聊聊，我会给你看看我们这对梦幻搭档一起收集了多少具尸体！
entries.sampleRaw: Come talk to me and I'll show you how many corpses we, the dream team, have gathered together!

entries.source: After reaching certain Frozen Corpse Milestones I'll even give you some useful stuff from my stash!
entries.translation: 达到特定的冰冻尸体里程碑后，我甚至会从我的存货里给你一些有用的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: After reaching certain §bFrozen Corpse Milestones §fI'll even give you some useful stuff from my stash!

entries.source: Here, take a look!
entries.translation: 来，看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take a look!

entries.source: Hmm, maybe you're not ready then, yet.
entries.translation: 嗯，那你可能还没准备好。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm, maybe you're not ready then, yet.

entries.source: Glacite Mineshafts sometimes pop up while you're mining in the Glacite Tunnels.
entries.translation: 你在冰川矿道里挖矿时，冰晶矿井有时会冒出来。
entries.sampleRaw: §bGlacite Mineshafts §fsometimes pop up while you're mining in the §bGlacite Tunnels§f.

entries.source: If you enter one, you'll fine Frozen Corpses strewn throughout the place - they're all that's left of some unfortunate dwarves from long ago!
entries.translation: 如果你进入其中一个，会发现冰冻尸体散落各处——它们是许久以前一些不幸矮人留下的全部遗骸！
entries.sampleRaw: If you enter one, you'll fine §bFrozen Corpses §fstrewn throughout the place - they're all that's left of some unfortunate dwarves from long ago!

entries.source: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!
entries.translation: 虽然他们因为已经死了之类的原因不太爱说话，但你仍然可以翻翻他们的背包找点战利品！
entries.sampleRaw: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!

entries.source: Now, why don't you go and find a Glacite Mineshafts or two, and then come talk to me again when you're ready for us to partner up?
entries.translation: 现在，你为什么不去找一两个冰晶矿井，等你准备好和我们搭档时再来找我聊聊？
entries.sampleRaw: Now, why don't you go and find a §bGlacite Mineshafts §for two, and then come talk to me again when you're ready for us to partner up?

entries.source: I can hear the footsteps of a traitor. You're not supposed to be here!
entries.translation: 我能听见叛徒的脚步声。你不该出现在这里！
entries.sampleRaw: I can hear the footsteps of a traitor. You're not supposed to be here!

entries.source: Hey, I can see you over there! You're not supposed to be here!
entries.translation: 嘿，我看见你在那边了！你不该出现在这里！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, I can see you over there! You're not supposed to be here!

entries.source: Get out of here, traitorous scum.
entries.translation: 滚出这里，叛徒渣滓。
entries.sampleRaw: Get out of here, traitorous scum.

entries.source: I lost them. Got to be around here somewhere...
entries.translation: 我跟丢了。他们肯定就在这附近……
entries.sampleRaw: I lost them. Got to be around here somewhere...

entries.source: I'm not that smart, they just needed a third person.
entries.translation: 我没那么聪明，他们只是需要第三个人。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not that smart, they just needed a third person.

entries.source: I like voicing my opinion.
entries.translation: 我喜欢表达自己的意见。
entries.sampleRaw: I like voicing my opinion.

entries.source: This side of the table isn't as valuable as the other side.
entries.translation: 桌子这一边可没有另一边那么有价值。
entries.sampleRaw: This side of the table isn't as valuable as the other side.

entries.source: Hey, this is a restricted area. Leave now!
entries.translation: 嘿，这里是禁区。立刻离开！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, this is a restricted area. Leave now!

entries.source: There's lots to do in the Spider's Den.
entries.translation: 蜘蛛巢穴里有很多事可做。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere's lots to do in the §4Spider's Den§f.

entries.source: Behind me is the Spiders Mound.
entries.translation: 我身后就是蜘蛛丘。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBehind me is the §4Spiders Mound§f.

entries.source: Be careful, though! The Broodmother has made the summit home, and she's quite tenacious!
entries.translation: 不过要小心！母巢已经占据了峰顶，而且她相当难缠！
entries.sampleRaw: §fBe careful, though! The §4Broodmother§f has made the summit home, and she's quite tenacious!

entries.source: Once there, test yourself against the Broodmother, if you're up to the challenge!
entries.translation: 到了那里，如果你敢接受挑战，就去和母巢较量一番吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Once there, test yourself against the §4Broodmother§f, if you're up to the challenge!

entries.source: Be careful, though. The Broodmother has made the summit to her home, and she's quite tenacious!
entries.translation: 不过要小心.蛛母已经把峰顶变成了她的巢穴,而且她相当难缠!
entries.sampleRaw: Be careful, though. The §4Broodmother§r has made the summit to her home, and she's quite tenacious!

entries.source: Behind me is Spider Mound. Many like to test their skills by trying to reach the top of it.
entries.translation: 我身后就是蜘蛛丘.很多人喜欢试着爬到它的顶端来考验自己的本领.
entries.sampleRaw: Behind me is §cSpider Mound§r. Many like to test their skills by trying to reach the top of it.

entries.source: Wow you're quite strong!.
entries.translation: 哇，你相当强啊！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow you're quite strong!.

entries.source: Unfortunately, there's always bigger fish. Or, in this case, a bigger spider.
entries.translation: 可惜，总是一山更比一山高。或者说，在这个情况下，是更大的蜘蛛。
entries.sampleRaw: Unfortunately, there's always bigger fish. Or, in this case, a bigger spider.

entries.source: But, for now, you should hone your skills until you reach Combat Skill Level 12, and then travel to The End.
entries.translation: 不过,眼下你应该磨练自己的技能,直到达到战斗技能等级 12,然后再前往末地.

entries.source: The gravel on this island seems to magically reappear when you break it. I don't ask questions.
entries.translation: 这座岛上的沙砾在你挖掉后似乎会魔法般地重新出现。我可不多问。
entries.sampleRaw: The gravel on this island seems to magically reappear when you break it. I don't ask questions.

entries.source: Those Dashing Spiders are pretty obnoxious. I find a well-placed arrow can help with that.
entries.translation: 那些疾冲蜘蛛挺烦人的。我发现一支射得准的箭能帮上忙。
entries.sampleRaw: Those Dashing Spiders are pretty obnoxious. I find a well-placed arrow can help with that.

entries.source: Broodmother, Broodfather, Arachne... There are so many dangerous spiders around here.
entries.translation: 蛛母、蛛父、阿拉克涅……这附近有太多危险的蜘蛛了。
entries.sampleRaw: Broodmother, Broodfather, Arachne... There are so many dangerous spiders around here.

entries.source: Slimes seem to spawn on the hills when it rains. They're a bit more dangerous during a thunderstorm.
entries.translation: 下雨时史莱姆似乎会在山丘上生成。在雷暴期间它们会更危险一些。
entries.sampleRaw: Slimes seem to spawn on the hills when it §brains§f. They're a bit more dangerous during a §6thunderstorm§f.

entries.source: Welcome to the Harvest Feast!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到丰收盛宴！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome to the §6Harvest Feast§f!

entries.source: We're cooking up a massive Communal Stew for everyone in SkyBlock and we need your help to season it!
entries.translation: 我们正在为 SkyBlock 的每个人烹制一大锅公共炖锅，我们需要你来帮忙调味！
entries.sampleRaw: We're cooking up a massive §eCommunal Stew §ffor everyone in SkyBlock and we need your help to season it!

entries.source: Three crops will be in-season at any given time, harvesting them will help season the stew and earn you exclusive items!
entries.translation: 任何时候都会有三样作物当季，收获它们能帮助给炖锅调味，并为你赢得专属物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Three crops will be in-season at any given time, harvesting them will help season the stew and earn you exclusive items!

entries.source: Welcome to the Grand Feast!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到盛大盛宴！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the §dGrand Feast§f!

entries.source: Whenever you get Seasoning you'll also earn a Kernel which my brother Scott can bake into more items!
entries.translation: 每当你获得调味料时，你还会获得一颗果仁，我的兄弟斯科特可以把它烘焙成更多物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Whenever you get §aSeasoning §fyou'll also earn a §eKernel §fwhich my brother Scott can bake into more items!

entries.source: Thanks for the donation! I've added a Kernel to your purse.
entries.translation: 感谢你的捐赠！我已经往你的钱包里添加了一颗果仁。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThanks for the donation! I've added a §eKernel §fto your purse.

entries.source: You've hit a new Feast Donation Tier!
entries.translation: 你达到了新的盛宴捐赠等级！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou've hit a new §aFeast Donation Tier§f!

entries.source: Talk to me to claim your Mason Jar and Kernels!
entries.translation: 来找我领取你的 Mason 罐子和果仁吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fTalk to me to claim your Mason Jar and §eKernels§f!

entries.source: ✆ Oh I don't give out my information to just anyone.
entries.translation: ✆ 哦，我可不会随便把我的信息告诉任何人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOh I don't give out my information to just anyone.

entries.source: ✆ Only the Feast's top patrons get that luxury.
entries.translation: ✆ 只有盛宴的顶级赞助者才能享受这种待遇。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOnly the Feast's top patrons get that luxury.

entries.source: ✆ Check out my brother Scott's Bakery, I'm sure he'll have something to help you get in contact with me.
entries.translation: ✆ 去看看我兄弟斯科特的烘焙坊吧，我相信他会有东西能帮你联系上我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCheck out my brother Scott's Bakery, I'm sure he'll have something to help you get in contact with me.

entries.source: ✆ I heard that <crop> will drop Seasoning more often then the other crops this month...
entries.translation: ✆ 我听说这个月 <crop> 掉落调味料的频率会比其它作物更高……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI heard that §a<crop> §fwill drop §2Seasoning §fmore often then the other crops this month...

entries.source: ✆ Yo! Just wanted to let you know that <crop>, <crop>, and <crop> are now in their harvesting season!
entries.translation: ✆ 哟！只是想告诉你，<crop>、<crop> 和 <crop> 现在进入了收获季节！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYo! Just wanted to let you know that §a<crop>§f, §a<crop>§f, and §a<crop> §fare now in their harvesting season!

entries.source: ✆ Farming these crops will earn you Seasonings and unique items!
entries.translation: ✆ 种植这些作物能为你赢得调味料和专属物品！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fFarming these crops will earn you §2Seasonings §fand unique items!

entries.source: ✆ Catch ya later!
entries.translation: ✆ 回头见！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCatch ya later!

entries.source: YUCK!! What is this??
entries.translation: 呕！！这是什么？？
entries.sampleRaw: YUCK!! What is this??

entries.source: Welcome to the Grand Bakery!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到盛大烘焙坊！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome to the §cGrand Bakery§f!

entries.source: Whenever you help season the Communal Stew during a Grand Feast, you'll earn a Kernel.
entries.translation: 每当你在盛大盛宴期间帮忙给公共炖锅调味，你都会获得一颗果仁。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhenever you help season the §eCommunal Stew §fduring a §dGrand Feast§f, you'll earn a §eKernel§f.

entries.source: Those Kernels can be baked here into a variety of items!
entries.translation: 那些果仁可以在这里烤成各种各样的物品！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThose §eKernels §fcan be baked here into a variety of items!

entries.source: ✆ My contact? Hmmmmm...
entries.translation: ✆ 我的联系方式？嗯……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMy contact? Hmmmmm...

entries.source: ✆ My wife says I need to stop giving out my number to strangers.
entries.translation: ✆ 我老婆说我不能再随便把号码给陌生人了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMy wife says I need to stop giving out my number to strangers.

entries.source: ✆ But if you have enough Kernels, I'm sure I could make an exception.
entries.translation: ✆ 但如果你有足够的果仁，我肯定可以破个例。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut if you have enough Kernels, I'm sure I could make an exception.

entries.source: You like flint? I like flint! I sell flint!
entries.translation: 你喜欢燧石？我喜欢燧石！我卖燧石！
entries.sampleRaw: You like flint? I like flint! I sell flint!

entries.source: My brother is mining the gravel from the Spider's Den. We are the Flint Bros!
entries.translation: 我兄弟正在蜘蛛巢穴挖沙砾。我们是燧石兄弟！
entries.sampleRaw: My brother is mining the gravel from the §cSpider's Den§f. We are the §7Flint Bros§f!

entries.source: Ouch!
entries.translation: 哎哟!
entries.sampleRaw: Ouch!

entries.source: That tickles more than you'd think!
entries.translation: 这比你想象的还要痒！
entries.sampleRaw: That tickles more than you'd think!

entries.source: A little gentleness goes a long way, you know?
entries.translation: 你知道吗，温柔一点会大有帮助的？
entries.sampleRaw: A little gentleness goes a long way, you know?

entries.source: There's a RING hologram right above. Try using that, would you?
entries.translation: 正上方有一个戒指全息投影。试试用那个，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: There's a §e§lRING§f hologram right above. Try using that, would you?

entries.source: Sigh, the things I endure... Youth these days indeed!
entries.translation: 唉，我受的这些罪……现在的年轻人真是的！
entries.sampleRaw: Sigh, the things I endure... Youth these days indeed!

entries.source: All forgiven. Just, maybe click on RING next time?
entries.translation: 都原谅你了。只是，下次也许可以点一下戒指？
entries.sampleRaw: All forgiven. Just, maybe click on §e§lRING§f next time?

entries.source: Ah, seeking Wizardman? They're currently on a cosmic errand.
entries.translation: 啊，你在找Wizardman？他们目前正在执行一项宇宙任务。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, seeking Wizardman? They're currently on a cosmic errand.

entries.source: If you say "Help Wizardman!" I am sure they will come save you.
entries.translation: 如果你喊“救救我，Wizardman！”，我相信他们会来救你的。
entries.sampleRaw: If you say "§cHelp Wizardman!§f" I am sure they will come save you.

entries.source: That's the spot! Just kidding, please click the RING.
entries.translation: 就是这里！开玩笑的，请点一下戒指。
entries.sampleRaw: That's the spot! Just kidding, please click the §e§lRING§f.

entries.source: Ahhh! That actually hurts, you know!
entries.translation: 啊啊！这真的很疼，你知道吗！
entries.sampleRaw: Ahhh! That actually hurts, you know!

entries.source: You're really committed to this, aren't you? I can't wait to see what you don't do next.
entries.translation: 你还真是坚持不懈啊，不是吗？我都等不及想看你接下来不做什么了。
entries.sampleRaw: You're really committed to this, aren't you? I can't wait to see what you don't do next.

entries.source: What joy! Another press. I was just hoping you'd ignore the RING again.
entries.translation: 真开心！又按了一次。我正希望你再次无视戒指呢。
entries.sampleRaw: What joy! Another press. I was just hoping you'd ignore the §e§lRING§f again.

entries.source: It's almost like the RING doesn't exist for you. How poetic.
entries.translation: 简直就像戒指对你来说不存在一样。多么诗意啊。
entries.sampleRaw: It's almost like the §e§lRING§f doesn't exist for you. How poetic.

entries.source: Congratulations! You've mastered the art of ignoring obvious instructions.
entries.translation: 恭喜！你已经掌握了无视明显指示的艺术。
entries.sampleRaw: Congratulations! You've mastered the art of ignoring obvious instructions.

entries.source: No, please, press me again. It's not like I had any plans today besides being your personal toy.
entries.translation: 不，拜托，再按我一次。反正我今天除了当你的私人玩具之外也没什么计划。
entries.sampleRaw: No, please, press me again. It's not like I had any plans today besides being your personal toy.

entries.source: Why do you continue to do this? Wizardman is right there!
entries.translation: 你为什么还要继续这样做？Wizardman就在那儿！
entries.sampleRaw: Why do you continue to do this? Wizardman is right there!

entries.source: Okay, so you really do just want to torture me.
entries.translation: 好吧，看来你真的就是想折磨我。
entries.sampleRaw: Okay, so you really do just want to torture me.

entries.source: I guess it was pure cosmic randomness that you figured out how to ring Wizardman.
entries.translation: 我猜你能弄明白怎么给Wizardman打电话，纯粹是宇宙级的随机巧合。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess it was pure cosmic randomness that you figured out how to ring Wizardman.

entries.source: Ow! That's my face you're stepping on!
entries.translation: 哎哟！你踩的是我的脸！
entries.sampleRaw: §fOw! That's my face you're stepping on!

entries.source: Show some respect and punch the "READY" hologram, please.
entries.translation: 放尊重点，请打一下“就绪”全息投影。
entries.sampleRaw: §fShow some respect and punch the "§6§lREADY§f" hologram, please.

entries.source: Ah, the sweet sensation of being stepped on again. If only there was a way to avoid this!
entries.translation: 啊，又被踩了，这甜美的感觉。要是有什么办法能避免就好了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAh, the sweet sensation of being stepped on again. If only there was a way to avoid this!

entries.source: Ouch! Did you miss the READY sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?
entries.translation: 哎哟！你是没看到就绪标志，还是就喜欢制造痛苦？
entries.sampleRaw: §fOuch! Did you miss the §6§lREADY§f sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?

entries.source: Ever considered punching something? Say, a hologram?
entries.translation: 有没有考虑过打点别的东西？比如说，一个全息投影？
entries.sampleRaw: §fEver considered punching something? Say, a hologram?

entries.source: Fantastic, you've found the floor.
entries.translation: 太棒了，你找到地板了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fFantastic, you've found the floor.

entries.source: Here we go again...
entries.translation: 又来了……
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere we go again...

entries.source: Marvelous, another footprint for my collection!
entries.translation: 真奇妙，我的收藏又多了一个脚印！
entries.sampleRaw: §fMarvelous, another footprint for my collection!

entries.source: Back for more, I see. If only there was a big, glowing hint above me on what to do instead...
entries.translation: 看来你又回来了。要是我的头顶上有个又大又亮的提示告诉我该怎么做就好了……
entries.sampleRaw: §fBack for more, I see. If only there was a big, glowing hint above me on what to do instead...

entries.source: You treat all inanimate objects this way, or am I just the lucky one? Try the READY hologram for a change.
entries.translation: 你对所有无生命的东西都这样，还是只有我这么幸运？试试那个 READY 全息投影吧。

entries.source: I crave vast heaps of carrots, my hunger ferrets!
entries.translation: 我渴望成堆成堆的胡萝卜，我饥饿的雪貂们！
entries.sampleRaw: I crave vast heaps of carrots, my hunger ferrets!

entries.source: I will hunger no longer.
entries.translation: 我再也不会饥饿了。
entries.sampleRaw: I will hunger no longer.

entries.source: How dare you let this hare hunger.
entries.translation: 你怎敢让这只野兔挨饿。
entries.sampleRaw: How dare you let this hare hunger.

entries.source: Come back and talk to me once you have unlocked the Ship Crew!
entries.translation: 等你解锁了船队后再回来找我谈谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back and talk to me once you have unlocked the §6Ship Crew§f!

entries.source: Reach Fishing Level X and talk to Captain Baha on your Ship!
entries.translation: 达到钓鱼等级 X，并在你的船上与 Captain Baha 交谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Reach §aFishing Level X §fand talk to §6Captain Baha §fon your §6Ship§f!

entries.source: Hello!
entries.translation: 你好！
entries.sampleRaw: Hello!

entries.source: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of Frogs!
entries.translation: 我是一名专注于研究青蛙的研究员！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of §2Frogs§f!

entries.source: Well, I was a researcher, I suppose.
entries.translation: 嗯,我想,我曾经是一名研究员.
entries.sampleRaw: Well, I §f§owas §fa researcher, I suppose.

entries.source: Today marks the first day of my retirement!
entries.translation: 今天是我退休的第一天！
entries.sampleRaw: Today marks the first day of my retirement!

entries.source: Thank you!
entries.translation: 谢谢你！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you!

entries.source: Say, is that your Ship parked by the side of the island?
entries.translation: 我说，停在岛边的那艘船是你的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Say, is that your §6Ship §fparked by the side of the island?

entries.source: Hmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?
entries.translation: 嗯，我能否冒昧地问一句，我能不能和你一起冒险？
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?

entries.source: I don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.
entries.translation: 我现在没什么事可做，毕竟退休了嘛。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.

entries.source: Amazing.
entries.translation: 太棒了。
entries.sampleRaw: Amazing.

entries.source: Say, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.
entries.translation: 不过，我想带一件纪念品上路，好让我记住这个地方。
entries.sampleRaw: Say, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.

entries.source: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a Busted Belt Buckle?
entries.translation: 如果不太麻烦的话，你能帮我钓上一个破损的腰带扣吗？
entries.sampleRaw: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a §9Busted Belt Buckle§f?

entries.source: As much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?
entries.translation: 这地方虽然是个垃圾场，但真的感觉像是我的垃圾场，你懂吧……？
entries.sampleRaw: As much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?

entries.source: Do you have that souvenir for me?
entries.translation: 你拿到给我的纪念品了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you have that souvenir for me?

entries.source: I'm just looking for a Busted Belt Buckle in case I ever need to return here!
entries.translation: 我只是在找破损的腰带扣，以防我哪天需要回到这里！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm just looking for a §9Busted Belt Buckle §fin case I ever need to return here!

entries.source: It appears you don't have my souvenir yet! It would be such a shame to leave without it...
entries.translation: 看来你还没有拿到我的纪念品！要是没带它就离开，那真是太可惜了……
entries.sampleRaw: It appears you don't have my souvenir yet! It would be such a shame to leave without it...

entries.source: Please could you get me a Busted Belt Buckle from Junker Joel?
entries.translation: 你能从 Junker Joel 那里帮我弄到一个破损的腰带扣吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Please could you get me a §9Busted Belt Buckle §ffrom §2Junker Joel§f?

entries.source: Amazing, thank you so much!
entries.translation: 太棒了，非常感谢！
entries.sampleRaw: Amazing, thank you so much!

entries.source: I'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!
entries.translation: 我去向其他船员介绍一下自己！
entries.sampleRaw: I'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!

entries.source: Anchors away!
entries.translation: 起锚出发！
entries.sampleRaw: Anchors away!

entries.source: I'll come and join you on the Ship shortly!
entries.translation: 我很快就会上船和你汇合！
entries.sampleRaw: I'll come and join you on the §6Ship §fshortly!

entries.source: I love the feel of the wind in my hair!
entries.translation: 我喜欢风吹过头发的感觉！
entries.sampleRaw: I love the feel of the wind in my hair!

entries.source: I hope you brought your fishing rod!
entries.translation: 希望你带了钓鱼竿！
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you brought your fishing rod!

entries.source: I love the taste of the salt in the air!
entries.translation: 我喜欢空气中咸咸的味道！
entries.sampleRaw: I love the taste of the salt in the air!

entries.source: I hope we catch something big!
entries.translation: 希望能钓到大家伙！
entries.sampleRaw: I hope we catch something big!

entries.source: I can't wait to catch some fish!
entries.translation: 我迫不及待想钓些鱼了！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't wait to catch some fish!

entries.source: I love the sound of the waves!
entries.translation: 我喜欢海浪的声音！
entries.sampleRaw: I love the sound of the waves!

entries.source: We don't get many new faces around these parts...
entries.translation: 我们这地方可不太常见新面孔……
entries.sampleRaw: We don't get many new faces around these parts...

entries.source: Welcome, sailor, to our lil' Backwater Bayou!
entries.translation: 欢迎你，水手，来到我们的小小静水河湾！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome, sailor, to our lil' §2Backwater Bayou§f!

entries.source: We've got trash, junk, and everything in between!
entries.translation: 我们这儿有垃圾、破烂，还有介于两者之间的一切！
entries.sampleRaw: We've got trash, junk, and everything in between!

entries.source: I'm here to guide you through what our corner of SkyBlock has to offer!
entries.translation: 我来带你了解我们这片空岛生存角落能提供些什么！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm here to guide you through what our corner of §aSkyBlock §fhas to offer!

entries.source: You gotta be careful ‘round these parts.
entries.translation: 在这附近你可得小心点。
entries.sampleRaw: You gotta be careful ‘round these parts.

entries.source: Lotsa dangerous stuff livin’ in this here bayou.
entries.translation: 这河湾里住着不少危险的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Lotsa dangerous stuff livin’ in this here bayou.

entries.source: ‘ere, take a look!
entries.translation: 来，看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: ‘ere, take a look!

entries.source: Welcome to the Lotus Atoll!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到Lotus Atoll！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the §3Lotus Atoll§f!

entries.source: Us Researchers are currently hard at work documenting the various species of Frog found here.
entries.translation: 我们研究员目前正忙着记录这里发现的各种青蛙物种。
entries.sampleRaw: Us §2Researchers §fare currently hard at work documenting the various species of §2Frog §ffound here.

entries.source: Want to give us a hand?

entries.sampleRaw: Want to give us a hand?

entries.source: Awesome attitude!
entries.translation: 态度真棒！
entries.sampleRaw: Awesome attitude!
