entries.translation: 在Lotus Atoll周围可以钓到12种奖杯青蛙。
entries.sampleRaw: There are §212 species §fof §2Trophy Frogs §fthat can be fished around the §3Lotus Atoll§f.
entries.numericSource: There are {{N0}} species of Trophy Frogs that can be fished around the Lotus Atoll.
entries.numericTranslation: 在Lotus Atoll周围可以钓到{{N0}}种奖杯青蛙。

entries.source: Each species comes in four rarities - BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, and DIAMOND.
entries.translation: 每种青蛙都有四种稀有度——青铜、白银、黄金和钻石。
entries.sampleRaw: Each species comes in four rarities - §8§lBRONZE§f, §7§lSILVER§f, §6§lGOLD§f, and §b§lDIAMOND§f.

entries.source: That means there are 48 unique Trophy Frogs to find!
entries.translation: 也就是说，共有48种独特的奖杯青蛙等你发现！
entries.sampleRaw: That means there are §248 §funique §2Trophy Frogs §fto find!
entries.numericSource: That means there are {{N0}} unique Trophy Frogs to find!
entries.numericTranslation: 也就是说，共有{{N0}}种独特的奖杯青蛙等你发现！

entries.source: We'll need you to catch one of every frog in order to complete our research!
entries.translation: 我们需要你每种青蛙都钓到一只,才能完成我们的研究!
entries.sampleRaw: We'll need you to catch §aone of every frog §fin order to complete our research!

entries.source: If you bring any Frogs you catch to me, I'll reward you with some Lotus!
entries.translation: 如果你把钓到的青蛙带给我，我会奖励你一些莲花！
entries.sampleRaw: If you bring any §2Frogs §fyou catch to me, I'll reward you with some §aLotus§f!

entries.source: Progress through your Lotus Collection to unlock new useful items!
entries.translation: 推进你的莲花收藏，即可解锁新的实用物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Progress through your §aLotus Collection §fto unlock new useful items!

entries.source: And that's not all!
entries.translation: 还不止这些！
entries.sampleRaw: And that's not all!

entries.source: Each time you catch all of the Frogs at a certain tier, I'll give you a little something extra!
entries.translation: 每当你集齐某一档位的所有青蛙，我都会额外给你点小奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: Each time you catch all of the §2Frogs §fat a certain tier, I'll give you a little something extra!

entries.source: Now, go start with the BRONZE tier!
entries.translation: 现在，从青铜档位开始吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Now, go start with the §8§lBRONZE §ftier!

entries.source: Come talk to me any time to donate Frogs and to view your current progress!
entries.translation: 随时来找我捐赠青蛙并查看你当前的进度！
entries.sampleRaw: Come talk to me any time to donate §2Frogs §fand to view your current progress!

entries.source: Hi! I assume you are here to help with our Trophy Frog research.
entries.translation: 嗨！我猜你是来帮我们研究奖杯青蛙的吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHi! I assume you are here to help with our §2Trophy Frog §fresearch.

entries.source: I've got your list of tasks to complete while on the Lotus Atoll.
entries.translation: 我这儿有份任务清单，需要你在Lotus Atoll上完成。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've got your list of §atasks §fto complete while on the §3Lotus Atoll§f.

entries.source: Complete them all and you'll be rewarded. Here, take a look!
entries.translation: 全部完成就能获得奖励。来，看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fComplete them all and you'll be §6rewarded§f. Here, take a look!

entries.source: YEET!
entries.translation: 耶！
entries.sampleRaw: YEET!

entries.source: Yeet!
entries.translation: 耶！
entries.sampleRaw: Yeet!

entries.source: One moment please - I've run into quite a severe conundrum.
entries.translation: 请稍等——我遇到了一个相当严重的难题。
entries.sampleRaw: One moment please - I've run into quite a severe conundrum.

entries.source: Okay, I'll tell you. But promise me you won't freak out.
entries.translation: 好吧，我告诉你。但你要答应我别吓到。
entries.sampleRaw: Okay, I'll tell you. But promise me you won't freak out.

entries.source: There appear to be several Wormholes on this island.
entries.translation: 这座岛上似乎出现了好几个虫洞。
entries.sampleRaw: There appear to be several §dWormholes §fon this island.

entries.source: It started with just one, we began conducting research on it, and then more started appearing...
entries.translation: 一开始只有一个，我们开始对它进行研究，然后更多虫洞开始出现了……
entries.sampleRaw: It started with just one, we began conducting research on it, and then more started appearing...

entries.source: C'mon dude, don't you deal with stuff like this all the time?
entries.translation: 拜托，老兄，你不是一直都在处理这种事吗？
entries.sampleRaw: C'mon dude, don't you deal with stuff like this all the time?

entries.source: Ah, right! I probably sound crazy right now!
entries.translation: 啊，对！我现在听起来大概像个疯子！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, right! I probably sound crazy right now!

entries.source: You can only see Wormholes while wearing a pair of Froggles!
entries.translation: 只有戴上一副蛙镜才能看见虫洞！
entries.sampleRaw: You can only see §dWormholes §fwhile wearing a pair of §aFroggles§f!

entries.source: You can craft your own pair after unlocking the Lotus Collection!
entries.translation: 解锁莲花收藏后，你就可以自己制作一副了！
entries.sampleRaw: You can craft your own pair after unlocking the §aLotus Collection§f!

entries.source: After that, you can help us out!
entries.translation: 之后，你就可以来帮我们了！
entries.sampleRaw: After that, you can help us out!

entries.source: Look, bro. The term Wormhole doesn't sound very reassuring, right?
entries.translation: 听着，兄弟。虫洞这个词听起来可不太让人安心，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Look, bro. The term §dWormhole §fdoesn't sound very reassuring, right?

entries.source: Destabilization, fragmentation, displacement - all very possible results of these anomalies.
entries.translation: 失稳、碎裂、位移——这些都可能是这些异常现象造成的结果。
entries.sampleRaw: Destabilization, fragmentation, displacement - all very possible results of these anomalies.

entries.source: Bottom line is, we need to catch the Frogs that are responsible for creating these holes!
entries.translation: 总之，我们需要抓住那些制造出这些洞的青蛙！
entries.sampleRaw: Bottom line is, we need to catch the §2Frogs §fthat are responsible for creating these holes!

entries.source: Yeah, I know it sounds weird. But trust me, these aren't ordinary frogs.
entries.translation: 是啊，我知道这听起来很怪。但相信我，这些可不是普通的青蛙。
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah, I know it sounds weird. But trust me, these aren't ordinary frogs.

entries.source: These are Trophy Frogs! If you help us catch them, we can study them and figure out how to close the Wormholes!
entries.translation: 它们是奖杯青蛙！如果你帮我们抓住它们，我们就能研究它们，并找出关闭虫洞的方法！
entries.sampleRaw: These are §2Trophy Frogs§f! If you help us catch them, we can study them and figure out how to close the §dWormholes§f!

entries.source: Equip your Froggles, find the Wormholes, and cast your rod!
entries.translation: 装备好你的蛙镜，找到虫洞，然后甩出你的钓竿！
entries.sampleRaw: Equip your §aFroggles§f, find the §dWormholes§f, and cast your rod!

entries.source: With some luck, you'll be able to catch the elusive Reality Hopper!
entries.translation: 运气好的话，你就能钓到那只难以捉摸的现实跃迁者！
entries.sampleRaw: With some luck, you'll be able to catch the elusive §aReality Hopper§f!

entries.source: After a bit of time, the hole will stabilize and disappear.
entries.translation: 过一段时间后，这个洞就会稳定下来并消失。
entries.sampleRaw: After a bit of time, the hole will §dstabilize §fand disappear.

entries.source: However, another one will open up somewhere else on the island...
entries.translation: 不过，另一个洞会在岛上的其他地方打开……
entries.sampleRaw: However, another one will open up somewhere else on the island...

entries.source: I know, it's an arduous process.
entries.translation: 我知道，这过程很艰难。
entries.sampleRaw: I know, it's an arduous process.

entries.source: I am happy to answer any questions you might have! Best of luck!
entries.translation: 我很乐意回答你的任何问题！祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: I am happy to answer any questions you might have! Best of luck!

entries.source: Hey, what's up?
entries.translation: 嘿，怎么了？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, what's up?

entries.source: You can craft your own pair of Froggles after reaching Lotus Collection I.
entries.translation: 达到莲花收藏 I 后，你就可以自己制作一副蛙镜了。
entries.sampleRaw: You can craft your own pair of §aFroggles §fafter reaching §aLotus Collection I§f.

entries.source: Reality Hoppers are a type of Trophy Frog that somehow create Wormholes!
entries.translation: 现实跃迁者是一种奖杯青蛙，它们不知怎么地能制造出虫洞！
entries.sampleRaw: §aReality Hoppers §fare a type of §2Trophy Frog §fthat somehow create §dWormholes§f!

entries.source: Equip your Froggles and look around for otherworldly particles in the water.
entries.translation: 装备上你的蛙镜，在水中四处寻找异界粒子。
entries.sampleRaw: Equip your §aFroggles §fand look around for §dotherworldly §fparticles in the water.

entries.source: When you find one, cast your rod into and wait for a bite!
entries.translation: 找到一处后，把鱼竿抛进去，等待鱼儿上钩！
entries.sampleRaw: When you find one, cast your rod into and wait for a bite!

entries.source: You'll either pull a Reality Hopper out of the hole, or some loot that it's gathered.
entries.translation: 你可能会从洞中钓出一只现实跃迁蛙，也可能钓出它收集的一些战利品。
entries.sampleRaw: You'll either pull a §aReality Hopper §fout of the hole, or some loot that it's gathered.

entries.source: Holes will close once you fish in them a few times, but a new one will open up elsewhere on the island.
entries.translation: 在同一个洞里钓几次后，洞就会关闭，但岛上其他地方会开启一个新的洞。
entries.sampleRaw: Holes will §aclose §fonce you fish in them a few times, but a new one will open up §aelsewhere §fon the island.

entries.source: Wormholes have begun to open up all around the Lotus Atoll!
entries.translation: 虫洞已经开始在Lotus Atoll周围各处出现！
entries.sampleRaw: §dWormholes §fhave begun to open up all around the §3Lotus Atoll§f!

entries.source: They seem to be directly related to the Reality Hopper frog!
entries.translation: 它们似乎与现实跃迁蛙直接相关！
entries.sampleRaw: They seem to be directly related to the §aReality Hopper §ffrog!

entries.source: At least, that's our current hypothesis!
entries.translation: 至少，这是我们目前的假设！
entries.sampleRaw: At least, that's our current hypothesis!

entries.source: The frequent rain throughout the Atoll means we see a lot of Wetlands Frogs!
entries.translation: 环礁上频繁的降雨意味着我们能见到很多湿地蛙！
entries.sampleRaw: The frequent §brain §fthroughout the Atoll means we see a lot of §aWetlands Frogs§f!

entries.source: I love the rain!
entries.translation: 我爱下雨！
entries.sampleRaw: I love the rain!

entries.source: Sadly it'll stop raining in about # minute[s] from now.
entries.translation: 可惜的是，大约#分钟后雨就会停。
entries.sampleRaw: Sadly it'll stop raining in about §a# minute[s] §ffrom now.

entries.source: I hate the sun!
entries.translation: 我讨厌太阳！
entries.sampleRaw: I hate the sun!

entries.source: Luckily it'll start raining in about # minute[s] from now.
entries.translation: 幸运的是，大约#分钟后就会开始下雨。
entries.sampleRaw: Luckily it'll start raining in about §a# minute[s] §ffrom now.

entries.source: You can increase your chance of catching Trophy Frogs by increasing your ♔ Trophy Chance stat!
entries.translation: 你可以通过提高♔奖杯蛙概率属性来增加钓到奖杯蛙的几率！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can increase your chance of catching §2Trophy Frogs §fby increasing your §6♔ Trophy Chance §fstat!

entries.source: The higher your ♔ Trophy Chance, the faster you'll catch whatever Frog you're after!
entries.translation: 你的♔奖杯蛙概率越高，钓到目标蛙的速度就越快！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe higher your §6♔ Trophy Chance§f, the faster you'll catch whatever §2Frog §fyou're after!

entries.source: The Lotus Collection has some useful items that will give you some ♔ Trophy Chance.
entries.translation: 莲花收藏中有一些实用物品，可以为你提供一些♔奖杯蛙概率。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §aLotus Collection §fhas some useful items that will give you some §6♔ Trophy Chance§f.

entries.source: Ribbit!
entries.translation: 呱呱!
entries.sampleRaw: Ribbit!

entries.source: Heard of the Personal Bank?
entries.translation: 听说过个人银行吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Heard of the §aPersonal Bank§f?

entries.source: It will let you access your bank remotely.
entries.translation: 它可以让你远程访问你的银行。
entries.sampleRaw: It will let you access your bank remotely.

entries.source: Unlock it through the Emerald Collection.
entries.translation: 通过绿宝石收藏解锁它。
entries.sampleRaw: Unlock it through the §aEmerald Collection§f.

entries.source: Heard you may got some mushrooms...I've been looking for some...
entries.translation: 听说你可能弄到了一些蘑菇……我一直在找一些……
entries.sampleRaw: Heard you may got some mushrooms...I've been looking for some...

entries.source: Thank ya man, I knew I could trust you! These will come in good use!
entries.translation: 谢了兄弟，我就知道能信你！这些会派上大用场！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank ya man, I knew I could trust you! These will come in good use!

entries.source: Oh man gee, that's awful man, call me when you got 'em alright?
entries.translation: 天哪，太糟了兄弟，拿到之后叫我一声，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh man gee, that's awful man, call me when you got 'em alright?

entries.source: ✆ There ain't many customers around here, so I spend all my time playing Snake on my Abiphone.
entries.translation: ✆ 这附近没什么顾客，所以我所有时间都在我的Abiphone上玩贪吃蛇。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThere ain't many customers around here, so I spend all my time playing Snake on my Abiphone.

entries.source: ✆ The controls are really bad, right?
entries.translation: ✆ 操作手感真的很差，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe controls are really bad, right?

entries.source: ✆ Anyway, I get bored by this job.
entries.translation: ✆ 总之，这份工作让我很无聊。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAnyway, I get bored by this job.

entries.source: ✆ Not just because of the lack of action, but there's nothing to be proud about the drinks I serve.
entries.translation: ✆ 不仅因为没什么刺激的事，而且我调的酒也没什么值得骄傲的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fNot just because of the lack of action, but there's nothing to be proud about the drinks I serve.

entries.source: ✆ I'm a fan of fancy drinks!
entries.translation: ✆ 我可是精致饮品的粉丝！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm a fan of fancy drinks!

entries.source: ✆ And yet Lucius makes me sell addictive garbage!
entries.translation: ✆ 可Lucius却让我卖这些让人上瘾的垃圾！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAnd yet Lucius makes me sell addictive garbage!

entries.source: ✆ Look... I'll add you as a contact if you can bring me some good drinks, such as a Scarleton Premium and a Red Thornleaf Tea.
entries.translation: ✆ 听着……如果你能给我带些好酒来，比如斯卡雷顿 高级版和红刺叶茶，我就把你加为联系人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLook... I'll add you as a contact if you can bring me some good drinks, such as a §9Scarleton Premium§f and a §9Red Thornleaf Tea§f.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have both beverages in your inventory!
entries.translation: ✆ 你的物品栏里没有两种饮料！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have both beverages in your inventory!

entries.source: ✆ Sadly, Lucius heard of our little deal and asked me to hold the drinks for him.
entries.translation: ✆ 可惜，Lucius 听说了我们的小交易，让我替他留着那些饮料。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSadly, Lucius heard of our little deal and asked me to hold the drinks for him.

entries.source: ✆ Here, take my contact anyway.
entries.translation: ✆ 算了，还是把我的联系方式拿去吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere, take my contact anyway.

entries.source: ✆ This place is terrible.
entries.translation: ✆ 这地方太糟糕了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThis place is terrible.

entries.source: You've purchased <number> items from the Dark Auction.
entries.translation: 你已从暗黑拍卖行购买了 <number> 件物品。
entries.sampleRaw: You've purchased §6<number> §fitems from the §5Dark Auction§f.

entries.source: Come back when you've purchased 3. I'll have something for you then.
entries.translation: 等你购买了 3 件物品后再回来。到那时我会给你点东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you've purchased §c3§f. I'll have something for you then.
entries.numericSource: Come back when you've purchased {{N0}}. I'll have something for you then.
entries.numericTranslation: 等你购买了 {{N0}} 件物品后再回来。到那时我会给你点东西。

entries.source: Come back when you've purchased 7. I'll have something for you then.
entries.translation: 等你购买了 7 件物品后再回来。到那时我会给你点东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you've purchased §c7§f. I'll have something for you then.
entries.numericSource: Come back when you've purchased {{N0}}. I'll have something for you then.
entries.numericTranslation: 等你购买了 {{N0}} 件物品后再回来。到那时我会给你点东西。

entries.source: You've purchased 7 items from the Dark Auction.
entries.translation: 你已从暗黑拍卖行购买了 7 件物品。
entries.sampleRaw: You've purchased §67 §fitems from the §5Dark Auction§f.
entries.numericSource: You've purchased {{N0}} items from the Dark Auction.
entries.numericTranslation: 你已从暗黑拍卖行购买了 {{N0}} 件物品。

entries.source: You're basically family at this point.
entries.translation: 到这时候你基本上算是自家人了。
entries.sampleRaw: You're basically family at this point.

entries.source: Hey!
entries.translation: 嘿！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey!

entries.source: A Tewtil just snatched a Trophy Frog right out of my hands!
entries.translation: 一只 Tewtil 刚从我的手里抢走了一只奖杯青蛙！
entries.sampleRaw: §fA §aTewtil §fjust snatched a §2Trophy Frog §fright out of my hands!

entries.source: Unlucky for him! These Tewtils have a tendency to get bigger when eating Trophy Frogs...
entries.translation: 算他倒霉！这些 Tewtil 吃了奖杯青蛙后往往会变得更大……
entries.sampleRaw: §fUnlucky for him! These §aTewtils §fhave a tendency to get §6bigger §fwhen eating §2Trophy Frogs§f...

entries.source: I've been frogging around all this time...
entries.translation: 我一直都在到处找青蛙……
entries.sampleRaw: I've been frogging around all this time...

entries.source: But yesterday, I saw something amazing! An island the likes of which I had never seen before!
entries.translation: 但昨天，我看到了了不起的东西！An 岛，我从未见过那样的岛！
entries.sampleRaw: But yesterday, I saw something amazing! An island the likes of which I had never seen before!

entries.source: The Lotus Atoll!
entries.translation: 莲花环礁!
entries.sampleRaw: The §3Lotus Atoll§f!

entries.source: It was brimming with Lotus Sea Creatures and Trophy Frogs galore!
entries.translation: 那里满是莲花海怪和成群的奖杯青蛙！
entries.sampleRaw: It was brimming with §3Lotus Sea Creatures §fand §2Trophy Frogs §fgalore!

entries.source: If you want to see it for yourself, go and find Captain Baha in the Fishing Outpost!
entries.translation: 如果你想亲眼看看，就去钓鱼前哨找 Captain Baha 吧！
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to see it for yourself, go and find §6Captain Baha §fin the §bFishing Outpost§f!

entries.source: If you're having trouble storing all the runes you've been collecting, you can buy a Rune Sack from Elizabeth in the Community Center!
entries.translation: 如果你收集的符文太多、存放有困难，可以去社区中心找 Elizabeth 买一个符文袋！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you're having trouble storing all the §5runes §fyou've been collecting, you can buy a §5Rune Sack §ffrom §dElizabeth §fin the §bCommunity Center§f!

entries.source: ✆ Shhhh!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fShhhh!

entries.source: ✆ Don't talk so loud.
entries.translation: ✆ 别说得那么大声。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDon't talk so loud.

entries.source: ✆ I can give you my contact but you need to do something for me.
entries.translation: ✆ 我可以把我的联系方式给你，但你得帮我做件事。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI can give you my contact but you need to do something for me.

entries.source: ✆ Could you kill a Runic Enderman? It HAS to be an enderman. Please.
entries.translation: ✆ 你能杀掉一只符文末影人吗？必须得是末影人。拜托了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCould you kill a §5Runic Enderman§f? It HAS to be an enderman. Please.

entries.source: ✆ Ohhhh, you did it.
entries.translation: ✆ 哦哦哦，你做到了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOhhhh, you did it.

entries.source: ✆ Perfect.
entries.translation: ✆ 完美。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fPerfect.

entries.source: ✆ Here take my contact, but don't give it to anyone else!
entries.translation: ✆ 来，把我的联系方式拿去，但别给其他任何人！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere take my contact, but don't give it to anyone else!

entries.source: Welcome to the Colosseum!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到竞技场！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the §bColosseum§f!

entries.source: Here you can prove your fighting skills to everyone.
entries.translation: 在这里你可以向所有人证明你的战斗技巧。
entries.sampleRaw: Here you can prove your fighting skills to everyone.

entries.source: The arena is temporarily closed for renovations!
entries.translation: 竞技场因翻修暂时关闭！
entries.sampleRaw: The arena is temporarily closed for renovations!

entries.source: You look like you're still getting the hang of things. Come back when you're SkyBlock Level 10!
entries.translation: 你看起来还在摸索门道。等你达到空岛生存等级 10 后再回来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou look like you're still getting the hang of things. Come back when you're §aSkyBlock Level 10§f!
entries.numericSource: You look like you're still getting the hang of things. Come back when you're SkyBlock Level {{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 你看起来还在摸索门道。等你达到空岛生存等级 {{N0}} 后再回来吧！

entries.source: Hey, are you here to volunteer for the Safety Squad?
entries.translation: 嘿，你是来报名参加安全小队志愿者的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, are you here to volunteer for the Safety Squad?

entries.source: Good heavens, that's great news!
entries.translation: 天哪，这真是好消息！
entries.sampleRaw: Good heavens, that's great news!

entries.source: With dangerous activity running rampant recently, we could really use your help.
entries.translation: 最近危险活动猖獗，我们真的很需要你的帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: With dangerous activity running rampant recently, we could really use your help.

entries.source: You'll need to undergo some training to become a Safety Advocate.
entries.translation: 你需要接受一些训练才能成为安全倡导者。
entries.sampleRaw: You'll need to undergo some training to become a Safety Advocate.

entries.source: Is this fine with you? I promise it won't take long.
entries.translation: 这样可以吗？我保证不会花太久。
entries.sampleRaw: Is this fine with you? I promise it won't take long.

entries.source: The Safety Squad is dedicated to keeping SkyBlock safe.
entries.translation: 安全小队致力于维护 SkyBlock 的安全。
entries.sampleRaw: The Safety Squad is dedicated to keeping SkyBlock safe.

entries.source: A lot of incidents can be avoided if there just was more awareness about safety.
entries.translation: 只要大家多了解一些安全知识，很多事故都是可以避免的。
entries.sampleRaw: A lot of incidents can be avoided if there just was more awareness about safety.

entries.source: As such, we are recruiting Safety Advocates to help spread the importance of safety in SkyBlock.
entries.translation: 因此，我们正在招募安全倡导者，帮助传播 SkyBlock 中安全的重要性。
entries.sampleRaw: As such, we are recruiting Safety Advocates to help spread the importance of safety in SkyBlock.

entries.source: Are you willing to become a Safety Advocate?
entries.translation: 你愿意成为安全倡导者吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you willing to become a Safety Advocate?

entries.source: The world needs your help!
entries.translation: 世界需要你的帮助！
entries.sampleRaw: The world needs your help!

entries.source: That's fine, you can always come back later.
entries.translation: 没关系，你随时可以再来。
entries.sampleRaw: That's fine, you can always come back later.

entries.source: Talk to me when you're ready.
entries.translation: 准备好了就来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me when you're ready.

entries.source: Are you ready for your Safety Advocate training?
entries.translation: 你准备好接受安全倡导者训练了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you ready for your Safety Advocate training?

entries.source: Processing your registration...
entries.translation: 正在处理你的登记……
entries.sampleRaw: Processing your registration...

entries.source: Awesome! You're our #th volunteer!
entries.translation: 太棒了！你是我们的第 # 位志愿者！
entries.sampleRaw: Awesome! You're our §c#th §fvolunteer!

entries.source: Head into the doorway next to me, she'll be waiting for you!
entries.translation: 走进我旁边的门口，她会在那里等你！
entries.sampleRaw: Head into the doorway next to me, she'll be waiting for you!

entries.source: Brigette is waiting for you in the Security Hall. Better not keep her waiting!
entries.translation: Brigette 正在安全大厅等你。最好别让她久等！
entries.sampleRaw: Brigette is waiting for you in the §bSecurity Hall§f. Better not keep her waiting!

entries.source: I'm a little busy right now... come back soon!
entries.translation: 我现在有点忙……回头再来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a little busy right now... come back soon!

entries.source: Hey, recruit!
entries.translation: 嘿，新兵！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, recruit!

entries.source: Come this way.
entries.translation: 这边走。
entries.sampleRaw: Come this way.

entries.source: Here, take a seat.
entries.translation: 来，请坐。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take a seat.

entries.source: Welcome to the Security Hall. It's the place for all safety matters.
entries.translation: 欢迎来到安全大厅。这里是处理一切安全事务的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome to the §bSecurity Hall§f. It's the place for all safety matters.

entries.source: I believe Elizabeth has already introduced you to what we do.
entries.translation: 我想 Elizabeth 已经向你介绍过我们的工作了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI believe §dElizabeth§f has already introduced you to what we do.

entries.source: The goal of the Safety Squad is to keep SkyBlock safe, and it starts with you.
entries.translation: 安全小队的目标是维护 SkyBlock 的安全，而这一切从你开始。
entries.sampleRaw: The goal of the Safety Squad is to keep SkyBlock safe, and it starts with §c§lyou§f.

entries.source: Yes, you!
entries.translation: 没错，就是你！
entries.sampleRaw: Yes, you!

entries.source: If everyone is aware of the importance of safety, the number of safety-related incidents would greatly decrease.
entries.translation: 如果每个人都意识到安全的重要性，与安全相关的事故数量就会大大减少。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf everyone is aware of the importance of safety, the number of safety-related incidents would greatly decrease.

entries.source: I'm glad you asked.
entries.translation: 很高兴你问了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm glad you asked.

entries.source: On one hand, it is very important to do things to keep yourself as safe as possible.
entries.translation: 一方面，采取行动尽可能保护自己的安全非常重要。
entries.sampleRaw: On one hand, it is very §6§oimportant §fto do things to keep yourself as safe as possible.

entries.source: Stay indoors when there's a thunderstorm, wear a safety hat while at a construction site, washing your hands frequently while in a hospital...
entries.translation: 雷暴天气时待在室内，在建筑工地时戴上安全帽，在医院时勤洗手……
entries.sampleRaw: Stay indoors when there's a thunderstorm, wear a safety hat while at a construction site, washing your hands frequently while in a hospital...

entries.source: These are all examples of physical safety.
entries.translation: 这些都是人身安全的例子。
entries.sampleRaw: These are all examples of §d§ophysical §fsafety.

entries.source: Today, however, we will be focused on something that's also very important.
entries.translation: 不过今天，我们要关注的是另一件同样非常重要的事。
entries.sampleRaw: Today, however, we will be focused on something that's §f§oalso §fvery important.

entries.source: That being - Account Safety.
entries.translation: 那就是——账号安全。
entries.sampleRaw: That being - §c§lAccount Safety§f.

entries.source: Imagine logging in to SkyBlock and finding that all your belongings have disappeared.
entries.translation: 想象一下，你登录 SkyBlock，却发现所有物品都不见了。
entries.sampleRaw: Imagine logging in to SkyBlock and finding that all your belongings have disappeared.

entries.source: Or even worse, trying to log into your Minecraft account but finding yourself locked out.
entries.translation: 或者更糟，你想登录你的 Minecraft 账号，却发现自己被锁在外面了。
entries.sampleRaw: Or even worse, trying to log into your Minecraft account but finding yourself locked out.

entries.source: The point of Account Safety is to prevent this from happening.
entries.translation: 账号安全的意义就是防止这种情况发生。
entries.sampleRaw: The point of §c§lAccount Safety §fis to prevent this from happening.

entries.source: And that's why you should pay close attention to today's briefing.
entries.translation: 正因如此，你应该认真听今天的简报。
entries.sampleRaw: And that's why you should pay close attention to today's briefing.

entries.source: SkyBlock has a lot of players.
entries.translation: SkyBlock 有很多玩家。
entries.sampleRaw: SkyBlock has a lot of players.

entries.source: You will meet a lot of them throughout playing SkyBlock.
entries.translation: 在玩 SkyBlock 的过程中，你会遇到很多玩家。
entries.sampleRaw: You will meet a lot of them throughout playing SkyBlock.

entries.source: You could even make some very good friends!
entries.translation: 你甚至可以交到一些非常好的朋友！
entries.sampleRaw: You could even make some very good friends!

entries.source: However, not everyone is here to make friends.
entries.translation: 然而，并不是所有人都是来交朋友的。
entries.sampleRaw: However, not everyone is here to make friends.

entries.source: Some of them are here to steal your coins, items, or even your account!
entries.translation: 有些人来这里是为了偷你的硬币、物品，甚至你的账号！
entries.sampleRaw: Some of them are here to steal your coins, items, or even your account!

entries.source: Of course it doesn't.
entries.translation: 当然不是。
entries.sampleRaw: Of course it doesn't.

entries.source: Rule number 1, never trust strangers on the internet.
entries.translation: 第 1 条规则：永远不要相信互联网上的陌生人。
entries.sampleRaw: §fRule number 1, never trust §ostrangers §fon the internet.
entries.numericSource: Rule number {{N0}}, never trust strangers on the internet.
entries.numericTranslation: 第 {{N0}} 条规则：永远不要相信互联网上的陌生人。

entries.source: Strangers are people you just met. You don't know who they are.
entries.translation: 陌生人就是你刚认识的人。你不知道他们是谁。
entries.sampleRaw: §fStrangers are people you just met. You §c§ldon't know §fwho they are.

entries.source: If someone approaches you, they very likely want something from you.
entries.translation: 如果有人主动接近你，他们很可能想从你这里得到些什么。
entries.sampleRaw: If someone approaches you, they very likely want §f§osomething §ffrom you.

entries.source: What looks like a seemingly innocent request could lead to you losing your account.
entries.translation: 看似无害的请求，可能会让你失去账号。
entries.sampleRaw: What looks like a seemingly innocent request could lead to you §c§llosing your account§f.

entries.source: The most common way to lose your account is by opening suspicious links.
entries.translation: 失去账号最常见的方式就是打开可疑链接。
entries.sampleRaw: The most common way to lose your account is by opening §c§lsuspicious §flinks.

entries.source: If someone sends a link in chat, chances are they are trying to steal your account.
entries.translation: 如果有人在聊天中发来链接，那很可能是在试图盗取你的账号。
entries.sampleRaw: If someone sends a link in chat, chances are they are trying to §c§lsteal §fyour account.

entries.source: I'm sure you're not!
entries.translation: 我相信你不会的！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sure you're not!

entries.source: The thing is, the evil people who steal accounts will try to catch you off guard.
entries.translation: 问题是，那些盗取账号的坏人会试图趁你不备。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe thing is, the evil people who steal accounts will try to catch you §e§loff guard§f.

entries.source: They try to make you open links in situations where it seems reasonable.
entries.translation: 他们会设法让你在看似合理的情况下打开链接。
entries.sampleRaw: They try to make you open links in situations where it seems reasonable.

entries.source: Or situations where you're distracted, or least suspecting a scam.
entries.translation: 或者在你分心、最不怀疑骗局的情况下。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOr situations where you're distracted, or least suspecting a §cscam§f.

entries.source: A way hackers can gain your trust is by messaging you from an account they've already hacked.
entries.translation: 黑客获取你信任的一种方式，是用他们已经盗取的账号给你发消息。
entries.sampleRaw: A way hackers can gain your trust is by messaging you from an account they've already hacked.

entries.source: If it looks like your friend sent you that message, you'd be inclined to trust them more, right?
entries.translation: 如果看起来是你的朋友发来的消息，你会更倾向于相信他们，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: If it looks like your friend sent you that message, you'd be inclined to trust them more, right?

entries.source: Then when you click the link they send you...
entries.translation: 然后当你点击他们发来的链接时……
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen when you click the link they send you...

entries.source: Just like that, your account is gone.
entries.translation: 就这样，你的账号没了。
entries.sampleRaw: Just like that, your account is gone.

entries.source: Scary I am indeed.
entries.translation: 确实很可怕。
entries.sampleRaw: Scary I am indeed.

entries.source: But losing your account is an even scarier proposition.
entries.translation: 但失去你的账号是更可怕的事。
entries.sampleRaw: But losing your account is an even scarier proposition.

entries.source: Anyways.
entries.translation: 总之。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways.

entries.source: We were talking about links, and how you should be very careful when clicking on links.
entries.translation: 我们刚才在聊链接，以及点击链接时应该格外小心。
entries.sampleRaw: We were talking about links, and how you should be very careful when clicking on links.

entries.source: If you ever receive a suspicious message in-game, you should report the player with the \/report command.
entries.translation: 如果你在游戏内收到可疑消息，应该用 \/report 命令举报该玩家。
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever receive a §c§lsuspicious §fmessage in-game, you should report the player with the \/report command.

entries.source: The dangers of clicking unverified links is not limited to within SkyBlock.
entries.translation: 点击未经验证的链接的危险并不局限于 SkyBlock 内。
entries.sampleRaw: The dangers of clicking unverified links is not limited to within SkyBlock.

entries.source: It's something that applies all over the internet, really.
entries.translation: 这其实适用于整个互联网。
entries.sampleRaw: It's something that applies all over the internet, really.

entries.source: There are some situations where you may encounter suspicious links for SkyBlock outside of the game itself.
entries.translation: 有些情况下，你可能会在游戏之外遇到与 SkyBlock 相关的可疑链接。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere are some situations where you may encounter suspicious links for SkyBlock outside of the game itself.

entries.source: For example, you may be trying to download a mod for SkyBlock.
entries.translation: 例如，你可能正想下载一个 SkyBlock 模组。
entries.sampleRaw: For example, you may be trying to download a mod for SkyBlock.

entries.source: Or perhaps, you're linked a page to someone's SkyBlock profile, to check out their stats or something.
entries.translation: 又或者，有人给你发了一个链接，指向某人的 SkyBlock 档案，让你查看他们的数据之类的。
entries.sampleRaw: Or perhaps, you're linked a page to someone's SkyBlock profile, to check out their stats or something.

entries.source: While it's unlikely that these links are bad, you should be careful when clicking them, and try your best to verify whether they're trustworthy.
entries.translation: 虽然这些链接不太可能是恶意的，但点击时仍应小心，并尽量确认它们是否可信。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhile it's unlikely that these links are bad, you should be careful when clicking them, and try your best to verify whether they're trustworthy.

entries.source: That's the spirit!
entries.translation: 这就对了！
entries.sampleRaw: That's the spirit!

entries.source: You're saying we got another recruit? That's great, I'll get them settled.
entries.translation: 你是说我们又招到一名新成员？太好了，我来安排他们安顿下来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou're saying we got another recruit? That's great, I'll get them settled.

entries.source: Thanks, Salad!
entries.translation: 谢了，沙拉！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks, Salad!

entries.source: It's Charlotte, not Salad!!
entries.translation: 是 Charlotte，不是沙拉！！
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lIt's Charlotte, not Salad!!

entries.source: Well that's not good!
entries.translation: 那可不太妙！
entries.sampleRaw: Well that's not good!

entries.source: I hope you both are okay.
entries.translation: 希望你们俩都没事。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you both are okay.

entries.source: Sorry <username>, I'll go grab a chair real quick, and get someone to clean up this mess.
entries.translation: 抱歉，<username>，我这就去拿把椅子，再找人清理一下这堆烂摊子。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry §b<username>§f, I'll go grab a chair real quick, and get someone to clean up this mess.

entries.source: New recruit, you may use my chair for now.
entries.translation: 新成员，你可以先用我的椅子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNew recruit, you may use my chair for now.

entries.source: Be right back!
entries.translation: 马上回来！
entries.sampleRaw: Be right back!

entries.source: STOP RIGHT THERE!
entries.translation: 站住别动！
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lSTOP RIGHT THERE!

entries.source: That's not a recruit, he's supposed to be a detainee!
entries.translation: 那不是新成员，他本该是被拘留的人！
entries.sampleRaw: That's not a recruit, he's supposed to be a detainee!

entries.source: Aw shucks, I was so close!
entries.translation: 唉，差一点就成了！
entries.sampleRaw: Aw shucks, I was so close!

entries.source: I'll try again next time.
entries.translation: 下次我再试试。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll try again next time.

entries.source: You haven't seen the last of me!
entries.translation: 你还没见到我最后一面呢！
entries.sampleRaw: You haven't seen the last of me!

entries.source: I'm so sorry about putting you in danger like that.
entries.translation: 很抱歉让你陷入那样的危险。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm so sorry about putting you in danger like that.

entries.source: Are you alright?
entries.translation: 你还好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you alright?

entries.source: Jimmy is currently wanted for twelve counts of scamming and five more counts of assault.
entries.translation: Jimmy 目前因十二项诈骗罪和另外五项袭击罪而被通缉。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Jimmy§f is currently wanted for twelve counts of §cscamming§f and five more counts of assault.

entries.source: Who knows what he could have done to you.
entries.translation: 谁知道他会对你做什么。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWho knows what he could have done to you.

entries.source: I heard you were going to trade with Jimmy?
entries.translation: 我听说你要和Jimmy交易？
entries.sampleRaw: I heard you were going to trade with §9Jimmy§f?

entries.source: Lucky for you, he couldn't pull off his scam within the Security Hall.
entries.translation: 算你走运，他在安全大厅里没法得逞他的骗局。
entries.sampleRaw: Lucky for you, he couldn't pull off his §cscam §fwithin the §bSecurity Hall§f.

entries.source: Jimmy wanted you to trade outside so that he wouldn't get caught.
entries.translation: Jimmy想让你在外面交易，这样他就不会被抓。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Jimmy§f wanted you to trade outside so that he wouldn't get caught.

entries.source: Jimmy would show you his "very cool gauntlets" in the trading menu.
entries.translation: Jimmy会在交易菜单里给你看他的“超酷护手”。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Jimmy§f would show you his "very cool gauntlets" in the trading menu.

entries.source: When you attempt to accept the trade, he would quickly swap it to something much cheaper.
entries.translation: 当你试图接受交易时，他会迅速把它换成便宜得多的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhen you attempt to accept the trade, he would quickly swap it to something much cheaper.

entries.source: If the trade goes through, you'd be stuck with the cheaper item!
entries.translation: 如果交易成功，你就只能拿着那件更便宜的东西了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf the trade goes through, you'd be stuck with the cheaper item!

entries.source: There are many other forms of these scams.
entries.translation: 这类骗局还有很多其他形式。
entries.sampleRaw: There are many other forms of these §cscams§f.

entries.source: Some people will set frequently used items up for auctions at a high price, hoping that someone accidentally clicks on them.
entries.translation: 有些人会把常用物品以高价挂到拍卖上，指望有人不小心点到它们。
entries.sampleRaw: Some people will set frequently used items up for §6§oauctions §fat a high price, hoping that someone accidentally clicks on them.

entries.source: Some people will pretend they can help you reforge something, then just steal your item once you handed it over to them.
entries.translation: 有些人会假装能帮你洗练东西，等你把物品交给他们后就把它偷走。
entries.sampleRaw: Some people will pretend they can help you §c§lreforge §fsomething, then just steal your item once you handed it over to them.

entries.source: There's even scarier things, like someone telling you to click a link to join a giveaway.
entries.translation: 还有更可怕的事情，比如有人让你点击链接参加抽奖。
entries.sampleRaw: There's even scarier things, like someone telling you to click a link to join a §c§lgiveaway§f.

entries.source: It will ask you to enter your Microsoft email and sends you a login code.
entries.translation: 它会要求你输入你的微软邮箱，并给你发送一个登录验证码。
entries.sampleRaw: It will ask you to enter your §bMicrosoft email §fand sends you a login code.

entries.source: If you give them your code, you've just lost your account entirely.
entries.translation: 如果你把验证码给了他们，你就彻底失去你的账号了。
entries.sampleRaw: If you give them your code, you've just §f§llost §fyour account entirely.

entries.source: There are a lot of scams lurking around every corner.
entries.translation: 每个角落都潜伏着许多骗局。
entries.sampleRaw: There are a §clot §fof scams lurking around every corner.

entries.source: We try our best to prevent scams from happening, but scammers always come up with new tricks.
entries.translation: 我们尽力防止骗局发生，但骗子总能想出新的花招。
entries.sampleRaw: We try our best to prevent §cscams §ffrom happening, but §cscammers §falways come up with new tricks.

entries.source: That's why it's always important to stay alert, and stay safe.
entries.translation: 所以保持警惕、注意安全始终很重要。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat's why it's always important to stay alert, and stay safe.

entries.source: Be especially wary of people you just met!
entries.translation: 尤其要提防你刚认识的人！
entries.sampleRaw: Be especially wary of people you just met!

entries.source: Anyhow, that's all for today.
entries.translation: 总之，今天就到这里。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyhow, that's all for today.

entries.source: I hope you've learnt quite a bit about account security.
entries.translation: 希望你对账号安全已经有了不少了解。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI hope you've learnt quite a bit about account security.

entries.source: To cap it off, we have a short quiz to recap what we just went through.
entries.translation: 最后，我们有一个小测验来回顾刚才讲的内容。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTo cap it off, we have a short quiz to recap what we just went through.

entries.source: Answer a few questions, and you'll become a certified Safety Advocate!
entries.translation: 回答几个问题，你就能成为认证的安全倡导者！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnswer a few questions, and you'll become a certified Safety Advocate!

entries.source: Correct! In fact, all of the listed statements are true - losing your account can mean lost items, money, profiles, or even your whole Microsoft account.
entries.translation: 正确！事实上，列出的所有说法都是真的——失去账号可能意味着失去物品、金钱、存档，甚至整个微软账号。
entries.sampleRaw: §a§lCorrect! §fIn fact, all of the listed statements are true - losing your account can mean lost items, money, profiles, or even your whole Microsoft account.

entries.source: YOU GOT IT! You can report the player with the \/report command, followed by the player's username.
entries.translation: 你答对了！你可以用 /report 命令举报该玩家，后面跟上玩家的用户名。
entries.sampleRaw: §a§lYOU GOT IT! §fYou can report the player with the \/report command, followed by the player's username.

entries.source: That's right! You can try to reach out to your friend through other methods of contact to verify if it's really them. Even so, you should try and verify that the link is from a reputable website - google the domain name to make sure you're landing at the right website.
entries.translation: 没错！你可以尝试通过其他联系方式联系你的朋友，确认是否真的是他本人。即便如此，你也应该尽量核实链接来自信誉良好的网站——用谷歌搜索域名，确保你访问的是正确的网站。
entries.sampleRaw: §a§lThat's right! §fYou can try to reach out to your friend through other methods of contact to verify if it's really them. Even so, you should try and verify that the link is from a reputable website - google the domain name to make sure you're landing at the right website.

entries.source: Congratulations! You aced the test!
entries.translation: 恭喜！你以优异成绩通过了测试！
entries.sampleRaw: Congratulations! You aced the test!

entries.source: Fill in the following information so that we can issue you a membership card.
entries.translation: 填写以下信息，以便我们为你签发会员卡。
entries.sampleRaw: Fill in the following information so that we can issue you a membership card.

entries.source: HEY! You should not be revealing personal or sensitive information!
entries.translation: 嘿！你不应该泄露个人或敏感信息！
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lHEY! §fYou should §lnot§f be revealing personal or sensitive information!

entries.source: It is a bad idea to share your personal details to others online.
entries.translation: 在网上向他人分享你的个人详细信息是个坏主意。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt is a bad idea to share your personal details to others online.

entries.source: Didn't fall for that one eh? Good job!
entries.translation: 没上那个当吧？干得好！
entries.sampleRaw: §fDidn't fall for that one eh? Good job!

entries.source: Great job with the briefing, now let's finish your orientation.
entries.translation: 简报做得很好，现在我们来完成你的入职介绍。
entries.sampleRaw: Great job with the briefing, now let's finish your orientation.

entries.source: Great job with the quiz! Go speak with the Security Clerk for your security badge!
entries.translation: 测验做得很好！去找Security Clerk领取你的安全徽章吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fGreat job with the quiz! Go speak with the Security Clerk§f for your §bsecurity badge§f!

entries.source: Not now, recruit — get yourself properly checked in first.
entries.translation: 现在不行，新兵——先去把登记手续办好。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNot now, recruit — get yourself properly checked in first.

entries.source: If you ever receive a suspicious message in-game, you should report the player with the /report command.
entries.translation: 如果你在游戏中收到可疑消息，应该用 /report 命令举报该玩家。
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever receive a §r§c§lsuspicious §r§fmessage in-game, you should report the player with the /report command.

entries.source: YOU GOT IT! You can report the player with the /report command, followed by the player's username.
entries.translation: 答对了！你可以用 /report 命令举报该玩家，后面跟上玩家的用户名。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§a§lYOU GOT IT! §r§fYou can report the player with the /report command, followed by the player's username.

entries.source: The Security Hall is only for authorized personnel.
entries.translation: 安全大厅仅限授权人员进入。
entries.sampleRaw: The §bSecurity Hall §fis only for authorized personnel.

entries.source: Your Safety Badge is ready! Your information has been digitally registered.
entries.translation: 你的安全徽章准备好了！你的信息已完成数字登记。
entries.sampleRaw: Your Safety Badge is ready! Your information has been digitally registered.

entries.source: You're now a fully fledged Safety Advocate!
entries.translation: 你现在是一名正式的安全倡导者了！
entries.sampleRaw: You're now a fully fledged Safety Advocate!

entries.source: Hopefully there won't be more incidents happening around.
entries.translation: 希望附近不会再发生更多事件了。
entries.sampleRaw: Hopefully there won't be more incidents happening around.

entries.source: Oh, Elizabeth wants to have a word with you.
entries.translation: 哦，Elizabeth想和你说几句话。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, §dElizabeth §fwants to have a word with you.

entries.source: I'm just checking out the security here. It's top notch!
entries.translation: 我只是来看看这里的安保。真是一流！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm just checking out the security here. It's top notch!

entries.source: Hi, the name's Jimmy.
entries.translation: 嗨,我叫Jimmy.
entries.sampleRaw: §fHi, the name's §9Jimmy§f.

entries.source: This place looks awesome. I'm all about security.
entries.translation: 这地方看起来真棒。我最喜欢安保了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis place looks awesome. I'm all about security.

entries.source: I got these really cool gauntlets. It lets me fight against baddies.
entries.translation: 我搞到了这副超酷的护手。它能让我对抗坏蛋。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI got these really cool gauntlets. It lets me fight against baddies.

entries.source: You don't look quite ready for a security job. Where's your gear, bro?
entries.translation: 你看起来还没准备好干安保工作。你的装备呢，兄弟？
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou don't look quite ready for a security job. Where's your gear, bro?

entries.source: Say, would you like to trade for my gauntlets?
entries.translation: 我说，你想不想用我的护手做个交易？
entries.sampleRaw: §fSay, would you like to trade for my gauntlets?

entries.source: It will allow you to punch well above your weight.
entries.translation: 它能让你以弱胜强。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt will allow you to punch well above your weight.

entries.source: For the lowly price of 999 coins, they can be yours.
entries.translation: 只要区区999硬币,它们就是你的了.
entries.sampleRaw: §fFor the lowly price of §6999 coins§f, they can be yours.
entries.numericSource: For the lowly price of {{N0}} coins, they can be yours.
entries.numericTranslation: 只要区区{{N0}}硬币,它们就是你的了.

entries.source: If you're down for it, we can trade outside the Security Hall.
entries.translation: 如果你愿意，我们可以在安全大厅外面交易。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you're down for it, we can trade outside the §bSecurity Hall§f.

entries.source: Deal?
entries.translation: 成交？
entries.sampleRaw: §fDeal?

entries.source: Great, we're now besties!
entries.translation: 太好了，我们现在是好哥们了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fGreat, we're now besties!

entries.source: Say, how did you end up here?
entries.translation: 我说，你是怎么来到这儿的？
entries.sampleRaw: §f§l§oSay, how did you end up here?

entries.source: That's cool. I got here because I got into a scuffle with the Security Sloth.
entries.translation: 真酷。我来这儿是因为我和安保树懒打了一架。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat's cool. I got here because I got into a scuffle with the Security Sloth.

entries.source: Man, I was so close to defeating the big guy, can't believe his backup came so fast!
entries.translation: 老兄，我差点就打败那个大块头了，真不敢相信他的援兵来得那么快！
entries.sampleRaw: §fMan, I was so close to defeating the big guy, can't believe his backup came so fast!

entries.source: SkyBlock is turning 7 years old today!
entries.translation: SkyBlock 今天满 7 岁了!
entries.sampleRaw: SkyBlock is turning §e7 years §fold today!
entries.numericSource: SkyBlock is turning {{N0}} years old today!
entries.numericTranslation: SkyBlock 今天满 {{N0}} 岁了!

entries.source: We're so happy to have had you along for the journey so far!
entries.translation: 很高兴你一路陪我们走到现在！
entries.sampleRaw: We're so happy to have had you along for the journey so far!

entries.source: I've already given you a Cake Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!
entries.translation: 今年我已经给过你蛋糕帽了！周年快乐！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've already given you a Cake Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!

entries.source: I have the power to conjure rain from the skies.
entries.translation: 我有从天上召唤雨的能力。
entries.sampleRaw: I have the power to conjure §brain§f from the skies.

entries.source: But it'll cost you!
entries.translation: 但这得花你点钱！
entries.sampleRaw: But it'll cost you!

entries.source: Heyhey! Welcome to Torrhus Canyon!
entries.translation: 嘿嘿！欢迎来到Torrhus Canyon！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHeyhey! Welcome to §6Torrhus Canyon§f!

entries.source: Under the heat of the scorching sun, your journey's just begun!
entries.translation: 在烈日炙烤之下，你的旅程才刚刚开始！
entries.sampleRaw: §fUnder the heat of the scorching sun, your journey's just begun!

entries.source: I'm in charge of the Torrhus Chapters - complete my tasks and claim your Rewards!
entries.translation: 我负责托鲁斯章节——完成我的任务，领取你的奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm in charge of the §6Torrhus Chapters §f- complete my tasks and claim your §6Rewards§f!

entries.source: So, before you go dashing off to find Miria and take part in her Starlyn Contest, why don't you take a look?
entries.translation: 所以，在你匆匆赶去找Miria参加她的星琳竞赛之前，何不先来看看？
entries.sampleRaw: §fSo, before you go dashing off to find §bMiria §fand take part in her §dStarlyn Contest§f, why don't you take a look?

entries.source: Have you spoken to Miria yet? She's just down the Spring Path!
entries.translation: 你和Miria说过话了吗？她就在泉水小径那头！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave you spoken to §bMiria §fyet? She's just down the §6Spring Path§f!

entries.source: Simply turn left at the crossroads up ahead and keep going until you see her!
entries.translation: 在前面十字路口左转，一直走就能看到她！
entries.sampleRaw: §fSimply turn left at the crossroads up ahead and keep going until you see her!

entries.source: Wow, you actually did it!
entries.translation: 哇，你真的做到了！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, you actually did it!

entries.source: You've completed all of the Torrhus Chapters!
entries.translation: 你完成了所有托鲁斯章节！
entries.sampleRaw: You've completed all of the §6Torrhus Chapters§f!

entries.source: You're one of a kind - a four-leaf clover among the foliage!
entries.translation: 你真是独一无二——万叶丛中的一株四叶草！
entries.sampleRaw: You're one of a kind - a four-leaf clover among the foliage!

entries.source: Great job, Player! I look forward to seeing where your journey takes you next!
entries.translation: 干得好，Player！我很期待看到你的旅程接下来会通向何方！
entries.sampleRaw: Great job, Player! I look forward to seeing where your journey takes you next!

entries.source: There are multiple types of Fuel, like Coal, Enchanted Bread and many more!
entries.translation: 燃料有多种类型，比如煤炭、附魔面包等等！
entries.sampleRaw: There are multiple types of Fuel, like Coal, Enchanted Bread and many more!

entries.source: Use a Budget Hopper to make your Minions automatically sell their items once full!
entries.translation: 使用简易漏斗，让你的仆从在装满后自动出售物品！
entries.sampleRaw: §fUse a §aBudget Hopper §fto make your Minions automatically sell their items once full!

entries.source: My wheat minion has been slacking recently, I am thinking about giving it an upgrade. He hasn't produced any wheat in years! Every time I check on him, he's empty.
entries.translation: 我的小麦仆从最近一直在偷懒，我正考虑给它升个级。它好几年都没产出过小麦了！每次我去看它，它都是空的。
entries.sampleRaw: My wheat minion has been slacking recently, I am thinking about giving it an upgrade. He hasn't produced any wheat in years! Every time I check on him, he's empty.

entries.source: Holy Macaroni! That should boost my minion to at least Tier 5! Thank you a lot!
entries.translation: 我的天哪！这至少能把我的仆从提升到 5 级！太感谢你了！
entries.sampleRaw: Holy Macaroni! That should boost my minion to at least Tier 5! Thank you a lot!
entries.numericSource: Holy Macaroni! That should boost my minion to at least Tier {{N0}}! Thank you a lot!
entries.numericTranslation: 我的天哪！这至少能把我的仆从提升到 {{N0}} 级！太感谢你了！

entries.source: I guess I'll have to keep going like this.
entries.translation: 看来我只能继续这样下去了。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I'll have to keep going like this.

entries.source: Hey, you're not part of our Cult! Get out of here!
entries.translation: 嘿，你不是我们教派的人！滚出去！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, you're not part of our §cCult§f! Get out of here!

entries.source: AAAHHHHH! Don't startle me like that bro!
entries.translation: 啊啊啊啊啊!别这样吓我啊兄弟!
entries.sampleRaw: §cAAAHHHHH! §fDon't startle me like that bro!

entries.source: Y'know, someone as stealthy as you could be a useful member of the Campfire Cult.
entries.translation: 你知道吗，像你这样身手隐蔽的人，可以成为营火教派的有用成员。
entries.sampleRaw: Y'know, someone as stealthy as you could be a useful member of the §cCampfire Cult§f.

entries.source: What do you say to that?
entries.translation: 你觉得怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: What do you say to that?

entries.source: Cool! Anyways, there's just one thing you have to do before you can join.
entries.translation: 酷！总之，加入之前你只需要做一件事。
entries.sampleRaw: Cool! Anyways, there's just one thing you have to do before you can join.

entries.source: Stand in the CAMPFIRE!
entries.translation: 站进营火里！
entries.sampleRaw: Stand in the §6§lCAMPFIRE§f!

entries.source: Yeah don't worry, it's not as hot as it looks.
entries.translation: 别担心，它没有看起来那么烫。
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah don't worry, it's not as hot as it looks.

entries.source: If you can last for 10 seconds while standing in the campfire, I'll give you a reward!
entries.translation: 如果你能站在营火里坚持 10 秒,我就给你一份奖励!
entries.sampleRaw: If you can last for §a10 seconds §fwhile standing in the campfire, I'll give you a reward!
entries.numericSource: If you can last for {{N0}} seconds while standing in the campfire, I'll give you a reward!
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你能站在营火里坚持 {{N0}} 秒,我就给你一份奖励!

entries.source: Wow, you did it!
entries.translation: 哇，你做到了！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, you did it!

entries.source: Nice job, hotshot! I'd give you the Campfire Initiate Badge I right now, but I'm out of wood to make one with...
entries.translation: 干得好，猛人！我现在就想把营火入门徽章 I 给你，但我没有木头来做它了……
entries.sampleRaw: Nice job, hotshot! I'd give you the Campfire Initiate Badge I right now, but I'm out of wood to make one with...

entries.source: Sorry about that...
entries.translation: 真是抱歉……
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry about that...

entries.source: I need to keep watch and make sure nobody blows out the Campfire, but if you can grab me 256 Dark Oak Logs, I'll make one for ya!
entries.translation: 我得守着，确保没人把营火吹灭，但如果你能给我弄来 256 个深色橡木原木，我就给你做一个！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI need to keep watch and make sure nobody blows out the §6Campfire§f, but if you can grab me §a256 Dark Oak Logs§f, I'll make one for ya!
entries.numericSource: I need to keep watch and make sure nobody blows out the Campfire, but if you can grab me {{N0}} Dark Oak Logs, I'll make one for ya!

entries.source: Thanks for the wood! Here's your badge, as promised!
entries.translation: 谢谢你的木头！这是答应给你的徽章！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for the wood! Here's your badge, as promised!

entries.source: A Campfire Initiate Badge I, for our latest initiate, <username>!
entries.translation: 一枚营火入门徽章 I，授予我们最新的入门者，<username>！
entries.sampleRaw: A Campfire Initiate Badge I, for our latest initiate, §7<username>§f!

entries.source: I can upgrade that badge for you as you survive more Campfire Trials, you know?
entries.translation: 只要你通过更多营火试炼，我就能帮你升级那枚徽章，知道吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I can upgrade that badge for you as you survive more §cCampfire Trials§f, you know?

entries.source: Simply stand in the campfire whenever you think you're ready!
entries.translation: 只要你觉得准备好了，就站进营火里吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Simply stand in the §6campfire §fwhenever you think you're ready!

entries.source: But be careful, though, as each trial burns hotter than the last!
entries.translation: 但要小心，每次试炼都会比上一次烧得更烫！

entries.source: Wow! You survived the campfire!
entries.translation: 哇！你在营火中活下来了！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! You survived the §6campfire§f!

entries.source: The campfire deals true damage, which means it ignores your ❈ Defense!
entries.translation: 营火造成真实伤害，这意味着它会无视你的 ❈ 防御！
entries.sampleRaw: The campfire deals §etrue §fdamage, which means it ignores your §a❈ Defense§f!

entries.source: Try to survive the Trial of Fire II and I'll give you the Campfire Initiate Badge!

entries.sampleRaw: Try to survive the §6Trial of Fire II §fand I'll give you the §aCampfire Initiate Badge§f!

entries.source: Incredible! Seems like you got the spark for this!
entries.translation: 太不可思议了！看来你天生就有这股火花！
entries.sampleRaw: Incredible! Seems like you got the spark for this!

entries.source: Here's your Campfire Initiate Badge!
entries.translation: 这是你的Campfire Initiate徽章!
entries.sampleRaw: Here's your §aCampfire Initiate Badge§f!

entries.sampleRaw: Complete the §6Trial of Fire III §fand I'll upgrade your badge!

entries.sampleRaw: Next step is the §6Trial of Fire <tier>§f! §7(<amount> damage)

entries.translation: 走进营火开始试炼,并存活 10 秒!
entries.sampleRaw: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for §610s§f!
entries.numericSource: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for {{N0}}s!
entries.numericTranslation: 走进营火开始试炼,并存活 {{N0}} 秒!

entries.sampleRaw: §cI need you to hold your §7<badge item name> §cso I can upgrade it!

entries.source: Congrats! Your <old badge item name> was upgraded to a <new badge item name>!

entries.sampleRaw: §aCongrats! §fYour §7<old badge item name> §fwas upgraded to a §7<new badge item name>§f!

entries.source: Try the Trial of Fire Trial <tier> for a greater challenge!
entries.translation: 试试火焰试炼 <tier>，迎接更大的挑战！
entries.sampleRaw: Try the §6Trial of Fire Trial <tier> §ffor a greater challenge!

entries.source: Congrats on completing tier V!
entries.translation: 恭喜完成 V 阶！
entries.sampleRaw: §aCongrats on completing tier §6V§a!

entries.source: You are ready for the next badge rarity!

entries.sampleRaw: You are ready for the next badge rarity!

entries.numericSource: To receive it, we require Spruce Log x{{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 要领取它，我们需要云杉原木 x{{N0}}！

entries.source: Congrats on completing tier XIV!

entries.sampleRaw: §aCongrats on completing tier §6XIV§a!

entries.translation: 要领取它，我们需要附魔金合欢原木 x100！

entries.sampleRaw: To receive it, we require §aEnchanted Jungle Log §8x1,500§f!
entries.numericSource: To receive it, we require Enchanted Jungle Log x{{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 要领取它，我们需要附魔丛林原木 x{{N0}}！

entries.translation: 你已完成每一次火焰试炼!恭喜!
entries.sampleRaw: §aYou've completed each §6Trial of Fire§f! §aCongratulations!

entries.source: Welcome, fellow member of the Campfire Cult. It is time to embrace the Campfire within and sacrifice something. What that something should be is an interesting question. I am thinking potato. Yes. Yes, a good baked potato does sound very good right now.
entries.translation: 欢迎，营火教团的同道。是时候拥抱内心的营火，并献上一些东西了。该献上什么倒是个有趣的问题。我在想马铃薯。对。对，现在来一个香喷喷的烤马铃薯听起来确实很不错。
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome, fellow member of the Campfire Cult. It is time to embrace the Campfire within and sacrifice something. What that something should be is an interesting question. I am thinking potato. Yes. Yes, a good baked potato does sound very good right now.

entries.source: Come, my brethren, and let us rejoice!
entries.translation: 来吧，我的兄弟们，让我们一同欢庆！
entries.sampleRaw: Come, my brethren, and let us rejoice!

entries.source: sigh
entries.translation: 唉
entries.sampleRaw: §osigh

entries.source: Well nice to meet ya, <player>!
entries.translation: 很高兴见到你，<player>！
entries.sampleRaw: Well nice to meet ya, §7<player>§f!

entries.source: About time you made your way to Torrhus Canyon, Agatha has told me all about you!
entries.translation: 你终于来到Torrhus Canyon了，Agatha跟我讲过你所有的事！
entries.sampleRaw: About time you made your way to §6Torrhus Canyon§f, §bAgatha §fhas told me all about you!

entries.source: So, now that you're here, are you ready to take on your next set of Starlyn Contests?
entries.translation: 那么，既然你来了，准备好迎接下一轮星琳竞赛了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: So, now that you're here, are you ready to take on your next set of §dStarlyn Contests§f?

entries.source: Gonna have a look around the island first? No problem! Toodles!
entries.translation: 想先在岛上四处看看？没问题！回头见！
entries.sampleRaw: Gonna have a look around the island first? No problem! Toodles!

entries.source: Great!
entries.translation: 太好了！
entries.sampleRaw: Great!

entries.source: Just so you know, my Starlyn Contests are partnered with the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 顺便告诉你，我的星琳竞赛是与小兽狩猎区合作的。
entries.sampleRaw: Just so you know, my §dStarlyn Contests §fare partnered with the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: What that means is, whenever you reach the UNCOMMON bracket or higher in one of my contests, you'll get a free Safari Ticket alongside your usual rewards!
entries.translation: 也就是说，只要你在我的任意一场竞赛中达到罕见档位或更高，除了常规奖励外，你还会额外获得一张免费的狩猎区门票！
entries.sampleRaw: What that means is, whenever you reach the §a§lUNCOMMON §fbracket or higher in one of my contests, you'll get a free §2Safari Ticket §falongside your usual §6rewards§f!

entries.source: Show your ticket to the Safari Manager and he'll give you access to the Critter Safari for a limited time!
entries.translation: 把门票出示给Safari Manager,他就会让你在限定时间内进入小兽狩猎区!
entries.sampleRaw: Show your ticket to the §2Safari Manager §fand he'll give you access to the §2Critter Safari §ffor a limited time!

entries.source: I go there quite often - it's a pretty cool place where you can hunt dozens of  Critters to your heart’s content.
entries.translation: 我经常去那里——那是个很棒的地方，你可以尽情猎捕几十种小兽。
entries.sampleRaw: I go there quite often - it's a pretty cool place where you can hunt dozens of §a Critters §fto your heart’s content.

entries.source: The better your ticket, the more free stuff you'll get, so aim for the stars!
entries.translation: 门票越好，你能拿到的免费东西就越多，所以朝着星辰努力吧！
entries.sampleRaw: The better your ticket, the more free stuff you'll get, so aim for the §bstars§f!

entries.source: #AD!
entries.translation: #AD！
entries.sampleRaw: §c§l#AD!

entries.source: So, with all that in mind, are you ready to take on my Starlyn Contests?
entries.translation: 那么，了解了这些之后，你准备好参加我的星琳竞赛了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: So, with all that in mind, are you ready to take on my §dStarlyn Contests§f?

entries.source: See you around! Come back anytime!
entries.translation: 回头见！随时再来！
entries.sampleRaw: See you around! Come back anytime!

entries.source: Come take a look at what my Starlyn Contests have to offer!
entries.translation: 来看看我的星琳竞赛都有什么吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Come take a look at what my §dStarlyn Contests §fhave to offer!

entries.source: Huh? You reached my hidden MYTHIC bracket already? You're sure good at this Foraging business!
entries.translation: 嗯？你已经达到我隐藏的神话档位了？你还真是擅长这项采集事业！
entries.sampleRaw: Huh? You reached my hidden §d§lMYTHIC §fbracket already? You're sure good at this Foraging business!

entries.source: Whaaat? You reached my hidden DIVINE bracket? Great job - keep it going!
entries.translation: 什么？你已经达到我隐藏的神圣档位了？干得好——继续保持！
entries.sampleRaw: Whaaat? You reached my hidden §b§lDIVINE §fbracket? Great job - keep it going!

entries.source: You found my hidden SPECIAL bracket? Wow, my sister was right about you!
entries.translation: 你找到了我隐藏的特殊档位？哇，我姐姐说得没错！
entries.sampleRaw: You found my hidden §c§lSPECIAL §fbracket? Wow, my sister was right about you!

entries.translation: ✆ 很高兴见到你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fNice to see ya!

entries.source: ✆ Hmm, you want my Abiphone Contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯，你想要我的Abiphone联系人？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHmm, you want my §3Abiphone Contact§f?

entries.source: ✆ Sure, I guess I can do that...
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，我想我可以给你……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fSure, I guess I can do that...

entries.translation: ✆ 但前提是你先在我的竞赛中达到传说档位！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fBut only if you reach the §6§lLEGENDARY §fbracket in my contest first!

entries.translation: ✆ 你已经达到了？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fYou already reached it?

entries.source: ✆ HOW?
entries.translation: ✆ 怎么做到的？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§f§c§lHOW?

entries.source: ✆ Deal's a deal, I guess.

entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f...Or you can call me anytime to view my §eShop§f!

entries.source: Psst, have you heard of the Tree Protection Agency?
entries.translation: 嘘，你听说过树木保护局吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Psst, have you heard of the §cTree Protection Agency§f?

entries.source: Well, they're an evil group that is all about protecting the Trees!
entries.translation: 嗯，他们是一个邪恶组织，专门保护树木！
entries.sampleRaw: Well, they're an evil group that is all about protecting the §aTrees§f!

entries.source: Any poor tree with a Tree Protection Order on it, you simply can't cut!
entries.translation: 任何被贴上树木保护令的可怜树木，你都不能砍！
entries.sampleRaw: Any poor tree with a §cTree Protection Order §fon it, you simply can't cut!

entries.source: Though, while we can't cut them, what we can do is deface them a little...
entries.translation: 不过，虽然我们不能砍它们，但我们可以稍微破坏一下它们的外观……
entries.sampleRaw: Though, while we can't cut them, what we can do is deface them a little...

entries.source: Well I'm gonna tell you anyways, because you don't look like someone who knows a lot.
entries.translation: 反正我还是要告诉你，因为你看起来不像是个懂很多的人。
entries.sampleRaw: Well I'm gonna tell you anyways, because you don't look like someone who knows a lot.

entries.source: So, about the Tree Protection Agency...
entries.translation: 那么，关于树木保护局……
entries.sampleRaw: So, about the §cTree Protection Agency§f...

entries.source: Yeah, if you progress through the Honeycomb Collection, you'll notice that there's a Fun-Sized Pot of Honeycomb.
entries.translation: 是的，如果你推进蜜脾收藏，你会注意到有一个趣味装蜂巢罐。

entries.translation: 如果你制作一个，你可以直接走到受保护的树前，把蜜脾涂满整棵树！
entries.sampleRaw: If you make one of those, you can go right up to a §cProtected Tree §fand smear §6Honeycomb §fall over it!

entries.source: Then, if you check back after a while, a  Critter will have come along and started eating all the Honeycomb!
entries.translation: 然后，如果你过一段时间再回来查看，会发现一只小兽已经过来开始吃光所有蜜脾了！
entries.sampleRaw: Then, if you check back after a while, a §a Critter §fwill have come along and started eating all the §6Honeycomb§f!

entries.source: Eh, why don't I just show you a visual?
entries.translation: 呃，我为什么不直接给你看个直观演示呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Eh, why don't I just show you a visual?

entries.source: I came all the way to Torrhus Canyon just to experience the Critter Safari!
entries.translation: 我大老远跑到Torrhus Canyon，就是为了体验小兽狩猎区！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI came all the way to §6Torrhus Canyon§f just to experience the §2Critter Safari§f!

entries.source: However, I can't seem to place high enough in Miria's Contests to win any Safari Tickets...
entries.translation: 然而,我似乎在Miria的竞赛中排名不够高,赢不到任何狩猎区门票……
entries.sampleRaw: §fHowever, I can't seem to place high enough in §bMiria§b's Contests§f to win any §2Safari Tickets§f...

entries.source: When cutting Helix Trees, you should always start with the Beige logs.
entries.translation: 砍伐螺旋树时，你应该总是从米色原木开始。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhen cutting §6Helix Trees§f, you should always start with the §6Beige §flogs.

entries.source: Once those have been dealt with, you can move on to the Red ones.
entries.translation: 处理完那些之后，你就可以继续处理红色的了。

entries.source: Make sure you do it in the right order, or you'll get a Sweep Penalty and the Tree will take longer to cut…
