entries.sampleRaw: §fMake sure you do it in the right order, or you'll get a §cSweep Penalty §fand the §aTree §fwill take longer to cut…

entries.source: Welcome to the Critter Safari!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到小兽狩猎区！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome to the §2Critter Safari§f!

entries.source: If you have any questions, I am at your service!
entries.translation: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你服务！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you have any questions, I am at your service!

entries.source: Otherwise, please speak to the Safari Manager to enter!
entries.translation: 否则,请与Safari Manager交谈以进入!
entries.sampleRaw: §fOtherwise, please speak to the §2Safari Manager§f to enter!

entries.source: The Critter Safari is a special hunting ground, dedicated entirely to catching  Critters!
entries.translation: 小兽狩猎区是一个特殊的狩猎场，完全致力于捕捉小兽！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §2Critter Safari§f is a special hunting ground, dedicated entirely to catching §a Critters§f!

entries.source: It's split into four unique biomes, and each one is home to its own kinds of  Critters.
entries.translation: 它分为四个独特的生物群系，每个群系都栖息着各自种类的小兽。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's split into four unique biomes, and each one is home to its own kinds of §a Critters§f.

entries.source: Be sure to explore them all to see everything there is to hunt!
entries.translation: 一定要探索所有群系，看看所有可狩猎的内容！
entries.sampleRaw: §fBe sure to explore them all to see everything there is to hunt!

entries.source: Getting in is simple! Just hand a Safari Ticket to the Safari Manager.
entries.translation: 进入很简单!只需把一张狩猎区门票交给Safari Manager.
entries.sampleRaw: §fGetting in is simple! Just hand a §2Safari Ticket§f to the §2Safari Manager§f.

entries.source: He's right over there, and he'll sort out the rest for you.
entries.translation: 他就在那边，他会为你安排其余的事。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe's right over there, and he'll sort out the rest for you.

entries.source: Before you head in, there are three rules you ought to know.
entries.translation: 在你进去之前，有三条规则你应该知道。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBefore you head in, there are three rules you ought to know.

entries.source: Rule One: You can't bring any items, armor, or potions inside with you.
entries.translation: 规则一：你不能携带任何物品、护甲或药水进入。
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lRule One: §fYou can't bring any items, armor, or potions inside with you.

entries.source: The only exception is your Safari Belt - that, you're welcome to bring along.
entries.translation: 唯一的例外是你的野生动物园腰带——那个你可以带进去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe only exception is your §fSafari Belt§f - that, you're welcome to bring along.

entries.source: If you don't have one yet, go and grab one from Andrea upstairs.
entries.translation: 如果你还没有，去楼上找Andrea拿一个。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you don't have one yet, go and grab one from §aAndrea§f upstairs.

entries.source: Rule Two: You can only hunt using the Critter Capsules we provide when you enter.
entries.translation: 规则二：你只能使用进入时我们提供的生物胶囊进行狩猎。
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lRule Two: §fYou can only hunt using the §cCritter Capsules§f we provide when you enter.

entries.source: Some  Critters are trickier to catch than others, but you'll get the hang of it!
entries.translation: 有些小兽比其他小兽更难捕捉,但你会慢慢掌握的!
entries.sampleRaw: §fSome §a Critters§f are trickier to catch than others, but you'll get the hang of it!

entries.source: Rule Three: The Critter Safari takes no responsibility for any bites, scratches, or bruised egos sustained on your visit.
entries.translation: 规则三：小兽狩猎区对你在参观期间遭受的任何咬伤、抓伤或自尊心受挫概不负责。
entries.sampleRaw: §c§lRule Three: §fThe §2Critter Safari§f takes no responsibility for any bites, scratches, or bruised egos sustained on your visit.

entries.source: ...Have fun!
entries.translation: ……玩得开心！
entries.sampleRaw: §f...Have fun!

entries.source: Safari Tickets are your reward for taking part in Miria's Contests.
entries.translation: 狩猎门票是你参加Miria竞赛的奖励.
entries.sampleRaw: §2Safari Tickets§f are your reward for taking part in §bMiria§b's Contests§f.

entries.source: Reach the UNCOMMON bracket and you'll earn yourself a Basic Safari Ticket.
entries.translation: 达到罕见等级，你就能获得一张基础狩猎门票。
entries.sampleRaw: §fReach the §a§lUNCOMMON §fbracket and you'll earn yourself a §2Basic Safari Ticket§f.

entries.source: Place higher and the tickets only get better - all the way up to a First-Class Safari Ticket in the LEGENDARY bracket.
entries.translation: 名次越高，门票就越好——最高可达传说等级的头等狩猎门票。
entries.sampleRaw: §fPlace higher and the tickets only get better - all the way up to a §6First-Class Safari Ticket§f in the §6§lLEGENDARY §fbracket.

entries.source: And the fancier the ticket, the better the perks it comes with!
entries.translation: 门票越高级，附带的福利就越好！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd the fancier the ticket, the better the perks it comes with!

entries.source: You can hear all about her Contests from Miria herself - she lives just down the Spring Path.
entries.translation: 你可以从Miria本人那里了解她竞赛的全部信息——她就住在泉水小径那头。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can hear all about her Contests from §bMiria§f herself - she lives just down the §eSpring Path§f.

entries.source: Have you got your very own Safari Belt yet? All of our customers get one!
entries.translation: 你已经拥有属于自己的野生动物园腰带了吗？我们所有顾客都会得到一条！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave you got your very own §fSafari Belt§f yet? All of our customers get one!

entries.source: Well, please take this spare one!
entries.translation: 那么，请收下这条备用的吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell, please take this spare one!

entries.source: The Safari Belt is the only item you can take with you into the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 野生动物园腰带是你唯一能带入小兽狩猎区的物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §fSafari Belt§f is the only item you can take with you into the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: You'll find it already equipped once you enter - for your convenience.
entries.translation: 为了方便起见，你入场后会发现它已经装备好了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou'll find it already equipped once you enter - for your convenience.

entries.source: Whenever you reach a new Safari Milestone, your Safari Belt will upgrade either its stats or its rarity.
entries.translation: 每当你达到新的狩猎里程碑，你的野生动物园腰带就会升级其属性或稀有度。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhenever you reach a new §2Safari Milestone§f, your §fSafari Belt§f will upgrade either its stats or its rarity.

entries.source: It's kind of like David's Cloak, if you think about it.
entries.translation: 仔细想想，它有点像戴维的斗篷。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's kind of like §fDavid's Cloak§f, if you think about it.

entries.source: You can progress through each biome's milestones by catching  Critters while in that biome. Simple, right?
entries.translation: 你可以通过在该生物群系中捕捉小兽来推进每个生物群系的里程碑。很简单，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can progress through each biome's milestones by catching §a Critters§f while in that biome. Simple, right?

entries.source: Anyways, if you ever want to check your progress towards your next Safari Milestone, just come and chat with me!
entries.translation: 总之，如果你想查看自己距离下一个狩猎里程碑的进度，随时来找我聊聊！
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnyways, if you ever want to check your progress towards your next §2Safari Milestone§f, just come and chat with me!

entries.source: Hello and welcome to the Critter Safari!
entries.translation: 你好，欢迎来到小兽狩猎区！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHello and welcome to the §2Critter Safari§f!

entries.source: Say, have you heard of Safari Essence?
entries.translation: 对了，你听说过狩猎精华吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fSay, have you heard of §2Safari Essence§f?

entries.source: Then there's no need for me to explain!
entries.translation: 那我就不必解释了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen there's no need for me to explain!

entries.source: All of the Safari Essence you gain while in the Critter Safari can be spent in my shop.
entries.translation: 你在小兽狩猎区获得的所有狩猎精华都可以在我的商店里使用。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAll of the §2Safari Essence§f you gain while in the §2Critter Safari§f can be spent in my shop.

entries.source: You can use it to buy useful perks that will help you out while in the zone.
entries.translation: 你可以用它购买有用的增益，它们会在区域内助你一臂之力。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can use it to buy useful perks that will help you out while in the zone.

entries.source: Here, take a look!
entries.translation: 来，看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, take a look!

entries.source: Then allow me to explain!
entries.translation: 那就让我来解释一下吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen allow me to explain!

entries.source: Safari Essence can only be gained while in the Critter Safari. There are two ways of obtaining it.
entries.translation: 狩猎精华只能在小兽狩猎区中获得。获取方式有两种。
entries.sampleRaw: §2Safari Essence§f can only be gained while in the §2Critter Safari§f. There are two ways of obtaining it.

entries.source: Firstly, it can be obtained from hunting mobs in the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 首先，可以通过在小兽狩猎区狩猎生物来获得。
entries.sampleRaw: §fFirstly, it can be obtained from §6hunting§f mobs in the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: The rarer a mob's shard, the more Safari Essence it will drop when hunted.
entries.translation: 生物的碎片越稀有，被狩猎时掉落的狩猎精华就越多。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe rarer a mob's shard, the more §2Safari Essence§f it will drop when hunted.

entries.source: Secondly, you can sometimes find Safari Essence on the ground while walking around in the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 其次，你在小兽狩猎区四处走动时，有时能在地上找到狩猎精华。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSecondly, you can sometimes find §2Safari Essence§f on the ground while walking around in the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: So, if you ever see something shining on the ground. be sure to pick it up!
entries.translation: 所以，如果你看到地上有什么东西在闪闪发光，一定要把它捡起来！
entries.sampleRaw: §fSo, if you ever see something shining on the ground. be sure to pick it up!

entries.source: ✆ Critter Safari been treating you well?
entries.translation: ✆ 小兽狩猎区待你还不错吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§f§2Critter Safari§f been treating you well?

entries.source: ✆ Hmm, you want my Abiphone Contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯，你想要我的 Abiphone 联系人？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHmm, you want my §3Abiphone Contact§f?

entries.source: ✆ Sure, I suppose, why not?
entries.translation: ✆ 当然，我想可以，为什么不呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fSure, I suppose, why not?

entries.source: ✆ Not much else to do here on slow days except get sunburn.
entries.translation: ✆ 在这样清闲的日子里，除了被晒伤，这里也没别的事可做。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fNot much else to do here on slow days except get sunburn.

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Helixis and I'm sure we can strike a deal.
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一个螺旋结晶来，我保证我们能谈成一笔交易。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fBring me a §9Helixis§f and I'm sure we can strike a deal.

entries.source: ✆ Err, buddy, I don't see a Helixis on you.
entries.translation: ✆ 呃，伙计，我没看到你身上有螺旋结晶。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fErr, buddy, I don't see a §9Helixis§f on you.

entries.source: ✆ You sure you had one? Did you lose it, maybe?
entries.translation: ✆ 你确定你之前有吗？会不会是弄丢了？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou sure you had one? Did you lose it, maybe?

entries.source: ✆ Cheers man! That's exactly what I was after.
entries.translation: ✆ 谢啦兄弟！这正是我想要的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fCheers man! That's exactly what I was after.

entries.source: ✆ Woodworking is my true passion, you see, but I'm stuck behind this desk all day.
entries.translation: ✆ 你看，木工才是我真正的热爱，可我却整天被困在这张书桌后面。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fWoodworking is my true passion, you see, but I'm stuck behind this desk all day.

entries.source: ✆ And then, when I'm finally done, I haven't got any energy left to pursue my passions.
entries.translation: ✆ 然后，等我终于忙完，我已经没剩多少精力去追求我的热爱了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fAnd then, when I'm finally done, I haven't got any energy left to pursue my passions.

entries.source: ✆ Vicious cycle, huh?
entries.translation: ✆ 恶性循环，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fVicious cycle, huh?

entries.source: ✆ Anyways... Sorry about that.
entries.translation: ✆ 总之……抱歉说了这些。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fAnyways... Sorry about that.

entries.source: ✆ Here's my Abiphone Contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 这是我的 Abiphone 联系人！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHere's my §3Abiphone Contact§f!

entries.source: Torrhus Springs being so high up means they run down super deep.
entries.translation: 托鲁斯泉地地势这么高，意味着泉水会向下流得极深。
entries.sampleRaw: §bTorrhus Springs §fbeing so high up means they run down super deep.

entries.source: The further down you go, the more Pressure builds up.
entries.translation: 你下潜得越深，积累的压力就越大。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe further down you go, the more §9Pressure §fbuilds up.

entries.source: If you're thinking of taking a dive, make sure you've got enough  Pressure Resistance and  Respiration to reach your destination.
entries.translation: 如果你打算潜水，请确保你有足够的  抗压能力和  水下呼吸，才能抵达目的地。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you're thinking of taking a dive, make sure you've got enough §9 Pressure Resistance §fand §3 Respiration §fto reach your destination.

entries.source: Last thing I want to be doing on my day off work is hauling your butt out of there.
entries.translation: 我休假时最不想做的事，就是把你从下面拖上来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fLast thing I want to be doing on my day off work is hauling your butt out of there.

entries.source: Phew, you were almost a goner there. Good thing I'm a lifeguard, huh?
entries.translation: 呼，你刚才差点就没命了。还好我是救生员，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §fPhew, you were almost a goner there. Good thing I'm a lifeguard, huh?

entries.source: Before diving down again, ensure you have enough  Pressure Resistance and  Respiration.
entries.translation: 再次下潜之前，请确保你有足够的  抗压能力和  水下呼吸。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBefore diving down again, ensure you have enough §9 Pressure Resistance §fand §3 Respiration§f.

entries.source: My buddy Nemo over in Murkwater Loch sells some supplies, if you need them.
entries.translation: 如果你需要补给，我在浊水湖的朋友 Nemo 会卖一些。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy buddy §bNemo §fover in §2Murkwater Loch §fsells some supplies, if you need them.

entries.source: That there Fishing Hotspot is the only place to catch Giant Water Bug shards.
entries.translation: 那个钓鱼热点是唯一能钓到巨型水虫碎片的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat there §dFishing Hotspot §fis the only place to catch §9Giant Water Bug §fshards.

entries.source: Who knows why they like it so much down here?
entries.translation: 谁知道它们为什么这么喜欢这下面呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWho knows why they like it so much down here?

entries.source: Getting all the way down here dang near killed me...
entries.translation: 一路下到这里差点要了我的命……
entries.sampleRaw: §fGetting all the way down here dang near killed me...

entries.source: I don't really hunt  Critters, it's not enough of a challenge.
entries.translation: 我其实不怎么猎捕  小兽，那算不上什么挑战。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI don't really hunt §a Critters§f, it's not enough of a challenge.

entries.source: Torrhus Sea Creatures, though? That's more like it.
entries.translation: 不过托鲁斯海洋生物？这才像样。
entries.sampleRaw: §6Torrhus Sea Creatures§f, though? That's more like it.

entries.source: Here's all of the ones that I've found throughout my time in Torrhus Springs.
entries.translation: 这些就是我在托鲁斯泉地期间找到的全部了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere's all of the ones that I've found throughout my time in §bTorrhus Springs§f.

entries.source: Welcome to the Critter Safari, amigo!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到小兽狩猎区，朋友！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWelcome to the §2Critter Safari§f, amigo!

entries.source: First things first, you'll need a Safari Belt - it's the only item you can bring into the Critter Safari with you.
entries.translation: 首先，你需要一条野生动物园腰带——这是你唯一能带进小兽狩猎区的物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §fFirst things first, you'll need a §2Safari Belt§f - it's the only item you can bring into the §2Critter Safari§f with you.

entries.source: Here, take this one. It's on me!
entries.translation: 来，拿着这条。算我请你的！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, take this one. It's on me!

entries.source: Looks like you've got yourself a Safari Belt already, so we can get straight down to business!
entries.translation: 看来你已经有野生动物园腰带了，那我们就可以直接谈正事了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fLooks like you've got yourself a §fSafari Belt§f already, so we can get straight down to business!

entries.source: Give me any tier of Safari Ticket and I'll get you right on into the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 给我任意等级的野生动物园门票，我就直接送你进小兽狩猎区。
entries.sampleRaw: §fGive me any tier of §2Safari Ticket§f and I'll get you right on into the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: Here, why don't you take a look at the experiences we currently have on offer?
entries.translation: 来，看看我们目前提供的体验项目吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, why don't you take a look at the experiences we currently have on offer?

entries.source: I already saw your ticket, so you're free to go.
entries.translation: 我已经看过你的门票了，你可以走了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI already saw your ticket, so you're free to go.

entries.source: Your friends will need to show me their tickets, though.
entries.translation: 不过你的朋友们得把他们的门票给我看。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYour friends will need to show me their tickets, though.

entries.source: Looks good to me. Have fun out there!
entries.translation: 我看没问题。玩得开心！
entries.sampleRaw: §fLooks good to me. Have fun out there!

entries.source: You already gave me your ticket, bud.
entries.translation: 你已经把门票给我了，伙计。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou already gave me your ticket, bud.

entries.source: You're free to explore the Critter Safari 'til your heart's content!
entries.translation: 你可以尽情探索小兽狩猎区，想玩多久就玩多久！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou're free to explore the §2Critter Safari§f 'til your heart's content!

entries.source: Dude, if you're not gonna pay, you're not gonna play.
entries.translation: 老兄，不付钱就别想玩。
entries.sampleRaw: §fDude, if you're not gonna pay, you're not gonna play.

entries.source: You're just standing around doing nothing - I'm sending you back to the Critter Safari Entrance.
entries.translation: 你就干站着什么都不做——我要把你送回小兽狩猎区入口了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou're just standing around doing nothing - I'm sending you back to the §2Critter Safari Entrance§f.

entries.source: Come and see me again if you decide you actually want to play next time.
entries.translation: 如果下次你决定真的想玩了，再来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: §fCome and see me again if you decide you actually want to play next time.

entries.source: Looks like you used up your last Critter Capsule!
entries.translation: 看来你用完了最后一个生物胶囊！
entries.sampleRaw: §fLooks like you used up your last §cCritter Capsule§f!

entries.source: Would you like to leave the Critter Safari?
entries.translation: 你想离开小兽狩猎区吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWould you like to leave the §2Critter Safari§f?

entries.source: Uh guys, you better come and see this...
entries.translation: 呃伙计们，你们最好过来看看这个……
entries.sampleRaw: Uh guys, you better come and see this...

entries.source: What's up?
entries.translation: 怎么了？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhat's up?

entries.source: I'm the greatest hunter around - the name's Tobias.
entries.translation: 我是这里最伟大的猎人——我叫Tobias。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm the greatest hunter around - the name's §6Tobias§f.

entries.source: I'm actually so great that I've caught every single  Critter in the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 我实在太厉害了，小兽狩猎区里的每一只小兽都被我抓到了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm actually so great that I've caught every single §a Critter§f in the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: ...And, before you ask, my success has nothing to do with the fact that my dad owns the place.
entries.translation: ……还有，在你问之前先说清楚，我的成功跟我爸拥有这个地方毫无关系。
entries.sampleRaw: §f...And, before you ask, my success has nothing to do with the fact that my dad owns the place.

entries.source: Anyways, why don't we see how many  Critters you've caught?.
entries.translation: 总之，我们来看看你抓到了多少只小兽吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnyways, why don't we see how many §a Critters§f you've caught?.

entries.source: ...Less than I have, for sure.
entries.translation: ……肯定比我少。
entries.sampleRaw: §f...Less than §oI have§f, for sure.

entries.source: What did you say to me?
entries.translation: 你刚才对我说什么？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhat did you say to me?

entries.source: Say sorry right now, or I won't let you use the Critterdex.
entries.translation: 现在就说对不起，不然我不让你用小兽图鉴。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSay §csorry§f right now, or I won't let you use the §aCritterdex§f.

entries.source: I'm not letting you use the Critterdex until you say I am very sorry Tobias and regret my actions deeply.
entries.translation: 除非你说“我非常抱歉Tobias，并对我的行为深感后悔”，否则我不让你用小兽图鉴。

styleMappings.I am very sorry Tobias and regret my act: 我非常抱歉Tobias，并对我的行为深感后悔

entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm not letting you use the §aCritterdex§f until you say §cI am very sorry Tobias and regret my actions deeply§f.

entries.source: I'm waiting!
entries.translation: 我等着呢！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm waiting!

entries.source: That's what I thought! Thanks for acknowledging your inferiority.
entries.translation: 我就知道！谢谢你承认自己不如我。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat's what I thought! Thanks for acknowledging your inferiority.

entries.source: Now, here's the Critterdex.
entries.translation: 现在，这是小兽图鉴。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNow, here's the §aCritterdex§f.

entries.source: You can use it to view all of the  Critters you've caught while in the Critter Safari.
entries.translation: 你可以用它查看你在小兽狩猎区捕获的所有只小兽。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can use it to view all of the §a Critters§f you've caught while in the §2Critter Safari§f.

entries.source: While you'll never catch as many as me, you should try your best anyways.
entries.translation: 虽然你永远抓不到像我这么多，但你还是应该尽力而为。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhile you'll never catch as many as me, you should try your best anyways.

entries.source: Heyyy!
entries.translation: 嘿呀！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHeyyy!

entries.source: Do you want this <shard>? I already maxed that Attribute...
entries.translation: 你想要这个<shard>吗？那个属性我已经升满了……
entries.sampleRaw: §fDo you want this §7<shard>§f? I already maxed that Attribute...

entries.source: How about I give you it in exchange for, say, a <cost>?

entries.sampleRaw: When its time to deliver Gifts, §cMount Jerry§f always erupts and the village is ravaged by heat-based enemies!

entries.source: It is up to you, [player], to help save the day. Take this Snow Cannon to aid you in your defense against the Magma Grinches.
entries.translation: [player]，拯救这一切就靠你了。带上这门雪炮，助你抵御岩浆捣蛋鬼。
entries.sampleRaw: It is up to you, §b[player]§f, to help save the day. Take this §aSnow Cannon§f to aid you in your defense against the §cMagma Grinches§f.

entries.source: It holds and fires Snowballs, which are the best way to extinguish the enemy!
entries.translation: 它能装填并发射雪球，这是扑灭敌人的最佳方式！
entries.sampleRaw: It holds and fires §bSnowballs§f, which are the best way to extinguish the enemy!

entries.source: I can refill it at any time for a modest price. Also feel free to check out my shop upstairs!
entries.translation: 我随时可以以实惠的价格为你补充。也欢迎去楼上看看我的商店！
entries.sampleRaw: I can refill it at any time for a modest price. Also feel free to check out my shop upstairs!

entries.source: Click me with a Snow Cannon, Snow Blaster, or Frosty the Howitzer to refill it!
entries.translation: 手持雪炮、雪球爆破枪或榴弹雪人点击我即可补充！
entries.sampleRaw: Click me with a Snow Cannon, Snow Blaster, or Frosty the Howitzer to refill it!

entries.source: I noticed you don't have a Snow Cannon, would you like to buy another?
entries.translation: 我注意到你没有雪炮，想再买一门吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I noticed you don't have a Snow Cannon, would you like to buy another?

entries.source: For the holidays, we're offering exclusive doorbuster deals for the whole family to enjoy!
entries.translation: 节日期间，我们为全家准备了独家开门大促！
entries.sampleRaw: For the holidays, we're offering exclusive doorbuster deals for the whole family to enjoy!

entries.source: Check out our new Festive Sinker, which is great for fishing up Gifts!
entries.translation: 看看我们全新的节日沉子吧，非常适合钓上礼物！
entries.sampleRaw: Check out our new §9Festive Sinker§f, which is great for fishing up §aGifts§f!

entries.source: We are also offering Frosty the Snow Blaster, an upgraded Snow Cannon that shoots much farther!
entries.translation: 我们还提供雪球爆破手 Frosty，这是升级版雪炮，射程远得多！
entries.sampleRaw: We are also offering §5Frosty the Snow Blaster§f, an upgraded Snow Cannon that shoots much farther!

entries.source: My helmet is constantly breaking. Could you provide me with some Pumpkins to help with maintenance?
entries.translation: 我的头盔总是坏。你能给我一些南瓜来帮忙维护吗？
entries.sampleRaw: My helmet is constantly breaking. Could you provide me with some Pumpkins to help with maintenance?

entries.source: Thank you, I'll never run out of Pumpkins!
entries.translation: 谢谢你，我再也不会缺南瓜了！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you, I'll never run out of Pumpkins!

entries.source: I'll look elsewhere for more Pumpkins.
entries.translation: 我会去别处找更多南瓜。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll look elsewhere for more Pumpkins.

entries.source: 'Tis the Season of Jerry, [player]!
entries.translation: [player]，现在是Jerry的季节！
entries.sampleRaw: 'Tis the §cSeason of Jerry§f, §b[player]§f!

entries.source: You may have noticed some Gifts laying around.
entries.translation: 你可能注意到周围散落着一些礼物。
entries.sampleRaw: You may have noticed some §aGifts§f laying around.

entries.source: Each SkyBlock year, I place them throughout the village to spread joy and good tidings.
entries.translation: 每个 SkyBlock 年，我都会把它们放在村庄各处，传递欢乐与佳音。
entries.sampleRaw: Each SkyBlock year, I place them throughout the village to spread joy and good tidings.

entries.source: Find them all and come back to me!
entries.translation: 把它们全部找到，然后回来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Find them all and come back to me!

entries.source: Find all of the Gifts around the village and come back to me!
entries.translation: 找到村庄周围所有的礼物，然后回来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Find all of the Gifts around the village and come back to me!

entries.source: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!
entries.translation: 我看到你找到了一些礼物，但村庄里还有很多。找到其余的，然后回来领取奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!

entries.source: You're getting there, [player]! Find the rest of the Gifts and come back for a reward!
entries.translation: [player]，你进展不错！找到其余的礼物，然后回来领取奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: You're getting there, §7[player]§f! Find the rest of the Gifts and come back for a reward!

entries.source: You're so close! Find # more Gifts and come back to me!
entries.translation: 就差一点了！再找到 # 个礼物，然后回来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: You're so close! Find §a# §fmore Gifts and come back to me!

entries.source: You're so close! Find the last Gift and come back for a reward!
entries.translation: 就差一点了！找到最后一个礼物，然后回来领取奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: You're so close! Find the last Gift and come back for a reward!

entries.source: You found all of the Gifts!
entries.translation: 你找到了所有的礼物！
entries.sampleRaw: You found all of the Gifts!

entries.source: Take this Green Gift! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!
entries.translation: 收下这个绿色礼物吧！希望你能在里面找到比那些白色礼物更好的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: Take this §aGreen Gift§f! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!

entries.source: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!
entries.translation: 如果还没送出去，记得把你的其他礼物送给别人。赠送礼物对你和收礼者都有好处！
entries.sampleRaw: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!

entries.source: ✆ Of course I can add you as a contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 当然可以把你加为联系人！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Of course I can add you as a contact!

entries.source: ✆ I have # contacts on my Abiphone.
entries.translation: ✆ 我的 Abiphone 里有 # 个联系人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I have §c# contacts §fon my Abiphone.

entries.source: ✆ It's a really big Abiphone!
entries.translation: ✆ 这可是一台超大的 Abiphone！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f It's a really big Abiphone!

entries.source: ✆ If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你想要我的联系方式，只需一字不差地重复这句话……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...

entries.source: ✆ "I love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow"
entries.translation: ✆ "尽管大雪纷飞,我依然喜爱节日的温暖"

styleMappings.I love the warmth of the Holidays despit: 尽管大雪纷飞,我依然喜爱节日的温暖"

entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f "§bI love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow"

entries.source: ✆ That's grandiose!
entries.translation: ✆ 那真是太棒了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f That's grandiose!

entries.source: ✆ I really like you!
entries.translation: ✆ 我真的很喜欢你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I really like you!

entries.source: ✆ Call me every year and I'll hand you a White Gift!
entries.translation: ✆ 每年都来找我，我就送你一份白色礼物！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Call me every year and I'll hand you a White Gift!

entries.source: ✆ I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
entries.translation: ✆ 我已经把一份礼物送进你的物品栏了！爱你的，St. Jerry。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.

entries.source: ✆ But hey, merry season of the Jerry to you anyway!
entries.translation: ✆ 不过嘛，还是祝你Jerry的季节快乐！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f But hey, merry season of the Jerry to you anyway!

entries.source: ✆ Call me again next year!
entries.translation: ✆ 明年再来找我吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Call me again next year!

entries.source: Golly gee - I want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!
entries.translation: 天哪——我想以原材料的形式，把欢乐传遍全世界！
entries.sampleRaw: Golly gee - I want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!

entries.source: Your help has been the greatest gift of all.
entries.translation: 你的帮助就是最棒的礼物。
entries.sampleRaw: Your help has been the greatest gift of all.

entries.source: Without your help, I can only supply plain white gifts this holiday.
entries.translation: 没有你的帮助，这个节日我只能提供普通的白色礼物。
entries.sampleRaw: Without your help, I can only supply plain white gifts this holiday.

entries.source: Did you know you can access your Bank from Jerry's Workshop? Check out the Bank in the center of the village!
entries.translation: 你知道吗？你可以从杰瑞的工坊访问你的银行！去看看村庄中央的银行吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know you can access your Bank from Jerry's Workshop? Check out the Bank in the center of the village!

entries.source: Click someone with a Gift to give both you and them a Gift!
entries.translation: 拿着礼物点击某人，就能同时给你和他各送一份礼物！
entries.sampleRaw: Click someone with a Gift to give both you and them a Gift!

entries.source: Come back next SkyBlock year to find more Gifts!
entries.translation: 下一个 SkyBlock 年度再来，就能找到更多礼物！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back next SkyBlock year to find more Gifts!

entries.source: Ice fishing is a great way to relax during the winter!
entries.translation: 冰钓是冬季放松的绝佳方式！
entries.sampleRaw: §bIce fishing§f is a great way to relax during the winter!

entries.source: There are all sorts of icy creatures within the depths of Jerry Pond!
entries.translation: 杰瑞池塘深处有各种各样的冰系生物！
entries.sampleRaw: There are all sorts of icy creatures within the depths of §bJerry Pond§f!

entries.source: You can trade Gifts directly with others or randomly gift players on the island!
entries.translation: 你可以直接与他人交换礼物，也可以随机赠送岛上的玩家！
entries.sampleRaw: You can trade Gifts directly with others or randomly gift players on the island!

entries.source: Gifting others benefits both you and the other person!
entries.translation: 赠送他人对你和对方都有好处！
entries.sampleRaw: Gifting others benefits both you and the other person!

entries.source: ✆ You've already recieved[sic<
entries.translation: ✆ 你已经领取过了[sic<
entries.sampleRaw: §r§b✆§r§f You've already recieved[sic<

entries.source: Welcome to the Community Center!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到社区中心！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the §bCommunity Center§f!

entries.source: Contribute to community projects, upgrade your account, and more by talking to Elizabeth!
entries.translation: 与 Elizabeth 交谈即可为社区项目做贡献、升级你的账户等等！
entries.sampleRaw: Contribute to community projects, upgrade your account, and more by talking to §dElizabeth§f!

entries.source: Welcome to the Election Room!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到选举室！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the §bElection Room§f!

entries.source: ✆ Nice to see you, [Player]!
entries.translation: ✆ 很高兴见到你,[Player]!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fNice to see you, §7[Player]§f!

entries.source: ✆ Hm, you'd like my Abiphone Contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯，你想要我的 Abiphone 联系人？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHm, you'd like my §9Abiphone Contact§f?

entries.source: ✆ Sure, I'd be honored!
entries.translation: ✆ 当然，这是我的荣幸！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fSure, I'd be honored!

entries.source: ✆ Give me a call if you ever want to vote remotely in a Mayor Election!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你想在市长选举中远程投票，随时给我打电话！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fGive me a call if you ever want to vote remotely in a §9Mayor Election§f!

entries.source: ✆ I'll also give you a call each year to let you know when voting's begun!
entries.translation: ✆ 每年投票开始时，我也会打电话通知你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI'll also give you a call each year to let you know when voting's begun!

entries.source: ✆ Hi, [player]!
entries.translation: ✆ 嗨,[player]!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHi, §7[player]§f!

entries.source: ✆ I just wanted to call to let you know that voting for this year's Mayor Election has begun!
entries.translation: ✆ 我打电话只是想告诉你，今年市长选举的投票已经开始了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI just wanted to call to let you know that voting for this year's §9Mayor Election §fhas begun!

entries.source: ✆ Here, take a look at the candidates!
entries.translation: ✆ 来，看看这些候选人吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere, take a look at the candidates!

entries.source: ✆ Hey, [player]! Voting for the next Mayor Election hasn't opened yet, check back in [time]!
entries.translation: ✆ 嘿,[player]!下一届市长选举的投票还没开始,请在 [time] 后再来看看!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHey, [player]! Voting for the next §9Mayor Election§f hasn't opened yet, check back in §a[time]§f!

entries.source: Hey <player>, the mayor elections are coming up and I've ran out of ballot paper! Could you help me out?
entries.translation: 嘿 <player>，市长选举快到了，可我的选票纸用完了！你能帮我一下吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey §b<player>§f, the mayor elections are coming up and I've ran out of ballot paper! Could you help me out?

entries.source: Thank you very much! I'll make sure to give these extra ballots to only the elites!
entries.translation: 非常感谢！我会确保把这些额外的选票只发给精英们！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you very much! I'll make sure to give these extra ballots to only the elites!

entries.source: Oh no... I might have to cancel the elections now...
entries.translation: 哦不……我可能得取消选举了……
entries.sampleRaw: Oh no... I might have to cancel the elections now...

entries.source: Talk to me later for information about the resistance...
entries.translation: 稍后再来找我了解抵抗组织的情报……
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me later for information about the resistance...

entries.source: If you are here, it probably means you want to join the resistance.
entries.translation: 如果你来到这里，大概说明你想加入抵抗组织。
entries.sampleRaw: If you are here, it probably means you want to join the resistance.

entries.source: Dante needs to be overthrown, it'll take time but we are organizing a coup.
entries.translation: Dante 必须被推翻，这需要时间，但我们正在策划一场政变。
entries.sampleRaw: Dante needs to be overthrown, it'll take time but we are organizing a coup.

entries.source: However we have not decided who should be our leader, and we believe we should go back to a vote.
entries.translation: 不过我们还没决定由谁来当领袖，我们认为应该重新进行投票。
entries.sampleRaw: However we have not decided who should be our leader, and we believe we should go back to a vote.

entries.source: Please let me know which community member you believe should lead the resistance.
entries.translation: 请告诉我你认为哪位社区成员应该领导抵抗组织。
entries.sampleRaw: Please let me know which community member you believe should lead the resistance.

entries.source: You can vote for any player you deem worthy.
entries.translation: 你可以投票给任何你认为值得的玩家。
entries.sampleRaw: You can vote for any player you deem worthy.

entries.source: But those are on the side of Dante... are you sure it's a good idea to vote for them? Please choose someone else.
entries.translation: 但那些人是站在 Dante 那边的……你确定投给他们是个好主意吗？请另选他人吧。
entries.sampleRaw: But those are on the side of Dante... are you sure it's a good idea to vote for them? Please choose someone else.

entries.source: Come talk to me once you've played some more!
entries.translation: 等你多玩一段时间后再来找我谈谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Come talk to me once you've played some more!

entries.source: Thanks for voting, the Leader and his generals have been selected!
entries.translation: 感谢投票，领袖和他的将领们已经选出来了！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for voting, the Leader and his generals have been selected!

entries.source: We have a lot of work now before the revolt can happen.
entries.translation: 在起义发生之前，我们现在还有很多工作要做。
entries.sampleRaw: We have a lot of work now before the revolt can happen.

entries.source: I'll let you know soon on the day and place it will happen.
entries.translation: 我很快会通知你起义的日期和地点。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll let you know soon on the day and place it will happen.

entries.source: Please take this Armor and Hope of the Resistance!
entries.translation: 请收下这套抵抗组织的盔甲和希望！
entries.sampleRaw: Please take this Armor and Hope of the Resistance!

entries.source: Courage, we can win!
entries.translation: 鼓起勇气，我们能赢！
entries.sampleRaw: Courage, we can win!

entries.source: Thanks for collecting your resistance gear!
entries.translation: 感谢你领取抵抗组织的装备！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for collecting your resistance gear!

entries.source: You should now start training ready for the fight!
entries.translation: 你现在应该开始训练，为战斗做好准备！
entries.sampleRaw: You should now start training ready for the fight!

entries.source: I will give you more information soon about when the rebellion will happen.
entries.translation: 我很快会给你更多关于叛乱何时发生的信息。
entries.sampleRaw: I will give you more information soon about when the rebellion will happen.

entries.source: SEND YOUR ENERGY TO YOUR LEADER, LOOK UP TO THE SKY!
entries.translation: 把你的能量献给领袖，仰望天空！
entries.sampleRaw: §e§lSEND YOUR ENERGY TO YOUR LEADER, LOOK UP TO THE SKY!

entries.source: I managed to undo some of Dante's damage! Pets should be back!
entries.translation: 我设法撤销了 Dante 造成的一些破坏！宠物应该恢复了！
entries.sampleRaw: I managed to undo some of Dante's damage! Pets should be back!

entries.source: Welcome to the mayor elections!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到市长选举！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the mayor elections!

entries.source: Democracy has never been this simple!
entries.translation: 民主从未如此简单！
entries.sampleRaw: §bDemocracy§f has never been this simple!

entries.source: Everyone votes for their favorite candidate...
entries.translation: 每个人都为自己最喜欢的候选人投票……
entries.sampleRaw: Everyone votes for their §dfavorite§f candidate...

entries.source: ... and whoever has the most votes becomes mayor for a year!
entries.translation: ……得票最多的人将成为任期一年的市长！
entries.sampleRaw: ... and whoever has the most votes becomes mayor for a year!

entries.source: The elected mayor offers perks for everyone!
entries.translation: 当选的市长会为所有人提供增益！
entries.sampleRaw: The elected mayor offers §aperks§f for everyone!

entries.source: We're still decorating since the building renovations!
entries.translation: 建筑翻修之后我们还在装饰呢！
entries.sampleRaw: We're still decorating since the building renovations!

entries.source: The Community Center will be finished soon!
entries.translation: 社区中心很快就会完工！
entries.sampleRaw: The Community Center will be finished soon!

entries.source: Check back later for updates!
entries.translation: 稍后再来看看更新吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Check back later for updates!

entries.source: This is going to be our Village's Community Center!
entries.translation: 这里将会是我们村庄的社区中心！
entries.sampleRaw: This is going to be our Village's Community Center!

entries.source: Right now, it's under construction.
entries.translation: 目前它还在施工中。
entries.sampleRaw: Right now, it's under construction.

entries.source: Check back later to view leaderboards and the latest news!
entries.translation: 稍后再来看看排行榜和最新消息吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Check back later to view leaderboards and the latest news!

entries.source: Hi, [player]! Welcome to the Furniture Shop.
entries.translation: 嗨,[player]!欢迎来到家具商店.
entries.sampleRaw: §fHi, §7[player]§f! Welcome to the §aFurniture Shop§f.

entries.source: Sales are too good right now, I can't keep up with the demand!
entries.translation: 现在生意太好了，我都跟不上需求了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fSales are too good right now, I can't keep up with the demand!

entries.source: Could you bring a stack of White Wool to help replenish my stock?
entries.translation: 你能带一组白色羊毛来帮我补充库存吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fCould you bring a §astack of White Wool§f to help replenish my stock?

entries.source: Sheep over in The Barn drop wool, but you can also purchase it from the Wool Weaver.
entries.translation: 农庄里的羊会掉落羊毛，但你也可以从Wool Weaver处购买。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSheep over in The Barn drop wool, but you can also purchase it from the §dWool Weaver§f.

entries.source: She lives in a house in the main plaza near the bank.
entries.translation: 她住在主广场上银行附近的一栋房子里。
entries.sampleRaw: §fShe lives in a house in the main plaza near the bank.

entries.source: Come back with a stack of White Wool!
entries.translation: 带一组白色羊毛回来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fCome back with a stack of White Wool!

entries.source: Wow, thanks so much for the help!
entries.translation: 哇，非常感谢你的帮助！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, thanks so much for the help!

entries.source: Carpentry is my passion, I always love to teach others.
entries.translation: 木工是我的热情所在，我一直很喜欢教别人。
entries.sampleRaw: Carpentry is my passion, I always love to teach others.

entries.source: Here's the recipe for the Carpentry Table. You can place it in your world and craft furniture that you've unlocked!
entries.translation: 这是木工台的配方。你可以把它放置在你的世界里，制作你已解锁的家具！
entries.sampleRaw: Here's the recipe for the §aCarpentry Table§f. You can place it in your world and craft furniture that you've unlocked!

entries.source: You can now gain Carpentry XP by crafting items. Leveling your Carpentry Skill unlocks new furniture recipes!
entries.translation: 现在你可以通过制作物品来获得木工经验。提升你的木工技能等级可以解锁新的家具配方！
entries.sampleRaw: You can now gain §fCarpentry XP by crafting items. Leveling your §aCarpentry Skill§f unlocks new furniture recipes!

entries.source: Some furniture is available exclusively in the Furniture Shop downstairs. Check it out!
entries.translation: 有些家具只在楼下的家具商店独家出售。去看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Some furniture is available exclusively in the Furniture Shop downstairs. Check it out!

entries.source: Hey, <playername>. I found this blueprint laying around in my house, just collecting dust. Thought it might catch your interest.
entries.translation: 嘿，<playername>。我在家里发现了这份闲置积灰的蓝图。觉得你可能会感兴趣。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, §7<playername>§f. I found this blueprint laying around in my house, just collecting dust. Thought it might catch your interest.

entries.source: Ahoy, <player>! Welcome to the Jerry Pond!
entries.translation: 嗨，<player>！欢迎来到杰瑞池塘！
entries.sampleRaw: Ahoy, §b<player>§f! Welcome to the Jerry Pond!

entries.source: You may have noticed that this pond is full of unique creatures and treasures!
entries.translation: 你可能已经注意到这个池塘里满是独特的生物和宝藏！
entries.sampleRaw: You may have noticed that this pond is full of unique creatures and treasures!

entries.source: I'm looking for Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks!
entries.translation: 我正在寻找冰块和蓝冰块！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm looking for §bIce Hunks§f and §bBlue Ice Hunks§f!

entries.source: You can find these by ice fishing in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!
entries.translation: 你可以在池塘里进行冰钓来找到它们——打破冰面，然后抛出你的钓竿！
entries.sampleRaw: You can find these by §bice fishing§f in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!

entries.source: Bring enough hunks back to me and I will reforge your fishing rod with modifiers exclusive to me - Terry!
entries.translation: 带足够的冰块回来给我，我就会用我独有的修饰词来洗练你的钓鱼竿——Terry！
entries.sampleRaw: Bring enough hunks back to me and I will reforge your fishing rod with modifiers exclusive to me - Terry!

entries.source: Ahoy, <player>! People always tell me they like ice cream, but ice never really tastes like anything for me!
entries.translation: 嗨，<player>！人们总说他们喜欢冰淇淋，但冰对我来说从来没什么味道！
entries.sampleRaw: Ahoy, §b<player>§f! People always tell me they like ice cream, but ice never really tastes like anything for me!

entries.source: ✆ Ahoy, <player>!
entries.translation: ✆ 嗨，<player>！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fAhoy, §b<player>§f!

entries.source: ✆ If you want my Abiphone Contact, you're gonna have to bring me the goods.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你想要我的 Abiphone 联系方式，你得把货带来给我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fIf you want my §3Abiphone Contact§f, you're gonna have to bring me the goods.

entries.source: ✆ Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks won't cut it anymore, unfortunately.
entries.translation: ✆ 不幸的是，冰块和蓝冰块已经不够了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§f§aIce Hunks §fand §9Blue Ice Hunks §fwon't cut it anymore, unfortunately.

entries.source: ✆ If you want me in your phone, bring me a Winter Water Orb!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你想让我出现在你的手机里，就带一个冬季水球给我！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fIf you want me in your phone, bring me a §6Winter Water Orb§f!

entries.source: ✆ Thanks for the orb!
entries.translation: ✆ 谢谢你的宝珠！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThanks for the orb!

entries.source: ✆ Now that I have this, the possibilities are endless!
entries.translation: ✆ 有了这个，一切皆有可能！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fNow that I have this, the possibilities are endless!

entries.source: ✆ Here, take my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 来，收下我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere, take my contact.

entries.source: ✆ I'm just a call away if you ever need me!
entries.translation: ✆ 需要我的时候，随时呼叫我！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm just a call away if you ever need me!

entries.source: ✆ That's not what I asked for!
entries.translation: ✆ 那可不是我要的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThat's not what I asked for!

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Winter Water Orb!
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一个冬季水球来！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me a §6Winter Water Orb§f!

entries.source: The Experimentation Table, which is unlocked at Enchanting X, is definitely the fastest way to level up quickly!
entries.translation: 实验台在附魔 X 级解锁，绝对是快速升级的最快方式！

entries.source: I saw a really strange  Critter the other day...
entries.translation: 前几天我看到了一只非常奇怪的  生物……
entries.sampleRaw: §fI saw a really strange §a Critter§f the other day...

entries.source: It looked different from the usual stuff I see around here - it was SPARKLING...
entries.translation: 它看起来和这附近常见的东西都不一样——它在闪闪发光……
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt looked different from the usual stuff I see around here - it was §6§lSPARKLING§f...

entries.source: I stopped what I was doing and tried my best to catch it...but it got away.
entries.translation: 我停下手中的活，尽力去抓它……但它跑掉了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI stopped what I was doing and tried my best to catch it...but it got away.

entries.source: Haven't seen one since - they must be pretty rare...
entries.translation: 从那以后就再没见过——它们一定相当稀有……
entries.sampleRaw: §fHaven't seen one since - they must be pretty rare...

entries.source: Perhaps "Hunter" Tobias knows something about them?
entries.translation: 也许 "Hunter" Tobias 知道一些关于它们的事?
entries.sampleRaw: §fPerhaps §6"Hunter" Tobias§f knows something about them?

entries.source: My brother Teddy and I are some of the greatest hunters who have ever lived.
entries.translation: 我兄弟 Teddy 和我是有史以来最伟大的猎人之一。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy brother §aTeddy §fand I are some of the greatest hunters who have ever lived.

entries.source: This here Torrhus Canyon has become a second home to me over the years.
entries.translation: 这些年来，这里的 Torrhus Canyon 已经成了我的第二个家。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis here §6Torrhus Canyon §fhas become a second home to me over the years.

entries.source: If you ever need tips on how to hunt any  Critter on this here island, I’m yer man.
entries.translation: 如果你需要在这座岛上猎捕任何  生物的诀窍，找我就对了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you ever need tips on how to hunt any §a Critter §fon this here island, I’m yer man.

entries.source: Ants?
entries.translation: 蚂蚁？
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnts§f?

entries.source: Hmm, them little fellas live down in Ant's Cave...
entries.translation: 嗯，那些小家伙住在安特的洞穴里……
entries.sampleRaw: §fHmm, them little fellas live down in §6Ant's Cave§f...

entries.source: That thing's deep down in Torrhus Springs.
entries.translation: 那东西在托鲁斯泉地深处。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat thing's deep down in §bTorrhus Springs§f.

entries.source: Be sure to bring a Vacuum with ya - you'll need it to suck 'em up.
entries.translation: 记得带上吸尘器——你得用它把它们吸起来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBe sure to bring a §aVacuum §fwith ya - you'll need it to suck 'em up.

entries.source: Beeheemoths? Even I dunno where they come from.
entries.translation: 蜜蜂蛾？连我都不知道它们从哪来的。
entries.sampleRaw: §5Beeheemoths§f? Even I dunno where they come from.

entries.source: They just show up sometimes, yaknow? Flying high around the island.
entries.translation: 它们就是有时候会冒出来，懂吧？在岛的高处飞来飞去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey just show up sometimes, yaknow? Flying high around the island.

entries.source: Listen out for a loud humming and keep yer eyes peeled and Lasso at the ready, I'd say.
entries.translation: 要我说，留意响亮的嗡嗡声，睁大眼睛，把套索准备好。
entries.sampleRaw: §fListen out for a loud humming and keep yer eyes peeled and §2Lasso §fat the ready, I'd say.

entries.source: Blue Jays? Them little guys live up in Torrhus Heights.
entries.translation: 蓝松鸦？那些小家伙住在托鲁斯高地上。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBlue Jays§f? Them little guys live up in §6Torrhus Heights§f.

entries.source: Climb up high, Lasso in hand, and sneak up on 'em.
entries.translation: 爬到高处，手里拿着套索，悄悄靠近它们。
entries.sampleRaw: §fClimb up high, §2Lasso §fin hand, and sneak up on 'em.

entries.source: Bunbuns? You ain't seen one yet?
entries.translation: 兔兔？你还没见过一只？
entries.sampleRaw: §fBunbuns§f? You ain't seen one yet?

entries.source: They're everywhere, hoppin' around!
entries.translation: 它们到处都是，蹦来蹦去的！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey're everywhere, hoppin' around!

entries.source: Them there Drybarks spawn from Helix Tree Gifts.
entries.translation: 那些枯树皮会从螺旋树礼物中生成。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThem there §9Drybarks §fspawn from §6Helix Tree Gifts§f.

entries.source: Keep an eye on 'em while you get yer Lasso out.
entries.translation: 在你拿出套索的时候，盯紧它们。
entries.sampleRaw: §fKeep an eye on 'em while you get yer §2Lasso §fout.

entries.source: Don't blink, or they'll come right atcha.
entries.translation: 别眨眼，不然它们会直接朝你扑过来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fDon't blink, or they'll come right atcha.

entries.source: Them frogs known as Dustybits leap around the Spring Path.
entries.translation: 那些叫尘屑的青蛙在泉水小径周围跳跃。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThem frogs known as §aDustybits §fleap around the §6Spring Path§f.

entries.source: Chase 'em down, following them after each leap, an' eventually they'll get too tired to run any more.
entries.translation: 追着它们跑，每次跳跃后都跟上，最终它们会累得跑不动。
entries.sampleRaw: §fChase 'em down, following them after each leap, an' eventually they'll get too tired to run any more.

entries.source: It's a battle of attrition, I'll say, you versus the beast.
entries.translation: 要我说，这就是一场消耗战，你和野兽之间的较量。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's a battle of attrition, I'll say, you versus the beast.

entries.source: Them Embers live in Torrhus Springs, I believe.
entries.translation: 我相信那些余烬生活在托鲁斯泉地。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThem §aEmbers §flive in §bTorrhus Springs§f, I believe.

entries.source: They be quite deep down, compared to Solars.
entries.translation: 和太阳鱼相比，它们住得相当深。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey be quite deep down, compared to §aSolars§f.

entries.source: Catch 'em all in yer Fishing Net.
entries.translation: 用你的渔网把它们全抓住。
entries.sampleRaw: §fCatch 'em all in yer §9Fishing Net§f.

entries.source: Pop open a Helix Tree Gift, ye might find a Firefox.
entries.translation: 打开一个螺旋树礼物，你可能会找到一只火狐。
entries.sampleRaw: §fPop open a §6Helix Tree Gift§f, ye might find a §fFirefox§f.

entries.source: They be quite timid, and won't cause yer Lasso any problems.
entries.translation: 它们相当胆小，不会给你的套索添任何麻烦。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey be quite timid, and won't cause yer §2Lasso §fany problems.

entries.source: Hmm, the Goldolot.
entries.translation: 嗯，金乌贼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHmm, the §9Goldolot§f.

entries.source: That be a rare mutation of the Sepialot that sometimes appears in Torrhus Springs.
entries.translation: 那是墨乌贼的稀有变种，有时会出现在托鲁斯泉地。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat be a rare mutation of the §aSepialot §fthat sometimes appears in §bTorrhus Springs§f.

entries.source: I would say, hmm, maybe a 20% chance o' replacin' it.
entries.translation: 要我说，嗯，大概有 20% 的几率替换它。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI would say, hmm, maybe a §a20% §fchance o' replacin' it.
entries.numericSource: I would say, hmm, maybe a {{N0}} chance o' replacin' it.
entries.numericTranslation: 要我说，嗯，大概有 {{N0}} 的几率替换它。

entries.source: Sneak up on it and catch it in yer Fishing Net.
entries.translation: 悄悄靠近它，用你的渔网抓住它。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSneak up on it and catch it in yer §9Fishing Net§f.

entries.source: If I recall, them Groundhogs spawn from Helix Tree Gifts.
entries.translation: 如果我没记错，那些土拨鼠会从螺旋树礼物中生成。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf I recall, them Groundhogs spawn from §6Helix Tree Gifts§f.

entries.source: They're quite feisty, but use that there Lasso to tire 'em out.
entries.translation: 它们相当好斗，但用那套索把它们累垮。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey're quite feisty, but use that there §2Lasso §fto tire 'em out.

entries.source: Hideonsun, hmm, sneaky buggers.
entries.translation: 躲猫猫，嗯，鬼鬼祟祟的家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHideonsun§f, hmm, sneaky buggers.

entries.source: Keep yer eyes peeled for any strange lookin' Orange Boxes.
entries.translation: 睁大眼睛留意任何看起来奇怪的橙色箱子。
entries.sampleRaw: §fKeep yer eyes peeled for any strange lookin' §6Orange Boxes§f.

entries.source: They blend into the environment real well.
entries.translation: 它们和环境融合得非常好。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey blend into the environment real well.

entries.source: Once ya find one, jump on its head or give it a punch to wake it up.
entries.translation: 一旦你找到一只，就跳到它头上或者给它一拳把它弄醒。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOnce ya find one, jump on its head or give it a punch to wake it up.

entries.source: I seen a Hivethief or two show up sometimes.
entries.translation: 我有时候会看到一两只盗蜜蜂出现。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI seen a §9Hivethief §for two show up sometimes.

entries.translation: 当你用蜜脾涂抹螺旋树时，它们就会过来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey come by when you smear a §6Helix Tree §fwith §6Honeycomb§f.

entries.translation: 我的好朋友Honey对这些的了解比我多。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMe good friend §6Honey §fknows more about all that than me.

entries.source: Groups of Honeybuzz live within Honeyhives 'round the island.
entries.translation: 成群的蜜嗡嗡生活在岛上的蜜巢里。
entries.sampleRaw: §fGroups of §fHoneybuzz §flive within §6Honeyhives §f'round the island.

entries.source: Stick yer hand in and you might just find one!
entries.translation: 把手伸进去，说不定就能找到一只！
entries.sampleRaw: §fStick yer hand in and you might just find one!

entries.source: The Mountain Goat live right up high.
entries.translation: 岩山羊就住在高高的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §5Mountain Goat §flive right up high.

entries.source: On the Spring Path and other tall points is where you'll find 'em.
entries.translation: 在泉水小径和其他高处，你就能找到它们。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOn the §6Spring Path §fand other tall points is where you'll find 'em.

entries.source: Keep yer distance when you Lasso 'em, though - their headbutt will send yer flying.
entries.translation: 不过用套索套它们时要保持距离——它们的头槌会把你撞飞。
entries.sampleRaw: §fKeep yer distance when you §2Lasso §f'em, though - their headbutt will send yer flying.

entries.source: Them Pangolins be right scared of their own shadow, I tell ya.
entries.translation: 我跟你说，那些穿山甲连自己的影子都怕得要命。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThem §9Pangolins §fbe right scared of their own shadow, I tell ya.

entries.source: Sneak up on 'em, quiet as you can, and Lasso 'em before they can turn into a ball.
entries.translation: 尽可能悄悄地靠近它们，趁它们还没缩成一团时用套索套住它们。

entries.translation: 如果它们真的蜷起来了，你就得等上一阵子，直到它们再次放松警惕。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf they do curl up, yer gonna have to wait a while until they let their guard down again.

entries.source: Them Parched be really thirsty.
entries.translation: 那些焦渴者真的很渴。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThem §aParched §fbe really thirsty.

entries.translation: 如果你用Honey涂抹螺旋树，它们可能会出现。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you smear a §6Helix Tree §fwith §6Honey§f, they might show up.

entries.source: The lovely Honey knows more about all that stuff than I do.
entries.translation: 可爱的Honey对这些东西的了解比我多。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe lovely §6Honey §fknows more about all that stuff than I do.

entries.source: Them Pollendarts love their Honey, I know that much!
entries.translation: 那些花粉镖可喜欢它们的Honey了，这我清楚！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThem §fPollendarts §flove their §6Honey§f, I know that much!

entries.source: If you smear a Helix Tree with Honey, they might come.
entries.translation: 如果你用Honey涂抹螺旋树，它们可能会来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you smear a §6Helix Tree §fwith §6Honey§f, they might come.

entries.source: Miss Honey knows more about all that than I do. Ask her!
entries.translation: Honey小姐对这些的了解比我多。去问她吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fMiss §6Honey §fknows more about all that than I do. Ask her!

entries.translation: 打开一个螺旋树礼物，你可能会找到一只捣蛋鬼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOpen up a §6Helix Tree Gift§f, ye might find a §9Puck§f.

entries.translation: 它们是小捣蛋鬼，但可挡不住一记精准的套索，这我可以告诉你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey be mischievous little buggers, but they ain't as strong as a well-placed §2Lasso§f, I can tell yer that much.
