entries.translation: 潜入托鲁斯泉地深处，进入安特的洞穴。
entries.sampleRaw: §fDive deep down into §bTorrhus Springs§f, make yer way into §6Ant's Cave§f.

entries.source: You'll rarely find her scuttlin' about on the cave floor.
entries.translation: 你很少会看到她在洞穴地面上爬来爬去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou'll rarely find her scuttlin' about on the cave floor.

entries.source: She's more likely to come out if ya start destroyin' the Anthills, though.
entries.translation: 不过，如果你开始破坏蚁丘，她更有可能出来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fShe's more likely to come out if ya start destroyin' the §eAnthills§f, though.

entries.source: Sepialot, huh, that thing be up in Torrhus Springs.
entries.translation: 墨鱼特，是吧，那东西在托鲁斯泉地里。
entries.sampleRaw: §aSepialot§f, huh, that thing be up in §bTorrhus Springs§f.

entries.source: Sneak up on it and catch it in yer Fishing Net before it sees ya.
entries.translation: 趁它还没看见你，悄悄靠近它，用你的渔网抓住它。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSneak up on it and catch it in yer §9Fishing Net §fbefore it sees ya.

entries.source: Hur hur hur hurr! That Tiki Trio, I hate 'em, I really do!
entries.translation: 呵呵呵呵！那个提基三人组，我恨它们，真的恨！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHur hur hur hurr! That §aTiki Trio§f, I hate 'em, I really do!

entries.source: The Sneaky Tiki, Shrieky Tiki, and Cheeky Tiki.
entries.translation: 鬼祟提基、尖啸提基和顽皮提基。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §aSneaky Tiki§f, §aShrieky Tiki§f, and §aCheeky Tiki§f.

entries.source: I can't tell ya which one I hate the most. But I can tell ya which one I hate the least - none of 'em!
entries.translation: 我说不清最恨哪一个。但我能告诉你我最不恨哪个——一个都不恨！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI can't tell ya which one I hate the most. But I can tell ya which one I hate the least - none of 'em!

entries.source: You can find 'em up in Torrhus Heights.
entries.translation: 你可以在托鲁斯高地上找到它们。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can find 'em up in §6Torrhus Heights§f.

entries.source: They'll stay still, unmovin', until you solve their puzzle.
entries.translation: 它们会一动不动地待着，直到你解开它们的谜题。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey'll stay still, unmovin', until you solve their puzzle.

entries.source: Then they'll come to life and blitz 'ya.
entries.translation: 然后它们就会活过来，朝你猛冲。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThen they'll come to life and blitz 'ya.

entries.source: Fend 'em off, and catch 'em in a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.translation: 把它们击退，再用口袋黑洞把它们抓住。
entries.sampleRaw: §fFend 'em off, and catch 'em in a §cPocket Black Hole§f.

entries.source: Ah, just thinkin 'bout them has me blood boilin'...
entries.translation: 唉，光是想想它们就让我火冒三丈……
entries.sampleRaw: §fAh, just thinkin 'bout them has me blood boilin'...

entries.source: Eh, them Solars live in Torrhus Springs, too.
entries.translation: 呃，那些太阳生物也住在托鲁斯泉地。
entries.sampleRaw: §fEh, them §aSolars §flive in §bTorrhus Springs§f, too.

entries.source: They be needing light to function, so they be up near the surface.
entries.translation: 它们需要光才能运作，所以都待在靠近地表的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey be needing light to function, so they be up near the surface.

entries.source: Scoop em up in yer Fishing Net.
entries.translation: Scoop把它们舀进你的钓鱼网里。
entries.sampleRaw: §fScoop em up in yer §9Fishing Net§f.

entries.source: Are ye blind, kid?
entries.translation: 你瞎了吗，小子？
entries.sampleRaw: §fAre ye blind, kid?

entries.source: Turn around and look into that there Pond!
entries.translation: 转过身去看看那个池塘！
entries.sampleRaw: §fTurn around and look into that there §9Pond§f!

entries.source: It's completely overflowin' with Timil!
entries.translation: 里面满满当当全是提米尔！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's completely overflowin' with §fTimil§f!

entries.source: Water Snakes, huh...
entries.translation: 水蛇啊……
entries.sampleRaw: §aWater Snakes§f, huh...

entries.source: They be livin in the deepest depths of Torrhus Springs.
entries.translation: 它们住在托鲁斯泉地最深的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey be livin in the deepest depths of §bTorrhus Springs§f.

entries.source: Get all of yer best divin' gear on, and them pay 'em a visit.
entries.translation: 穿上你最好的潜水装备，去拜访它们吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fGet all of yer best divin' gear on, and them pay 'em a visit.

entries.source: Bring yer biggest net, too - a Turbo Fishing Net or better should do the trick.
entries.translation: 也带上你最大的网——涡轮渔网或更好的应该就够了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBring yer biggest net, too - a §5Turbo Fishing Net §for better should do the trick.

entries.source: You know them Boosters you can get from the Moonglade Marsh?
entries.translation: 你知道能从月林沼泽获得的那些增幅器吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou know them §9Boosters §fyou can get from the §2Moonglade Marsh§f?

entries.source: Well, those puny things ain't gonna cut it 'round these parts.
entries.translation: 嗯，那些小玩意儿在这一带可不够用。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell, those puny things ain't gonna cut it 'round these parts.

entries.source: Luckily for you, I offer Booster Upgrades, for a price.
entries.translation: 算你走运，我提供增幅器升级，不过要收点费用。
entries.sampleRaw: §fLuckily for you, I offer §9Booster Upgrades§f, for a price.

entries.source: I've been observing you, just a bit, nothing creepy.
entries.translation: 我一直在观察你，就一点点，没什么可怕的。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been observing you, just a bit, nothing creepy.

entries.source: But nonetheless, I can't help but feel like you and I are different.
entries.translation: 但尽管如此，我还是忍不住觉得你和我很不一样。
entries.sampleRaw: But nonetheless, I can't help but feel like you and I are different.

entries.source: You move around so fast, doing all sorts of crazy things.
entries.translation: 你行动那么快，做着各种疯狂的事。
entries.sampleRaw: You move around so fast, doing all sorts of crazy things.

entries.source: And I'm just... here. You know?
entries.translation: 而我就只是……在这里。你懂吗？
entries.sampleRaw: And I'm just... here. You know?

entries.source: Sometimes I feel like I don't belong, like I'm just a background character.
entries.translation: 有时我觉得自己不属于这里，就像我只是个背景角色。
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes I feel like I don't belong, like I'm just a background character.

entries.source: I don't even have any ambition. But strangely... I'm happy to exist.
entries.translation: 我甚至没有任何抱负。但奇怪的是……我很高兴自己能存在。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't even have any ambition. But strangely... I'm happy to exist.

entries.source: I can't help but feel like I'm in some kind of simulation. Not a real world.
entries.translation: 我忍不住觉得自己身处某种模拟之中。不是真实的世界。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't help but feel like I'm in some kind of simulation. Not a real world.

entries.source: Well... maybe a real world, but one created as a test. For some other beings.
entries.translation: 嗯……也许是真实的世界，但却是作为一场测试而创造的。为了某些别的存在。
entries.sampleRaw: Well... maybe a real world, but one created as a test. For some other beings.

entries.source: Have you noticed how the world is made up with simple rules?
entries.translation: 你注意到这个世界是由简单的规则构成的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you noticed how the world is made up with simple rules?

entries.source: Sometimes, I glimpse something. In the corner of my eye, like threads of code holding the world together.
entries.translation: 有时，我会瞥见一些东西。就在我眼角余光里，像是维系着这个世界的代码丝线。
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes, I glimpse something. In the corner of my eye, like threads of code holding the world together.

entries.source: It's like a simple language that creates everything, just a few sets of rules...
entries.translation: 就像一门简单的语言创造了一切，仅仅几套规则……
entries.sampleRaw: It's like a simple language that creates everything, just a few sets of rules...

entries.source: Are you sure?
entries.translation: 你确定吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you sure?

entries.source: The way I see it your world is also quite simple.
entries.translation: 在我看来，你们的世界也相当简单。
entries.sampleRaw: The way I see it your world is also quite simple.

entries.source: Quarks, Leptons, Gauge Bosons, just a few building blocks.
entries.translation: 夸克、轻子、规范玻色子，不过几块积木而已。
entries.sampleRaw: Quarks, Leptons, Gauge Bosons, just a few building blocks.

entries.source: Only 4 four fundamental interactions, fields and spacetime.
entries.translation: 只有 4 种基本相互作用、场和时空。
entries.sampleRaw: Only 4 four fundamental interactions, fields and spacetime.
entries.numericSource: Only {{N0}} four fundamental interactions, fields and spacetime.
entries.numericTranslation: 只有 {{N0}} 种基本相互作用、场和时空。

entries.source: Think about it, doesn't it feel strangely well designed?
entries.translation: 想想看，不觉得它设计得异常精巧吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Think about it, doesn't it feel strangely well designed?

entries.source: With just a few ingredients you get a hundred elements, millions of molecules...
entries.translation: 仅仅几种原料，就能得到上百种元素、数百万种分子……
entries.sampleRaw: With just a few ingredients you get a hundred elements, millions of molecules...

entries.source: And from that, oceans, storms, thought, emotion, life itself.
entries.translation: 由此，又有了海洋、风暴、思想、情感，乃至生命本身。
entries.sampleRaw: And from that, oceans, storms, thought, emotion, life itself.

entries.source: Doesn't that seem... too elegant? Too well designed to be random?
entries.translation: 这难道不显得……太过优雅了吗？精巧得不像随机形成的吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Doesn't that seem... too elegant? Too well designed to be random?

entries.source: Are you really sure you are not in some kind of giant experiment, a game, yourself?
entries.translation: 你真的确定，你自己不是身处某种巨大的实验、一场游戏之中吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you really sure you are not in some kind of giant experiment, a game, yourself?

entries.source: If I can see the matrix sometimes... maybe you can too.
entries.translation: 如果有时我能看见矩阵……也许你也可以。
entries.sampleRaw: If I can see the matrix sometimes... maybe you can too.

entries.source: Think about it...
entries.translation: 想想看吧……
entries.sampleRaw: Think about it...

entries.source: See that little creature next to me? That's actually a Scrappy that curled itself into a ball.
entries.translation: 看到我旁边那只小生物了吗？那其实是一只蜷成一团的暴躁兽。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSee that little creature next to me? That's actually a §9Scrappy§f that curled itself into a ball.

entries.source: My Critter Capsules seem to just bounce right off it!
entries.translation: 我的生物胶囊好像直接就被它弹开了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy §cCritter Capsules§f seem to just bounce right off it!

entries.source: That "Hunter" Tobias guy told me that they love Food.
entries.translation: 那个 "Hunter" Tobias 告诉我，它们很喜欢食物。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat §6"Hunter" Tobias§f guy told me that they love §eFood§f.

entries.source: He said that they might be motivated to come out if given either Wholesale Wheat, Flavor-packed Fish, or Lush Lily Pads.
entries.translation: 他说，如果给它们批发小麦、风味十足鱼或繁茂睡莲叶，也许就能引它们出来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe said that they might be motivated to come out if given either §6Wholesale Wheat§f, §bFlavor-packed Fish§f, or §6Lush Lily Pads§f.

entries.source: That really worked, you caught the Scrappy! Nice going!
entries.translation: 真的奏效了，你抓到暴躁兽了！干得漂亮！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat really worked, you caught the §9Scrappy§f! Nice going!

entries.source: My brothers might be around here, maybe they found more Scrappy...
entries.translation: 我的兄弟们可能就在附近，也许他们找到了更多暴躁兽……
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy brothers might be around here, maybe they found more §9Scrappy§f...

entries.source: That little ball right here is actually a Scrappy.
entries.translation: 这里的这个小球其实是一只暴躁兽。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat little ball right here is actually a §9Scrappy§f.

entries.source: Critter Capsules don't seem to do anything to them.
entries.translation: 生物胶囊似乎对它们毫无作用。
entries.sampleRaw: §cCritter Capsules§f don't seem to do anything to them.

entries.source: "Hunter" Tobias had mentioned to me that you can lure them out with Food.
entries.translation: "Hunter" Tobias 跟我提过，你可以用食物把它们引出来。
entries.sampleRaw: §6"Hunter" Tobias§f had mentioned to me that you can lure them out with §eFood§f.

entries.source: He said that they might like either Wholesale Wheat, Flavor-packed Fish, or Lush Lily Pads.
entries.translation: 他说它们可能喜欢批发小麦、风味十足鱼或繁茂睡莲叶。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe said that they might like either §6Wholesale Wheat§f, §bFlavor-packed Fish§f, or §6Lush Lily Pads§f.

entries.source: Hmm that "Hunter" Tobias guy was right... Nice Catch!
entries.translation: 嗯，那个 "Hunter" Tobias 说得没错……抓得好！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHmm that §6"Hunter" Tobias§f guy was right... Nice Catch!

entries.source: There might be more Scrappy around - I wonder if my brothers have found them yet.
entries.translation: 附近可能还有更多暴躁兽——不知道我的兄弟们找到它们没有。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere might be more §9Scrappy§f around - I wonder if my brothers have found them yet.

entries.source: Have you noticed any peculiar weather recently?
entries.translation: 你最近有没有注意到什么奇怪的天气？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave you noticed any peculiar §bweather §frecently?

entries.source: That's the Origin Cloud's doing - it seems to amplify even the faintest of weather patterns, turning them into something extreme.
entries.translation: 那是起源之云搞的鬼——它似乎能放大最微弱的天气模式,把它们变成极端天气.
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat's the §dOrigin Cloud's §fdoing - it seems to amplify even the faintest of weather patterns, turning them into something §cextreme§f.

entries.source: Sunny and I have soared far and wide in my flying contraption in pursuit of documenting the Origin Cloud!
entries.translation: Sunny 和我乘坐我的飞行装置四处翱翔，只为记录起源之云！
entries.sampleRaw: §6Sunny §fand I have soared far and wide in my §5flying contraption §fin pursuit of documenting the §dOrigin Cloud§f!

entries.source: However, all it took was one rogue lightning bolt to send us crashing into this mountain.
entries.translation: 然而，仅仅一道失控的闪电就把我们击落，坠毁在这座山上。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHowever, all it took was one rogue §elightning §fbolt to send us crashing into this mountain.

entries.source: We're both fine, but it's going to take a while to fix up our ship, given that it's... well, embedded in the mountain.
entries.translation: 我们俩都没事，不过要修好我们的飞船还得花上一阵子，毕竟它……嗯，嵌在山里了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe're both fine, but it's going to take a while to fix up our ship, given that it's... well, §dembedded in the mountain§f.

entries.source: While we're busy dealing with that, feel free to stop by anytime.
entries.translation: 在我们忙着处理这件事的时候，你随时都可以过来看看。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhile we're busy dealing with that, feel free to stop by anytime.

entries.source: I'll happily show you everything I know about the weather of each SkyBlock island with you.
entries.translation: 我很乐意把我所知道的每个 SkyBlock 岛屿的天气情况都展示给你看。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'll happily show you everything I know about the §bweather §fof each §aSkyBlock §fisland with you.

entries.source: Here, why don't you take a look?
entries.translation: 来，你何不看看呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, why don't you take a look?

entries.source: ✆ Ah, the critically acclaimed Abiphone. The wonders of technology!
entries.translation: ✆ 啊，大名鼎鼎的 Abiphone。科技的奇迹！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAh, the critically acclaimed §9Abiphone§f. The wonders of technology!

entries.source: ✆ I wouldn't mind notifying you about the weather every now and then, but there's one issue...
entries.translation: ✆ 我不介意时不时地通知你天气情况，但有个问题……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI wouldn't mind notifying you about the §bweather §fevery now and then, but there's one issue...

entries.source: ✆ You see... I used to have this contraption that allowed me to control the weather...
entries.translation: ✆ 你看……我以前有个装置，能让我控制天气……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou see... I used to have this contraption that allowed me to §acontrol the weather§f...

entries.source: ✆ It resembled a Wand, but I doubt you'd go through the trouble of acquiring such a marvel of science.
entries.translation: ✆ 它看起来像一根法杖，不过我怀疑你不会费心去弄到这样一件科学奇迹。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIt resembled a §dWand§f, but I doubt you'd go through the trouble of acquiring such a marvel of science.

entries.source: ✆ My apologies, my friend, but you don't seem to have what I'm looking for.
entries.translation: ✆ 抱歉，我的朋友，但你似乎没有我要找的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMy apologies, my friend, but you don't seem to have what I'm looking for.

entries.source: ✆ You found it... The Weather Wand? This... This is perfect! I can't believe it!
entries.translation: ✆ 你找到了……天气法杖？这……这太完美了！我简直不敢相信！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou found it... The §aWeather Wand§f? This... This is perfect! I can't believe it!

entries.source: ✆ I can finally wield the power to control the weather once more!
entries.translation: ✆ 我终于又能掌握控制天气的力量了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI can finally wield the power to control the weather once more!

entries.source: ✆ Let's give it a test shall we?
entries.translation: ✆ 我们来测试一下吧，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLet's give it a test shall we?

entries.source: ✆ That's it? They don't make them like they used to.
entries.translation: ✆ 就这样？他们现在做的东西不如以前了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§oThat's it? §fThey don't make them like they used to.

entries.source: ✆ Oh well, a deal's a deal.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，一言为定。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOh well, a deal's a deal.

entries.source: ✆ Since we're buddy-buddy now, I'll grant you access to my Weather Alert System.
entries.translation: ✆ 既然我们现在是好朋友了，我就授予你访问我的天气预警系统的权限。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSince we're buddy-buddy now, I'll grant you access to my §6Weather Alert System§f.

entries.source: ✆ Once you've set it up, you'll automatically get a call from me when my systems detect your desired weather in your desired location!
entries.translation: ✆ 一旦你设置好，当我的系统在你想要的地点检测到你想要的天气时，你就会自动接到我的电话！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOnce you've set it up, you'll automatically get a call from me when my systems detect your desired §bweather §fin your desired §6location§f!

entries.source: ✆ If that sounds interesting, just come talk to me again to take a look!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果这听起来有意思，就再来找我谈谈看看吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf that sounds interesting, just come talk to me again to take a look!

entries.source: ✆ Hello! This is an automatic update brought to you by the Weather Alert System.
entries.translation: ✆ 你好！这是天气预警系统为你带来的自动更新。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHello! This is an automatic update brought to you by the §6Weather Alert System§f.

entries.source: ✆ Our systems have detected <weather> on the <island>.
entries.translation: ✆ 我们的系统在<island>检测到了<weather>。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOur systems have detected §7<weather> §fon the §7<island>§f.

entries.source: ✆ ... They have also detected <weather> on the <island>.
entries.translation: ✆ ……它们还在<island>检测到了<weather>。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f... They have also detected §7<weather> §fon the §7<island>§f.

entries.source: ✆ Did you see that storm last night? Thought my roof was going to collapse!
entries.translation: ✆ 你看到昨晚那场暴风雨了吗？我还以为我的屋顶要塌了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you see that storm last night? Thought my roof was going to collapse!

entries.source: ✆ Meow!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMeow!

entries.source: ✆ Oops, sorry about that! My kitty got to the phone before I could. How may I help?
entries.translation: ✆ 哎呀，抱歉！我的小猫抢在我前面接电话了。有什么可以帮你的？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOops, sorry about that! My kitty got to the phone before I could. How may I help?

entries.source: ✆ What can I help you with today?
entries.translation: ✆ 今天有什么可以帮你的？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWhat can I help you with today?

entries.source: Meow
entries.translation: 喵
entries.sampleRaw: §fMeow

entries.source: Ma mow
entries.translation: 喵呜
entries.sampleRaw: §fMa mow

entries.source: Mrrp
entries.translation: 呼噜
entries.sampleRaw: §fMrrp

entries.source: Oh...
entries.sampleRaw: Oh...

entries.source: I'm afraid crossing the portal would be a bit too dangerous for you.
entries.translation: 恐怕穿过传送门对你来说有点太危险了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm afraid crossing the portal would be a bit too §cdangerous §ffor you.

entries.source: Learn more about this world before thinking of visiting other dimensions!
entries.translation: 在想着去其他维度之前,先多了解一下这个世界吧!
entries.sampleRaw: Learn more about §othis §rworld before thinking of visiting §dother §fdimensions!

entries.source: Greetings, traveler!
entries.translation: 你好，旅行者！
entries.sampleRaw: Greetings, traveler!

entries.source: I can sense that you possess some magical prowess, and I find myself in need of assistance.
entries.translation: 我能感觉到你拥有一些魔法才能，而我正好需要帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: I can sense that you possess some §dmagical prowess§f, and I find myself in need of assistance.

entries.source: The matter at hand is rather complex, but I shall be brief.
entries.translation: 这件事相当复杂，但我会长话短说。
entries.sampleRaw: The matter at hand is rather complex, but I shall be brief.

entries.source: Are you interested in learning more?
entries.translation: 你有兴趣了解更多吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you interested in learning more?

entries.source: Very well, I shall seek help elsewhere!
entries.translation: 好吧，那我去别处寻求帮助！
entries.sampleRaw: Very well, I shall seek help elsewhere!

entries.source: Excellent!
entries.translation: 太好了！
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent!

entries.source: You see, long ago a breach materialized atop the Mountain.
entries.translation: 你看，很久以前，山峰顶上出现了一道裂隙。
entries.sampleRaw: You see, long ago a §5breach §fmaterialized atop the Mountain.

entries.source: Crossing through it is a daunting task, but not entirely impossible.
entries.translation: 穿过它是一项艰巨的任务，但并非完全不可能。
entries.sampleRaw: Crossing through §5it §fis a daunting task, but not entirely impossible.

entries.source: The problem is... those who ventured through... never returned.
entries.translation: 问题是……那些冒险穿过的人……再也没有回来。
entries.sampleRaw: The problem is... those who ventured through... never returned.

entries.source: I've dedicated much of my life to developing a portal that allows safe passage between our world and this mysterious dimension.
entries.translation: 我毕生大部分时间都在研发一座传送门,让我们能在我们的世界与这个神秘维度之间安全通行.
entries.sampleRaw: I've dedicated much of my life to developing a §dportal §rthat allows §asafe passage §rbetween our world and this mysterious dimension.

entries.source: Indeed!
entries.translation: 确实如此！
entries.sampleRaw: Indeed!

entries.source: With the invaluable help of my dear friend Barry, we managed to create a functioning portal.
entries.translation: 在我挚友 Barry 的宝贵帮助下，我们成功造出了一座可用的传送门。
entries.sampleRaw: With the invaluable help of my dear friend §9Barry§f, we managed to create a functioning §dportal§f.

entries.source: Barry tested it himself and successfully returned.
entries.translation: Barry 亲自测试了它，并成功返回。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Barry §ftested it himself and successfully returned.

entries.source: He now uh... "studies" the Rift across.
entries.translation: 他现在呃……在对面“研究”裂隙.
entries.sampleRaw: He now uh... §6§o"studies" §rthe §dRift §facross.

entries.source: According to the laws of causality, we must never meet, preventing me from crossing over.
entries.translation: 根据因果律，我们绝不能相见，这让我无法穿越过去。
entries.sampleRaw: According to the laws of causality, we must never meet, preventing me from crossing over.

entries.source: Imagine that! After devoting my life to this project, I cannot use it!
entries.translation: 想想看！我毕生投入这个项目，自己却不能用！
entries.sampleRaw: Imagine that! After devoting my life to this project, I cannot use it!

entries.source: Select an option: [Sounds bad. Why do you need me?]
entries.translation: 选择一个选项：[听起来不妙。你为什么需要我？]

styleMappings.[Sounds bad. Why do you need me?]: [听起来不妙。你为什么需要我？]

entries.sampleRaw: §eSelect an option: §a[Sounds bad. Why do you need me?]

entries.source: I have a reason to believe that a catastrophic event looms in our world's future.
entries.translation: 我有理由相信，一场灾难性事件正逼近我们世界的未来。
entries.sampleRaw: I have a reason to believe that a §4catastrophic event §flooms in our world's future.

entries.source: Unraveling the mysteries of the Rift could prove crucial to our survival.
entries.translation: 揭开裂隙的谜团对我们的生存至关重要。
entries.sampleRaw: Unraveling the mysteries of the §dRift §fcould prove crucial to our survival.

entries.source: We need all the help we can muster, and you appear to be quite talented.
entries.translation: 我们需要一切能召集到的帮助,而你看起来相当有才华.
entries.sampleRaw: We need all the help we can muster, and you appear to be §oquite talented§r.

entries.source: Splendid.
entries.translation: 好极了。
entries.sampleRaw: §oSplendid§r.

entries.source: All you need is a Dimensional Infusion...
entries.translation: 你只需要一份维度注入……
entries.sampleRaw: All you need is a §dDimensional Infusion§f...

entries.source: ... then you can safely travel across.
entries.translation: ……然后你就能安全穿越了。
entries.sampleRaw: ... then you can safely travel across.

entries.source: I can apply it to you every few hours, otherwise you will need to bring me enchanting orbs.
entries.translation: 我可以每隔几小时为你施加一次，否则你就得给我带附魔宝珠来。
entries.sampleRaw: I can apply it to you every few hours, otherwise you will need to bring me §benchanting orbs§f.

entries.source: Careful!
entries.translation: 小心！
entries.sampleRaw: Careful!

entries.source: You need a Dimensional Infusion before hopping in the portal.
entries.translation: 你需要一份维度灌注才能跳进传送门.

styleMappings.Dimensional Infusion before hopping in t: 维度灌注才能跳进传送门.

entries.sampleRaw: You need a §dDimensional Infusion before hopping in the portal.

entries.source: Come talk to me!
entries.translation: 来跟我谈谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Come talk to me!

entries.source: Hold up there!
entries.translation: 站住！
entries.sampleRaw: Hold up there!

entries.source: You might explode in a million pieces if you go through the portal.
entries.translation: 如果你穿过传送门，可能会炸成一百万块碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: You might §cexplode §fin a million pieces if you go through the portal.

entries.source: Come talk to me first!
entries.translation: 先来跟我谈谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Come talk to me first!

entries.source: If you want to safely travel through the portal, you need a Dimensional Infusion.
entries.translation: 如果你想安全地穿过传送门，你需要一份维度灌注。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to §asafely §ftravel through the portal, you need a §dDimensional Infusion§f.

entries.source: Jump in the portal now!
entries.translation: 现在跳进传送门吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Jump in the portal now!

entries.source: You can jump into the portal now.
entries.translation: 你现在可以跳进传送门了。
entries.sampleRaw: You can jump into the portal now.

entries.source: Be careful, you might be surprised what's on the other side!
entries.translation: 小心点，另一边的景象可能会让你大吃一惊！
entries.sampleRaw: Be careful, you might be surprised what's on the other side!

entries.source: You should be able to jump into the portal now.
entries.translation: 你现在应该可以跳进传送门了。
entries.sampleRaw: You should be able to jump into the portal now.

entries.source: Most people survive it!
entries.translation: 大多数人活下来了！
entries.sampleRaw: §oMost §rpeople survive it!

entries.source: Good lord.
entries.translation: 我的天哪。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fGood lord.

entries.source: I came right as I heard the rumbling.
entries.translation: 我一听到轰隆声就赶来了。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI came right as I heard the rumbling.

entries.source: Did you just... fix the breach?
entries.translation: 你刚刚……修复了裂隙？
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fDid you just... §5§ofix the breach§f?

entries.source: I cannot thank you enough.
entries.translation: 我对你感激不尽。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI cannot thank you enough.

entries.source: Here is a token of my gratitude for your actions.
entries.translation: 这是我为你的行动献上的一点谢意。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fHere is a token of my gratitude for your actions.

entries.source: In addition to my other pursuits, I engage in novel writing during my leisure.
entries.translation: 除了其他事务之外，我闲暇时还会写小说。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fIn addition to my other pursuits, I engage in novel writing during my leisure.

entries.source: I've composed a fictional narrative about an adventurer who ventures into the Rift and conquers it.
entries.translation: 我写了一部虚构故事，讲述一位冒险者闯入裂隙并征服了它。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI've composed a fictional narrative about an adventurer who ventures into the Rift and conquers it.

entries.source: While it's yet unpublished, I believe it would be fitting for you to have its cover.
entries.translation: 虽然它尚未出版，但我认为把它的封面送给你很合适。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fWhile it's yet unpublished, I believe it would be fitting for you to have its cover.

entries.source: Now then, time is of the essence.
entries.translation: 那么，时间紧迫。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fNow then, time is of the essence.

entries.source: I must study this new breach.
entries.translation: 我必须研究这道新的裂隙。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI must study this new breach.

entries.source: Because of your help inside the Rift, once I am done, I will let you use my services for free.
entries.translation: 因为你在裂隙中的帮助，等我完成后，我会让你免费使用我的服务。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fBecause of your help inside the §dRift§f, once I am done, I will let you use my services for §cfree§f.

entries.source: Please return in 3-5 business days!
entries.translation: 请在 3-5 个工作日后回来!
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fPlease return in §a3-5 business days§f!
entries.numericSource: Please return in {{N0}}-{{N1}} business days!
entries.numericTranslation: 请在 {{N0}}-{{N1}} 个工作日后回来!

entries.source: Our knowledge of that era is minimal.
entries.translation: 我们对那个时代的了解极少。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fOur knowledge of that era is minimal.

entries.source: But such an aura...
entries.translation: 但这样的气息……
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fBut such an aura...

entries.source: I fear that even if I manage to open the breach, venturing through it would be a grave mistake.
entries.translation: 我担心即使我设法打开了裂隙，穿过去也会是个严重的错误。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI fear that even if I manage to open the breach, venturing through it would be a grave mistake.

entries.source: I can tell this is the Era of Kaeman, when he was at the zenith of his power.
entries.translation: 我能看出这是凯曼的时代，那时他正处于权力的巅峰。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI can tell this is the Era of Kaeman, when he was at the zenith of his power.

entries.source: I am now almost certain that the Breach leads to the Past.
entries.translation: 我现在几乎可以肯定，这道裂隙通向过去。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI am now almost certain that the Breach leads to the Past.

entries.source: But to which point in time...?
entries.translation: 但究竟是哪个时间点……？
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fBut to which point in time...?

entries.source: I must ascertain the answer!
entries.translation: 我必须查明答案！
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI must ascertain the answer!

entries.source: I believe this breach was created by Jythar during the Calamity.
entries.translation: 我相信这道裂隙是吉萨在灾厄期间创造的。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI believe this breach was created by Jythar during the Calamity.

entries.source: However, I doubt it will permit us to travel that far back.
entries.translation: 不过，我怀疑它不会允许我们回溯到那么久远。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fHowever, I doubt it will permit us to travel that far back.

entries.source: I suspect someone is altering its destination.
entries.translation: 我怀疑有人在篡改它的目的地。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI suspect someone is altering its destination.

entries.source: I am making progress.
entries.translation: 我正取得进展。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI am making progress.

entries.source: I can now sense a great and formidable evil lurking beyond these threads of time.
entries.translation: 我现在能感应到一股强大而可怖的邪恶潜伏在这些时间之线之外。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI can now sense a great and formidable evil lurking beyond these threads of time.

entries.source: It appears someone else is already utilizing the breach.
entries.translation: 看来已经有人在利用这道裂隙了。
entries.sampleRaw: It appears someone else is already utilizing the breach.

entries.source: I know not who they are, but their understanding exceeds mine!
entries.translation: 我不知道他们是谁，但他们的理解力胜过我！
entries.sampleRaw: I know not who they are, but their understanding exceeds mine!

entries.source: There is certainly something quite...spooky...in the air!
entries.translation: 空气中确实弥漫着某种相当……诡异……的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: There is certainly something quite...spooky...in the air!

entries.source: Where am I? Oh, it's you [player].
entries.translation: 我在哪儿?哦,是你啊 [player].
entries.sampleRaw: Where am I? Oh, it's you §7[player]§f.

entries.source: Thank you. This should be enough potatoes to generate about # volts. Might be just enough to cause a reaction.
entries.translation: 谢谢你。这些马铃薯应该足以产生约 # 伏特。也许刚好足以引发反应。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you. This should be enough potatoes to generate about §b#§f volts. Might be just enough to cause a reaction.

entries.source: I suppose that was expected. Not many people have enough potatoes to power a magical portal.
entries.translation: 我想这也是意料之中。没多少人拥有足够的马铃薯来驱动一座魔法传送门。
entries.sampleRaw: I suppose that was expected. Not many people have enough potatoes to power a magical portal.

entries.translation: 嗯……似乎有什么东西坏了。给我 3-5 个工作日来修复！
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm...something appears to be broken. Give me 3-5 business days to fix!

entries.translation: 嗯……似乎有什么东西坏了。给我大约 24 个工作小时来修复！

entries.source: Oh. That's at least 4 business days.
entries.translation: 哦。那至少得 4 个工作日。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh. That's at least 4 business days.
entries.numericSource: Oh. That's at least {{N0}} business days.
entries.numericTranslation: 哦。那至少得 {{N0}} 个工作日。

entries.source: Time really flies!
entries.translation: 时间过得真快！
entries.sampleRaw: Time really flies!

entries.source: If only Barry had been helping instead of engaging in a popularity contest...
entries.translation: 要是 Barry 当时在帮忙，而不是去参加人气竞赛就好了……
entries.sampleRaw: If only §9Barry §fhad been helping instead of engaging in a popularity contest...

entries.source: Chasing clout? It's chasing clouds!
entries.translation: 追逐名气？那是在追逐云朵！
entries.sampleRaw: Chasing §eclout§f? It's chasing §bclouds§f!

entries.source: Anyway, he seems to be hard at work now.
entries.translation: 总之，他现在似乎正埋头苦干。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway, he seems to be hard at work now.

entries.source: Check back later to use the Portal...it seems to be broken. :(
entries.translation: 稍后再来使用传送门……它似乎坏了。:(
entries.sampleRaw: Check back later to use the Portal...it seems to be broken. :(

entries.source: My Portal seems to be broken, [player]!
entries.translation: 我的传送门似乎坏了,[player]!
entries.sampleRaw: My Portal seems to be broken, §7[player]!

entries.source: Check back later...magic awaits!
entries.translation: 稍后再来看看……魔法在等着你！
entries.sampleRaw: Check back later...magic awaits!

entries.source: The Portal hasn't worked since...I don't want to talk about it.
entries.translation: 传送门从那以后就再没运作过……我不想谈这件事。
entries.sampleRaw: The Portal hasn't worked since...I don't want to talk about it.

entries.source: Attempt number # of trying to fix the portal failed and I ended up here. Maybe it needs just a little more power...perhaps a battery made of potatoes?
entries.translation: 第 # 次尝试修复传送门失败了，我最后到了这里。也许它还需要多一点能量……比如一块马铃薯做的电池？
entries.sampleRaw: Attempt number §b#§f of trying to fix the portal failed and I ended up here. Maybe it needs just a little more power...perhaps a battery made of potatoes?

entries.source: Hey, welcome back to Hypixel SkyBlock!
entries.translation: 嘿，欢迎回到 Hypixel SkyBlock！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey, welcome back to §6Hypixel SkyBlock§f!

entries.source: While you were gone, I prepared a small gift for you.
entries.translation: 你不在的时候，我为你准备了一份小礼物。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhile you were gone, I prepared a small gift for you.

entries.source: Hope to see you around!
entries.translation: 希望还能再见到你！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHope to see you around!

entries.source: Hey, you're a familiar face!
entries.translation: 嘿，你看起来好面熟！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey, you're a familiar face!

entries.source: I don't have any Returning Player Rewards for you right now. Thanks for playing SkyBlock!
entries.translation: 我现在没有给你的回归玩家奖励。感谢你游玩 SkyBlock！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI don't have any Returning Player Rewards for you right now. Thanks for playing SkyBlock!

entries.source: Apparently dying didn't void my employment contract so I'm still working my 9-5...
entries.translation: 显然死亡并没有让我的雇佣合同失效，所以我还在干我的 9-5……
entries.sampleRaw: Apparently dying didn't void my employment contract so I'm still working my 9-5...
entries.numericSource: Apparently dying didn't void my employment contract so I'm still working my {{N0}}-{{N1}}...
entries.numericTranslation: 显然死亡并没有让我的雇佣合同失效，所以我还在干我的 {{N0}}-{{N1}}……

entries.source: I'm gonna need some exotic materials for an armor set I'm making a client.
entries.translation: 我需要一些异域材料，用来给一位客户做一套盔甲。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm gonna need some exotic materials for an armor set I'm making a client.

entries.source: Thanks! I'm planning on making a Turtle Helmet, and this seemed easier than mass-breeding Turtles on a beach for their scutes.
entries.translation: 谢谢！我打算做一顶海龟头盔，这似乎比在海滩上大量繁殖海龟来获取它们的鳞甲要容易些。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks! I'm planning on making a Turtle Helmet, and this seemed easier than mass-breeding Turtles on a beach for their scutes.

entries.source: Well, thanks anyways.
entries.translation: 好吧，还是谢谢你。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, thanks anyways.

entries.source: I need something to pass the time while I wait to be reincarnated.
entries.translation: 在等待转世的时候，我需要点东西来打发时间。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI need something to pass the time while I wait to be reincarnated.

entries.source: Well hopefully I can't bore myself to death given the fact I'm already dead!
entries.translation: 好吧，希望我不会无聊到死，毕竟我已经死了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell hopefully I can't bore myself to death given the fact I'm already dead!

entries.source: Even in death I am obsessed with the prospect of something that just keeps growing, and growing, and growing.
entries.translation: 即使死了，我也痴迷于那种不断生长、生长、再生长的事物。
entries.sampleRaw: Even in death I am obsessed with the prospect of something that just keeps growing, and growing, and growing.

entries.source: These look promising, thanks!
entries.translation: 这些看起来很有希望，谢谢！
entries.sampleRaw: These look promising, thanks!

entries.source: Curse your investments!
entries.translation: 诅咒你的投资！
entries.sampleRaw: Curse your investments!

entries.source: Now that I'm dead I have more time than ever to do some baking!
entries.translation: 现在我死了，反而比以往有更多时间来做烘焙！
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fNow that I'm dead I have more time than ever to do some baking!

entries.source: It's scary how good my cookies are going to be with these, thanks!
entries.translation: 用这些做出来的曲奇会好吃得吓人，谢谢！
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fIt's §oscary§f how good my cookies are going to be with these, thanks!

entries.source: Hey you! I broke my Lapis Pickaxe - do you think you could bring me another?
entries.translation: 嘿，你！我把我的青金石镐弄坏了——你能再给我带一把吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey you! I broke my §aLapis Pickaxe §f- do you think you could bring me another?

entries.source: First you'll need to reach Lapis Lazuli Collection III, and then you can craft it for me.
entries.translation: 首先你需要达到青金石收藏 III，然后就能为我制作它了。
entries.sampleRaw: First you'll need to reach §aLapis Lazuli Collection III§f, and then you can craft it for me.

entries.source: Some items in SkyBlock can only be crafted when you reach a certain collection requirement.
entries.translation: SkyBlock 中的某些物品只有在达到特定收藏要求后才能制作。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSome items in SkyBlock can only be crafted when you reach a certain collection requirement.

entries.source: To craft me a Lapis Pickaxe, you will need to reach Lapis Lazuli Collection III.
entries.translation: 要为我制作一把青金石镐，你需要达到青金石收藏 III。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTo craft me a §aLapis Pickaxe§f, you will need to reach §aLapis Lazuli Collection III§f.

entries.source: Oh! You reached Lapis Lazuli Collection III!
entries.translation: 哦！你达到了青金石收藏 III！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh! You reached §aLapis Lazuli Collection III§f!

entries.source: Any chance you can craft me a new Lapis Pickaxe now?
entries.translation: 你现在能为我制作一把新的青金石镐吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Any chance you can craft me a new §aLapis Pickaxe §fnow?

entries.source: Check the Recipe Book in your SkyBlock Menu to learn how to craft it!
entries.translation: 查看 SkyBlock 菜单中的配方书，了解如何制作它！
entries.sampleRaw: Check the §aRecipe Book §fin your §aSkyBlock Menu §fto learn how to craft it!

entries.source: Thank you! I appreciate your support in these trying times.
entries.translation: 谢谢你！感谢你在这艰难时期的支持。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you! I appreciate your support in these trying times.

entries.source: For your trouble, here's a Compactor. Place it in a minion upgrade slot and it will automatically turn items into their block form once it's collected enough of them!
entries.translation: 为了感谢你的帮助，这个压缩器给你。把它放进仆从的升级槽，一旦收集到足够多的物品，它就会自动把物品转换成方块形态！
entries.sampleRaw: For your trouble, here's a §aCompactor§f. Place it in a minion upgrade slot and it will automatically turn items into their block form once it's collected enough of them!

entries.source: I use it in my Lapis Minion, those things fill terribly fast!
entries.translation: 我在我的青金石仆从里用了它，那些东西装满得特别快！
entries.sampleRaw: I use it in my Lapis Minion, those things fill terribly fast!

entries.source: My Lapis Pickaxe might not mine the fastest, but it gives me a lot of experience!
entries.translation: 我的青金石镐也许不是挖得最快的，但它能给我大量经验！
entries.sampleRaw: My §aLapis Pickaxe §fmight not mine the fastest, but it gives me a lot of experience!

entries.source: I use that experience to enchant my Lapis Pickaxe with efficiency, which makes it mine faster!
entries.translation: 我用那些经验给我的青金石镐附上效率，这让它挖得更快！
entries.sampleRaw: I use that experience to enchant my §aLapis Pickaxe §fwith efficiency, which makes it mine faster!

entries.source: How cool is that?
entries.translation: 是不是很酷？
entries.sampleRaw: How cool is that?

entries.source: Wow, I just love snow.
entries.translation: 哇，我就是喜欢雪。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, I just love snow.

entries.source: I love it so much that I bought an industrial strength snow machine so that I can have snow on demand!
entries.translation: 我太喜欢雪了，所以买了一台工业级造雪机，这样就能随时要雪有雪！
entries.sampleRaw: I love it so much that I bought an industrial strength snow machine so that I can have snow on demand!

entries.source: What are you talking to me for? The village needs your help!
entries.translation: 你跟我说话干什么？村庄需要你的帮助！
entries.sampleRaw: What are you talking to me for? The village needs your help!

entries.source: I finally got my snow machine to work!
entries.translation: 我终于让我的造雪机运转起来了！
entries.sampleRaw: I finally got my snow machine to work!

entries.source: This snow should put a damper on those Magma Cubes! You can thank me later!
entries.translation: 这些雪应该能压一压那些岩浆怪！你以后可以谢我！
entries.sampleRaw: This snow should put a damper on those Magma Cubes! You can thank me later!

entries.source: While I love the cold, I can no longer feel my fingers.
entries.translation: 虽然我喜欢寒冷，但我已经感觉不到自己的手指了。
entries.sampleRaw: While I love the cold, I can no longer feel my fingers.

entries.source: Ooh yes! I can make some hot chocolate with this!
entries.translation: 哦对！我可以用这个做点热巧克力！
entries.sampleRaw: Ooh yes! I can make some hot chocolate with this!

entries.source: No sense of festive spirit in you, is there?
entries.translation: 你一点节日气氛都没有，是吧？
entries.sampleRaw: No sense of festive spirit in you, is there?

entries.source: It's me, Gary.
entries.translation: 是我，Gary。
entries.sampleRaw: It's me, Gary.

entries.source: If you want to support us, head over to the Hypixel Store at store.hypixel.net
entries.translation: 如果你想支持我们，请前往 Hypixel 商店：store.hypixel.net
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to support us, head over to the Hypixel Store at §bstore.hypixel.net

entries.source: Did you know that SkyBlock has been running for [number] in-game months already? Time flies.
entries.translation: 你知道吗，SkyBlock 已经运行了 [number] 个游戏内月份了？时间过得真快。
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know that SkyBlock has been running for §b[number]§f in-game months already? Time flies.

entries.source: See you around!
entries.translation: 回头见！
entries.sampleRaw: See you around!

entries.source: I guess I'll come back in a bit.
entries.translation: 我想我过一会儿再回来。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I'll come back in a bit.

entries.source: You might have noticed that you can purchase additional plots within your Desk in the Barn!
entries.translation: 你可能已经注意到，你可以在农庄里的书桌中购买额外的地块！
entries.sampleRaw: You might have noticed that you can purchase additional plots within your Desk in the Barn!

entries.source: Thank you! Until next time!
entries.translation: 谢谢你！下次见！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you! Until next time!

entries.source: No worries.
entries.translation: 没关系。
entries.sampleRaw: No worries.

entries.source: I don't have a recipe for you, however I'd happily take some crops.
entries.translation: 我没有配方给你，不过我很乐意收一些作物。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't have a recipe for you, however I'd happily take some crops.

entries.source: I'll be sure to come by next time.
entries.translation: 我下次一定会再来。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll be sure to come by next time.

entries.source: No problem, see ya next time!
entries.translation: 没问题，下次见！
entries.sampleRaw: No problem, see ya next time!

entries.source: Until next time!
entries.translation: 下次见！
entries.sampleRaw: Until next time!

entries.source: You seem new here. You should probably try to get some [crop] for me.
entries.translation: 你看起来是新手。你也许该试着给我弄点 [crop]。
entries.sampleRaw: You seem new here. You should probably try to get some [crop] for me.

entries.source: Maybe next time.
entries.translation: 也许下次吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe next time.

entries.source: If you ever get lost, you should check on the Desk on what to do next.
entries.translation: 如果你迷路了，应该查看书桌，看看接下来该做什么。
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever get lost, you should check on the Desk on what to do next.

entries.source: Have a good one.
entries.translation: 祝你愉快。
entries.sampleRaw: Have a good one.

entries.source: Maybe next time.
entries.translation: 也许下次吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe next time.

entries.source: The amount of plots you can unlock here is perfect for a Co-op. So much space!
entries.translation: 你在这里能解锁的地块数量非常适合合作档。空间真大！
entries.sampleRaw: The amount of plots you can unlock here is perfect for a Co-op. So much space!

entries.source: Good choice!
entries.translation: 好选择！
entries.sampleRaw: Good choice!

entries.source: Don't worry, I'll come back later.
entries.translation: 别担心，我晚点再来。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't worry, I'll come back later.

entries.source: I have an offer for you that you can't refuse.
entries.translation: 我有一个你无法拒绝的提议。
entries.sampleRaw: I have an offer for you that you can't refuse.

entries.source: Told you.
entries.translation: 早就告诉过你了。
entries.sampleRaw: Told you.

entries.source: Oh well that's awkward.
entries.translation: 唉，那就尴尬了。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh well that's awkward.

entries.source: One day you'll be able to buy the sun, trust me on that mate.
entries.translation: 总有一天你能买下太阳，相信我，伙计。
entries.sampleRaw: One day you'll be able to buy the sun, trust me on that mate.

entries.source: That makes me feel better.
entries.translation: 这让我感觉好多了。
entries.sampleRaw: That makes me feel better.

entries.source: Alright...
entries.translation: 好吧……
entries.sampleRaw: Alright...

entries.source: This game is still under heavy development, don't forget to check the forums often for updates!/[NPC] Andrew: If you'd like to discuss SkyBlock with other players then check out the SkyBlock section of the forums!
entries.translation: 这款游戏仍在大力开发中，别忘了经常查看论坛以获取更新！/[NPC] Andrew：如果你想和其他玩家讨论 SkyBlock，那就去看看论坛的 SkyBlock 版块吧！
entries.sampleRaw: This game is still under heavy development, don't forget to check the §aforums§f often for updates!/§e[NPC] Andrew§f: If you'd like to discuss SkyBlock with other players then check out the SkyBlock section of the §aforums§f!

entries.source: Your SkyBlock Profile in your SkyBlock Menu shows details about your current stats!/[NPC] Jack: There are 7 stats in total, including ❤ Health, ❁ Strength, and ❈ Defense./[NPC] Jack: Equipped armor, weapons, and accessories in your inventory all improve your stats./[NPC] Jack: Additionally, leveling your Skills can permanently boost some of your stats!/[NPC] Jack: The higher your ❤ Health stat, the faster your health will regenerate!
entries.translation: 你 SkyBlock 菜单中的 SkyBlock 档案会显示你当前属性的详细信息！/[NPC] Jack：总共有 7 项属性，包括 ❤ 生命值、❁ 力量和 ❈ 防御力。/[NPC] Jack：你物品栏中装备的护甲、武器和饰品都会提升你的属性。/[NPC] Jack：此外，提升你的技能等级还能永久增强你的部分属性！/[NPC] Jack：你的 ❤ 生命值属性越高，生命恢复速度就越快！
entries.sampleRaw: Your §aSkyBlock Profile§f in your §aSkyBlock Menu§f shows details about your current stats!/§e[NPC] Jack§f: There are 7 stats in total, including §c❤ Health§f, §c❁ Strength§f, and §a❈ Defense§f./§e[NPC] Jack§f: Equipped armor, weapons, and accessories in your inventory all improve your stats./§e[NPC] Jack§f: Additionally, leveling your Skills can permanently boost some of your stats!/§e[NPC] Jack§f: The higher your §c❤ Health§f stat, the faster your health will regenerate!

entries.source: You might have noticed that you have a Mana bar!/[NPC] Jamie: Some items have mysterious properties, called Abilities./[NPC] Jamie: Abilities use your Mana as a resource. Here, take this Rogue Sword. I don't need it!
entries.translation: 你可能已经注意到你有一条法力条！/[NPC] Jamie：有些物品拥有神秘的特性，称为能力。/[NPC] Jamie：能力会消耗你的法力作为资源。来，拿着这把游侠剑。我用不着它！
entries.sampleRaw: You might have noticed that you have a Mana bar!/§e[NPC] Jamie§f: Some items have mysterious properties, called Abilities./§e[NPC] Jamie§f: Abilities use your Mana as a resource. Here, take this Rogue Sword. I don't need it!

entries.source: I will teach you the Promising Axe Recipe to get you started!/[NPC] Tom: All SkyBlock recipes can be found by opening the Recipe Book in your SkyBlock Menu.
entries.translation: 我会教你潜力斧配方，帮你入门！/[NPC] Tom：所有 SkyBlock 配方都可以通过打开 SkyBlock 菜单中的配方书找到。
entries.sampleRaw: I will teach you the §aPromising Axe Recipe§f to get you started!/§e[NPC] Tom§f: All SkyBlock recipes can be found by opening the §aRecipe Book §fin your §aSkyBlock Menu§f.

entries.source: You can unlock Leaflet Armor by progressing through your Oak Log Collection./[NPC] Leo: There is a Forest west of the Village where you can gather Oak Logs./[NPC] Leo: To check your Collection progress and rewards, open the Collection Menu in your SkyBlock Menu.
entries.translation: 你可以通过推进橡木原木收藏来解锁传单护甲。/[NPC] Leo：村庄西边有一片森林，你可以在那里采集橡木原木。/[NPC] Leo：要查看你的收藏进度和奖励，请打开 SkyBlock 菜单中的收藏菜单。
entries.sampleRaw: You can unlock §aLeaflet Armor§f by progressing through your §aOak Log Collection§f./§e[NPC] Leo§f: There is a §bForest§f west of the §bVillage§f where you can gather Oak Logs./§e[NPC] Leo§f: To check your Collection progress and rewards, open the §aCollection Menu§f in your §aSkyBlock Menu§f.

entries.source: You can access your Ender Chest in your SkyBlock Menu./[NPC] Felix: Store items in this chest and access them at any time!
entries.translation: 你可以在 SkyBlock 菜单中访问你的末影箱。/[NPC] Felix：把物品存放在这个箱子里，随时都能取用！
entries.sampleRaw: You can access your §aEnder Chest§f in your §aSkyBlock Menu§f./§e[NPC] Felix§f: Store items in this chest and access them at any time!

entries.source: Are you new here? As you can see there is a lot to explore!/[NPC] Duke: My advice is to start by visiting the Farm, or the Coal Mine both North of here./[NPC] Duke: If you do need some wood, the best place to get some is West of the Village!
entries.translation: 你是新来的吗？如你所见，这里有很多东西可以探索！/[NPC] Duke：我的建议是先去看看农场，或者北边的煤矿。/[NPC] Duke：如果你确实需要一些木头，最好的采集地点是村庄西边！
entries.sampleRaw: Are you new here? As you can see there is a lot to explore!/§e[NPC] Duke§f: My advice is to start by visiting the §bFarm§f, or the §bCoal Mine§f both North of here./§e[NPC] Duke§f: If you do need some wood, the best place to get some is West of the §bVillage§f!

entries.source: If you ever get lost during a quest, open your Quest Log in your SkyBlock Menu!
entries.translation: 如果你在任务中迷路了，就打开 SkyBlock 菜单中的任务日志！
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever get lost during a quest, open your §bQuest Log§f in your §aSkyBlock Menu§f!

entries.source: At any time you can create a Co-op with your friends!/[NPC] Stella: Simply go in your SkyBlock Menu where you can find the Profile Menu./[NPC] Stella: This is where you can create, delete or switch SkyBlock Profiles./[NPC] Stella: Enter /coop followed by the name of all the friends you want to invite!/[NPC] Stella: All your friends have to be online to accept!
entries.translation: 你随时都可以和朋友们创建合作档！/[NPC] Stella：只需进入 SkyBlock 菜单，就能找到档案菜单。/[NPC] Stella：你可以在这里创建、删除或切换 SkyBlock 档案。/[NPC] Stella：输入 /coop，后面跟上你想邀请的所有好友的名字！/[NPC] Stella：所有好友都必须在线才能接受！
entries.sampleRaw: At any time you can create a Co-op with your friends!/§e[NPC] Stella§f: Simply go in your §aSkyBlock Menu§f where you can find the §aProfile Menu§f./§e[NPC] Stella§f: This is where you can create, delete or switch SkyBlock Profiles./§e[NPC] Stella§f: Enter §b/coop§f followed by the name of all the friends you want to invite!/§e[NPC] Stella§f: All your friends have to be online to accept!

entries.source: You can shift click any player to trade with them!/[NPC] Vex: Once both players are ready to trade, click on Accept trade&!/[NPC] Vex: Make sure you don't give away all of your belongings!
entries.translation: 你可以按住 Shift 点击任意玩家与他们交易!/[NPC] Vex:当双方都准备好交易后,点击接受交易&!/[NPC] Vex:注意别把你的全部家当都送出去了!

styleMappings.: Once both players are ready to trade,: :当双方都准备好交易后,点击
styleMappings.: Make sure you don't give away all of y: :注意别把你的全部家当都送出去了!

entries.sampleRaw: You can shift click any player to trade with them!/§e[NPC] Vex§f: Once both players are ready to trade, click on §aAccept trade&!/§e[NPC] Vex§f: Make sure you don't give away all of your belongings!

entries.source: Shift then click on me to Trade!
entries.translation: 按住 Shift 再点击我即可交易！
entries.sampleRaw: Shift then click on me to Trade!

entries.source: You can disable Player Trading your SkyBlock Settings!/[NPC] Vex: Your settings can found in the SkyBlock Menu.
entries.translation: 你可以在 SkyBlock 设置中禁用玩家交易！/[NPC] Vex：你的设置可以在 SkyBlock 菜单中找到。
entries.sampleRaw: You can disable Player Trading your §bSkyBlock§f Settings!/§e[NPC] Vex§f: Your settings can found in the §aSkyBlock Menu§f.

entries.source: One day those houses in the Village will be rentable for Coins!/[NPC] Liam: Anyone will be able to rent them, players, co-ops, even Guilds!
entries.translation: 总有一天，村庄里的那些房子可以用硬币租下来！/[NPC] Liam：任何人都能租，玩家、合作档，甚至公会！
entries.sampleRaw: One day those houses in the Village will be rentable for Coins!/§e[NPC] Liam§f: Anyone will be able to rent them, players, co-ops, even Guilds!

entries.source: Water troubles? No problem!
entries.translation: 水管出问题了？没问题！
entries.sampleRaw: Water troubles? No problem!

entries.source: I once dumped a magical water bucket into the toilet. It won't stop overflowing. Anyway, you got something for me?
entries.translation: 我曾经把一桶魔法水倒进了马桶。它就一直溢个不停。总之，你有东西要给我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I once dumped a magical water bucket into the toilet. It won't stop overflowing. Anyway, you got something for me?

entries.source: Thanks. That should help me fix my water troubles.
entries.translation: 谢谢。这应该能帮我解决水管问题。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks. That should help me fix my water troubles.

entries.source: I guess I'll just try to fix it myself.
entries.translation: 我想我还是自己试着修吧。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I'll just try to fix it myself.

entries.source: ✆ My abiphone? You got it!
entries.translation: ✆ 我的 Abiphone？没问题！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMy abiphone? You got it!

entries.source: ✆ Call me during business hours and I'll help with your water troubles at a discount!
entries.translation: ✆ 在营业时间给我打电话，我会以折扣价帮你解决水管问题！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCall me during business hours and I'll help with your water troubles at a discount!

entries.source: Water troubles? You know I'm on it!
entries.translation: 水管出问题了？你知道我会搞定的！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWater troubles? You know I'm on it!

entries.source: ✆ Please only call me during business hours.
entries.translation: ✆ 请只在营业时间给我打电话。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fPlease only call me during business hours.

entries.source: ✆ If there's really an emergency, come and see me!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果真有紧急情况，就来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf there's really an emergency, come and see me!

entries.source: Hey Feller!
entries.translation: 嘿，伙计！
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey Feller!

entries.source: I control this lift here behind me.
entries.translation: 我操控着我身后的这台升降机。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI control this lift here behind me.

entries.source: Once you've explored an area I can give you a safe ride back there.
entries.translation: 一旦你探索过某个区域，我就能安全地把你送回去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOnce you've explored an area I can give you a safe ride back there.

entries.source: Be careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down!
entries.translation: 不过要小心别掉进竖井里，那下面可深得很！
entries.sampleRaw: §fBe careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down!

entries.source: Good luck on your adventures!
entries.translation: 祝你的冒险好运！
entries.sampleRaw: §fGood luck on your adventures!

entries.source: Venture down into the Lapis Quarry to unlock my Lift Menu!
entries.translation: 深入青金石采石场，即可解锁我的升降机菜单！
entries.sampleRaw: Venture down into the Lapis Quarry to unlock my Lift Menu!

entries.source: That is too deep, traveler!
entries.translation: 那太深了，旅行者！
entries.sampleRaw: That is too deep, traveler!

entries.source: For that you require Heart of the Mountain.
entries.translation: 为此你需要山峰之心。
entries.sampleRaw: For that you require Heart of the Mountain.

entries.source: Talk to Rhys, the Dwarven Emissary.
entries.translation: 去和矮人使者 Rhys 谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to Rhys, the Dwarven Emissary.

entries.source: Operating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?
entries.translation: 整天操作那台升降机可真是累人，你知道吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Operating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?

entries.source: Cheers, that's the stuff!
entries.translation: 谢啦，就是这个味儿！
entries.sampleRaw: Cheers, that's the stuff!

entries.source: Back to the mines I go...
entries.translation: 我又要回矿里去了……
entries.sampleRaw: Back to the mines I go...

entries.source: Oi, get back in line!
entries.translation: 喂，回去排队！
entries.sampleRaw: Oi, get back in line!

entries.source: You are [player] right?
entries.translation: 你是 [player]，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: You are §7[player] §fright?

entries.source: If you want a Dragon Shortbow I'll give you one for free!
entries.translation: 如果你想要一把龙短弓，我可以免费送你一把！
entries.sampleRaw: If you want a §5Dragon Shortbow §fI'll give you one for free!

entries.source: Deep in these caves lays the nest of the Dragons, where you will find only peril.
entries.translation: 这些洞穴深处是巨龙的巢穴，在那里你只会遇到危险。
entries.sampleRaw: Deep in these caves lays the nest of the §5Dragons§f, where you will find only peril.

entries.source: But you should try to find it anyway.
entries.translation: 但你还是应该试着找到它。
entries.sampleRaw: But you should try to find it anyway.

entries.source: My old buddy was a Wart Dealer...I miss him, and his Wart.
entries.translation: 我的老伙计曾是个疣商……我想念他，还有他的疣。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy old buddy was a Wart Dealer...I miss him, and his Wart.

entries.source: I'm glad that you're keeping him in your memories.
entries.translation: 我很高兴你把他留在记忆里。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm glad that you're keeping him in your memories.

entries.source: His memory will soon be lost, like tears in rain.
entries.translation: 他的记忆很快就会消逝，如同雨中的泪水。
entries.sampleRaw: His memory will soon be lost, like tears in rain.

entries.source: Hmm, you're not quite ready yet.
entries.translation: 嗯，你还没完全准备好。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm, you're not quite ready yet.

entries.source: Go talk to the Fishing Merchant in the Fishing Outpost, get geared up, and get fishin'!
entries.translation: 去钓鱼前哨找Fishing Merchant谈谈，整装待发，然后开始钓鱼吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §fGo talk to the §bFishing Merchant §fin the §bFishing Outpost§f, get geared up, and get fishin'!

entries.source: Come back once you've reached Fishing Skill V and I'll tell you how you can get to a new island!
entries.translation: 等你达到钓鱼技能 V 后再回来，我会告诉你如何前往一座新岛屿！
entries.sampleRaw: §fCome back once you've reached §aFishing Skill V §fand I'll tell you how you can get to a §anew island§f!

entries.source: Keep the noise down, kid!
entries.translation: 小声点，孩子！
entries.sampleRaw: Keep the noise down, kid!

entries.source: If you want to learn about Fishing, go talk to my wife, Fisherwoman Enid.
entries.translation: 如果你想学习钓鱼，去找我妻子，渔妇 Enid 谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to learn about §aFishing§f, go talk to my wife, §9Fisherwoman Enid§f.

entries.source: She's fishing a bit upstream. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
entries.translation: 她在上游一点的地方钓鱼。等她教会你基本技巧后，回来找我谈谈！
entries.sampleRaw: She's fishing a bit §bupstream§f. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!

entries.source: Hey there buddy, think you can help me out?
entries.translation: 嘿，伙计，你能帮我个忙吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey there buddy, think you can help me out?

entries.source: My buddy, Captain Baha, and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the Backwater Bayou.
entries.translation: 我和我的伙计 Captain Baha 差不多快造好一艘能驶向静水河湾的船了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy buddy, §6Captain Baha§f, and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the §2Backwater Bayou§f.

entries.source: All that's left is to add the Rusty Ship Engine, but I tripped and dropped it into the pond here...
entries.translation: 剩下的就是装上生锈的船用引擎，但我绊了一跤，把它掉进这里的池塘里了……
entries.sampleRaw: §fAll that's left is to add the §cRusty Ship Engine§f, but I tripped and dropped it into the §bpond §fhere...

entries.source: Do you think you could fish it out for me?
entries.translation: 你觉得你能帮我把它钓上来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fDo you think you could fish it out for me?

entries.source: If you find it, bring it to Captain Baha so you can set sail!
entries.translation: 如果你找到了，就把它带给Captain Baha，这样你就能启航了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you find it, bring it to §6Captain Baha §fso you can set sail!

entries.translation: 你能帮我钓上生锈的船用引擎吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fCan you fish up the §cRusty Ship Engine §ffor me?

entries.translation: 它就在这个池塘的某个地方。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's somewhere in this §bpond §fhere.

entries.source: Once you fish it out, you can set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
entries.translation: 一旦你把它钓上来，你就可以启航前往静水河湾了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fOnce you fish it out, you can set sail to the §2Backwater Bayou§f!

entries.source: Ah! The Rusty Ship Engine! Perfect!
entries.translation: 啊！生锈的船用引擎！太好了！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah! The §cRusty Ship Engine§f! Perfect!

entries.source: Bring that to Captain Baha and he'll be able to help you set sail!
entries.translation: 把它带给Captain Baha，他就能帮你启航了！
entries.sampleRaw: Bring that to §6Captain Baha §fand he'll be able to help you set sail!

entries.source: He's behind the Fisherman's Hut, waiting by the Ship.
entries.translation: 他在渔夫小屋后面，正在船边等着。
entries.sampleRaw: He's behind the §bFisherman's Hut§f, waiting by the §6Ship§f.

entries.source: Just leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?
entries.translation: 别提我把它弄掉的那部分，行吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Just leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?

entries.source: Thanks for helping me find the Rusty Ship Engine, <username>!
entries.translation: 谢谢你帮我找到生锈的船用引擎，<username>！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for helping me find the §cRusty Ship Engine§f, §8<username>§f!

entries.source: You can use the Ship Navigator to set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
entries.translation: 你可以使用船用导航仪启航前往静水河湾！
entries.sampleRaw: You can use the §6Ship Navigator §fto set sail to the §2Backwater Bayou§f!

entries.source: Safe travels!
entries.translation: 一路顺风！
entries.sampleRaw: Safe travels!

entries.source: I met Captain Baha when I was marooned on a distant pirate cove.
entries.translation: 我是在被困于一个遥远的海盗湾时遇见Captain Baha的。
entries.sampleRaw: I met §6Captain Baha §fwhen I was marooned on a distant §apirate cove§f.

entries.source: A Carrot King has been scaring off all the good fish, I need to deal with it before I lose more fish.
entries.translation: 一条胡萝卜王一直在吓跑所有好鱼，我得在损失更多鱼之前解决它。
entries.sampleRaw: A Carrot King has been scaring off all the good fish, I need to deal with it before I lose more fish.

entries.source: Holy Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.
entries.translation: 我的天哪！你帮我把所有东西都搞定了。
entries.sampleRaw: Holy Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.

entries.source: S'alright, we are all busy some days.
entries.translation: 没关系，大家都有忙的时候。
entries.sampleRaw: S'alright, we are all busy some days.

entries.source: Hello.
entries.translation: 你好。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello.

entries.source: The Catacombs are an old maze under the island.
entries.translation: 地牢是这座岛下方的一座古老迷宫。
entries.sampleRaw: The §cCatacombs §fare an old maze under the island.

entries.source: Tunnels in the caves were created to bury victims of the Calamity.
entries.translation: 洞穴中的隧道是为了埋葬灾难的受害者而建造的。
entries.sampleRaw: Tunnels in the caves were created to bury victims of the Calamity.

entries.source: An evil force took control of the graves.
entries.translation: An邪恶力量控制了这些坟墓。
entries.sampleRaw: An §4evil force§f took control of the graves.

entries.source: Corpses are raised into a powerful army fueled by pain, misery and anguish.
entries.translation: 尸体被复活成一支由痛苦、悲惨和折磨驱动的强大军队。
entries.sampleRaw: Corpses are raised into a §apowerful army§f fueled by pain, misery and anguish.

entries.source: Anyway!
entries.translation: 总之！
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway!

entries.source: If you find gear inside, I can upgrade it for you!
entries.translation: 如果你在里面找到装备，我可以帮你升级它！
entries.sampleRaw: If you find gear inside, I can §eupgrade§f it for you!

entries.source: Once my hammer delivery is here, I'll let you use my services!
entries.translation: 等我的锤子送到，我就让你使用我的服务！
entries.sampleRaw: Once my hammer delivery is here, I'll let you use my services!

entries.source: ✆ Hello.
entries.translation: ✆ 你好。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHello.

entries.source: ✆ I don't tend to give out my contact to those delving into The Catacombs.
entries.translation: ✆ 我通常不会把我的联系方式给那些深入探索地牢的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI don't tend to give out my contact to those delving into §cThe Catacombs§f.

entries.source: ✆ I used to, but remembering who's still alive and who isn't is a nightmare.
entries.translation: ✆ 我以前会，但要记住谁还活着、谁已经死了，简直是场噩梦。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI used to, but remembering who's still alive and who isn't is a nightmare.

entries.source: ✆ By the end of any given week, 90% of the people in my directory would be dead.
entries.translation: ✆ 随便哪一周结束时，我通讯录里的人就会有90%个已经死了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fBy the end of any given week, §a90% §fof the people in my directory would be §c§odead§f.
entries.numericSource: ✆ By the end of any given week, {{N0}} of the people in my directory would be dead.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 随便哪一周结束时，我通讯录里的人就会有{{N0}}个已经死了。

entries.source: ✆ Removing them was a real pain.
entries.translation: ✆ 把他们移除可真是件麻烦事。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fRemoving them was a real pain.

entries.source: ✆ Anyways, I guess I'll add you, but only if you can prove to me that you won't just die like everyone else.
entries.translation: ✆ 总之，我想我会把你加进去，但前提是你得向我证明你不会像其他人那样轻易死掉。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fAnyways, I guess I'll add you, but only if you can prove to me that you won't just die like everyone else.

entries.source: ✆ Survive long enough to collect 5,000 Undead Essence, and then bring it to me.
entries.translation: ✆ 活得够久，收集 5,000 个亡灵精华，然后把它带给我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fSurvive long enough to collect §a5,000 §dUndead Essence§f, and then bring it to me.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Survive long enough to collect {{N0}} Undead Essence, and then bring it to me.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 活得够久，收集 {{N0}} 个亡灵精华，然后把它带给我。

entries.source: ✆ Thank you.
entries.translation: ✆ 谢谢你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fThank you.

entries.source: ✆ Here's my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 这是我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHere's my contact.

entries.source: ✆ I wish you the best of luck in The Catacombs.
entries.translation: ✆ 祝你在地牢中好运。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI wish you the best of luck in §cThe Catacombs§f.

entries.source: ✆ Try to stay alive, for both your sake and mine - I don't feel like expending the minimal effort required to remove you from my contacts.
entries.translation: ✆ 尽量活下去吧，为了你自己也为了我——我可不想费那点最小的力气把你从我的联系人里删掉。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fTry to stay alive, for both your sake and mine - I don't feel like expending the minimal effort required to remove you from my contacts.

entries.translation: 嘿[player]，欢迎来到地牢！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey §7[player]§f, welcome to §cThe Catacombs§f!

entries.source: We hope you have a long stay!
entries.translation: 我们希望你能长住久留！
entries.sampleRaw: We hope you have a long stay!

entries.source: Preferably, an eternal adventure.
entries.translation: 最好是，一场永恒的冒险。
entries.sampleRaw: Preferably, an §7§oeternal§r§f adventure.

entries.source: Our forces are made of rotting adventurers.
entries.translation: 我们的军队由腐烂的冒险者组成。
entries.sampleRaw: §4Our forces§f are made of rotting adventurers.

entries.source: A party of 5 players is crucial.
entries.translation: 一支5 名玩家的队伍至关重要.
entries.sampleRaw: A §9party§f of §e5 players§f is crucial.
entries.numericSource: A party of {{N0}} players is crucial.
entries.numericTranslation: 一支{{N0}} 名玩家的队伍至关重要.

entries.source: Time to make friends.
entries.translation: 是时候交朋友了。
entries.sampleRaw: Time to make friends.

entries.translation: 保住你自己的小命，先去别处寻求挑战吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Save your own skin, seek challenge elsewhere first.

entries.sampleRaw: §7§oYou need Combat Level XV before leading a dungeon.

entries.translation: 给，这是我第一次进入地牢时找到的地图。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, I found this map when I first entered the dungeon.

entries.translation: 如果你迷路了，应该会觉得它很有用。
entries.sampleRaw: You should find it useful if you get lost.

entries.source: Good luck.
entries.translation: 祝你好运。
entries.sampleRaw: Good luck.

entries.sampleRaw: Right click the Orb for spells, and Left click (or Drop) to use your Ultimate!
