entries.numericTranslation: 抱歉各位,今晚的演出只能取消了,请 {{N0}} 天后再来参加下一场拍卖!

entries.source: You don't need to enter the Dark Auction to complete the Bingo.
entries.translation: 你不需要进入暗黑拍卖行来完成宾果。
entries.sampleRaw: You don't need to enter the §5Dark Auction §fto complete the Bingo.

entries.source: Oh.
entries.translation: 哦。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh.

entries.source: That's the exact amount of coins I got from selling the first gift my father gave me.
entries.translation: 那正好是我卖掉父亲给我的第一份礼物所得的硬币数量。
entries.sampleRaw: That's the exact amount of coins I got from selling the first gift my father gave me.

entries.source: It's now my favorite number.
entries.translation: 它现在是我最喜欢的数字。
entries.sampleRaw: It's now my favorite number.

entries.source: I wrote a book about my childhood, do you want it?
entries.translation: 我写了一本关于我童年的书，你想要吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I wrote a book about my childhood, do you want it?

entries.source: Here, take it.
entries.translation: 来，拿着。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take it.

entries.source: I hope you will like it.
entries.translation: 希望你会喜欢。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you will like it.

entries.source: Shh, keep it down!
entries.translation: 嘘，小声点！
entries.sampleRaw: Shh, keep it down!

entries.source: Come on down to the basement, the auction is about to begin!
entries.translation: 快下来到地下室，拍卖马上就要开始了！
entries.sampleRaw: Come on down to the basement, the auction is about to begin!

entries.source: Welcome to the Dark Auction! I hope everyone's ready, the first item's about to start!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到暗黑拍卖行！希望大家准备好了，第一件物品即将开拍！
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to the §5Dark Auction§f! I hope everyone's ready, the first item's about to start!

entries.source: First up we have a <item>, the starting bid is # Coins!
entries.translation: 首先登场的是<item>，起拍价为#硬币！
entries.sampleRaw: First up we have a §7<item>§f, the starting bid is §6# Coins§f!

entries.source: The bidding will start in #s.
entries.translation: 竞拍将在 # 秒后开始。
entries.sampleRaw: The bidding will start in #s.

entries.source: You can place your bids now!
entries.translation: 你现在可以出价了！
entries.sampleRaw: You can place your bids now!

entries.source: <player> placed a bid of # Coins!
entries.translation: <player>出价#硬币！
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player> §fplaced a bid of §6# Coins§f!

entries.source: ✆ Pstt. Don't tell anyone, but I've refunded you <amount> Coins for being such a loyal customer.
entries.translation: ✆ 嘘。别告诉任何人，但因为你是个如此忠诚的顾客，我已经退还了你<amount>硬币。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§oPstt. §fDon't tell anyone, but I've refunded you §7<amount> §6Coins §ffor being such a loyal customer.

entries.source: The highest bidder was <player> with a bid of # Coins!
entries.translation: 最高出价者是<player>，出价为#硬币！
entries.sampleRaw: The highest bidder was §7<player>§f with a bid of §6# Coins§f!

entries.source: Next up we have a <item>, the starting bid is # Coins!
entries.translation: 接下来登场的是<item>，起拍价为#硬币！
entries.sampleRaw: Next up we have a §7<item>§f, the starting bid is §6# Coins§f!

entries.source: No one made any bids! Let's move on to the next item!
entries.translation: 没有人出价！我们继续下一件物品吧！
entries.sampleRaw: No one made any bids! Let's move on to the next item!

entries.source: Alright show's over folks! Come back in 3 nights for the next auction.
entries.translation: 好了,演出结束了各位!3个夜晚后再来参加下一场拍卖吧.
entries.sampleRaw: Alright show's over folks! Come back in §b3 nights§f for the next auction.
entries.numericSource: Alright show's over folks! Come back in {{N0}} nights for the next auction.
entries.numericTranslation: 好了,演出结束了各位!{{N0}}个夜晚后再来参加下一场拍卖吧.

entries.source: ✆ Let me guess, you're yet another player who desires my contact...
entries.translation: ✆ 让我猜猜，你又是另一个想要我联系方式的玩家……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fLet me guess, you're yet another player who desires my contact...

entries.source: ✆ Well, I'm afraid you'll have to get in line with everyone else.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，恐怕你得和其他所有人一起排队了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWell, I'm afraid you'll have to get in line with everyone else.

entries.source: ✆ If you come to enough auctions, you'll find what you're looking for.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你多来参加几场拍卖，就会找到你想要的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you come to enough auctions, you'll find what you're looking for.

entries.source: ✆ Though you'll still have to outbid everyone else, of course!
entries.translation: ✆ 当然，你仍然得比其他所有人都出价更高！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThough you'll still have to outbid everyone else, of course!

entries.source: ✆ Hello. This is an automated message being sent to all of my closest contacts.
entries.translation: ✆ 你好。这是一条发送给我所有最亲密联系人的自动消息。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHello. This is an automated message being sent to all of my closest contacts.

entries.source: ✆ The next Dark Auction will be taking place very soon. Same time, same place as usual.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一场暗黑拍卖行即将开始。和往常一样的时间，一样的地点。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe next Dark Auction will be taking place very soon. Same time, same place as usual.

entries.source: ✆ If you are interested in making a purchase, please begin to make your way over.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你有兴趣购买，请开始前往。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you are interested in making a purchase, please begin to make your way over.

entries.source: I've always wanted to start a farm but instead I got sucked into this life of crim...I mean business!
entries.translation: 我一直想开个农场，但我却卷入了这种犯罪……我是说商业生活！
entries.sampleRaw: I've always wanted to start a farm but instead I got sucked into this life of crim...I mean business!

entries.source: This smell... it reminds me of my childhood when I used to pick flowers in the garden. Keep this between you and me, understand?
entries.translation: 这气味……让我想起了童年时在花园里采花的日子。这事只有你知我知，明白吗？
entries.sampleRaw: This smell... it reminds me of my childhood when I used to pick flowers in the garden. Keep this between you and me, understand?

entries.source: I'll be back. I know you'll make the right decision.
entries.translation: 我会回来的。我知道你会做出正确的决定。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll be back. I know you'll make the right decision.

entries.source: ✆ You know [player], I'm a pet lover.
entries.translation: ✆ 你知道吗[player]，我是个宠物爱好者。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You know §7[player]§f, I'm a pet lover.

entries.source: ✆ So my abiphone contacts list is FILLED with TONS of other pet lovers.
entries.translation: ✆ 所以我的Abiphone联系人列表里塞满了大量其他宠物爱好者。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f So my abiphone contacts list is §lFILLED§r§f with §lTONS§r§f of other pet lovers.

entries.source: Ah, a seasoned tamer, I see! Welcome!
entries.translation: 啊，我看出来了，是位经验丰富的驯兽师！欢迎！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, a seasoned tamer, I see! Welcome!

entries.source: You've mastered the art of Taming to level 50, a commendable feat.
entries.translation: 你已经将驯养技艺精通至50级，值得称赞。
entries.sampleRaw: You've mastered the art of §aTaming §fto level 50, a commendable feat.
entries.numericSource: You've mastered the art of Taming to level {{N0}}, a commendable feat.
entries.numericTranslation: 你已经将驯养技艺精通至{{N0}}级，值得称赞。

entries.source: You see, I have a penchant for collecting exotic pets.
entries.translation: 你看，我有个收集异域宠物的癖好。
entries.sampleRaw: You see, I have a penchant for collecting §dexotic pets§f.

entries.source: A hobby that's not as easy for me as it is for a skilled tamer like yourself.
entries.translation: 这个爱好对我来说，可不像对你这样熟练的驯兽师那么容易。
entries.sampleRaw: A hobby that's not as easy for me as it is for a skilled tamer like yourself.

entries.source: In exchange for your help in expanding my collection, I offer a unique opportunity.
entries.translation: 作为帮我扩充收藏的回报，我提供一个独特的机会。
entries.sampleRaw: In exchange for your help in expanding my collection, I offer a unique opportunity.

entries.source: For each rare pet you bring to me, starting with the elusive Epic Rift Ferret, I'll unlock an additional level in your Taming skill.
entries.translation: 每带来一只稀有宠物，从难以捉摸的史诗裂隙雪貂开始，我就会为你的驯养技能解锁一个额外等级。
entries.sampleRaw: For each rare pet you bring to me, starting with the elusive §5Epic Rift Ferret§f, I'll unlock an additional level in your Taming skill.

entries.source: Why the Rift Ferret you ask?
entries.translation: 你问为什么是裂隙雪貂？
entries.sampleRaw: Why the Rift Ferret you ask?

entries.source: Ah, the Rift is a place of mystery, one I've longed to explore but alas, have never had the chance.
entries.translation: 啊，裂隙是个充满神秘的地方，我一直渴望去探索，可惜始终没有机会。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, the Rift is a place of mystery, one I've longed to explore but alas, have never had the chance.

entries.source: Bring me this creature from beyond, and let's advance your taming prowess together!
entries.translation: 把这只来自异界的生物带给我，让我们一起提升你的驯养本领吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Bring me this creature from beyond, and let's advance your taming prowess together!

entries.source: Thank you for bringing me the Mythic Enderman.
entries.translation: 谢谢你给我带来神话末影人。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for bringing me the §dMythic Enderman§f.

entries.source: Their enigmatic presence and otherworldly aura have always captivated me.
entries.translation: 它们神秘的存在和超凡脱俗的气息一直令我着迷。
entries.sampleRaw: Their enigmatic presence and otherworldly aura have always captivated me.

entries.source: Your Taming level cap has been increased!
entries.translation: 你的驯养等级上限已提升！
entries.sampleRaw: Your Taming level cap has been increased!

entries.source: Shhhh. Don't disturb the Legendary Black Cat.
entries.translation: 嘘。别打扰传说黑猫。
entries.sampleRaw: Shhhh. Don't disturb the §6Legendary Black Cat§f.

entries.source: I've always been fascinated by their mysterious charm.
entries.translation: 我一直被它们神秘的魅力所吸引。
entries.sampleRaw: I've always been fascinated by their mysterious charm.

entries.source: Thank you for bringing me this pet!
entries.translation: 谢谢你给我带来这只宠物！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for bringing me this pet!

entries.source: Oh yes, an Epic Slug.
entries.translation: 哦对，一只史诗蛞蝓。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh yes, an §5Epic Slug§f.

entries.source: My garden seems to miss having one around!
entries.translation: 我的花园似乎很想念有它在身边的日子！
entries.sampleRaw: My garden seems to miss having one around!

entries.source: Is that a Epic Spirit?
entries.translation: 那是一只史诗灵魂吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is that a §5Epic Spirit§f?

entries.source: Their mysterious aura has always intrigued me.
entries.translation: 它们神秘的气息一直让我好奇。
entries.sampleRaw: Their mysterious aura has always intrigued me.

entries.source: I've always wanted a Epic Giraffe?
entries.translation: 我一直想要一只史诗长颈鹿？
entries.sampleRaw: I've always wanted a §5Epic Giraffe§f?

entries.source: I'm curious to see if they really are as tall as the legends say.
entries.translation: 我很好奇它们是不是真的像传说中那么高。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm curious to see if they really are as tall as the legends say.

entries.source: Do you think the Epic Jellyfish can dance?
entries.translation: 你觉得史诗水母会跳舞吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you think the §5Epic Jellyfish§f can dance?

entries.source: I've always been mesmerized by their underwater ballet.
entries.translation: 我一直被它们的水下芭蕾所迷住。
entries.sampleRaw: I've always been mesmerized by their underwater ballet.

entries.source: Thank you for getting the Epic Bal.
entries.translation: 谢谢你弄到史诗巴尔。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for getting the §5Epic Bal§f.

entries.source: It's a bit too hot for me down there!
entries.translation: 下面对我来说有点太热了！
entries.sampleRaw: It's a bit too hot for me down there!

entries.source: I'm glad you could fetch me a Epic Baby Yeti?
entries.translation: 很高兴你能给我弄来一只史诗雪人宝宝？
entries.sampleRaw: I'm glad you could fetch me a §5Epic Baby Yeti§f?

entries.source: I cannot stand the cold!
entries.translation: 我受不了寒冷！
entries.sampleRaw: I cannot stand the cold!

entries.source: Now, I am be delighted to see a Rare Frost Wisp.
entries.translation: 现在，我很高兴见到一只稀有霜灵。
entries.sampleRaw: Now, I am be delighted to see a §9Rare Frost Wisp§f.

entries.source: Their icy presence is said to be quite refreshing.
entries.translation: 据说它们冰冷的存在相当提神。
entries.sampleRaw: Their icy presence is said to be quite refreshing.

entries.source: You've done it!
entries.translation: 你做到了！
entries.sampleRaw: You've done it!

entries.source: You've brought me all the pets I've asked for, and in doing so, have shown exceptional dedication and skill.
entries.translation: 你带来了我要求的所有宠物，并在此过程中展现了非凡的投入与技巧。
entries.sampleRaw: You've brought me all the pets I've asked for, and in doing so, have shown exceptional dedication and skill.

entries.source: Your Taming level cap can now reach the maximum level of 60, thanks to your efforts.
entries.translation: 多亏你的努力，你的驯养等级上限现在可以达到最高等级 60。
entries.sampleRaw: Your Taming level cap can now reach the maximum level of 60, thanks to your efforts.
entries.numericSource: Your Taming level cap can now reach the maximum level of {{N0}}, thanks to your efforts.
entries.numericTranslation: 多亏你的努力，你的驯养等级上限现在可以达到最高等级 {{N0}}。

entries.source: You've not only helped me complete my collection but also demonstrated the true spirit of a master tamer.
entries.translation: 你不仅帮我完成了收藏，还展现了真正的大师驯养师精神。
entries.sampleRaw: You've not only helped me complete my collection but also demonstrated the true spirit of a master tamer.

entries.source: Remember, the world of taming is vast and ever-changing.
entries.translation: 记住，驯服的世界广阔无垠，且瞬息万变。
entries.sampleRaw: Remember, the world of taming is vast and ever-changing.

entries.source: May your adventures continue to be as fruitful and exciting as this quest has been!
entries.translation: 愿你的冒险能像这次任务一样硕果累累、激动人心！
entries.sampleRaw: May your adventures continue to be as fruitful and exciting as this quest has been!

entries.source: ✆ Oh absolutely you can have my contact info.
entries.translation: ✆ 哦，当然可以，你可以拿走我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Oh absolutely you can have my contact info.

entries.source: ✆ It may look like I'm always here at my desk, but really I'm always traveling.
entries.translation: ✆ 看起来我好像一直待在我的书桌旁，但其实我一直在旅行。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f It may look like I'm always here at my desk, but really I'm always traveling.

entries.source: ✆ Lately I've been looking across the universe for 3 specific pets.
entries.translation: ✆ 最近我一直在整个宇宙中寻找 3 种特定的宠物。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Lately I've been looking across the universe for 3 specific pets.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Lately I've been looking across the universe for {{N0}} specific pets.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 最近我一直在整个宇宙中寻找 {{N0}} 种特定的宠物。

entries.source: ✆ The [pet], [pet] and [pet] pets.
entries.translation: ✆ 就是[pet]、[pet]和[pet]这三种宠物。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f The [pet], [pet] and [pet] pets.

entries.source: ✆ If you can bring me ALL of those, you can have my contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你能把它们全部带给我，你就可以拿走我的联系方式！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f If you can bring me ALL of those, you can have my contact!

entries.source: ✆ Oh, by the way, they should all be Lvl 1.
entries.translation: ✆ 哦,顺便说一下,它们都必须是 1 级.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Oh, by the way, they should all be §7Lvl 1§f.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Oh, by the way, they should all be Lvl {{N0}}.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 哦,顺便说一下,它们都必须是 {{N0}} 级.

entries.source: ✆ That's fantastic!
entries.translation: ✆ 太棒了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f That's fantastic!

entries.source: ✆ I love pets!
entries.translation: ✆ 我爱宠物！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I love pets!

entries.source: ✆ Here take my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 来，拿走我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Here take my contact.

entries.source: ✆ You'll be able to reach me while I am or you are in the wilderness.
entries.translation: ✆ 只要我或你身处荒野，你就能联系到我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You'll be able to reach me while I am or you are in the wilderness.

entries.source: Have you found the Mythic Enderman yet?
entries.translation: 你找到神话末影人了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §dMythic Enderman §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Legendary Black Cat yet?
entries.translation: 你找到传说黑猫了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §6Legendary Black Cat §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Rift Ferret yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗裂隙雪貂了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §5Epic Rift Ferret §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Slug yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗蛞蝓了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §5Epic Slug §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Spirit yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗幽灵了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §5Epic Spirit §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Jellyfish yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗水母了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §5Epic Jellyfish §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Bal yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗巴尔了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §5Epic Bal §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Baby Yeti yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗雪人宝宝了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §5Epic Baby Yeti §fyet?

entries.source: Have you found the Rare Frost Wisp yet?
entries.translation: 你找到稀有霜灵了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found the §9Rare Frost Wisp §fyet?

entries.source: Hey you! Over here! Come talk to me! I'll teach you about racing!
entries.translation: 嘿，你！这边！过来跟我聊聊！我来教你赛跑！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey you! Over here! Come talk to me! I'll teach you about racing!

entries.source: The End is a large island... my favorite hobby is racing across it!
entries.translation: 末地是一座很大的岛……我最喜欢的爱好就是在上面赛跑！
entries.sampleRaw: The End is a large island... my favorite hobby is racing across it!

entries.source: My best time is pretty fast, you probably will never beat me. But you can try!
entries.translation: 我的最佳成绩相当快，你大概永远也赢不了我。不过你可以试试！
entries.sampleRaw: My best time is pretty fast, you probably will never beat me. But you can try!

entries.source: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island and come all the way back.
entries.translation: 要完成比赛,你需要到达岛屿的另一端,然后再一路跑回来.
entries.sampleRaw: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the §eopposite side of the island §rand come all the way back.

entries.source: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 3 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.translation: 踩上压力板即可开始比赛。如果你能在 3 分钟内完成，我就会给你奖励！祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 3 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.numericSource: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under {{N0}} minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.numericTranslation: 踩上压力板即可开始比赛。如果你能在 {{N0}} 分钟内完成，我就会给你奖励！祝你好运！

entries.source: Give it a go! Can you finish the race in 3 minutes or less?
entries.translation: 来试试吧！你能在 3 分钟或更短时间内完成比赛吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Give it a go! Can you finish the race in 3 minutes or less?
entries.numericSource: Give it a go! Can you finish the race in {{N0}} minutes or less?
entries.numericTranslation: 来试试吧！你能在 {{N0}} 分钟或更短时间内完成比赛吗？

entries.source: Run over the pressure plate to start racing!
entries.translation: 跑过压力板即可开始比赛！
entries.sampleRaw: Run over the pressure plate to start racing!

entries.source: What are you talking to me for? Get back in the race!
entries.translation: 你跟我说话干什么？快回去比赛！
entries.sampleRaw: What are you talking to me for? Get back in the race!

entries.source: Run across The End to the opposite side of the island to complete the race!
entries.translation: 跑过末地,到达岛屿的另一端,完成比赛!
entries.sampleRaw: Run across The End to the §eopposite side of the island §rto complete the race!

entries.source: Not bad, [player]!
entries.translation: 不错嘛,[player]!
entries.sampleRaw: Not bad, §7[player]§f!

entries.source: But you can get a much quicker time if you use the items that I do.
entries.translation: 但如果你用我用的那些物品，你的用时可以快得多。
entries.sampleRaw: But you can get a much quicker time if you use the items that I do.

entries.source: Take these Silent Pearls, they allow you to teleport without angering Endermen.
entries.translation: 拿着这些无声珍珠,它们能让你传送而不激怒末影人.
entries.sampleRaw: Take these §5Silent Pearls§r, they allow you to teleport without angering Endermen.

entries.source: Try again, but this time come back in 2 minutes or less!
entries.translation: 再试一次，但这次要在 2 分钟或更短时间内回来！
entries.sampleRaw: Try again, but this time come back in 2 minutes or less!
entries.numericSource: Try again, but this time come back in {{N0}} minutes or less!
entries.numericTranslation: 再试一次，但这次要在 {{N0}} 分钟或更短时间内回来！

entries.source: Keep it up! Can you finish the race in 2 minutes or less?
entries.translation: 继续保持！你能在 2 分钟或更短时间内完成比赛吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Keep it up! Can you finish the race in 2 minutes or less?
entries.numericSource: Keep it up! Can you finish the race in {{N0}} minutes or less?
entries.numericTranslation: 继续保持！你能在 {{N0}} 分钟或更短时间内完成比赛吗？

entries.source: You shouldn't be talking to me if you want to beat 2 minutes!
entries.translation: 如果你想跑进 2 分钟，就不该跟我说话！
entries.sampleRaw: You shouldn't be talking to me if you want to beat 2 minutes!
entries.numericSource: You shouldn't be talking to me if you want to beat {{N0}} minutes!
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你想跑进 {{N0}} 分钟，就不该跟我说话！

entries.source: You're getting much faster!
entries.translation: 你越来越快了！
entries.sampleRaw: You're getting much faster!

entries.source: Have this Enderman Mask! I wear it sometimes to make me feel like an Enderman.
entries.translation: 拿着这个末影人面具!我有时会戴上它,让自己感觉像个末影人.
entries.sampleRaw: Have this §5Enderman Mask§r! I wear it sometimes to make me feel like an Enderman.

entries.source: See if you can beat 80 seconds!
entries.translation: 看看你能不能跑进 80 秒！
entries.sampleRaw: See if you can beat 80 seconds!
entries.numericSource: See if you can beat {{N0}} seconds!
entries.numericTranslation: 看看你能不能跑进 {{N0}} 秒！
