entries.sampleRaw: Keep at it! Can you finish the race in 80 seconds or less?
entries.numericSource: Keep at it! Can you finish the race in {{N0}} seconds or less?
entries.numericTranslation: 继续努力！你能在 {{N0}} 秒或更短时间内完成比赛吗？

entries.source: How do you suppose you'll beat 80 seconds by talking to me?
entries.translation: 你觉得跟我说话能帮你跑进 80 秒吗？
entries.sampleRaw: How do you suppose you'll beat 80 seconds by talking to me?
entries.numericSource: How do you suppose you'll beat {{N0}} seconds by talking to me?
entries.numericTranslation: 你觉得跟我说话能帮你跑进 {{N0}} 秒吗？

entries.source: Get back in the race! You only have 80 seconds!
entries.translation: 快回去比赛！你只剩 80 秒了！
entries.sampleRaw: Get back in the race! You only have 80 seconds!
entries.numericSource: Get back in the race! You only have {{N0}} seconds!
entries.numericTranslation: 快回去比赛！你只剩 {{N0}} 秒了！

entries.source: Now we're talking! You're getting close to my record!
entries.translation: 这才像话！你快要接近我的纪录了！
entries.sampleRaw: Now we're talking! You're getting close to my record!

entries.source: Here's a weird item that I have no use for. It won't help you beat my personal best, but it's your item now.
entries.translation: 这是一件我用不上的奇怪物品。它帮不了你打破我的个人最佳成绩，但它现在是你的了。
entries.sampleRaw: Here's a weird item that I have no use for. It won't help you beat my personal best, but it's your item now.

entries.source: Finish the race in under 48 seconds and come talk to me! I promise the reward will be better!
entries.translation: 在 48 秒内完成比赛，然后来找我！我保证奖励会更好！
entries.sampleRaw: Finish the race in under 48 seconds and come talk to me! I promise the reward will be better!
entries.numericSource: Finish the race in under {{N0}} seconds and come talk to me! I promise the reward will be better!
entries.numericTranslation: 在 {{N0}} 秒内完成比赛，然后来找我！我保证奖励会更好！

entries.source: You're so close!! Can you finish the race in 48 seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.translation: 你就快成功了！！你能在 48 秒或更短时间内完成比赛，打破我的个人纪录吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You're so close!! Can you finish the race in 48 seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.numericSource: You're so close!! Can you finish the race in {{N0}} seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.numericTranslation: 你就快成功了！！你能在 {{N0}} 秒或更短时间内完成比赛，打破我的个人纪录吗？

entries.source: Get back in the race! You only have 48 seconds!
entries.translation: 快回去比赛！你只剩 48 秒了！
entries.sampleRaw: Get back in the race! You only have 48 seconds!
entries.numericSource: Get back in the race! You only have {{N0}} seconds!
entries.numericTranslation: 快回去比赛！你只剩 {{N0}} 秒了！

entries.source: Get back in the race! 48 seconds isn't enough time for there to be chit chat!
entries.translation: 快回去比赛！48 秒可不够你闲聊的！
entries.sampleRaw: Get back in the race! 48 seconds isn't enough time for there to be chit chat!
entries.numericSource: Get back in the race! {{N0}} seconds isn't enough time for there to be chit chat!
entries.numericTranslation: 快回去比赛！{{N0}} 秒可不够你闲聊的！

entries.source: You'll never beat my personal best if you waste this much time! Yikes!
entries.translation: 你要是浪费这么多时间，就永远别想打破我的个人最佳成绩！哎呀！
entries.sampleRaw: You'll never beat my personal best if you waste this much time! Yikes!

entries.source: You did it! Congratulations, [player]. You are now faster than Guber!
entries.translation: 你做到了!恭喜你,[player].你现在比 Guber 还快了!
entries.sampleRaw: You did it! Congratulations, §7[player]§f. You are now faster than §dGuber§r!

entries.source: A legendary speedster once ran this island, some say he finished the race in mere seconds!
entries.translation: 传说曾有一位飞毛腿跑遍这座岛，有人说他仅用几秒就完成了比赛！
entries.sampleRaw: A legendary speedster once ran this island, some say he finished the race in mere seconds!

entries.source: He left behind this Pig's Foot. I want you to have it, as you have proven to be the best of the best!
entries.translation: 他留下了这只猪脚.我想把它交给你,因为你已证明自己是精英中的精英!
entries.sampleRaw: He left behind this §dPig's Foot§r. I want you to have it, as you have proven to be the best of the best!

entries.source: As you can see, this item is quite powerful. It makes you incredibly fast!
entries.translation: 如你所见，这件物品相当强大。它能让你快得不可思议！
entries.sampleRaw: As you can see, this item is quite powerful. It makes you incredibly fast!

entries.source: It's a great day to go for a run!
entries.translation: 今天真是跑步的好日子！
entries.sampleRaw: It's a great day to go for a run!

entries.source: You're always welcome to try the race again. Just run over the pressure plate to begin!
entries.translation: 随时欢迎你再来挑战这场比赛。踩上压力板就能开始！
entries.sampleRaw: You're always welcome to try the race again. Just run over the pressure plate to begin!

entries.source: You should know by now talking to me during the race is only going to hurt your time! Yeesh!
entries.translation: 你现在应该知道，比赛时跟我说话只会拖慢你的用时！唉！
entries.sampleRaw: You should know by now talking to me during the race is only going to hurt your time! Yeesh!

entries.source: Wow, that's impressive.
entries.translation: 哇，真厉害。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, that's impressive.

entries.source: Here, take this Obscure Ending!
entries.translation: 来，拿着这个晦暗终章！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this §9Obscure Ending§f!

entries.source: What? Lumber Jack said I have a Treecapitator? In my dreams...
entries.translation: 什么？Lumber Jack说我有伐木狂魔？做梦吧……
entries.sampleRaw: What? §aLumber Jack§f said I have a §5Treecapitator§f? In my dreams...

entries.source: You can buy and sell harvested crops with me!
entries.translation: 你可以在我这里买卖收获的农作物！
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can buy and sell harvested crops with me!

entries.source: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, and melon are my specialities!
entries.translation: 小麦、胡萝卜、马铃薯和西瓜是我的专长！
entries.sampleRaw: §fWheat, carrots, potatoes, and melon are my specialities!

entries.source: I'm sorry, I have nothing for you.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我没有什么可以给你的。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sorry, I have nothing for you.

entries.source: To fast travel or not to fast travel?
entries.translation: 快速旅行，还是不快速旅行？
entries.sampleRaw: To fast travel or not to fast travel?

entries.source: ONE SECOND I'M PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!
entries.translation: 等一下，我现在挺忙的！
entries.sampleRaw: ONE SECOND I'M PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!

entries.source: COULD YOU HELP ME INSTEAD OF JUST SITTING THERE?!
entries.translation: 你能不能帮帮我，而不是光坐在那儿？！
entries.sampleRaw: COULD YOU HELP ME INSTEAD OF JUST SITTING THERE?!

entries.source: Wow, that was something!
entries.translation: 哇，这可真不简单！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, that was something!

entries.source: I'm immune to fire but those monsters are still quite troublesome...
entries.translation: 我对火焰免疫，但那些怪物还是相当麻烦……
entries.sampleRaw: I'm immune to fire but those monsters are still quite troublesome...

entries.source: Thanks for your help, I seriously appreciate that.
entries.translation: 谢谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for your help, I seriously appreciate that.

entries.source: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though. I need to collect 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks and I'm super late.
entries.translation: 不过我有点赶时间。我需要收集2个幽灵之尘、3个烈焰灰烬、4个岩浆块，我已经超级迟了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though. I need to collect §22 Spectre Dust§f, §23 Blaze Ashes§f, §24 Magma Chunks§f and I'm super late.
entries.numericSource: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though. I need to collect {{N0}} Spectre Dust, {{N1}} Blaze Ashes, {{N2}} Magma Chunks and I'm super late.
entries.numericTranslation: 不过我有点赶时间。我需要收集{{N0}}个幽灵之尘、{{N1}}个烈焰灰烬、{{N2}}个岩浆块，我已经超级迟了。

entries.source: Will you help me?
entries.translation: 你愿意帮我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Will you help me?

entries.source: Okay, that's fine. I just won't be able to buy food today and I won't be able to pay my rent.
entries.translation: 好吧，没关系。只是我今天买不了食物，也付不起房租了。
entries.sampleRaw: Okay, that's fine. I just won't be able to buy food today and I won't be able to pay my rent.

entries.source: I might also die finding those items and you'll have that on your conscience.
entries.translation: 我找那些东西时也可能死掉，那你的良心会过意不去的。
entries.sampleRaw: I might also die finding those items and you'll have that on your conscience.

entries.source: Have a nice day.
entries.translation: 祝你今天愉快。
entries.sampleRaw: Have a nice day.

entries.source: Thanks! You seem pretty strong, all you have to do is exterminate some of the monsters around. Follow me!
entries.translation: 谢谢！你看起来挺强的，你只要消灭周围的一些怪物就行。跟我来！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks! You seem pretty strong, all you have to do is exterminate some of the monsters around. Follow me!

entries.source: Here, some of the mobs are inside that building and some are on the outside if you follow the path. Piece of cake!
entries.translation: 到了，有些怪物在那栋建筑里面，有些在外面，你沿着路走就能找到。小菜一碟！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, some of the mobs are inside that building and some are on the outside if you follow the path. Piece of cake!

entries.source: I need 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
entries.translation: 我需要2个幽灵之尘、3个烈焰灰烬、4个岩浆块。
entries.sampleRaw: I need §22 Spectre Dust§f, §23 Blaze Ashes§f, §24 Magma Chunks§f.
entries.numericSource: I need {{N0}} Spectre Dust, {{N1}} Blaze Ashes, {{N2}} Magma Chunks.
entries.numericTranslation: 我需要{{N0}}个幽灵之尘、{{N1}}个烈焰灰烬、{{N2}}个岩浆块。

entries.source: Most monsters around drop valuable items, you can make a living killing them.
entries.translation: 周围的怪物大多会掉落值钱的东西，你可以靠杀它们谋生。
entries.sampleRaw: Most monsters around drop valuable items, you can make a living killing them.

entries.source: I'll be right there, I need to catch my breath.
entries.translation: 我马上就到，我得喘口气。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll be right there, I need to catch my breath.

entries.source: I needed 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
entries.translation: 我需要2个幽灵之尘、3个烈焰灰烬、4个岩浆块。
entries.sampleRaw: I needed §22 Spectre Dust§f, §23 Blaze Ashes§f, §24 Magma Chunks§f.
entries.numericSource: I needed {{N0}} Spectre Dust, {{N1}} Blaze Ashes, {{N2}} Magma Chunks.
entries.numericTranslation: 我需要{{N0}}个幽灵之尘、{{N1}}个烈焰灰烬、{{N2}}个岩浆块。

entries.source: Oh, you already got everything?
entries.translation: 哦，你已经全都拿到了？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, you already got everything?

entries.source: Yoink!
entries.translation: Yoink！
entries.sampleRaw: Yoink!

entries.source: Thanks for the items, that's super nice of you!
entries.translation: 谢谢你的物品，你人真好！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for the items, that's super nice of you!

entries.source: You are new around here, right? Never seen you before.
entries.translation: 你是这附近新来的，对吧？以前从没见过你。
entries.sampleRaw: You are new around here, right? Never seen you before.

entries.source: You are probably wondering what the heck happened to this place?
entries.translation: 你大概在想这地方到底发生了什么吧？
entries.sampleRaw: You are probably wondering what the heck happened to this place?

entries.source: This land actually used to be a peaceful forest with farmers, a long long time ago.
entries.translation: 很久很久以前，这片土地其实是一片宁静的森林，住着农夫。
entries.sampleRaw: This land actually used to be a peaceful forest with farmers, a long long time ago.

entries.source: When the Emperor Dragon destroyed the world something awakened deep below the surface.
entries.translation: 当帝王龙摧毁世界时，地表深处有什么东西苏醒了。
entries.sampleRaw: When the §cEmperor Dragon§f destroyed the world something awakened deep below the surface.

entries.source: The giant volcano emerged and it kept on growing, over the centuries the whole place changed for the worse.
entries.translation: 巨大的火山浮现出来并不断增长，几个世纪以来，整个地方变得越来越糟。
entries.sampleRaw: The giant volcano emerged and it kept on growing, over the centuries the whole place changed for the worse.

entries.source: I've really got to go now but if you are interested I suggest you explore the island a bit more.
entries.translation: 我现在真的得走了，但如果你感兴趣，我建议你再多探索一下这座岛。
entries.sampleRaw: I've really got to go now but if you are interested I suggest you explore the island a bit more.

entries.source: Thanks for your help, see you around!
entries.translation: 谢谢你的帮助，回头见！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for your help, see you around!

entries.source: Why don't you explore the Village a bit more?
entries.translation: 你为什么不多探索一下村庄呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Why don't you explore the Village a bit more?

entries.source: You don't need to follow me everywhere you know?
entries.translation: 你知道的，你没必要到处跟着我。
entries.sampleRaw: You don't need to follow me everywhere you know?

entries.source: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Queen!
entries.translation: 哇，小心，你不能随便进入这栋建筑，这里是女王的住所！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the §2Queen§f!

entries.source: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Chief!
entries.translation: 哇，小心，你不能随便进入这栋建筑，这里是酋长的住所！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the §2Chief§f!

entries.source: There are 2 different Factions on this island with incredible tensions between them!
entries.translation: 这座岛上有 2 个不同的阵营，它们之间关系极其紧张！
entries.sampleRaw: There are 2 different §cFactions§f on this island with incredible tensions between them!
entries.numericSource: There are {{N0}} different Factions on this island with incredible tensions between them!
entries.numericTranslation: 这座岛上有 {{N0}} 个不同的阵营，它们之间关系极其紧张！

entries.source: They don't mind travelers but you have to earn their trust before you can do such things.
entries.translation: 他们不介意旅行者，但你必须先赢得他们的信任才能做这些事。
entries.sampleRaw: They don't mind travelers but you have to earn their trust before you can do such things.

entries.source: In fact, you'll have to choose a faction, but it's a little bit early for that.
entries.translation: 事实上，你必须选择一个阵营，但现在说这个还有点早。
entries.sampleRaw: In fact, you'll have to §2choose a faction§f, but it's a little bit early for that.

entries.source: Joining a faction is an important choice, I suggest you get to know the two factions first.
entries.translation: 加入阵营是一个重要的选择，我建议你先去了解这两个阵营。
entries.sampleRaw: Joining a faction is an important choice, I suggest you get to know the two factions first.

entries.source: Perhaps you should start by talking to multiple villagers from each faction.
entries.translation: 也许你应该先从与每个阵营的多位村民交谈开始。

styleMappings.talking to multiple villagers from each: 与每个阵营的多位村民交谈

entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps you should start by §2talking to multiple villagers from each faction§f.

entries.source: The other faction is on the other side of the island.
entries.translation: 另一个阵营在岛的另一边。
entries.sampleRaw: The other faction is on the other side of the island.

entries.source: The history between the 2 factions is long and complicated.
entries.translation: 2 个阵营之间的历史漫长而复杂。
entries.sampleRaw: The history between the 2 factions is long and complicated.
entries.numericSource: The history between the {{N0}} factions is long and complicated.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}} 个阵营之间的历史漫长而复杂。

entries.source: Talk to the villagers and come back to me.
entries.translation: 和村民们谈谈，然后回来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to the villagers and come back to me.

entries.source: Make sure you also talk to villagers from the other faction before you make your choice.
entries.translation: 在你做出选择之前，确保你也和另一个阵营的村民谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Make sure you also talk to villagers from the other faction before you make your choice.

entries.source: So you talked to a few villagers from both factions? Nice.
entries.translation: 所以你和两个阵营的几位村民都谈过了？不错。
entries.sampleRaw: So you talked to a few villagers from both factions? Nice.

entries.source: I hope you know which faction you want to join. But don't worry, you'll be able to change factions if you want.
entries.translation: 我希望你知道自己想加入哪个阵营。但别担心，如果你想的话，你之后可以更换阵营。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you know which faction you want to join. But don't worry, you'll be able to change factions if you want.

entries.source: However, changing factions usually means that you become unfriendly with your current faction.
entries.translation: 不过，更换阵营通常意味着你会与你当前的阵营变得不友好。
entries.sampleRaw: However, changing factions usually means that you become unfriendly with your current faction.

entries.source: Anyways, which faction did you choose?
entries.translation: 总之，你选择了哪个阵营？
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, which faction did you choose?

entries.source: Hum, so you chose the Mage Faction then.
entries.translation: 嗯，那么你选择了法师阵营。
entries.sampleRaw: Hum, so you chose the §cMage Faction§f then.

entries.source: It's not going to be easy to join them.
entries.translation: 加入他们可不会容易。
entries.sampleRaw: It's not going to be easy to join them.

entries.source: You first have to prove your worth if you want to have a chance at joining their ranks.
entries.translation: 如果你想有机会加入他们的行列，首先必须证明自己的价值。
entries.sampleRaw: You first have to prove your worth if you want to have a chance at joining their ranks.

entries.source: Hum, let me think...
entries.translation: 嗯，让我想想……
entries.sampleRaw: Hum, let me think...

entries.source: Oh! I know what you should do!
entries.translation: 哦！我知道你该做什么了！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh! I know what you should do!

entries.source: The Taika people really like educated individuals.
entries.translation: 泰卡人非常喜欢有学识的人。
entries.sampleRaw: The §cTaika§f people really like educated individuals.

entries.source: If you can bring them back a book or a piece of technology they have never seen before, I'm sure they will take a liking to you.
entries.translation: 如果你能给他们带回一本他们从未见过的书或一件科技产品，我相信他们会喜欢你的。
entries.sampleRaw: If you can bring them back a book or a piece of technology they have never seen before, I'm sure they will take a liking to you.

entries.source: I couldn't help but notice that you come from the place we commonly know as The Hub.
entries.translation: 我忍不住注意到，你来自我们通常称为中心岛的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: I couldn't help but notice that you come from the place we commonly know as The Hub.

entries.source: In which case, you must have met Maddox?
entries.translation: 既然如此，那你一定见过Maddox了？
entries.sampleRaw: In which case, you must have met §cMaddox§f?

entries.source: Both Maddox and his brother are in fact from Scarleton, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the 2 brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
entries.translation: 其实Maddox和他的兄弟都来自斯卡雷顿，但与那里的其他居民不同，2兄弟生来就没有任何魔法天赋。
entries.sampleRaw: Both §cMaddox §fand his brother are in fact from §5Scarleton§f, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the 2 brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
entries.numericSource: Both Maddox and his brother are in fact from Scarleton, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the {{N0}} brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
entries.numericTranslation: 其实Maddox和他的兄弟都来自斯卡雷顿，但与那里的其他居民不同，{{N0}}兄弟生来就没有任何魔法天赋。

entries.source: In fact, they instead showed that they had immense strength, and a taste for violence.
entries.translation: 事实上，他们反而展现出了巨大的力量，以及对暴力的嗜好。
entries.sampleRaw: In fact, they instead showed that they had immense strength, and a taste for violence.

entries.source: They got banned from the Academy during their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.
entries.translation: 他们在第一年就被学院禁止入内，甚至在一场可怕的事件后被逐出了这座岛。
entries.sampleRaw: They got banned from the §7Academy §fduring their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.

entries.source: But I digress. My point is they are both Taika, and I know for a fact that Aatrox is crafting simple Ability Phones for his brother.
entries.translation: 不过扯远了。我的意思是他们俩都是泰卡人，而且我确切知道Aatrox正在为他的兄弟制作简易的能力手机。
entries.sampleRaw: But I digress. My point is they are both §cTaika§f, and I know for a fact that §cAatrox §fis crafting simple §2Ability Phones §ffor his brother.

entries.source: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from Maddox. I keep losing them.
entries.translation: 其实我自己就有一部。来，拿去吧，我再向Maddox要一部就是了。我总是把它们弄丢。
entries.sampleRaw: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from §cMaddox§f. I keep losing them.

entries.source: Bring this to the Dean of the Academy in Scarleton, I'm sure he will find it quite interesting.
entries.translation: 把这个带给斯卡雷顿学院的Dean，我相信他会觉得这很有意思。
entries.sampleRaw: Bring this to the §2Dean of the Academy §fin §5Scarleton§f, I'm sure he will find it quite interesting.

entries.source: The Cathedral got reorganized a while ago, now a large portion of it is used for the Academy.
entries.translation: 大教堂前段时间进行了重组，现在其中很大一部分被用作学院。
entries.sampleRaw: The §2Cathedral §fgot reorganized a while ago, now a large portion of it is used for the §2Academy§f.

entries.source: Oh wow, it worked! I'm so happy for you!
entries.translation: 哦哇，成功了！我真为你高兴！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh wow, it worked! I'm so happy for you!

entries.source: And you even got an Abiphone! Take my contact so we can stay in touch.
entries.translation: 而且你甚至拿到了一部Abiphone！收下我的联系方式吧，这样我们就能保持联系了。
entries.sampleRaw: And you even got an Abiphone! Take my §acontact §fso we can stay in touch.

entries.source: Nice! So what are you up to?
entries.translation: 不错！那你最近在忙什么？
entries.sampleRaw: Nice! So what are you up to?

entries.source: The Dean told you his research got stolen?!
entries.translation: Dean告诉你他的研究被偷了？！
entries.sampleRaw: The Dean told you his research got stolen?!

entries.source: Ah, it's not so surprising, maybe you don't know but the Piglins are not so fond of the Taika people.
entries.translation: 啊，这倒不奇怪，也许你不知道，但猪灵并不怎么喜欢泰卡人。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, it's not so surprising, maybe you don't know but the Piglins are not so fond of the Taika people.

entries.source: I do have an idea where that stolen research might be, follow me.
entries.translation: 我确实知道那份被偷的研究可能在哪里，跟我来。
entries.sampleRaw: I do have an idea where that stolen research might be, follow me.

entries.source: You see this giant Dragon Skull inside the Barbarian Faction?
entries.translation: 你看到野蛮人阵营里那个巨大的龙骷髅了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You see this giant Dragon Skull inside the Barbarian Faction?

entries.source: That's the skeleton of Jythar the Eternal one - the one who caused the destruction of the world.
entries.translation: 那是永恒者Jythar的骸骨——正是他导致了世界的毁灭。
entries.sampleRaw: That's the skeleton of §cJythar the Eternal one §f- the one who caused the destruction of the world.

entries.source: Now you probably understand why the village in front is called Dragontail.
entries.translation: 现在你大概明白为什么前面的村庄叫龙尾镇了吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Now you probably understand why the village in front is called §cDragontail§f.

entries.source: Anyways, the Barbarians built their Bastion inside the skeleton, and I suspect this is where the stolen object is guarded.
entries.translation: 总之，野蛮人在骷髅内部建造了他们的堡垒，我怀疑被偷的东西就守卫在那里。

styleMappings.the stolen object is guarded: 被偷的东西就守卫在那里

entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, the Barbarians built their §cBastion§f inside the skeleton, and I suspect this is where §2the stolen object is guarded§f.

entries.source: Piglins fear the growing power of the Taika Kingdom, so they most likely stole it to study the research.
entries.translation: 猪灵畏惧泰卡王国日益增长的力量，所以他们很可能偷走它来研究这份成果。
entries.sampleRaw: Piglins fear the growing power of the Taika Kingdom, so they most likely stole it to study the research.

entries.source: Maybe you could sneak in and recover the item. Without getting seen and creating a major diplomatic incident, of course.
entries.translation: 也许你可以潜进去取回那件物品。当然，别被看见，也别引发重大外交事件。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe you could sneak in and recover the item. Without getting seen and creating a major diplomatic incident, of course.

entries.source: I'm not sure exactly where they keep it, but just make sure you don't get seen by the guards!
entries.translation: 我不确定他们具体把它放在哪里，但一定要确保别被守卫看见！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not sure exactly where they keep it, but just make sure you don't get seen by the guards!

entries.source: I can't help you however, I have way too much to lose sorry. But good luck!
entries.translation: 不过我没法帮你，抱歉，我要失去的东西太多了。祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't help you however, I have way too much to lose sorry. But good luck!

entries.source: Piglins can't see very far because of the fog, just don't stand in front of them.
entries.translation: 因为雾气，猪灵看不了太远，只要别站在他们正前方就行。
entries.sampleRaw: Piglins can't see very far because of the fog, just don't stand in front of them.

entries.source: Do you even know what you are looking for? Maybe a book or a magical item?
entries.translation: 你到底知不知道自己在找什么？也许是一本书或一件魔法物品？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you even know what you are looking for? Maybe a book or a magical item?

entries.source: ✆ Hello? Oh, you are still alive, awesome!
entries.translation: ✆ 喂？哦，你还活着，太棒了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHello? Oh, you are still alive, awesome!

entries.source: ✆ Have you got the research back or did you chicken out?
entries.translation: ✆ 你把研究拿回来了，还是临阵退缩了？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHave you got the research back or did you chicken out?

entries.source: ✆ Great! You are cooler than you look!
entries.translation: ✆ 太好了！你比看起来还要酷！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fGreat! You are cooler than you look!

entries.source: ✆ Go back to the Dean then, I'm sure this will grant you a lot of reputation!
entries.translation: ✆ 那就回到Dean吧，我确信这会为你赢得大量声望！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fGo back to the Dean then, I'm sure this will grant you a lot of reputation!

entries.source: ✆ Alright then! I have to go now, was nice talking to you!
entries.translation: ✆ 那好吧！我现在得走了，和你聊天很愉快！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAlright then! I have to go now, was nice talking to you!

entries.source: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hum.
entries.translation: 你想加入野蛮人阵营，嗯。
entries.sampleRaw: You want to join the §cBarbarian Faction§f, hum.

entries.source: What a strange choice.
entries.translation: 真是个奇怪的选择。
entries.sampleRaw: What a strange choice.

entries.source: In any case, I have no idea how to guarantee your entry in their faction!
entries.translation: 无论如何，我完全不知道怎样才能保证你进入他们的阵营！
entries.sampleRaw: In any case, I have no idea how to guarantee your entry in their faction!

entries.source: But let's not get discouraged just yet, we'll find something I'm sure.
entries.translation: 但先别灰心，我们一定能找到办法的。
entries.sampleRaw: But let's not get discouraged just yet, we'll find something I'm sure.

entries.source: Piglins crave Sulphur. Our first goal should be to find some.
entries.translation: 猪灵渴望硫磺。我们的首要目标应该是找到一些。
entries.sampleRaw: §cPiglins §fcrave §2Sulphur§f. Our first goal should be to find some.

entries.source: There are only 2 ways to get Sulphur.
entries.translation: 获取硫磺只有2种方法。
entries.sampleRaw: There are only 2 ways to get §2Sulphur§f.
entries.numericSource: There are only {{N0}} ways to get Sulphur.
entries.numericTranslation: 获取硫磺只有{{N0}}种方法。

entries.source: You either wait for the Volcano to erupt, or you find a Corrupted Monster.
entries.translation: 你要么等待火山喷发，要么找到一只腐化怪物。
entries.sampleRaw: You either wait for the §cVolcano §fto erupt, or you find a §2Corrupted Monster§f.

entries.source: And guess what, I know where to look!
entries.translation: 你猜怎么着，我知道该去哪儿找！
entries.sampleRaw: And guess what, I know where to look!

entries.source: Follow me!
entries.translation: 跟我来！
entries.sampleRaw: Follow me!

entries.source: So you want to join the Barbarian Faction then...
entries.translation: 那么你想加入野蛮人阵营……
entries.sampleRaw: So you want to join the Barbarian Faction then...

entries.source: I do have an idea how you could do it.
entries.translation: 我确实有个办法能让你做到。
entries.sampleRaw: I do have an idea how you could do it.

entries.source: Look, we found one! A Corrupted Monster!
entries.translation: 看，我们找到一只了！一只腐化怪物！
entries.sampleRaw: Look, we found one! A §2Corrupted Monster§f!

entries.source: It's just ahead of us, the Burning Spider!
entries.translation: 它就在我们前面，燃烧蜘蛛！
entries.sampleRaw: It's just ahead of us, the §2Burning Spider§f!

entries.source: Go fight it, good luck!
entries.translation: 去和它战斗吧，祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: Go fight it, good luck!

entries.source: You handled that quite well.
entries.translation: 你处理得相当不错。
entries.sampleRaw: You handled that quite well.

entries.source: Corrupted Monsters rarely appear on the island, it usually means they consumed too much Sulphur.
entries.translation: 腐化怪物很少出现在岛上，这通常意味着它们摄入了过多的硫磺。
entries.sampleRaw: §2Corrupted Monsters §frarely appear on the island, it usually means they consumed too much §2Sulphur§f.

entries.source: Oink
entries.translation: 哼唧
entries.sampleRaw: Oink

entries.source: Did you hear that?
entries.translation: 你听到了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Did you hear that?

entries.source: I think it was coming from here!
entries.translation: 我觉得声音是从这边传来的！
entries.sampleRaw: I think it was coming from here!

entries.source: Let's go.
entries.translation: 我们走吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's go.

entries.source: This Piglin got lost!
entries.translation: 这只猪灵迷路了！
entries.sampleRaw: This §cPiglin§f got lost!

entries.source: They probably got cornered by monsters and had to hide here.
entries.translation: 它们大概是被怪物逼到角落，只好躲在这里。
entries.sampleRaw: They probably got cornered by monsters and had to hide here.

entries.source: Piglins turn back into pigs if they go too long without Sulphur.
entries.translation: 猪灵如果太久没有硫磺，就会变回猪。
entries.sampleRaw: §cPiglins §fturn back into pigs if they go too long without §2Sulphur§f.

entries.source: That Corrupted Monster should have dropped some Sulphur. Quick, give it to them!
entries.translation: 那只腐化怪物应该掉落了一些硫磺。快，把它交给它们！
entries.sampleRaw: That §2Corrupted Monster§f should have dropped some §2Sulphur§f. Quick, give it to them!

entries.source: You saved me!
entries.translation: 你救了我！
entries.sampleRaw: You saved me!

entries.source: Memory is failing me but I think I remember getting attacked.
entries.translation: 我的记忆有些模糊，但我好像记得自己遭到了攻击。
entries.sampleRaw: Memory is failing me but I think I remember getting attacked.

entries.source: My leg got hurt and I had to hide here, the rest is blurry...
entries.translation: 我的腿受伤了，只好躲在这里，后面的事就记不清了……
entries.sampleRaw: My leg got hurt and I had to hide here, the rest is blurry...

entries.source: How could you leave Dragontail without Sulphur on you!
entries.translation: 你怎么能不带硫磺就离开龙尾镇！
entries.sampleRaw: How could you leave §cDragontail §fwithout §2Sulphur §fon you!

entries.source: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for...
entries.translation: 我知道，是我大意了，我当时在执行任务……
entries.sampleRaw: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for...

entries.source: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!!
entries.translation: 硫磺！我父亲会杀了我的！！
entries.sampleRaw: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!!

entries.source: Let's not exaggerate.
entries.translation: 别夸张了。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's not exaggerate.

entries.source: You don't understand, my father is the Chief!
entries.translation: 你不明白，我父亲就是酋长！
entries.sampleRaw: You don't understand, my father is the §cChief§f!

entries.source: You were not exaggerating.
entries.translation: 你确实没夸张。
entries.sampleRaw: You were not exaggerating.

entries.source: Please help me, I have to present myself to him.
entries.translation: 求求你帮帮我，我得去见他。
entries.sampleRaw: Please help me, I have to present myself to him.

entries.source: Of course.
entries.translation: 当然。
entries.sampleRaw: Of course.

entries.source: I will shoulder you to the Chief's Hut.
entries.translation: 我扶你去酋长小屋。
entries.sampleRaw: I will shoulder you to the §cChief's Hut§f.

entries.source: <player> make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there.
entries.translation: <player>，确保路上怪物不会袭击我们。
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player>§f make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there.

entries.source: Ugo, where have you been?
entries.translation: Ugo，你去哪儿了？
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lUgo, where have you been?

entries.source: You had ONE job!
entries.translation: 你就只有一件事要做！
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lYou had ONE job!

entries.source: 3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!?
entries.translation: 3天后你回来，两手空空还断了条腿！？
entries.sampleRaw: §f§l3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!?
entries.numericSource: {{N0}} days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!?
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}天后你回来，两手空空还断了条腿！？

entries.source: Well-
entries.translation: 这个——
entries.sampleRaw: Well-

entries.source: And you two, what are your names?
entries.translation: 还有你们两个，叫什么名字？
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lAnd you two, what are your names?

entries.source: I'm-
entries.translation: 我是——
entries.sampleRaw: I'm-

entries.source: Thank you for saving my rascal of a son.
entries.translation: 谢谢你们救了我这个混账儿子。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lThank you for saving my rascal of a son.

entries.source: Are you looking to join our ranks?
entries.translation: 你们是想加入我们的队伍吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lAre you looking to join our ranks?

entries.source: No but-
entries.translation: 不是，但是——
entries.sampleRaw: No but-

entries.source: Perfect!
entries.translation: 太好了！
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lPerfect!

entries.source: I welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction!
entries.translation: 我欢迎你们两位加入蛮族阵营！
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction!

entries.source: If you betray us you'll die.
entries.translation: 如果你们背叛我们，就得死。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lIf you betray us you'll die.

entries.source: I can't-
entries.translation: 我不能——
entries.sampleRaw: I can't-

entries.source: Enough talking!
entries.translation: 别废话了！
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lEnough talking!

entries.source: Ugo, go back out there and finish the job!
entries.translation: Ugo，回去把任务完成！
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lUgo, go back out there and finish the job!

entries.source: But-
entries.translation: 可是——
entries.sampleRaw: But-

entries.source: Guards, escort them out of my Hut!
entries.translation: 卫兵，把他们赶出我的小屋！
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lGuards, escort them out of my Hut!

entries.source: My leg really hurts.
entries.translation: 我的腿真的很疼。
entries.sampleRaw: My leg really hurts.

entries.source: It was already quite bad before this fall but now...
entries.translation: 这次摔倒之前就已经挺严重了，但现在……
entries.sampleRaw: It was already quite bad before this fall but now...

entries.source: Your father sure has some character.
entries.translation: 你父亲还真是有个性。
entries.sampleRaw: Your father sure has some character.

entries.source: He's not that bad, you get used to it.
entries.translation: 他没那么糟，习惯就好了。
entries.sampleRaw: He's not that bad, you get used to it.

entries.source: I don't know what he wants you to do out there, but we can't let you go back there with your injured leg.
entries.translation: 我不知道他想让你在外面做什么，但我们不能让你带着伤腿回到那里去。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know what he wants you to do out there, but we can't let you go back there with your injured leg.

entries.source: I'm afraid I have to.
entries.translation: 恐怕我必须得去。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm afraid I have to.

entries.source: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you.
entries.translation: 你就告诉我们你要做什么，我们替你做。
entries.sampleRaw: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you.

entries.source: I can't tell you it's highly confidential.
entries.translation: 我不能说，这是高度机密。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't tell you it's highly confidential.

entries.source: I don't care, you can't go back out there with a broken leg.
entries.translation: 我不管，你不能拖着断腿回到那里去。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't care, you can't go back out there with a broken leg.

entries.source: Sigh
entries.translation: 唉
entries.sampleRaw: §f§oSigh

entries.source: My father believes that the Mage Faction is working on some kind of powerful war instrument.
entries.translation: 我父亲认为法师阵营正在研制某种强大的战争器械.
entries.sampleRaw: My father believes that the §cMage Faction §fis working on some kind of powerful §2war instrument.

entries.source: We know they are hiding something inside their Cathedral.
entries.translation: 我们知道他们在大教堂里藏着什么东西。
entries.sampleRaw: We know they are hiding something inside their §cCathedral§f.

entries.source: My job is to infiltrate their Cathedral and steal their war machine so we can study it.
entries.translation: 我的任务是潜入他们的大教堂，偷走他们的战争机器，好让我们研究它。
entries.sampleRaw: My job is to infiltrate their §cCathedral §fand steal their §2war machine §fso we can study it.

entries.source: Say no more, that's a perfect job for <player>.
entries.translation: 不用多说了，这活儿正适合<player>。
entries.sampleRaw: Say no more, that's a perfect job for §7<player>§f.

entries.source: Why them?
entries.translation: 为什么是他们？
entries.sampleRaw: Why them?

entries.source: Alright let's go.
entries.translation: 好吧，我们走。
entries.sampleRaw: Alright let's go.

entries.source: This is the Mage Cathedral.
entries.translation: 这就是法师大教堂。
entries.sampleRaw: This is the §cMage Cathedral§f.

entries.source: Your job is to enter the Cathedral and find the Dean's office.
entries.translation: 你的任务是进入大教堂,找到Dean的办公室.
entries.sampleRaw: Your job is to enter the §cCathedral§f and find the §cDean's office.

entries.source: They are probably hiding the research there.
entries.translation: 他们很可能把研究资料藏在那里。
entries.sampleRaw: They are probably hiding the §2research§f there.

entries.source: There are multiple entrances, most of them have guards but this one down there is often unprotected.
entries.translation: 这里有多个入口，大多数都有守卫，但下面这个通常无人看守。
entries.sampleRaw: There are multiple entrances, most of them have guards but this one down there is often unprotected.

entries.source: Good luck, I'll be right there in case you need moral support.
entries.translation: 祝你好运，我会一直在这儿，以防你需要精神支持。
entries.sampleRaw: Good luck, I'll be right there in case you need moral support.

entries.source: Don't get caught by the guards!
entries.translation: 别被守卫抓住！
entries.sampleRaw: Don't get caught by the guards!

entries.source: The Dean's office? I don't know where it is.
entries.translation: Dean的办公室？我不知道在哪儿。
entries.sampleRaw: The Dean's office? I don't know where it is.

entries.source: It's definitely in their Cathedral though, I know they reorganized a lot of it into an Academy.
entries.translation: 不过它肯定在他们的大教堂里，我知道他们把里面很多地方改造成了学院。
entries.sampleRaw: It's definitely in their Cathedral though, I know they reorganized a lot of it into an Academy.

entries.source: You got the right item?
entries.translation: 你拿到正确的物品了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You got the right item?

entries.source: Are you sure?
entries.translation: 你确定吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you sure?

entries.source: Okay great, let's leave this place. I have Mycelium all over my shoes.
entries.translation: 好极了，我们离开这地方吧。我鞋子上全是菌丝体。
entries.sampleRaw: Okay great, let's leave this place. I have Mycelium all over my shoes.

entries.source: Let's talk to Ugo again.
entries.translation: 我们再去找Ugo谈谈吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's talk to Ugo again.

entries.source: I'll use a Travel Scroll, see you there.
entries.translation: 我用传送卷轴过去，到那儿见。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll use a Travel Scroll, see you there.

entries.source: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
entries.translation: Captain Ahone，Ugo，这是个误会！
entries.sampleRaw: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!

entries.source: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
entries.translation: 我看到发生了什么！我全都看到了！
entries.sampleRaw: I saw what happened! I saw everything!

entries.source: A monstruous<sup>[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!
entries.translation: 一只怪异的<sup>[原文如此]<\/sup>生物正搬运着硫磺，堆积如山的硫磺！
entries.sampleRaw: A monstruous<sup>[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!

entries.source: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!
entries.translation: 那怪物长着巨大的触手，我这辈子从没见过那样的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life!

entries.source: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.
entries.translation: Elle of the Nether，别想骗我们。
entries.sampleRaw: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us.

entries.source: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.
entries.translation: 你的动机很高尚，但外交的时间已经结束了。
entries.sampleRaw: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over.

entries.source: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.
entries.translation: 野蛮人，立刻归还我们的硫磺，否则就承担你们行为的后果。
entries.sampleRaw: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions.

entries.source: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!
entries.translation: 我们偷了你们的硫磺？！你们这些巫师可真够胆大的！
entries.sampleRaw: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves!

entries.source: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!
entries.translation: 我们是循着你们抢走的硫磺的踪迹来到这里的！
entries.sampleRaw: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed!

entries.source: ENOUGH!
entries.translation: 够了！
entries.sampleRaw: ENOUGH!

entries.source: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!
entries.translation: 你们俩都被抢了，这还不明显吗？！
entries.sampleRaw: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?!

entries.source: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
entries.translation: 罪魁祸首就在里面，而且既不是人类也不是猪灵。
entries.sampleRaw: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.

entries.source: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.
entries.translation: 我不知道它是什么，但我必须警告你们，那恶魔强大无比。
entries.sampleRaw: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful.

entries.source: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.
entries.translation: 现在，如果你们想取回硫磺，就跟我进去。
entries.sampleRaw: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside.

entries.source: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
entries.translation: 这个巨型触手怪物的故事是真的？
entries.sampleRaw: This giant tentacle monster story is real?

entries.source: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.
entries.translation: 我很难相信，但无论如何我们都得查个水落石出。
entries.sampleRaw: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.

entries.source: I agree, let's get inside.
entries.translation: 我同意，我们进去吧。
entries.sampleRaw: I agree, let's get inside.

entries.source: <player> if you know other strong adventurers, now is the time to bring them.
entries.translation: <player>，如果你认识其他强大的冒险者，现在是带他们来的时候了。
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player> §fif you know other strong adventurers, now is the time to bring them.

entries.source: This monster is something else, trust me.
entries.translation: 这怪物可不是一般的货色，相信我。
entries.sampleRaw: This monster is something else, trust me.

entries.source: Are you ready to fight?
entries.translation: 你准备好战斗了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you ready to fight?

entries.source: Come back when you are ready, hurry up!
entries.translation: 准备好再回来，快点！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you are ready, hurry up!

entries.source: Are you ready?
entries.translation: 你准备好了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you ready?

entries.source: Perfect! Let's fight!
entries.translation: 太好了！我们开打吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Perfect! Let's fight!

entries.source: What a fight!
entries.translation: 好一场战斗！
entries.sampleRaw: What a fight!

entries.source: And we got all the Sulphur back!
entries.translation: 而且我们把所有硫磺都拿回来了！
entries.sampleRaw: And we got all the Sulphur back!

entries.source: But what exactly was that monster?
entries.translation: 但那怪物到底是什么？
entries.sampleRaw: But what exactly was that monster?

entries.source: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
entries.translation: 不知道，这样的泰坦凭空出现可不是好兆头。
entries.sampleRaw: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.

entries.source: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.
entries.translation: 尤其是如果它是冲着我们的硫磺来的。
entries.sampleRaw: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.

entries.source: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.
entries.translation: 我们显然把它伤得很重，但据我们所知，它可能还活着。
entries.sampleRaw: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.

entries.source: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.
entries.translation: 野蛮人们，我想为之前指控你们而道歉。你们在外面打得很出色。
entries.sampleRaw: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.

entries.source: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly.
entries.translation: 别往心里去，我也太快评判你了。
entries.sampleRaw: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly.

entries.source: You too <player>, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you
entries.translation: 你也是，<player>，你和你的朋友们战斗得很勇敢，没有你们我们做不到。
entries.sampleRaw: You too §7<player>§f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you

entries.source: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste.
entries.translation: 我得向女王汇报，没时间浪费了。
entries.sampleRaw: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste.

entries.source: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go.
entries.translation: 我也会通知我们的首领。该走了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go.

entries.source: Is anyone going to thank me?
entries.translation: 有人打算谢谢我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is anyone going to thank me?

entries.source: Thanks for sticking around, you looked real cool out there!
entries.translation: 谢谢你留下来，你在外面看起来真酷！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for sticking around, you looked real cool out there!

entries.source: I really have to do everything around here.
entries.translation: 这里真是什么事都得我来做。
entries.sampleRaw: I really have to do everything around here.

entries.source: Talk with me to begin!
entries.translation: 和我对话以开始！
entries.sampleRaw: Talk with me to begin!

entries.source: Okay adventurers, I will go fish up Kuudra!
entries.translation: 好了冒险者们，我去把库德拉钓上来！
entries.sampleRaw: Okay adventurers, I will go fish up Kuudra!

entries.source: Head over to the main platform, I will join you when I get a bite!
entries.translation: 前往主平台，等有东西上钩我就来和你们会合！
entries.sampleRaw: Head over to the main platform, I will join you when I get a bite!

entries.source: THE KUUDRA IS COMING!
entries.translation: 库德拉来了！
entries.sampleRaw: THE KUUDRA IS COMING!

entries.source: It's coming!
entries.translation: 它来了！
entries.sampleRaw: It's coming!

entries.source: A lava kraken, Kuudra!
entries.translation: 一只熔岩海妖,库德拉!
entries.sampleRaw: A lava kraken, §cKuudra!

entries.source: This one is Angry!
entries.translation: 这一只很愤怒！
entries.sampleRaw: This one is Angry!

entries.source: THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!
entries.translation: 桥正在坍塌，快到中央去！
entries.sampleRaw: THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!

entries.source: Okay adventurers, I will go and fish up Kuudra!
entries.translation: 好了冒险者们，我去把库德拉钓上来！
entries.sampleRaw: Okay adventurers, I will go and fish up Kuudra!

entries.source: Nope, that's just a Magmafish!
entries.translation: 不，那只是一条岩浆鱼！
entries.sampleRaw: Nope, that's just a Magmafish!

entries.source: Wait... I think I've hooked onto something!
entries.translation: 等等……我想我钓到什么东西了！
entries.sampleRaw: Wait... I think I've hooked onto something!

entries.source: Whatever it is, it sure is big! This might be it!
entries.translation: 不管它是什么，它肯定很大！可能就是它！
entries.sampleRaw: Whatever it is, it sure is big! This might be it!

entries.source: Uh oh.
entries.translation: 哎呀。
entries.sampleRaw: Uh oh.

entries.source: Not again!
entries.translation: 又来了！
entries.sampleRaw: Not again!

entries.source: Phew... that was close!
entries.translation: 呼……好险！
entries.sampleRaw: Phew... that was close!

entries.source: ARGH! All of the supplies fell into the lava! You need to retrieve them quickly!
entries.translation: 啊！所有补给都掉进熔岩里了！你得赶快把它们捞回来！
entries.sampleRaw: ARGH! All of the §csupplies fell into the lava§f! You need to §cretrieve them quickly§f!

entries.source: Use your Lava Fishing Rods to pull them closer to the platform and collect them!
entries.translation: 用你的熔岩钓鱼竿把它们拉近平台并收集起来！
entries.sampleRaw: Use your §cLava Fishing Rods§f to §cpull them closer§f to the platform and collect them!

entries.source: I'll help you clear out Kuudra's minions, go fetch my supplies!
entries.translation: 我会帮你清理库德拉的仆从，去取回我的补给吧！
entries.sampleRaw: I'll help you clear out Kuudra's minions, go fetch my supplies!

entries.source: OMG! Great work collecting my supplies!
entries.translation: 天哪！收集我的补给干得漂亮！
entries.sampleRaw: OMG! Great work collecting my supplies!

entries.source: Now... please just cover me for a few minutes, I'll put together our special weapon!
entries.translation: 现在……请帮我掩护几分钟，我来组装我们的特殊武器！
entries.sampleRaw: Now... please just cover me for a few minutes, I'll put together our special weapon!

entries.source: It's time to build the Ballista again! Cover me!
entries.translation: 又该建造弩炮了！掩护我！
entries.sampleRaw: It's time to build the Ballista again! §cCover me§f!

entries.source: What the hell is that noise?! I think we've made him mad!
entries.translation: 那到底是什么声音？！我想我们把他惹怒了！
entries.sampleRaw: What the hell is that noise?! I think we've made him mad!

entries.source: Looks like the horde is coming! Cover me!
entries.translation: 看来兽群要来了！掩护我！
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like the horde is coming! §cCover me§f!

entries.source: Damaging Kuudra directly is futile. His thick skin is impenetrable with conventional weapons!
entries.translation: 直接伤害库德拉是徒劳的.常规武器无法穿透他厚实的皮肤!

styleMappings.His thick skin is impenetrable: 常规武器无法穿透他厚实的皮肤

entries.sampleRaw: Damaging Kuudra directly is futile. §cHis thick skin is impenetrable§f with conventional weapons!

entries.source: BRUH
entries.translation: 呃啊
entries.sampleRaw: BRUH

entries.source: That's a lot of damage!
entries.translation: 伤害可真高！
entries.sampleRaw: That's a lot of damage!

entries.source: I'm sure that'll buff out... I hope..
entries.translation: 我确定那能修好的……希望吧……
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sure that'll buff out... I hope..

entries.source: Argh, that didn't sound healthy.
entries.translation: 唉，那声音听起来可不妙。
entries.sampleRaw: Argh, that didn't sound healthy.

entries.source: Guys!! You need to focus the tentacles!
entries.translation: 伙计们！！你们得集中攻击触手！
entries.sampleRaw: Guys!! You need to focus the tentacles!

entries.source: Those Energized Chunks really pack a punch when they explode! Try hitting them towards Kuudra!
entries.translation: 那些充能碎块爆炸时威力可真不小！试着把它们打向库德拉！
entries.sampleRaw: Those Energized Chunks really pack a punch when they explode! Try hitting them towards Kuudra!

entries.source: A Dropship is approaching! Take it down before it's too late!
entries.translation: 一艘空投舰正在接近！趁还来得及，把它击落！
entries.sampleRaw: A §cDropship§f is approaching! Take it down before it's too late!

entries.source: A fleet of Dropships are approaching! Take them down before it's too late!
entries.translation: 一支空投舰队正在接近！趁还来得及，把它们击落！
entries.sampleRaw: A fleet of §cDropships§f are approaching! Take them down before it's too late!

entries.source: Look out, Magma Followers! Don't let them merge!
entries.translation: 小心，熔岩追随者！别让它们融合！
entries.sampleRaw: Look out, §cMagma Followers§f! Don't let them merge!

entries.source: A group of Wandering Blazes are emerging from Kuudra's mouth!
entries.translation: 一群游荡烈焰人正从库德拉的嘴里涌出！
entries.sampleRaw: A group of §cWandering Blazes§f are emerging from Kuudra's mouth!

entries.source: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blows now!
entries.translation: 呼！弩炮终于准备好了！它现在应该足够坚固，能承受库德拉的攻击了！
entries.sampleRaw: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blows now!

entries.source: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it must have fallen in the lava with the rest of my supplies!
entries.translation: 我们得找到弩炮的燃料,它肯定和我的其他补给一起掉进熔岩里了!

styleMappings.must have fallen in the lava: 肯定和我的其他补给一起掉进熔岩里了

entries.sampleRaw: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it §cmust §chave fallen in the lava§f with the rest of my supplies!

entries.source: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to shoot him with the Ballista!
entries.translation: 看来库德拉又出现了！该用弩炮射他了！
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to §cshoot him with the Ballista§f!

entries.source: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blow!
entries.translation: 呼！弩炮终于准备好了！它现在应该足够坚固，能承受库德拉的一击了！
entries.sampleRaw: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blow!

entries.source: We need to find fuel for the Ballista, it must be fallen into the lava with the rest of my supplies!
entries.translation: 我们得找到弩炮的燃料,它肯定和我的其他补给一起掉进熔岩里了!

styleMappings.must be fallen into the lava: 肯定和我的其他补给一起掉进熔岩里了

entries.sampleRaw: We need to find fuel for the Ballista, it §cmust be fallen into the lava§f with the rest of my supplies!

entries.source: Huh, what is that noise?
entries.translation: 咦，那是什么声音？
entries.sampleRaw: Huh, what is that noise?

entries.source: Whow...WHOW! What's happening!!
entries.translation: 哇……哇啊！发生什么了！！
entries.sampleRaw: Whow...WHOW! What's happening!!

entries.source: *muffles*Help! I'm still alive in here! It stinks!
entries.translation: *闷声*救命！我还活着，就在这里面！好臭！
entries.sampleRaw: §8*muffles*§fHelp! §cI'm still alive in here§f! It stinks!

entries.source: *muffles*I think I'm in Kuudra's Belly! I was standing too close!
entries.translation: *闷声*我想我在库德拉的肚子里！我站得太近了！
entries.sampleRaw: §8*muffles*§fI think I'm in §cKuudra's Belly§f! I was standing too close!

entries.source: *muffles*See if you can find a way to get in here too! I see something which may help us kill Kuudra!
entries.translation: *闷声*看看你能不能找到办法也进来!我看到了一些可能帮我们杀死库德拉的东西!

styleMappings.*muffles*See if you can find a way to: *闷声*看看你能不能找到办法

entries.sampleRaw: §8*muffles*See if you can find a way to §cget in here too§f! I see something which may §chelp us kill Kuudra§f!

entries.source: Oh, funny seeing you here.
entries.translation: 哦，在这儿见到你可真巧。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, funny seeing you here.

entries.source: What? Yes I am still alive. I landed in Kuudra's belly here.
entries.translation: 什么？是的，我还活着。我落到了库德拉的肚子里。
entries.sampleRaw: What? Yes I am still alive. I landed in Kuudra's belly here.

entries.source: It looks like if we mine these purple pods, we can do some real damage to Kuudra!
entries.translation: 看来如果我们开采这些紫色荚囊，就能对库德拉造成真正的伤害！
entries.sampleRaw: It looks like if we §cmine these purple pods§f, we can do some §creal damage§f to Kuudra!

entries.source: Oh come on! What is it this time!
entries.translation: 哦拜托！这次又是什么！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh come on! What is it this time!

entries.source: I'll fight the mobs, you focus on destroying these pods!
entries.translation: 我来对付这些怪物，你专心摧毁这些荚囊！
entries.sampleRaw: I'll fight the mobs, you §cfocus on destroying these pods§f!

entries.source: The lava level is rising inside Kuudra! He must have submerged under the lava!
entries.translation: 库德拉体内的熔岩水位正在上升！他一定是潜到熔岩下面去了！
entries.sampleRaw: The §clava level is rising§f inside Kuudra! He §cmust have submerged§f under the lava!

entries.source: We need to get out before we burn in this lava!
entries.translation: 我们得在被这熔岩烧死之前逃出去！
entries.sampleRaw: We need to §cget out§f before we burn in this lava!

entries.source: We can escape back out his throat at the top of his stomach!
entries.translation: 我们可以从他胃部顶端顺着他的喉咙逃出去！
entries.sampleRaw: We can §cescape back out his throat§f at the top of his stomach!

entries.source: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah
entries.translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊
entries.sampleRaw: §oaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah§f

entries.source: When Kuudra submerges, we will be flushed out of his stomach! We need to get back inside but be careful when he submerges!
entries.translation: 库德拉潜入熔岩时，我们会被从他的胃里冲出去！我们得重新回到里面，但他潜入时要小心！
entries.sampleRaw: When Kuudra submerges, we will be §cflushed out of his stomach§f! We need to §cget back inside§f but be careful when he submerges!

entries.source: That looks like it hurt! Quickly, while Kuudra is distracted shoot him with the Ballista!
entries.translation: 那看起来一定很疼！快，趁库德拉分心的时候用弩炮射他！

styleMappings.Kuudra is distracted shoot him with the: 库德拉分心的时候用弩炮射他

entries.sampleRaw: That looks like it hurt! Quickly, while §cKuudra is distracted shoot him with the Ballista§f!

entries.source: POW! SURELY THAT'S IT! I don't think he has any more in him!
entries.translation: 砰！这下肯定成了！我觉得他撑不住了！
entries.sampleRaw: POW! SURELY THAT'S IT! I don't think he has any more in him!

entries.source: I knew you could do it!
entries.translation: 我就知道你能做到！
entries.sampleRaw: I knew you could do it!

entries.source: One last flail before admitting defeat, huh?
entries.translation: 认输前还要最后挣扎一下，是吧？
entries.sampleRaw: One last flail before admitting defeat, huh?

entries.source: Good job everyone. A hard fought battle come to an end. Let's get out of here before we run into any more trouble!
entries.translation: 大家干得好。一场苦战终于结束了。趁还没遇到更多麻烦，我们赶紧离开这里！
entries.sampleRaw: Good job everyone. A hard fought battle come to an end. Let's get out of here before we run into any more trouble!

entries.source: What's happening? Why isn't he dying?
entries.translation: 怎么回事？他怎么还不死？
entries.sampleRaw: What's happening? Why isn't he dying?

entries.source: What just happened? Is this Kuudra's real lair?
entries.translation: 刚才发生了什么？这里才是库德拉真正的巢穴吗？
entries.sampleRaw: What just happened? Is this Kuudra's real lair?

entries.source: I'm not going down there... that's all you.
entries.translation: 我可不会下去……那就全靠你了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not going down there... that's all you.

entries.source: Hey!
entries.translation: 嘿！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey!

entries.source: How do you like your Faction?
entries.translation: 你觉得你的阵营怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: How do you like your Faction?

entries.source: If you want to swap Factions let me know, it really isn't that hard.
entries.translation: 如果你想更换阵营就告诉我，其实没那么难。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to swap Factions let me know, it really isn't that hard.

entries.source: All you have to do is lose all your Reputation points, we call that "becoming neutral".
entries.translation: 你只需要失去所有声望点数，我们称之为“转为中立”。
entries.sampleRaw: All you have to do is lose all your Reputation points, we call that "becoming neutral".

entries.source: If you go neutral, let me know!
entries.translation: 如果你转为中立了，就告诉我！
entries.sampleRaw: If you go neutral, let me know!

entries.source: Do you want to change your Faction?
entries.translation: 你想更换你的阵营吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you want to change your Faction?

entries.source: Great!
entries.translation: 太好了！
entries.sampleRaw: Great!

entries.source: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hmm.
entries.translation: 你想加入野蛮人阵营，嗯。
entries.sampleRaw: You want to join the §cBarbarian Faction§f, hmm.

entries.source: So you want to join the Mage Faction then...
entries.translation: 那么你想加入法师阵营……
entries.sampleRaw: So you want to join the Mage Faction then...

entries.source: You want to change factions AGAIN?!
entries.translation: 你又想换阵营了？！
entries.sampleRaw: You want to change factions AGAIN?!

entries.source: Well because you already joined that faction in the past, all you have to do is go to their Community Center.
entries.translation: 因为你过去已经加入过那个阵营，所以你只需要去他们的社区中心。
entries.sampleRaw: Well because you already joined that faction in the past, all you have to do is go to their Community Center.

entries.source: From their Town Board you can sign up to their Faction again as long as you were a part of it in the past!
entries.translation: 只要你在过去曾是其中一员，就可以从他们的城镇公告板再次报名加入他们的阵营！
entries.sampleRaw: From their Town Board you can sign up to their Faction again as long as you were a part of it in the past!

entries.source: I'm right here, don't get lost.
entries.translation: 我就在这儿，别走丢了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm right here, don't get lost.

entries.source: Are you a snail?
entries.translation: 你是蜗牛吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you a snail?

entries.source: Hello?
entries.translation: 喂？
entries.sampleRaw: Hello?

entries.source: What's taking so long?
entries.translation: 怎么这么久？
entries.sampleRaw: What's taking so long?

entries.source: Did you get lost?
entries.translation: 你迷路了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Did you get lost?

entries.source: Hey are you following?
entries.translation: 嘿，你跟着吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey are you following?

entries.source: I'M UP HERE! ON TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN!!
entries.translation: 我在上面！在山顶上！！
entries.sampleRaw: I'M UP HERE! ON TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN!!

entries.source: Sometimes, after a long day of fighting incomprehensible horrors in the Crimson Isle, you just want to kick back.
entries.translation: 有时候，在绯红之岛与难以理解的恐怖生物战斗了一整天后，你只想放松一下。
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes, after a long day of fighting incomprehensible horrors in the §cCrimson Isle§f, you just want to kick back.

entries.source: Time to kick back and put my feet up, at least until tomorrow!
entries.translation: 是时候放松一下，把脚翘起来了，至少到明天为止！
entries.sampleRaw: Time to kick back and put my feet up, at least until tomorrow!

entries.source: Do you have any idea how many Mushroom Bulls I'll have to go through just to find a single high-quality mushroom?
entries.translation: 你知道我得打多少只蘑菇牛，才能找到一株高品质的蘑菇吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you have any idea how many Mushroom Bulls I'll have to go through just to find a §osingle §r§fhigh-quality mushroom?

entries.source: A monstruous[sic] creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur!

entries.translation: 你看，最近我和高塔里的那位巫师聊过
entries.sampleRaw: You see, recently I spoke to the wizard up in his big tower

entries.source: He told me that he finally got his portal to work
entries.translation: 他告诉我，他的传送门终于能用了
entries.sampleRaw: He told me that he finally got his portal to work

entries.source: And that he knew of an alternate version of himself who existed, stuck in another world
entries.translation: 他还说他知道存在一个另一个版本的自己，被困在另一个世界里
entries.sampleRaw: And that he knew of an §dalternate version of himself §fwho existed, stuck in §canother world

entries.source: I wonder if there is an alternate version of myself out there too
entries.translation: 我在想，外面是不是也有另一个版本的我
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder if there is an alternate version of myself out there too

entries.source: But would he still really be me?
entries.translation: 但他真的还会是我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: But would he still really be me?

entries.source: If he has lived in such a different world and experienced so many different things
entries.translation: 如果他生活在如此不同的世界，经历过那么多不同的事
entries.sampleRaw: If he has lived in such a different world and experienced so many different things

entries.source: Is he still me by anything other than name?
entries.translation: 除了名字之外，他还算是我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is he still me by anything other than §9name§f?

entries.source: I am Tal Ker, and I speak often and loud
entries.translation: 我是Tal Ker，我说话频繁而响亮
entries.sampleRaw: I am Tal Ker, and I speak often and loud

entries.source: But what if he is Tal Ker, who speaks little and softly
entries.translation: 但如果他是Tal Ker，说话少而轻柔呢
entries.sampleRaw: But what if he is Tal Ker, who speaks little and softly

entries.source: What if he has lived an entire life in silence
entries.translation: 如果他一生都活在沉默中呢
entries.sampleRaw: What if he has lived an entire life in silence

entries.source: Not feeling like anyone cares for what he has to say
entries.translation: 觉得没人在意他想说什么
entries.sampleRaw: Not feeling like anyone cares for what he has to say

entries.source: So he simply does not speak
entries.translation: 于是他干脆不说话
entries.sampleRaw: So he simply does not speak

entries.source: In that case, are we still the same Tal Ker?
entries.translation: 那样的话，我们还是同一个Tal Ker吗？
entries.sampleRaw: In that case, are we still the same Tal Ker?

entries.source: Maybe he speaks through song
entries.translation: 也许他通过歌声来表达
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe he speaks through song

entries.source: And passes time by playing the piano
entries.translation: 靠弹钢琴来打发时间
entries.sampleRaw: And passes time by playing the piano

entries.source: Maybe he's been playing for so long that he's gotten really good at it
entries.translation: 也许他玩得太久了，已经变得非常擅长了
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe he's been playing for so long that he's gotten really good at it

entries.source: And, if we ever met, maybe we would just sit in silence
entries.translation: 而且，如果我们真的见面了，也许我们只会静静地坐着
entries.sampleRaw: And, if we ever met, maybe we would just sit in silence

entries.source: And he would play me a song
entries.translation: 然后他会为我弹一首曲子
entries.sampleRaw: And he would play me a song

entries.source: And he would share with me tales of his life, and his strange world, all without saying a word.
entries.translation: 他会与我分享他的人生故事，还有他那奇异的世界，全程一言不发。
entries.sampleRaw: And he would share with me tales of his life, and his §f§ostrange world§f, all without saying a word.

entries.source: Maybe if I went to this alternate dimension I would become like him
entries.translation: 也许如果我去了那个平行维度，我也会变得像他一样
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe if I went to this §dalternate dimension §fI would become like him

entries.source: Maybe I would speak less, think more
entries.translation: 也许我会少说些话，多想些事
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I would speak less, think more

entries.source: And maybe you would come along one day
entries.translation: 也许有一天你会来到这里
entries.sampleRaw: And maybe you would come along one day

entries.source: And tell me that I've changed
entries.translation: 然后告诉我，我变了
entries.sampleRaw: And tell me that I've changed

entries.source: And maybe I would tell you that I have never been more me
entries.translation: 也许我会告诉你，我从未如此像我自己
entries.sampleRaw: And maybe I would tell you that I have never been more me

entries.source: Because maybe I shouldn't worry that my alternate self isn't enough like me
entries.translation: 因为也许我不该担心我的另一个自己不够像我
entries.sampleRaw: Because maybe I shouldn't worry that my alternate self isn't enough like me

entries.source: Maybe I should worry that I'm not more like my alternate self
entries.translation: 也许我该担心的是，我不够像我的另一个自己
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I should worry that I'm not more like my alternate self

entries.source: You know?
entries.translation: 你懂吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You know?

entries.source: I wonder what your alternate self is like
entries.translation: 我很好奇你的另一个自己是什么样子
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder what your alternate self is like

entries.source: Maybe they are a florist
entries.translation: 也许他们是个花匠
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe they are a florist

entries.source: And they give out flowers to everyone, even if they can't afford them
entries.translation: 他们会把花送给所有人，即使对方买不起
entries.sampleRaw: And they give out flowers to everyone, even if they can't afford them

entries.source: Maybe that's why you are short on flowers in this life
entries.translation: 也许这就是为什么你这一世缺花
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe that's why you are short on flowers in this life

entries.source: Because your other self gave them all away
entries.translation: 因为你的另一个自己把它们全送出去了
entries.sampleRaw: Because your other self gave them all away

entries.source: I am not a pest
entries.translation: 我不是害虫
entries.sampleRaw: I am not a pest

entries.source: But given that you see me as such, I shall depart.
entries.translation: 但既然你这么看我，那我就告辞了。
entries.sampleRaw: But given that you see me as such, I shall depart.

entries.source: Adieu!
entries.translation: 再会！
entries.sampleRaw: Adieu!

entries.source: Wow there, you found us!
entries.translation: 哇哦，你找到我们了！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow there, you found us!

entries.source: Are you trying to stop us from doing our suspicious activities?
entries.translation: 你是想阻止我们进行可疑活动吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you trying to stop us from doing our suspicious activities?

entries.source: We are the Cult of the Fallen Star, we mean no harm.
entries.translation: 我们是陨星教团，我们没有恶意。
entries.sampleRaw: We are the §dCult of the Fallen Star§f, we mean no harm.

entries.source: To be honest, we just want to look cool.
entries.translation: 说实话，我们只是想看起来很酷。
entries.sampleRaw: To be honest, we just want to look cool.

entries.source: Wanna join us?
entries.translation: 想加入我们吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Wanna join us?

entries.source: Nice! Well, take this.
entries.translation: 太好了！那么，拿着这个。
entries.sampleRaw: Nice! Well, take this.

entries.source: It's one of our Fallen Star Helmets.
entries.translation: 这是我们的陨星头盔之一。
entries.sampleRaw: It's one of our §dFallen Star Helmets§f.

entries.source: Wear it in our next meetings!
entries.translation: 下次聚会时戴上它！
entries.sampleRaw: Wear it in our next meetings!

entries.source: Rude.
entries.translation: 真没礼貌。
entries.sampleRaw: Rude.

entries.source: Eager to join our cult I see?
entries.translation: 看来你迫不及待想加入我们的教团了？
entries.sampleRaw: Eager to join our cult I see?

entries.source: Come back to our next meeting in seven days while wearing the Fallen Star Helmet we gave you.
entries.translation: 七天后再来参加我们的下一次集会，记得戴上我们给你的陨星头盔。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back to our next meeting in §6seven days§f while wearing the §dFallen Star Helmet§f we gave you.

entries.source: Hey, <Player>! Glad you came to our cult meeting!
entries.translation: 嘿，<Player>！很高兴你来参加我们的教团集会！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, §7<Player>§f! Glad you came to our cult meeting!

entries.source: Long live the Fallen Star!!!!
entries.translation: 陨星万岁！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: Long live the §dFallen Star§f!!!!

entries.source: Here, have some of these cool looking stars we found.
entries.translation: 来，拿一些我们找到的漂亮星星吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, have some of these cool looking stars we found.

entries.source: Wait...
entries.translation: 等等……
entries.sampleRaw: Wait...

entries.source: Where's the Fallen Star Helmet we gave you?
entries.translation: 我们给你的陨星头盔呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Where's the §dFallen Star Helmet§f we gave you?

entries.source: You need it to join us!
entries.translation: 你需要它才能加入我们！
entries.sampleRaw: You need it to join us!

entries.source: Come back next time wearing our matching hat.
entries.translation: 下次来的时候戴上我们同款的帽子。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back next time wearing our matching hat.

entries.source: Hi again, <Player>.
entries.translation: 又见面了，<Player>。
entries.sampleRaw: Hi again, §7<Player>§f.

entries.source: We'll share some of our cool stars with you.
entries.translation: 我们会分你一些我们的漂亮星星。
entries.sampleRaw: We'll share some of our cool stars with you.

entries.source: Wanna get pizza after this cult meeting?
entries.translation: 这次教团集会结束后要不要一起去吃披萨？
entries.sampleRaw: Wanna get pizza after this cult meeting?

entries.source: We meet here every seven days at midnight. That's when the star is the brightest, after all.
entries.translation: 我们每七天午夜在这里集会。毕竟那时星星最亮。
entries.sampleRaw: We meet here every §6seven days§f at midnight. That's when the star is the brightest, after all.

entries.source: We hope you love the Fallen Star as much as we do.
entries.translation: 我们希望你能像我们一样热爱陨星.
entries.sampleRaw: We hope you love the §dFallen Star§d as much as we do.

entries.source: Great to have you here, <Player>.
entries.translation: 很高兴你能来，<Player>。
entries.sampleRaw: Great to have you here, §7<Player>§f.

entries.source: I wonder why the star is purple.
entries.translation: 我很好奇这颗星星为什么是紫色的。
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder why the star is purple.

entries.source: Hey, nice helmet.
entries.translation: 嘿，头盔不错。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, nice helmet.

entries.source: We all look pretty cool.
entries.translation: 我们看起来都挺酷的。
entries.sampleRaw: We all look pretty cool.

entries.source: ✆ I'm not just gonna give my contact out to anybody...
entries.translation: ✆ 我可不会随便把联系方式给任何人……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI'm not just gonna give my contact out to anybody...

entries.source: ✆ Huh? Are you a member of, y'know, our thing?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯？你是我们那个……你懂的，那个东西的成员吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHuh? Are you a member of, y'know, our §othing§f?

entries.source: ✆ Where's your Fallen Star Helmet? Put it on!
entries.translation: ✆ 你的陨星头盔呢？戴上它！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fWhere's your §9Fallen Star Helmet§f? Put it on!

entries.source: ✆ You want my Abiphone Contact? Respectfully, we don't see you at our meetings very often.
entries.translation: ✆ 你想要我的 Abiphone 联系方式？恕我直言，我们很少在集会上见到你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You want my §3Abiphone Contact§f? Respectfully, we don't see you at our meetings very often.

entries.source: ✆ Here's the deal.
entries.translation: ✆ 这样吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Here's the deal.

entries.source: ✆ Attend 3 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star, and you can have my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 参加 3 次陨星教团的集会，你就可以拿到我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Attend §63§f meetings of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f, and you can have my contact.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Attend {{N0}} meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star, and you can have my contact.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 参加 {{N0}} 次陨星教团的集会，你就可以拿到我的联系方式。

entries.source: ✆ Confirm your attendance at a meeting by speaking to me with your Fallen Star Helmet equipped.
entries.translation: ✆ 戴上陨星头盔与我交谈，即可确认你出席了一次集会。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Confirm your attendance at a meeting by speaking to me with your §1Fallen Star Helmet§f equipped.

entries.source: ✆ Before I give you my Abiphone Contact, do you think you could grab us a Powder Pie to split?
entries.translation: ✆ 在我给你我的 Abiphone 联系方式之前，你能帮我们弄一块粉末派来分着吃吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Before I give you my §3Abiphone Contact§f, do you think you could grab us a §aPowder Pie§f to split?

entries.source: ✆ Someone in the Dwarven Mines sells them, though I can't remember who.
entries.translation: ✆ 矮人矿坑里有人卖，不过我记不清是谁了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Someone in the §2Dwarven Mines§f sells them, though I can't remember who.

entries.source: ✆ Consider it your punishment for being late.
entries.translation: ✆ 就当这是你迟到的惩罚吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Consider it your punishment for being late.

entries.source: ✆ Thank you so very much, <Player>.
entries.translation: ✆ 非常感谢你，<Player>。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Thank you so very much, §7<Player>§f.

entries.source: ✆ Now we can wind down from our very serious meeting with some very serious food!
entries.translation: ✆ 现在我们可以用非常严肃的食物来放松一下这场非常严肃的会议了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Now we can wind down from our very serious meeting with some very serious food!

entries.source: ✆ Here is my Abiphone Contact. Give me a call if you ever want to know when our next meeting is.
entries.translation: ✆ 这是我的 Abiphone 联系人。如果你想了解下次会议的时间，随时给我打电话。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Here is my §3Abiphone Contact§f. Give me a call if you ever want to know when our next meeting is.

entries.source: ✆ Wait.
entries.translation: ✆ 等等。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Wait.

entries.source: ✆ Where's your Abiphone? I can't add you as a contact if you don't even have one!
entries.translation: ✆ 你的 Abiphone 呢？如果你连一部都没有，我可没法把你加为联系人！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Where's your §3Abiphone§f? I can't add you as a contact if you don't even have one!

entries.source: ✆ Come back once you've found it!
entries.translation: ✆ 找到之后再回来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Come back once you've found it!

entries.source: Ah, <Player>! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
entries.translation: 啊，<Player>！很高兴在教团会议上见到你！
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, §7<Player>§f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!

entries.source: You've now attended 1 meeting of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.translation: 你现已参加了 1 次陨星教团会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！
entries.sampleRaw: You've now attended §61§f meeting of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
entries.numericSource: You've now attended {{N0}} meeting of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.numericTranslation: 你现已参加了 {{N0}} 次陨星教团会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！

entries.source: Attend two more and I'll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.translation: 再参加两次，我就把我的 Abiphone 联系人给你。
entries.sampleRaw: Attend two more and I'll give you my §3Abiphone Contact§f.

entries.source: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
entries.translation: 好了，会议该开始了！
entries.sampleRaw: Now, time for the meeting to begin!

entries.source: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
entries.translation: 好吧，我们上次说到哪儿了？
entries.sampleRaw: Alright, where did we finish off last time?

entries.source: The master plan.
entries.translation: 宏伟计划。
entries.sampleRaw: The master plan.

entries.source: Right, the master plan. Thondin, care to update us?
entries.translation: 对，宏伟计划。Thondin，要不要给我们汇报一下进展？
entries.sampleRaw: Right, the master plan. §5Thondin§f, care to update us?

entries.source: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
entries.translation: 我老婆说，只要你保证这次不弄坏任何东西，我们就可以办过夜派对。
entries.sampleRaw: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.

entries.source: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was Brarnas! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
entries.translation: 弄坏东西？不是我，是Brarnas！而且说真的，谁会那样放盘子啊？
entries.sampleRaw: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was §5Brarnas§f! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?

entries.source: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
entries.translation: 它们简直就是等着被撞倒。为什么不干脆放进抽屉里，省得碍事？
entries.sampleRaw: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?

entries.source: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
entries.translation: 你没必要把它们摆出来。谁家都有盘子，没什么特别的。
entries.sampleRaw: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.

entries.source: You said you never even saw the plates.
entries.translation: 你刚才还说你根本没看见那些盘子。
entries.sampleRaw: You said you never even saw the plates.

entries.source: And I didn't! But Brarnas told me about it.
entries.translation: 我确实没看见！但Brarnas告诉我的。
entries.sampleRaw: And I didn't! But §5Brarnas§f told me about it.

entries.source: No I didn't.
entries.translation: 我可没有。
entries.sampleRaw: No I didn't.

entries.source: Anyways!
entries.translation: 总之！
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways!

entries.source: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
entries.translation: 我老婆说，只要我先洗完碗，就可以去参加过夜派对。
entries.sampleRaw: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.

entries.source: Try not to break those too.
entries.translation: 那些也尽量别打碎了。
entries.sampleRaw: Try not to break those too.

entries.source: Cool.
entries.translation: 酷。
entries.sampleRaw: Cool.

entries.source: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
entries.translation: 我想着在十五号办？
entries.sampleRaw: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?

entries.source: I don't think that would work.
entries.translation: 我觉得那样不行。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't think that would work.

entries.source: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?
entries.translation: 是啊，那跟我们教团的主题不太搭。改成十四号怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?

entries.source: Sure.
entries.translation: 当然。
entries.sampleRaw: Sure.

entries.source: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
entries.translation: 那时候我实在没空，几个同事请假了，老板想让我去顶班。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.

entries.source: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
entries.translation: 嗯，那你大概应该腾出点空来。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, you should probably make yourself available.

entries.source: Jobs may come and go, but the Cult of the Fallen Star is eternal.
entries.translation: 工作来来去去，但陨星教团是永恒的。
entries.sampleRaw: Jobs may come and go, but the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f is eternal.

entries.source: You are right. I shall be there.
entries.translation: 你说得对。我会去的。
entries.sampleRaw: You are right. I shall be there.

entries.source: Awesome.
entries.translation: 太好了。
entries.sampleRaw: Awesome.

entries.source: Alright, next point of interest...
entries.translation: 好，下一个议题……
entries.sampleRaw: Alright, next point of interest...

entries.source: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
entries.translation: 等一下，各位。我老婆来电话了。
entries.sampleRaw: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.

entries.source: Again?
entries.translation: 又来？
entries.sampleRaw: Again?

entries.source: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
entries.translation: 喂？嗯？好。冷静点。行，我过去看看，记得检查一下门廊下面。
