entries.sampleRaw: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.

entries.source: Cat again?
entries.translation: 又是猫？
entries.sampleRaw: Cat again?

entries.source: Cat again. I've got to go.
entries.translation: 又是猫。我得走了。
entries.sampleRaw: Cat again. I've got to go.

entries.source: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!
entries.translation: 好吧，那这次会议就到这里。下周同一时间见！
entries.sampleRaw: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!

entries.source: You've now attended 2 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.translation: 你现已参加了 2 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这些星陨给你！
entries.sampleRaw: You've now attended §62§f meetings of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
entries.numericSource: You've now attended {{N0}} meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.numericTranslation: 你现已参加了 {{N0}} 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这些星陨给你！

entries.source: Attend one more and I'll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.translation: 再参加一次，我就把我的 Abiphone 联系人给你。
entries.sampleRaw: Attend one more and I'll give you my §3Abiphone Contact§f.

entries.source: Today I have something I'd like to talk about.
entries.translation: 今天我有些事想说说。
entries.sampleRaw: Today I have something I'd like to talk about.

entries.source: What is it?
entries.translation: 什么事？
entries.sampleRaw: What is it?

entries.source: The sleepover.
entries.translation: 那次过夜聚会。
entries.sampleRaw: The sleepover.

entries.source: Uh-oh.
entries.translation: 哎呀。
entries.sampleRaw: Uh-oh.

entries.source: We're never having another one again.
entries.translation: 我们再也不会办第二次了。
entries.sampleRaw: We're never having another one again.

entries.source: Why?
entries.translation: 为什么？
entries.sampleRaw: Why?

entries.source: I wonder why. Where do I start?
entries.translation: 我也想知道为什么。从哪儿说起呢？
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder why. Where do I start?

entries.source: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.
entries.translation: 你进来的时候没脱鞋。
entries.sampleRaw: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.

entries.source: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
entries.translation: 你还把门敞着，结果猫跑了出去，我花了一个小时才找到它。
entries.sampleRaw: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.

entries.source: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
entries.translation: 而且，我找猫的时候，你把我给我们点的披萨全吃光了。
entries.sampleRaw: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.

entries.source: We were hungry.
entries.translation: 我们饿了。
entries.sampleRaw: We were hungry.

entries.source: We? I didn't get a single bite either.
entries.translation: 我们？我一口都没吃到。
entries.sampleRaw: We? I didn't get a single bite either.

entries.source: You're not helping.
entries.translation: 你这不是在帮忙。
entries.sampleRaw: You're not helping.

entries.source: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
entries.translation: 然后，在我们本该一起看的演出还没开始前，你就在我床上睡着了。
entries.sampleRaw: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.

entries.source: You don't even know which two people died!
entries.translation: 你连死的是哪两个人都不知道！
entries.sampleRaw: You don't even know which two people died!

entries.source: TWO?
entries.translation: 两个？
entries.sampleRaw: TWO?

entries.source: Might be three in a minute.
entries.translation: 再过一分钟可能就变三个了。
entries.sampleRaw: Might be three in a minute.

entries.source: You deserved that spoiler. And-
entries.translation: 这剧透是你自找的。还有——
entries.sampleRaw: You deserved that spoiler. And-

entries.source: Okay, okay, I get it. The next sleepover can be at my house. I'll make it up to you guys.
entries.translation: 好，好，我明白了。下次睡衣派对可以在我家办。我会补偿你们的。
entries.sampleRaw: Okay, okay, I get it. The next sleepover can be at my house. I'll make it up to you guys.

entries.source: You can pay for the pizza.
entries.translation: 披萨钱你来付。
entries.sampleRaw: You can pay for the pizza.

entries.source: Yes, of course! Now, can we move on with the meeting?
entries.translation: 当然，没问题！现在，我们能继续开会了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Yes, of course! Now, can we move on with the meeting?

entries.source: Yes.
entries.translation: 可以。
entries.sampleRaw: Yes.

entries.source: Again, Thondin?
entries.translation: 又来了，Thondin？
entries.sampleRaw: Again, §5Thondin§f?

entries.source: Apologies.
entries.translation: 抱歉。
entries.sampleRaw: Apologies.

entries.source: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.
entries.translation: 喂？失踪了？又？好吧。嗯，我能听见你。我马上就到。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.

entries.source: Cat again?
entries.translation: 又是猫？
entries.sampleRaw: Cat again?

entries.source: Nope, wife.
entries.translation: 不，是老婆。
entries.sampleRaw: Nope, wife.

entries.source: Oh. That's not good.
entries.translation: 哦。那可不太妙。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh. That's not good.

entries.source: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in Scarleton. Thought it was her day off.
entries.translation: 不，没事。她会在斯卡雷顿喝杯茶。我还以为今天她休息呢。
entries.sampleRaw: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in §5Scarleton§f. Thought it was her day off.

entries.source: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
entries.translation: 我大概该去告诉她，她本来应该在工作。
entries.sampleRaw: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.

entries.source: Yep.
entries.translation: 嗯。
entries.sampleRaw: Yep.

entries.source: Well, I guess we will have to suspend today's meeting... Until next week, everyone!
entries.translation: 好吧，看来我们只能暂停今天的会议了……大家下周见！
entries.sampleRaw: Well, I guess we will have to suspend today's meeting... Until next week, everyone!

entries.source: You've now attended 3 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.translation: 你现已参加了 3 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这些星陨给你！
entries.sampleRaw: You've now attended §63§f meetings of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
entries.numericSource: You've now attended {{N0}} meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.numericTranslation: 你现已参加了 {{N0}} 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这些星陨给你！

entries.source: Guys, today I have something super urgent to discuss.
entries.translation: 各位，今天我有一件超级紧急的事要讨论。
entries.sampleRaw: Guys, today I have something super urgent to discuss.

entries.source: What is it, Thondin?
entries.translation: 什么事，Thondin？
entries.sampleRaw: What is it, §5Thondin§f?

entries.source: And why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?
entries.translation: 还有，为什么我怀疑这事完全不重要？
entries.sampleRaw: And why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?

entries.source: Well... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?
entries.translation: 嗯……你们觉得这世界上是门更多，还是轮子更多？
entries.sampleRaw: Well... you think there are more doors or wheels in this world?

entries.source: There we go.
entries.translation: 果然来了。
entries.sampleRaw: There we go.

entries.source: I've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.
entries.translation: 我想了整整一周，我觉得大概是轮子更多。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been thinking about it all week, and I believe there are probably more wheels.

entries.source: And how did you reach that conclusion?
entries.translation: 那你是怎么得出这个结论的？
entries.sampleRaw: And how did you reach that conclusion?

entries.source: Well, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.
entries.translation: 嗯，首先，很多房子根本没有门。比如我们很多矮人就不用门。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, first of all, many houses don't even have doors. For example, many of us dwarves don't use them.

entries.source: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
entries.translation: 比如说，要不是有守卫，你完全可以径直走进矮人宫殿。
entries.sampleRaw: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.

entries.source: And guards, thoughthey serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.
entries.translation: 还有守卫，虽然它们的作用类似，但我想它们不是门。
entries.sampleRaw: And guards, thoughthey serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.

entries.source: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
entries.translation: 是啊。除非你是个哲学家之类的。
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.

entries.source: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.
entries.translation: 然后你想想，每辆矿车都有四个轮子，但上面却没有门。
entries.sampleRaw: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.

entries.source: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.
entries.translation: 而我们作为矮人，有非常多的矿车。
entries.sampleRaw: And us, being dwarves, have a whole lot of minecarts.

entries.source: Yup, I sleep in one.
entries.translation: 没错，我就睡在一辆里面。
entries.sampleRaw: Yup, I sleep in one.

entries.source: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, Thondin.
entries.translation: 但除了我们矮人之外，没多少文明会使用矿车，Thondin。
entries.sampleRaw: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, Thondin.

entries.source: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
entries.translation: 那你为什么这么确定矿车有轮子？
entries.sampleRaw: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?

entries.source: Huh?
entries.translation: 啊？
entries.sampleRaw: Huh?

entries.source: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
entries.translation: 按定义来说，轮子必须是圆形的。那些“轮子”是方块状的，而且我从没见过它们真正转动过。
entries.sampleRaw: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.

entries.source: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere
entries.translation: 你知道吗，现在想想，这周围的一切都方方正正的。而且到处都是
entries.sampleRaw: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere

entries.source: But it is a wheel!
entries.translation: 可它就是轮子啊！
entries.sampleRaw: But it is a wheel!

entries.source: How can you be so sure?
entries.translation: 你怎么能这么确定？
entries.sampleRaw: How can you be so sure?

entries.source: Because everyone calls it a wheel!
entries.translation: 因为大家都叫它轮子！
entries.sampleRaw: Because everyone calls it a wheel!

entries.source: Have you ever seen one turn?
entries.translation: 你见过它转动吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you ever seen one turn?

entries.source: Now that I think about it, no. I've neveer seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
entries.translation: 现在想想，没有。我从没见过矿车真正移动过。它们总是在同一个地方！
entries.sampleRaw: Now that I think about it, no. I've neveer seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!

entries.source: Me neither!
entries.translation: 我也没见过！
entries.sampleRaw: Me neither!

entries.source: The same is true for me.
entries.translation: 我也一样。
entries.sampleRaw: The same is true for me.

entries.source: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
entries.translation: 那它们放在那里是干什么的？只是为了装饰吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?

entries.source: Guys... are we living in a simulation?
entries.translation: 伙计们……我们是不是生活在一个模拟世界里？
entries.sampleRaw: Guys... are we living in a simulation?

entries.source: Don't be silly.
entries.translation: 别傻了。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't be silly.

entries.source: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
entries.translation: 不太可能。我们没办法证明自己生活在模拟世界里。
entries.sampleRaw: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.

entries.source: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!
entries.translation: 来吧，我们去看看那些矿车。会议结束！
entries.sampleRaw: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!

entries.source: You’ve now attended 4 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.translation: 你现已参加了 4 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！
entries.sampleRaw: You’ve now attended §64§f meetings of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
entries.numericSource: You’ve now attended {{N0}} meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.numericTranslation: 你现已参加了 {{N0}} 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！

entries.source: And guards, though they serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.
entries.translation: 还有守卫，虽然它们的作用类似，但我想它们不是门。
entries.sampleRaw: And guards, though they serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.

entries.source: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere.
entries.translation: 你知道吗，现在想想，这周围的一切都方方正正的。而且到处都是。
entries.sampleRaw: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere.

entries.source: Now that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
entries.translation: 现在想想，没有。我从没见过矿车真正移动过。它们总是在同一个地方！
entries.sampleRaw: Now that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!

entries.source: You’ve now attended 5 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.translation: 你现已参加了 5 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！
entries.sampleRaw: You’ve now attended §65§f meetings of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
entries.numericSource: You’ve now attended {{N0}} meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.numericTranslation: 你现已参加了 {{N0}} 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！

entries.source: Well, guys, I'm still a bit shook from our recent series of discoveries.
entries.translation: 好吧，伙计们，我还在为我们最近的一系列发现感到有点震惊。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, guys, I'm still a bit shook from our recent series of discoveries.

entries.source: I suppose we should recap them, just for the agenda. Brarnas, if you would...
entries.translation: 我想我们应该回顾一下，就当是议程吧。Brarnas，你来吧……
entries.sampleRaw: I suppose we should recap them, just for the agenda. §5Brarnas§f, if you would...

entries.source: Sure.
entries.translation: 当然。
entries.sampleRaw: Sure.

entries.source: Firstly, we discovered that the wheels on minecarts are solely for show, and that minecarts cannot actually move.
entries.translation: 首先，我们发现矿车的轮子纯粹是摆设，矿车实际上根本无法移动。
entries.sampleRaw: Firstly, we discovered that the wheels on minecarts are solely for show, and that minecarts cannot actually move.

entries.source: Next, Thondin made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.
entries.translation: 接着，Thondin意识到食物其实既没有味道也没有口感，尽管我们倾向于吃它。
entries.sampleRaw: Next, §5Thondin§f made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.

entries.source: Then, we realized that fallen stars always land at the same few spots. Mathematically unlikely, to put it lightly.
entries.translation: 然后，我们意识到陨星总是落在同样的几个地点。说得轻巧点，这在数学上不太可能。
entries.sampleRaw: Then, we realized that fallen stars always land at the same few spots. Mathematically unlikely, to put it lightly.

entries.source: After which, we noted that the same things always happen at the same time, each day.
entries.translation: 之后，我们注意到同样的事情每天都在同样的时间发生。
entries.sampleRaw: After which, we noted that the same things always happen at the same time, each day.

entries.source: Yup!
entries.translation: 没错！
entries.sampleRaw: Yup!

entries.source: Bednom always has a nightmare.
entries.translation: Bednom总是做噩梦。
entries.sampleRaw: §dBednom§f always has a §dnightmare§f.

entries.source: Brynmor always loses his Speckled Teacup.
entries.translation: Brynmor总是弄丢他的斑点茶杯。
entries.sampleRaw: §6Brynmor§f always loses his §cSpeckled Teacup§f.

entries.source: Fetchur always needs someone to bring him something.
entries.translation: Fetchur总是需要有人给他带点东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §eFetchur§f always needs someone to bring him something.

entries.source: And the Puzzler always has a stupid puzzle to solve!
entries.translation: 而Puzzler总是有个愚蠢的谜题要解！
entries.sampleRaw: And the §dPuzzler§f always has a stupid puzzle to solve!

entries.source: Indeed. It seems almost as if everyone here is living the same day, again and again.
entries.translation: 确实。看起来这里几乎每个人都日复一日地过着同一天。
entries.sampleRaw: Indeed. It seems almost as if everyone here is living the same day, again and again.

entries.source: And, when we asked them about it, none of them knew why they do what they do!
entries.translation: 而且，当我们问起他们时，他们都不知道自己为什么要做这些事！
entries.sampleRaw: And, when we asked them about it, none of them knew why they do what they do!

entries.source: Indeed. With this in mind, only one logical conclusion can be reached.
entries.translation: 确实。既然如此，只能得出一个合乎逻辑的结论。
entries.sampleRaw: Indeed. With this in mind, only one logical conclusion can be reached.

entries.source: What is it?
entries.translation: 是什么？
entries.sampleRaw: What is it?

entries.source: HUH?
entries.translation: 啊？
entries.sampleRaw: HUH?

entries.source: I can't deal with this right now, I need some time to process it all.
entries.translation: 我现在应付不了这个，我需要点时间消化这一切。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't deal with this right now, I need some time to process it all.

entries.source: To think I was right all along.
entries.translation: 想想我居然一直是对的。
entries.sampleRaw: To think I was right all along.

entries.source: Meeting adjourned!
entries.translation: 会议结束！
entries.sampleRaw: Meeting adjourned!

entries.source: You’ve now attended 6 meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.translation: 你现已参加了 6 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！
entries.sampleRaw: You’ve now attended §66§f meetings of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f! As a reward, here's some §9Starfall§f!
entries.numericSource: You’ve now attended {{N0}} meetings of the Cult of the Fallen Star! As a reward, here's some Starfall!
entries.numericTranslation: 你现已参加了 {{N0}} 次陨星教团的会议！作为奖励，这里有一些星陨！

entries.source: I don't know about you guys, but I'm still coming to terms with our recent findings...
entries.translation: 我不知道你们怎么想，但我还在消化我们最近的发现……
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know about you guys, but I'm still coming to terms with our recent findings...

entries.source: I can't believe it...
entries.translation: 我简直不敢相信……
entries.sampleRaw: I can't believe it...

entries.source: It is unfortunate. Though we are certain of it, there's simply nothing we can do.
entries.translation: 这很不幸。虽然我们对此确信无疑，但我们根本无能为力。
entries.sampleRaw: It is unfortunate. Though we are certain of it, there's simply nothing we can do.

entries.source: The moment all of the "players" leave the game, we shall cease to exist until they return.
entries.translation: 一旦所有“玩家”离开游戏，我们就会停止存在，直到他们回来。
entries.sampleRaw: The moment all of the "players" leave the game, we shall cease to exist until they return.

entries.source: Please don't leave, <Player>, I don't want to die!
entries.translation: 请不要离开，<Player>，我不想死！
entries.sampleRaw: Please don't leave, §7<Player>§f, I don't want to die!

entries.source: What was never alive may never die, Thondin.
entries.translation: 从未活过的东西也许永远不会死，Thondin。
entries.sampleRaw: What was never alive may never die, §5Thondin§f.

entries.source: But we are conscious, Brarnas, are we not? Surely we exist in some capacity.
entries.translation: 但我们是有意识的，Brarnas，不是吗？我们肯定以某种形式存在着。
entries.sampleRaw: But we are conscious, §5Brarnas§f, are we not? Surely we exist in some capacity.

entries.source: Or do we merely feign consciousness? Perhaps we are nothing more than the simulation experiencing itself.
entries.translation: 还是说我们只是在假装有意识？也许我们不过是模拟在体验它自身罢了。
entries.sampleRaw: Or do we merely feign consciousness? Perhaps we are nothing more than the simulation experiencing itself.

entries.source: This is all too much for me to comprehend. I liked things better before.
entries.translation: 这一切对我来说太难以理解了。我更喜欢以前的样子。
entries.sampleRaw: This is all too much for me to comprehend. I liked things better before.

entries.source: How about we order a pizza?
entries.translation: 我们点个披萨怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: How about we order a pizza?

entries.source: Let's do it.
entries.translation: 就这么办。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's do it.

entries.source: Alright, let me call them.
entries.translation: 好，我来给他们打电话。
entries.sampleRaw: Alright, let me call them.

entries.source: Hello, can I have a pizza please.
entries.translation: 你好，请给我来一份披萨。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello, can I have a pizza please.

entries.source: Hmm, give me a second, I'll ask my friends.
entries.translation: 嗯，等一下，我问问我朋友。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm, give me a second, I'll ask my friends.

entries.source: Guys, red pizza or blue pizza?
entries.translation: 伙计们，红色披萨还是蓝色披萨？
entries.sampleRaw: Guys, §cred pizza§f or §9blue pizza§f?

entries.source: Ooh, a blue pizza! That's my favorite!
entries.translation: 哦，蓝色披萨！那是我的最爱！
entries.sampleRaw: Ooh, a §9blue pizza§f! That's my favorite!

entries.source: Yes, I suppose we should go for the blue. It feels... familiar. Have we had it before?
entries.translation: 对，我觉得我们应该选蓝色的。感觉……很熟悉。我们以前吃过吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Yes, I suppose we should go for the blue. It feels... familiar. Have we had it before?

entries.source: I don't think so. Let's get it.
entries.translation: 我不这么认为。就点它吧。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't think so. Let's get it.

entries.source: Hey! One blue pizza, please. Yup, thanks, we'll come over now, bye!
entries.translation: 嘿！请来一份蓝色披萨。对，谢谢，我们现在就过去，再见！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey! One §9blue pizza§f, please. Yup, thanks, we'll come over now, bye!

entries.source: Hopefully it'll all be over when we wake up tomorrow...
entries.translation: 希望明天我们醒来时一切都会结束……
entries.sampleRaw: Hopefully it'll all be over when we wake up tomorrow...

entries.source: Me like dirt.
entries.translation: 我喜欢泥土。
entries.sampleRaw: Me like dirt.

entries.source: Dirty!
entries.translation: 脏脏的！
entries.sampleRaw: Dirty!

entries.source: Dirt!
entries.translation: 泥土！
entries.sampleRaw: Dirt!

entries.source: DIRT!
entries.translation: 泥土！
entries.sampleRaw: DIRT!

entries.source: PRECIOUS!
entries.translation: 珍贵！
entries.sampleRaw: PRECIOUS!

entries.source: Ooooh... this seed... needs dirt.
entries.translation: 哦哦哦……这颗种子……需要泥土。
entries.sampleRaw: Ooooh... this seed... needs dirt.

entries.source: YES! Needs the dirty, need to be DIRTY!
entries.translation: 对！需要脏脏的，需要变得脏脏的！
entries.sampleRaw: YES! Needs the dirty, need to be DIRTY!

entries.source: applies the fertilizer
entries.translation: 施加肥料
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oapplies the fertilizer§r

entries.source: Happy growl Now... MUCH better.
entries.translation: 开心地低吼 现在……好多了。
entries.sampleRaw: Happy growl Now... MUCH better.

entries.source: Fertilized... precious!
entries.translation: 施过肥了……珍贵！
entries.sampleRaw: Fertilized... precious!

entries.source: Grandan is my 7th favourite King.
entries.translation: 格兰丹是我第7喜欢的国王。
entries.sampleRaw: Grandan is my 7th favourite King.
entries.numericSource: Grandan is my {{N0}}th favourite King.
entries.numericTranslation: 格兰丹是我第{{N0}}喜欢的国王。

entries.source: Thormyr only sleeps and eats when he's not at this table. Nothing else.
entries.translation: 索米尔不在这张桌子旁的时候只会睡觉和吃饭。别的什么都不做。
entries.sampleRaw: Thormyr only sleeps and eats when he's not at this table. Nothing else.

entries.source: Norry, Brammor zbells too bad.
entries.translation: 诺里，布拉莫尔说话太糟糕了。
entries.sampleRaw: Norry, Brammor zbells too bad.

entries.source: I'm fairly sure Redros used to be a guard, and they added him to the table one day by mistake.
entries.translation: 我相当确定雷德罗斯以前是个卫兵，有一天他们不小心把他加到了桌子旁。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm fairly sure Redros used to be a guard, and they added him to the table one day by mistake.

entries.source: Emmor is the King today... sigh.
entries.translation: 今天埃莫当国王……唉。
entries.sampleRaw: Emmor is the King today... sigh.

entries.source: Erren keeps losing at Tic Tac Toe, but he loves the game. A brave man in a way.
entries.translation: 埃伦玩井字棋总是输，但他很喜欢这个游戏。从某种意义上说，是个勇敢的人。
entries.sampleRaw: Erren keeps losing at Tic Tac Toe, but he loves the game. A brave man in a way.

entries.source: Emkam is funny at least. But that's about it.
entries.translation: 埃姆卡姆至少挺有趣的。但也仅此而已。
entries.sampleRaw: Emkam is funny at least. But that's about it.

entries.source: ✆ You want me to give you Commissions instead?
entries.translation: ✆ 你想让我改给你委托吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You want me to give you §6Commissions §finstead?

entries.source: ✆ Are you implying that the King is incompetent?!
entries.translation: ✆ 你是在暗示国王无能吗？！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Are you implying that the §6King §fis incompetent?!

entries.source: ✆ I've been saying that for years!
entries.translation: ✆ 这话我都说了好几年了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I've been saying that for years!

entries.source: ✆ If you return my Royal Pigeon, I'll give you my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你把我的皇家鸽子还回来，我就把我的联系方式给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f If you return my §6Royal Pigeon§f, I'll give you my contact.

entries.source: ✆ My precious, beautiful Pigeon...
entries.translation: ✆ 我珍贵、美丽的鸽子……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f My precious, beautiful Pigeon...

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得倒美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.source: The King made me go grocery shopping. Me! Can you believe that? He has a pair of perfectly good legs, and still, here I am.
entries.translation: 国王让我去买菜。让我去！你能相信吗？他明明有一双完好无损的腿，可我还是得站在这儿。
entries.sampleRaw: The King made me go grocery shopping. Me! Can you believe that? He has a pair of perfectly good legs, and still, here I am.

entries.source: I bet when I am back, they are all still sitting around that table! All day, every day! It's ludicrous!
entries.translation: 我敢打赌，等我回去的时候，他们肯定还都围坐在那张桌子旁！整天整天地！简直荒唐！
entries.sampleRaw: I bet when I am back, they are all still sitting around that table! All day, every day! It's ludicrous!

entries.source: Oh, you refuse to work as well? I should have known.
entries.translation: 哦，你也拒绝干活？我早该知道的。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, you refuse to work as well? I should have known.

entries.source: Have you heard of the Cult of the Fallen Star?
entries.translation: 你听说过陨星教团吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave you heard of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f?

entries.source: I've never seen any members myself but I heard they were growing in numbers.
entries.translation: 我自己从没见过任何成员，但我听说他们的人数在不断增加。
entries.sampleRaw: I've never seen any members myself but I heard they were growing in numbers.

entries.source: Not sure what the point of their cult is, but it worries me a bit.
entries.translation: 不清楚他们这个教团的目的何在，但这让我有点担心。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNot sure what the point of their cult is, but it worries me a bit.

entries.source: They sometimes show up near the Fallen Star at night, as far as I know.
entries.translation: 据我所知，他们有时会在夜里出现在陨星附近。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey sometimes show up near the §5Fallen Star §fat night, as far as I know.

entries.source: I saw some weird guy in a mask go into a tiny hole inside the Dwarven Mines, maybe he's part of the Cult of the Fallen Star?
entries.translation: 我看见一个戴面具的怪人钻进了矮人矿坑里的一个小洞，也许他就是陨星教团的人？
entries.sampleRaw: I saw some weird guy in a mask go into a tiny hole inside the Dwarven Mines, maybe he's part of the Cult of the Fallen Star?

entries.source: These guys... are scaring me. I'm not quite sure what they are planning in there, but I'd also rather not want to know.
entries.translation: 这些家伙……让我害怕。我不太确定他们在里面谋划什么，但我也不想知道。
entries.sampleRaw: These guys... are scaring me. I'm not quite sure what they are planning in there, but I'd also rather not want to know.

entries.source: Mining Events on the Dwarven Mines happen regularly!
entries.translation: 矮人矿坑的采矿事件会定期发生！
entries.sampleRaw: §bMining Events §fon the §2Dwarven Mines §fhappen regularly!

entries.source: They are a good way to earn Heart of the Mountain Exp, complete Commissions, and more!
entries.translation: 它们是赚取山峰之心经验、完成委托等的好方法！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey are a good way to earn §5Heart of the Mountain Exp§f, complete §9Commissions§f, and more!

entries.source: If you ever need to know more about Mining Events, come talk to me!
entries.translation: 如果你需要了解更多关于采矿事件的信息，就来找我聊聊！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you ever need to know more about §bMining Events§f, come talk to me!

entries.source: People have no manners these days. They come up to me, and disappear instantly! They don't even greet me! Back in my day, we were raised better than that.
entries.translation: 现在的人一点礼貌都没有。他们走到我面前，然后瞬间就消失了！连招呼都不打！在我那个年代，我们可不是这么被教出来的。
entries.sampleRaw: People have no manners these days. They come up to me, and disappear instantly! They don't even greet me! Back in my day, we were raised better than that.

entries.source: It turns out, manners haven't all been lost yet.
entries.translation: 看来，礼貌还没有完全消失。
entries.sampleRaw: It turns out, manners haven't all been lost yet.

entries.source: Of course. What else did I expect from this generation.
entries.translation: 当然。我还能指望这一代人什么呢。
entries.sampleRaw: Of course. What else did I expect from this generation.

entries.source: I just had a very very strange dream...
entries.translation: 我刚做了一个非常非常奇怪的梦……
entries.sampleRaw: I just had a very very strange dream...

entries.source: In my dream I flew out of my body, went through some kind of screen barrier.
entries.translation: 在梦里，我从自己的身体里飞了出去，穿过了一道像是屏幕的屏障。
entries.sampleRaw: In my dream I flew out of my body, went through some kind of screen barrier.

entries.source: I turned and I could see myself standing behind that screen, right here.
entries.translation: 我转过身，能看到自己就站在这道屏幕后面，就在这儿。
entries.sampleRaw: I turned and I could see myself standing behind that screen, right here.

entries.source: Around me were strange objects everywhere, but the strangest part was the giant.
entries.translation: 我周围到处都是奇怪的物体，但最奇怪的是那个巨人。
entries.sampleRaw: Around me were strange objects everywhere, but the strangest part was the giant.

entries.source: A Giant! Sitting in front of that screen, watching me.
entries.translation: 一个巨人！坐在那块屏幕前，看着我。
entries.sampleRaw: A Giant! Sitting in front of that screen, watching me.

entries.source: The giant seemed to speak a foreign language, they screamed "POGGERS!"
entries.translation: 那个巨人似乎在说一种外语，他们大喊着“POGGERS！”
entries.sampleRaw: The giant seemed to speak a foreign language, they screamed "POGGERS!"

entries.source: Then I woke up in a sweat.
entries.translation: 然后我满头大汗地醒了过来。
entries.sampleRaw: Then I woke up in a sweat.

entries.source: I'm really upside down, I need time to think.
entries.translation: 我真是彻底糊涂了，我需要时间想想。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm really upside down, I need time to think.

entries.source: Thanks for listening.
entries.translation: 谢谢你听我说。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for listening.

entries.source: I had another nightmare, very similar to the previous one.
entries.translation: 我又做了个噩梦，和之前那个非常相似。
entries.sampleRaw: I had another nightmare, very similar to the previous one.

entries.source: I could see myself behind the screen again, it looked like I was talking.
entries.translation: 我又能看到屏幕后面的自己，看起来像是在说话。
entries.sampleRaw: I could see myself behind the screen again, it looked like I was talking.

entries.source: I couldn't hear it, but the words appeared on the screen.
entries.translation: 我听不见声音，但文字出现在了屏幕上。
entries.sampleRaw: I couldn't hear it, but the words appeared on the screen.

entries.source: The exact words I told you last time.
entries.translation: 正是我上次告诉你的那些话。
entries.sampleRaw: The exact words I told you last time.

entries.source: So weird, so weird.... I need time to think.
entries.translation: 太奇怪了，太奇怪了……我需要时间想想。
entries.sampleRaw: So weird, so weird.... I need time to think.

entries.source: Once again, I had the same recurring nightmare, a little different this time.
entries.translation: 我又一次做了同样的反复出现的噩梦，不过这次有点不同。
entries.sampleRaw: Once again, I had the same recurring nightmare, a little different this time.

entries.source: I was talking behind the screen again, I mentioned a treasure.
entries.translation: 我又在屏幕后面说话，我提到了一个宝藏。
entries.sampleRaw: I was talking behind the screen again, I mentioned a treasure.

entries.source: I knew the location of a treasure right right close to a giant Dwarf Statue.
entries.translation: 我知道一个宝藏的位置，就在一座巨大的矮人雕像旁边。
entries.sampleRaw: I knew the location of a treasure right right close to a giant Dwarf Statue.

entries.source: Buried in loose rocks next to a bridge I said.
entries.translation: 我说它埋在一座桥旁边的碎石堆里。
entries.sampleRaw: Buried in loose rocks next to a bridge I said.

entries.source: But it makes no sense, I've never even heard of such a treasure!!
entries.translation: 但这根本说不通，我甚至从没听说过这样的宝藏！！
entries.sampleRaw: But it makes no sense, I've never even heard of such a treasure!!

entries.source: Dwarf Statue, bridge,, loose rocks, treasure...? What a strange dream...
entries.translation: 矮人雕像、桥、、碎石堆、宝藏……？真是个奇怪的梦……
entries.sampleRaw: Dwarf Statue, bridge,, loose rocks, treasure...? What a strange dream...

entries.source: The dreams stopped, it'll forever remain a mystery.
entries.translation: 梦停止了，它将永远是个谜。
entries.sampleRaw: The dreams stopped, it'll forever remain a mystery.

entries.source: Last night I had another horrible nightmare. I'm afraid to fall asleep again.
entries.translation: 昨晚我又做了一个可怕的噩梦。我都不敢再睡着了。
entries.sampleRaw: Last night I had another horrible nightmare. I'm afraid to fall asleep again.

entries.source: Thank you. I'll make a strong brew from this that'll keep me awake all night.
entries.translation: 谢谢你。我要用这个熬一剂浓药，让我整晚都保持清醒。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you. I'll make a strong brew from this that'll keep me awake all night.

entries.source: Tough love, but maybe you're right. They're only nightmares, right? Not real. Heh.
entries.translation: 虽然有点扎心，但也许你说得对。那只是噩梦，对吧？不是真的。嘿。
entries.sampleRaw: Tough love, but maybe you're right. They're only nightmares, right? Not real. Heh.

entries.source: I wonder if I'll have that nightmare again tonight...
entries.translation: 不知道今晚我会不会再做那个噩梦……
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder if I'll have that nightmare again tonight...

entries.source: Wow that dream was weird.
entries.translation: 哇，那个梦真奇怪。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow that dream was weird.

entries.source: I'm still thinking about that dream I had.
entries.translation: 我还在想我做的那个梦。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm still thinking about that dream I had.

entries.source: What's this? A brew?
entries.translation: 这是什么？一剂药？
entries.sampleRaw: What's this? A brew?

entries.source: I need to drink this?
entries.translation: 我需要喝下这个？
entries.sampleRaw: I need to drink this?

entries.source: Okay well, I trust you.
entries.translation: 好吧，我相信你。
entries.sampleRaw: Okay well, I trust you.

entries.source: gulp
entries.translation: 咕咚
entries.sampleRaw: §d§ogulp

entries.source: Meh, I doubt this will do anything...
entries.translation: 唉，我怀疑这不会有什么用……
entries.sampleRaw: Meh, I doubt this will do anything...

entries.source: Holy crap this tastes terrible!!!
entries.translation: 天哪，这味道太糟糕了！！！
entries.sampleRaw: Holy crap this tastes terrible!!!

entries.source: What's the point!!!!
entries.translation: 这有什么意义啊！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: What's the point!!!!

entries.source: I guess it was rhetorical, uh?
entries.translation: 我猜那是反问吧，嗯？
entries.sampleRaw: I guess it was rhetorical, uh?

entries.source: WOW!!!!
entries.sampleRaw: WOW!!!!

entries.source: I REALLY CAN'T SLEEP AT ALL!!!!
entries.translation: 我根本完全睡不着觉！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: I REALLY CAN'T SLEEP AT ALL!!!!

entries.source: THAT'S FANTASTIC!!!!
entries.translation: 太棒了！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: THAT'S FANTASTIC!!!!

entries.source: NO MORE NIGHTMARES!!!!
entries.translation: 再也不做噩梦了！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: NO MORE NIGHTMARES!!!!

entries.source: HERE TAKE THIS!!!!
entries.translation: 来，拿着这个！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: HERE TAKE THIS!!!!

entries.source: That drink you gave me the other day...
entries.translation: 你前几天给我的那杯饮料……
entries.sampleRaw: That §edrink §fyou gave me the other day...

entries.source: It was amazing! I couldn't have nightmares that night!
entries.translation: 太神奇了！那天晚上我居然没做噩梦！
entries.sampleRaw: It was amazing! I couldn't have nightmares that night!

entries.source: You should give me another and visit in the morning!
entries.translation: 你应该再给我一杯，然后早上来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: You should give me another and visit in the morning!

entries.source: AM I TOO LOUD??!!
entries.translation: 我是不是太吵了？？！！
entries.sampleRaw: AM I TOO LOUD??!!

entries.source: I HAD NO IDEA I COULD JUST STAY AWAKE, IT'S GENIUS!!!
entries.translation: 我完全没想到我可以就这么保持清醒，这简直是天才！！！
entries.sampleRaw: I HAD NO IDEA I COULD JUST STAY AWAKE, IT'S GENIUS!!!

entries.source: WHY SLEEP WHEN YOU CAN JUST STAY AWAKE FOREVER!!!!
entries.translation: 既然能永远保持清醒，为什么还要睡觉！！！！
entries.sampleRaw: WHY SLEEP WHEN YOU CAN JUST STAY AWAKE FOREVER!!!!

entries.source: I love the snow!
entries.translation: 我爱雪！
entries.sampleRaw: I love the snow!

entries.source: I've got the perfect tool to make your island a winter wonderland!
entries.translation: 我有完美的工具，能把你的岛屿变成冬日仙境！
entries.sampleRaw: I've got the perfect tool to make your island a winter wonderland!

entries.source: You're a long way from home!
entries.translation: 你离家可真远啊！
entries.sampleRaw: You're a long way from home!

entries.source: Luckily your coins are safe with me! Store them here before venturing deep into the depths of the Dwarven Mines!
entries.translation: 幸运的是，你的金币放在我这里很安全！在深入矮人矿坑深处冒险之前，先把它们存到这里吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Luckily your §6coins §fare safe with me! Store them here before venturing deep into the depths of the §2Dwarven Mines§f!

entries.source: Standing in that bank all day. Just me and the dwarves. But they are either all business, or drunk. Or both! I need better company!
entries.translation: 整天站在那家银行里。只有我和矮人们。可他们要么一本正经，要么喝得烂醉。或者两者兼有！我需要更好的伙伴！
entries.sampleRaw: Standing in that bank all day. Just me and the dwarves. But they are either all business, or drunk. Or both! I need better company!

entries.source: Oh what a lovely specimen this is. I wonder, how should I name you?
entries.translation: 哦，多么可爱的标本啊。我在想，该给你起什么名字呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh what a lovely specimen this is. I wonder, how should I name you?

entries.source: Well, maybe I will be able to understand the burping dwarves if I try hard enough.
entries.translation: 嗯，也许只要我足够努力，就能听懂那些打嗝的矮人在说什么了。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, maybe I will be able to understand the burping dwarves if I try hard enough.

entries.source: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who's going to be the next king.
entries.translation: 他们大部分时间都在争论谁将成为下一任国王。
entries.sampleRaw: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who's going to be the next king.

entries.source: Currently the reigning king is <king>. I think...
entries.translation: 目前在位的是国王 <king>。我想……
entries.sampleRaw: Currently the reigning king is <king>. I think...

entries.source: Sup, [player]? I am Jotraeline Greatforge, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading Drills.
entries.translation: 嗨，[player]？我是 Jotraeline Greatforge，你补充燃料和升级钻头的一站式商店。
entries.sampleRaw: Sup, §b[player]§f? I am §2Jotraeline Greatforge§f, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading §aDrills§f.

entries.source: Biofuel is one of such fuels, which applies 3,000 fuel to your Drill!
entries.translation: 生物燃料就是其中一种燃料，可为你的钻头补充 3,000 点燃料！
entries.sampleRaw: §9Biofuel§f is one of such fuels, which applies §23,000§f fuel to your Drill!
entries.numericSource: Biofuel is one of such fuels, which applies {{N0}} fuel to your Drill!
entries.numericTranslation: 生物燃料就是其中一种燃料，可为你的钻头补充 {{N0}} 点燃料！

entries.source: You can also apply Drill Upgrades to Drills, offering various buffs!
entries.translation: 你还可以给钻头安装钻头升级，提供各种增益效果！
entries.sampleRaw: You can also apply §6Drill Upgrades§f to Drills, offering various buffs!

entries.source: ✆ You have an Abiphone! I've always wanted an Abiphone Basic!
entries.translation: ✆ 你有一部手机！我一直想要一部基础款手机！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You have an §3Abiphone§f! I've always wanted an Abiphone Basic!

entries.source: ✆ I could tinker with it while I wait here...
entries.translation: ✆ 我可以在这里等的时候顺便摆弄一下它……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I could tinker with it while I wait here...

entries.source: ✆ And if I had one, I would totally add you!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果我有的话，我一定会把你加进去的！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f And if I had one, I would totally add you!

entries.source: ✆ Hey it's very nice of you, but I can't take your ONLY Abiphone!
entries.translation: ✆ 嘿，你人真好，但我不能拿走你唯一的一部手机！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Hey it's very nice of you, but I can't take your ONLY Abiphone!

entries.source: ✆ Oooh an Abiphone, thank you so much!
entries.translation: ✆ 哦哦，一部手机，太感谢你了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Oooh an §3Abiphone§f, thank you so much!

entries.source: ✆ Now I can finally add Cole, and you!
entries.translation: ✆ 现在我终于可以加上 Cole，还有你了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Now I can finally add §bCole§f, and you!

entries.source: ✆ Uh... do you have any cheaper phone?
entries.translation: ✆ 呃……你有便宜点的手机吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Uh... do you have any cheaper phone?

entries.source: ✆ Sure I'd like you in my Contacts List, but I don't want this kind of burden on our relationship.
entries.translation: ✆ 我当然想把你加进我的联系人列表，但我不想让我们的关系背上这种负担。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Sure I'd like you in my §3Contacts List§f, but I don't want this kind of burden on our relationship.

entries.source: ✆ I only want an Abiphone Basic.
entries.translation: ✆ 我只想要一部基础款手机。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I only want an Abiphone Basic.

entries.source: I heard you have a composter in your barn, it happens to run on the same fuel drills run on! Could I check it out?
entries.translation: 我听说你的谷仓里有一台堆肥桶，它用的燃料正好和钻机用的一样！我能去看看吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I heard you have a composter in your barn, it happens to run on the same fuel drills run on! Could I check it out?

entries.source: Quite fascinating technology you have there, I'm sure with this machinery we could create even better appliances in the future!
entries.translation: 你那儿的技术真是相当迷人，我相信有了这套机械，我们将来能造出更好的器具！
entries.sampleRaw: Quite fascinating technology you have there, I'm sure with this machinery we could create even better appliances in the future!

entries.source: That's alright! I'll just save up 12 years to be able to afford one myself.
entries.translation: 没关系！我只要攒上 12 年就能自己买得起了。
entries.sampleRaw: That's alright! I'll just save up 12 years to be able to afford one myself.
entries.numericSource: That's alright! I'll just save up {{N0}} years to be able to afford one myself.
entries.numericTranslation: 没关系！我只要攒上 {{N0}} 年就能自己买得起了。

entries.source: Drills are sweet! Too bad you don't have one. I hear you can create them in the Forge!
entries.translation: 钻机太棒了！可惜你没有一台。我听说你可以在锻造所里打造它们！
entries.sampleRaw: Drills are sweet! Too bad you don't have one. I hear you can create them in the §6Forge§f!

entries.source: Come back to me when you have a Drill in your inventory!
entries.translation: 等你物品栏里有一台钻机时再来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back to me when you have a §aDrill§f in your inventory!

entries.source: What are you doing talking to me without a Drill? Come back when you have one!
entries.translation: 你连台钻机都没有，来找我干什么？有了再来！
entries.sampleRaw: What are you doing talking to me without a §aDrill§f? Come back when you have one!

entries.source: ✆ Pro Drill Maintenance, Jotraeline speaking.
entries.translation: ✆ 专业钻机维护，我是 Jotraeline。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Pro Drill Maintenance, Jotraeline speaking.

entries.source: ✆ Yes of course we can upgrade your drill.
entries.translation: ✆ 是的，我们当然可以升级你的钻机。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Yes of course we can upgrade your drill.

entries.source: ✆ Your drill is still under warranty, yes.
entries.translation: ✆ 你的钻机还在保修期内，没错。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Your drill is still under warranty, yes.

entries.source: ✆ I wish I ever had vacations.
entries.translation: ✆ 真希望我也能休个假。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I wish I ever had vacations.

entries.source: I used to think this world was peaceful, but there are some beings that are stronger than I could ever hope to handle...
entries.translation: 我以前以为这个世界很和平，但有些存在强大到我根本不敢奢望能应付……
entries.sampleRaw: §fI used to think this world was peaceful, but there are some beings that are stronger than I could ever hope to handle...

entries.source: This spider, Arachne - it's way out of my league...
entries.translation: 这只蜘蛛，阿拉克妮——完全不是我能对付的……
entries.sampleRaw: This spider, §4Arachne§f - it's way out of my league...

entries.source: I can barely defeat her Keepers...
entries.translation: 我连她的守卫都勉强打不过……
entries.sampleRaw: I can barely defeat her §5Keepers§f...

entries.source: With enough Arachne's Calling, you can summon her at the Altar.
entries.translation: 只要集齐足够的阿拉克妮的召唤，你就能在祭坛召唤她。
entries.sampleRaw: With enough §9Arachne's Calling§f, you can summon her at the §5Altar§f.

entries.source: You can find Arachne's Keepers in Arachne's Sanctuary.
entries.translation: 你可以在阿拉克妮圣所里找到阿拉克妮的守卫。
entries.sampleRaw: You can find §cArachne's Keepers §fin §4Arachne's Sanctuary§f.

entries.source: Wow, you actually challenged that old witch Arachne! You have some potential kid...
entries.translation: 哇，你居然真的挑战了那个老巫婆阿拉克妮！你小子有点潜力……
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, you actually challenged that old witch §4Arachne§f! You have some potential kid...

entries.source: Unfortunately, she has fled to bide her time and grow in power.
entries.translation: 不幸的是，她已经逃走，等待时机壮大力量。
entries.sampleRaw: Unfortunately, she has fled to bide her time and grow in power.

entries.source: In order to prevent her from growing too strong, we must keep pulling her into this world and weakening her.
entries.translation: 为了防止她变得过于强大，我们必须不断把她拉进这个世界并削弱她。
entries.sampleRaw: In order to prevent her from growing too strong, we must keep pulling her into this world and weakening her.

entries.source: If you're up for the challenge, I can trade you some Arachne Crystals.
entries.translation: 如果你愿意接受挑战，我可以跟你换一些阿拉克妮水晶。
entries.sampleRaw: If you're up for the challenge, I can trade you some §5Arachne Crystals§f.

entries.source: When you place one of these crystals at the Altar you'll pull a stronger version of Arachne into this world.
entries.translation: 当你把其中一颗水晶放在祭坛上时，你就会把更强版本的阿拉克妮拉进这个世界。
entries.sampleRaw: When you place one of these crystals at the §5Altar §fyou'll pull a stronger version of §4Arachne §finto this world.

entries.source: While she may drop some rarer items upon defeat, she is a lot stronger.
entries.translation: 虽然她被击败时可能会掉落一些更稀有的物品，但她要强得多。
entries.sampleRaw: While she may drop some rarer items upon defeat, she is a lot stronger.

entries.source: Here, take a look.
entries.translation: 来，看看吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take a look.

entries.source: Great, this is everything I need! With this I can make the crystal.
entries.translation: 太好了，这就是我需要的全部东西！有了这些我就能制作水晶了。
entries.sampleRaw: Great, this is everything I need! With this I can make the crystal.

entries.source: * Hammer and drilling sounds *
entries.translation: * 锤击和钻孔的声音 *
entries.sampleRaw: * Hammer and drilling sounds *

entries.source: * Glass breaking *
entries.translation: * 玻璃破碎声 *
entries.sampleRaw: * Glass breaking *

entries.source: Here ya go, if you put this on the alter, it will drag that retched creature to this world.
entries.translation: 给你，如果你把这个放在祭坛上，它就会把那可恶的生物拖到这个世界来。
entries.sampleRaw: Here ya go, if you put this on the alter, it will drag that retched creature to this world.

entries.source: But be warned, she is strong, and I have it set up to drag her back if she is not defeated in 10 minutes, for the safety of this whole world.
entries.translation: 但我要警告你，她很强，而且为了整个世界的安全，我设置好了如果她没在 10 分钟内被击败，就会被拖回去。
entries.sampleRaw: But be warned, she is strong, and I have it set up to drag her back if she is not defeated in 10 minutes, for the safety of this whole world.
entries.numericSource: But be warned, she is strong, and I have it set up to drag her back if she is not defeated in {{N0}} minutes, for the safety of this whole world.
entries.numericTranslation: 但我要警告你，她很强，而且为了整个世界的安全，我设置好了如果她没在 {{N0}} 分钟内被击败，就会被拖回去。

entries.source: I wish you good luck!
entries.translation: 祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: I wish you good luck!

entries.source: ✆ Nice to see you again.
entries.translation: ✆ 很高兴再次见到你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fNice to see you again.

entries.source: ✆ Hm, you want my Abiphone Contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯，你想要我的 Abiphone 联系人？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHm, you want my §3Abiphone Contact§f?

entries.source: ✆ That's fair, I suppose.
entries.translation: ✆ 我想，这很合理。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThat's fair, I suppose.

entries.source: ✆ Before I give you it, I ask but one thing of you...
entries.translation: ✆ 在我给你之前，我只求你一件事……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBefore I give you it, I ask but one thing of you...

entries.source: ✆ Defeat Arachne.
entries.translation: ✆ 击败阿拉克妮。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDefeat §4Arachne§f.

entries.source: ✆ She lives deep underground, in Arachne's Burrow.
entries.translation: ✆ 她住在地下深处，阿拉克妮巢穴里。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fShe lives deep underground, in §4Arachne's Burrow§f.

entries.source: ✆ Help take her down and save this island from a horrible fate, and you can have my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 帮忙击败她，让这座岛免遭可怕的命运，你就可以得到我的联系人。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHelp take her down and save this island from a horrible fate, and you can have my contact.

entries.source: ✆ Kill Arachne.
entries.translation: ✆ 杀死阿拉克妮。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fKill §4Arachne§f.

entries.source: ✆ Wait..
entries.translation: ✆ 等等……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWait..

entries.source: ✆ You've... already killed her?
entries.translation: ✆ 你……已经杀死她了？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou've... already killed her?

entries.source: ✆ Amazing! Great job!
entries.translation: ✆ 太棒了！干得好！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAmazing! Great job!

entries.source: ✆ The island is safe! For now, at least...
entries.translation: ✆ 这座岛安全了！至少目前是这样……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe island is safe! For now, at least...

entries.source: ✆ Here, take my contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 来，收下我的联系人吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHere, take my contact!

entries.source: ✆ Call me anytime you need to get your hands on some Arachne Crystals!
entries.translation: ✆ 无论何时你需要弄到一些阿拉克妮水晶，都可以打给我！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCall me anytime you need to get your hands on some §5Arachne Crystals§f!

entries.source: Hey kid, I haven't seen you in a while. Arachne's powers are growing day by day. Soon she'll take over the Spider's Den.
entries.translation: 嘿，孩子，我有一阵子没见到你了。阿拉克妮的力量与日俱增。很快她就会占领蜘蛛巢穴。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey kid, I haven't seen you in a while. Arachne's powers are growing day by day. Soon she'll take over the §cSpider's Den§f.

entries.source: The evil doesn't defeat itself. You should come to the Spider's Den again when you are free.
entries.translation: 邪恶不会自己消灭自己。你有空的时候应该再来蜘蛛巢穴一趟。
entries.sampleRaw: The evil doesn't defeat itself. You should come to the §cSpider's Den §fagain when you are free.

entries.source: I wish peace upon you.
entries.translation: 愿你平安。
entries.sampleRaw: I wish peace upon you.

entries.source: Oh, <player>! I'm having a conundrum! There's so much to kill, yet so little time.
entries.translation: 哦，<player>！我遇到难题了！要杀的东西那么多，时间却那么少。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, §7<player>§f! I'm having a conundrum! There's so much to kill, yet so little time.

entries.source: I've added the Grandma Wolf Pet to your Pets Menu.
entries.translation: 我已将 Grandma Wolf 宠物添加到你的宠物菜单中。
entries.sampleRaw: I've added the §aGrandma Wolf Pet §fto your §aPets Menu§f.

entries.source: The Grandma Wolf is particularly adept at combos. The more mobs you kill in quick succession, the better!
entries.translation: Grandma Wolf 特别擅长连击。你在短时间内连续击杀的怪物越多，效果就越好！
entries.sampleRaw: The Grandma Wolf is particularly adept at combos. The more mobs you kill in quick succession, the better!

entries.source: If you reach high enough Bestiary Milestones, I will increase the rarity of this pet!
entries.translation: 如果你的怪物图鉴里程碑足够高，我就会提升这只宠物的稀有度！
entries.sampleRaw: If you reach high enough §6Bestiary Milestones§f, I will increase the rarity of this pet!

entries.source: The pet does not need to be spawned for combos to work! Happy hunting!
entries.translation: 连击生效不需要召唤宠物！祝你狩猎愉快！
entries.sampleRaw: The pet does not need to be spawned for combos to work! Happy hunting!

entries.source: There you go! I've upgraded your Grandma Wolf Pet to Uncommon!
entries.translation: 给你!我已经把你的Grandma Wolf宠物升级为罕见!
entries.sampleRaw: There you go! I've upgraded your §aGrandma Wolf Pet§f to §aUncommon§f!

entries.source: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone X to upgrade it to Rare!
entries.translation: 等你达到怪物图鉴里程碑 X 后再回来，我会把它升级为稀有！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you've reached §6Bestiary Milestone X§f to upgrade it to §9Rare§f!

entries.source: There you go! I've upgraded your Grandma Wolf Pet to Rare!
entries.translation: 给你！我已经把你的Grandma Wolf宠物升级为稀有！
entries.sampleRaw: There you go! I've upgraded your §9Grandma Wolf Pet§f to §9Rare§f!

entries.source: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone XV to upgrade it to Epic!
entries.translation: 等你达到怪物图鉴里程碑 XV 后再回来，我会把它升级为史诗！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you've reached §6Bestiary Milestone XV§f to upgrade it to §5Epic§f!

entries.source: There you go! I've upgraded your Grandma Wolf Pet to Epic!
entries.translation: 给你！我已经把你的Grandma Wolf宠物升级为史诗！
entries.sampleRaw: There you go! I've upgraded your §5Grandma Wolf Pet§f to §5Epic§f!

entries.source: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone XX to upgrade it to Legendary!
entries.translation: 等你达到怪物图鉴里程碑 XX 后再回来，我会把它升级为传说！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you've reached §6Bestiary Milestone XX§f to upgrade it to §6Legendary§f!

entries.source: There you go! I've upgraded your Grandma Wolf Pet to Legendary!
entries.translation: 给你！我已经把你的Grandma Wolf宠物升级为传说！
entries.sampleRaw: There you go! I've upgraded your §6Grandma Wolf Pet§f to §6Legendary§f!

entries.source: I'm afraid that's all I can do for you. Thank you for helping this little old Grandma!
entries.translation: 恐怕我只能帮你到这里了。谢谢你帮助我这个老家伙Grandma！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm afraid that's all I can do for you. Thank you for helping this little old Grandma!

entries.source: I've already upgraded your pet to the maximum tier! Leave this little old Grandma alone!
entries.translation: 我已经把你的宠物升级到最高等级了！别再来烦我这个老家伙Grandma了！
entries.sampleRaw: I've already upgraded your pet to the maximum tier! Leave this little old Grandma alone!

entries.source: I'm afraid you don't have a Grandma Wolf Pet! Leave this little old Grandma alone!
entries.translation: 恐怕你没有Grandma Wolf宠物！别再来烦我这个老家伙Grandma了！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm afraid you don't have a §6Grandma Wolf Pet§f! Leave this little old Grandma alone!

entries.source: I will upgrade your Grandma Wolf Pet to [rarity] when you reach Bestiary Milestone #.
entries.translation: 当你达到怪物图鉴里程碑 # 时，我会把你的Grandma Wolf宠物升级为[rarity]。
entries.sampleRaw: I will upgrade your Grandma Wolf Pet to §7[rarity] §fwhen you reach §6Bestiary Milestone #§f.

entries.source: My little child, you don't look so good. You should eat something. I have an idea, give me some ingredients and I'll make you a nice soup.
entries.translation: 我的孩子，你看起来气色不太好。你该吃点东西。我有个主意，给我一些食材，我给你做一碗美味的汤。
entries.sampleRaw: My little child, you don't look so good. You should eat something. I have an idea, give me some ingredients and I'll make you a nice soup.

entries.source: I will make you a meal that you won't forget!
entries.translation: 我会给你做一顿让你难忘的饭！
entries.sampleRaw: I will make you a meal that you won't forget!

entries.source: You denied Grandma Wolf's request. How dare you treat your granny like that.
entries.translation: 你拒绝了Grandma Wolf的请求。你怎么敢这样对待你的奶奶。
entries.sampleRaw: You denied Grandma Wolf's request. How dare you treat your granny like that.

entries.source: Hey, are you an adventurer?
entries.translation: 嘿，你是一名冒险者吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, are you an adventurer?

entries.source: There are Relics I am searching for all around this island!
entries.translation: 这座岛上到处都有我正在寻找的圣物！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere are §bRelics §fI am searching for all around this island!

entries.source: But I am not strong enough to find them.
entries.translation: 但我还不够强，找不到它们。
entries.sampleRaw: But I am not strong enough to find them.

entries.source: Take my compass to assist you in your journey!
entries.translation: 带上我的指南针，助你旅途一臂之力！
entries.sampleRaw: §fTake my §bcompass §fto assist you in your journey!

entries.source: Some spider eggs look a bit different, check behind those.
entries.translation: 有些蜘蛛卵看起来有点不一样，检查一下它们后面。
entries.sampleRaw: Some spider eggs look a bit different, check behind those.

entries.source: Are you sure you looked through every cobweb?
entries.translation: 你确定你检查过每一张蛛网了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you sure you looked through every cobweb?

entries.source: Down there, multiple rooms are blocked by cobwebs.
entries.translation: 在下面，有好几个房间被蛛网挡住了。
entries.sampleRaw: Down there, multiple rooms are blocked by cobwebs.

entries.source: The spiders are hiding some of the relics behind cobwebs.
entries.translation: 蜘蛛们把一些圣物藏在蛛网后面。
entries.sampleRaw: The spiders are hiding some of the relics behind cobwebs.

entries.source: Look around spider eggs too, and cobwebs!
entries.translation: 也看看蜘蛛卵周围，还有蛛网！
entries.sampleRaw: Look around spider eggs too, and cobwebs!

entries.source: Dig through gravel and you should be able to find a relic.
entries.translation: 挖开沙砾，你应该能找到一件圣物。
entries.sampleRaw: Dig through gravel and you should be able to find a relic.

entries.source: I'm fairly sure there is a Relic nearby the dragon's tail.
entries.translation: 我很确定龙的尾巴附近有一件圣物。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm fairly sure there is a Relic nearby the dragon's tail.

entries.source: Don't forget to look down those caves, there are plenty down there lying around.
entries.translation: 别忘了看看那些洞穴下面，那里散落着不少。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't forget to look down those caves, there are plenty down there lying around.

entries.source: I managed to find one behind a spider egg, but once again I just couldn't reach it...
entries.translation: 我设法在一个蜘蛛卵后面找到了一个，但又一次，我就是够不到它……
entries.sampleRaw: I managed to find one behind a spider egg, but once again I just couldn't reach it...

entries.source: When in doubt, check behind cobwebs!
entries.translation: 拿不准的时候，就检查蛛网后面！
entries.sampleRaw: When in doubt, check behind cobwebs!

entries.source: Look up around the caves, some spiders have their nest behind some cobwebs up there.
entries.translation: 抬头看看洞穴周围，有些蜘蛛把巢筑在上面的蛛网后面。
entries.sampleRaw: Look up around the caves, some spiders have their nest behind some cobwebs up there.

entries.source: I won't lie, some of those I could find myself, but I hate cobwebs.
entries.translation: 不瞒你说，其中有些我自己也能找到，但我讨厌蛛网。
entries.sampleRaw: I won't lie, some of those I could find myself, but I hate cobwebs.

entries.source: Spiders often dig up mushrooms and create tiny rooms below, make sure to check those!
entries.translation: 蜘蛛经常挖出蘑菇，并在下面造出小房间，一定要检查那些地方！
entries.sampleRaw: Spiders often dig up mushrooms and create tiny rooms below, make sure to check those!

entries.source: There might be some below mushrooms too!
entries.translation: 蘑菇下面也可能有一些！
entries.sampleRaw: There might be some below mushrooms too!

entries.source: One of the Relics is inside a tiny hole inside the caves.
entries.translation: 其中一件圣物就在洞穴里的一个小洞中。
entries.sampleRaw: One of the Relics is inside a tiny hole inside the caves.

entries.source: There are some relics up there hidden on the Spider's Den.
entries.translation: 蜘蛛巢穴上面藏着一些圣物。
entries.sampleRaw: There are some relics up there hidden on the Spider's Den.

entries.source: Always check the roof in the caves, there are holes behind the cobwebs.
entries.translation: 一定要检查洞穴的顶部，蛛网后面有洞。
entries.sampleRaw: Always check the roof in the caves, there are holes behind the cobwebs.

entries.source: You know that breakable wall in the caves? Look around it.
entries.translation: 你知道洞穴里那面可破坏的墙吗？在它周围找找。
entries.sampleRaw: You know that breakable wall in the caves? Look around it.

entries.source: Walk around the edges, you will probably find some cave entrances.
entries.translation: 沿着边缘走走，你大概能找到一些洞穴入口。
entries.sampleRaw: Walk around the edges, you will probably find some cave entrances.

entries.source: I know a spot down in the caves but I just have no idea how to get into that room, the entrance is tiny.
entries.translation: 我知道洞穴下面有个地方，但我就是不知道该怎么进那个房间，入口太小了。
entries.sampleRaw: I know a spot down in the caves but I just have no idea how to get into that room, the entrance is tiny.

entries.source: There is a relic a little below a Fairy Soul in the caves.
entries.translation: 洞穴里一颗仙女之魂稍下方有一件圣物。
entries.sampleRaw: There is a relic a little below a Fairy Soul in the caves.

entries.source: Make sure you check all the mushrooms, sometimes there are tiny holes behind them.
entries.translation: 一定要检查所有蘑菇，有时它们后面有小洞。
entries.sampleRaw: Make sure you check all the mushrooms, sometimes there are tiny holes behind them.

entries.source: Sometimes look behind leaves too, there are many hidden caves on this island!
entries.translation: 有时也要看看树叶后面，这座岛上有很多隐藏的洞穴！
entries.sampleRaw: Sometimes look behind leaves too, there are many hidden caves on this island!

entries.source: I believe there is one down in the spider cave, behind a wall of cobwebs.
entries.translation: 我相信蜘蛛洞穴下面有一个，就在一堵蛛网墙后面。
entries.sampleRaw: I believe there is one down in the spider cave, behind a wall of cobwebs.

entries.source: I heard rumors that there is a man-made hole inside the cave, with a Fairy Soul even!
entries.translation: 我听说洞穴里有一个人工挖出的洞，里面甚至还有一颗仙女之魂！
entries.sampleRaw: I heard rumors that there is a man-made hole inside the cave, with a Fairy Soul even!

entries.source: Are you sure you checked every mushroom?
entries.translation: 你确定你检查过每一朵蘑菇了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you sure you checked every mushroom?

entries.source: I found one below the house too but I really can't access it, I'm not sure how to get there...
entries.translation: 我也在房子下面发现了一个，但我真的进不去，我不确定该怎么到那里……
entries.sampleRaw: I found one below the house too but I really can't access it, I'm not sure how to get there...

entries.source: Pretty sure there is one nearby the Dragon skull.
entries.translation: 很确定龙骷髅附近有一个。
entries.sampleRaw: Pretty sure there is one nearby the Dragon skull.

entries.source: Wow! You found all the Relics.
entries.translation: 哇！你找到了所有圣物。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! You found all the Relics.

entries.source: Take this as a reward, you've earned it.
entries.translation: 把这个当作奖励收下吧，这是你应得的。
entries.sampleRaw: Take this as a reward, you've earned it.

entries.source: I found an interesting specimen in the spider caves, perhaps there's other stuff to find in there.
entries.translation: 我在蜘蛛洞穴里发现了一个有趣的标本，也许那里还能找到别的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: I found an interesting specimen in the spider caves, perhaps there's other stuff to find in there.

entries.source: Oh, hello there! You must be the adventurer who helped who helped me find all those relics.
entries.translation: 哦，你好啊！你一定就是那位帮我找到所有圣物的冒险家。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, hello there! You must be the adventurer who helped who helped me find all those relics.

entries.source: I came to visit your Garden and see if I could find any artifacts. I heard there might be something interesting here.
entries.translation: 我来参观你的花园，看看能不能找到什么文物。我听说这里可能有有趣的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: I came to visit your Garden and see if I could find any artifacts. I heard there might be something interesting here.

entries.source: Oh, that's alright. I understand you're busy with your own adventures.
entries.translation: 哦，没关系。我理解你正忙着自己的冒险。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, that's alright. I understand you're busy with your own adventures.

entries.source: Hello, adventurer! I am Bramass Beastslayer! I've slain beasts of all sorts across SkyBlock!
entries.translation: 你好，冒险家！我是Bramass Beastslayer！我在整个 SkyBlock 中猎杀过各种各样的野兽！
entries.sampleRaw: Hello, adventurer! I am §cBramass Beastslayer§f! I've slain beasts of all sorts across SkyBlock!

entries.source: I sure wish there was a record of all my accomplishments in one place!
entries.translation: 我真希望有人能把我所有的成就都记录在一个地方！
entries.sampleRaw: I sure wish there was a record of all my accomplishments in one place!

entries.source: Oh wait...there is!
entries.translation: 哦等等……有的！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh wait...there is!

entries.source: Your Bestiary is a compendium of all of the mobs in SkyBlock!
entries.translation: 你的怪物图鉴收录了 SkyBlock 中所有怪物的资料！
entries.sampleRaw: Your §3Bestiary §fis a compendium of all of the mobs in SkyBlock!

entries.source: View your mob stats, unlock rewards, and more!
entries.translation: 查看你的怪物属性、解锁奖励以及更多内容！
entries.sampleRaw: View your mob stats, unlock rewards, and more!

entries.source: You can find the Bestiary in your Combat Skill menu!
entries.translation: 你可以在战斗技能菜单中找到怪物图鉴！
entries.sampleRaw: You can find the Bestiary in your §aCombat Skill §fmenu!

entries.source: Oh, you reached Bestiary Milestone 50! Few adventurers make it so far, especially in one piece...
entries.translation: 哦,你达到了怪物图鉴里程碑 50!很少有冒险者能走到这一步,尤其是还能完好无损……
entries.sampleRaw: §fOh, you reached §3Bestiary Milestone 50§f! Few adventurers make it so far, especially in one piece...
entries.numericSource: Oh, you reached Bestiary Milestone {{N0}}! Few adventurers make it so far, especially in one piece...
entries.numericTranslation: 哦,你达到了怪物图鉴里程碑 {{N0}}!很少有冒险者能走到这一步,尤其是还能完好无损……

entries.source: You're certainly worthy. Here, I want you to have this.
entries.translation: 你确实配得上。来，我想把这个交给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou're certainly worthy. Here, I want you to have this.

entries.source: That Beastslayer's Codex increases its Stats and Rarity as you reach more Bestiary Milestones.
entries.translation: 那本屠兽者法典会随着你达成更多怪物图鉴里程碑而提升其属性和稀有度。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat Beastslayer's Codex §fincreases its §aStats §fand §dRarity §fas you reach more §3Bestiary Milestones§f.

entries.source: It has served me throughout my travels, but those days are now long behind me.
entries.translation: 它曾陪伴我走过无数旅途，但那些日子如今早已远去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt has served me throughout my travels, but those days are now long behind me.

entries.source: Now, go and search the lands far and wide for more mobs to slay - that is the true calling of a Beastmaster!
entries.translation: 现在，去广阔的大地上寻找更多怪物来猎杀吧——这才是兽王真正的使命！
entries.sampleRaw: §fNow, go and search the lands far and wide for more mobs to slay - that is the true calling of a §cBeastmaster§f!

entries.source: Killing enough mobs in a given Family unlocks rewards.
entries.translation: 在某个科系中击杀足够多的怪物即可解锁奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: Killing enough mobs in a given §aFamily §funlocks §arewards§f.

entries.source: You can unlock ✯ Magic Find and ❁ Strength bonuses, and loot drop information for that Family!
entries.translation: 你可以解锁 ✯ 稀有物品概率加成和 ❁ 力量加成，以及该科系的战利品掉落信息！
entries.sampleRaw: You can unlock §b✯ Magic Find §fand §c❁ Strength §fbonuses, and loot drop information for that Family!

entries.source: Reach Milestones in your Bestiary by unlocking unique Family tiers.
entries.translation: 通过解锁独特的科系层级，在怪物图鉴中达成里程碑。
entries.sampleRaw: Reach §aMilestones §fin your Bestiary by unlocking unique Family tiers.

entries.source: Reaching Milestones rewards ❤ Health, Combat Exp, and more!
entries.translation: 达成里程碑可获得 ❤ 生命值、战斗经验等奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: Reaching Milestones rewards §c❤ Health§f, §aCombat Exp§f, and more!

entries.source: You can always view your Bestiary in your Combat Skill menu!
entries.translation: 你可以随时在战斗技能菜单中查看你的怪物图鉴！
entries.sampleRaw: You can always view your Bestiary in your §aCombat Skill §fmenu!

entries.source: Killing mobs in a Family enough times rewards you with ✯ Magic Find towards that mob!
entries.translation: 在某个科系中击杀足够多次怪物，即可获得针对该怪物的 ✯ 稀有物品概率加成！
entries.sampleRaw: Killing mobs in a Family enough times rewards you with §b✯ Magic Find §ftowards that mob!

entries.source: This increases your chance to find rare loot when killing this mob!
entries.translation: 这会提高你击杀该怪物时找到稀有战利品的几率！
entries.sampleRaw: This increases your chance to find rare loot when killing this mob!

entries.source: Come back to me when you reach Heart of the Mountain Tier 4.
entries.translation: 等你达到山峰之心 4 级后再来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back to me when you reach §dHeart of the Mountain§f Tier 4.
entries.numericSource: Come back to me when you reach Heart of the Mountain Tier {{N0}}.
entries.numericTranslation: 等你达到山峰之心 {{N0}} 级后再来找我。

entries.source: Hello! Behind me lies the entrance to the Crystal Hollows.
entries.translation: 你好！我身后就是水晶洞窟的入口。
entries.sampleRaw: Hello! Behind me lies the entrance to the §5Crystal Hollows§f.

entries.source: This place is full of treasures and secrets!
entries.translation: 这个地方充满了宝藏和秘密！
entries.sampleRaw: This place is full of treasures and secrets!

entries.source: We dwarves have tried to setup outposts there but it is harder than it looks.
entries.translation: 我们矮人曾试图在那里建立前哨站，但这事比看起来要难得多。
entries.sampleRaw: We dwarves have tried to setup outposts there but it is harder than it looks.

entries.source: Nowadays this place is only used for expeditions and adventures!
entries.translation: 如今这个地方只用于远征和冒险！
entries.sampleRaw: Nowadays this place is only used for expeditions and adventures!

entries.source: A fantastic place to explore and mine Gemstones.
entries.translation: 一个探索和开采宝石的绝佳之地。
entries.sampleRaw: A fantastic place to explore and mine §dGemstones§f.

entries.source: I'll grant you access to the Crystal Hollows for 6 hours, for only 10,000 coins!
entries.translation: 只需 10,000 硬币,我就能为你开通 6 小时的水晶洞窟通行权限!
entries.sampleRaw: I'll grant you access to the §5Crystal Hollows§f for 6 hours, for only §610,000 coins§f!
entries.numericSource: I'll grant you access to the Crystal Hollows for {{N0}} hours, for only {{N1}} coins!
entries.numericTranslation: 只需 {{N1}} 硬币,我就能为你开通 {{N0}} 小时的水晶洞窟通行权限!

entries.source: Once access is granted, you can always come here by using the Fast Travel menu in your SkyBlock Menu!
entries.translation: 开通权限后，你随时可以使用 SkyBlock 菜单中的快速旅行菜单来到这里！
entries.sampleRaw: Once access is granted, you can always come here by using the §bFast Travel §fmenu in your §aSkyBlock Menu§f!

entries.source: You should also talk to Emissary Braum, they have more information about commissions.
entries.translation: 你还应该和 Emissary Braum 谈谈，他们有更多关于委托的信息。
entries.sampleRaw: You should also talk to §6Emissary Braum§f, they have more information about §ecommissions§f.

entries.source: Great! Now hop on into the Minecart and I'll get you on your way!
entries.translation: 太好了！现在跳上矿车，我这就送你上路！
entries.sampleRaw: Great! Now hop on into the Minecart and I'll get you on your way!

entries.source: Good luck in the mines!
entries.translation: 祝你在矿洞里好运！
entries.sampleRaw: Good luck in the mines!

entries.source: Oh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!
entries.translation: 哦不！看来你错过了矿车！

styleMappings.Oh no! It looks like you missed the Mine: 哦不！看来你错过了矿车！

entries.sampleRaw: §cOh no! It looks like you missed the Minecart!

entries.source: Hey! Someone special has been asking to meet you!
entries.translation: 嘿！有位特别的人一直想见你！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey! Someone §dspecial §fhas been asking to meet you!

entries.source: I'm not quite sure what he's doing back in the Dwarven Mines- it's been years since I last saw him!
entries.translation: 我不太确定他回矮人矿坑做什么——我已经好多年没见过他了！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not quite sure what he's doing back in the §2Dwarven Mines§f- it's been §oyears §r§fsince I last saw him!

entries.source: Anyways, he's expecting you over in the Hanging Court by the Royal Palace. Better not keep him waiting!
entries.translation: 总之，他在王宫旁的悬空庭院等你。最好别让他久等！
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, he's expecting you over in the §bHanging Court §fby the Royal Palace. Better not keep him waiting!

entries.source: One day I will be useful.
entries.translation: 总有一天我会派上用场的。
entries.sampleRaw: One day I will be useful.

entries.source: I don't really have a sweet tooth, but chocolate is probably my favorite thing in this world. But the supply is really poor mostly because of the mines' lack of accessibility.
entries.translation: 我其实不太爱吃甜食，但巧克力大概是我在这个世界上最喜欢的东西了。不过因为矿坑交通不便，供应实在很差。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't really have a sweet tooth, but chocolate is probably my favorite thing in this world. But the supply is really poor mostly because of the mines' lack of accessibility.

entries.source: Amazing! I haven't eaten such chocolatey goodness in a long time...Maybe they should invest in that rusty old lift.
entries.translation: 太棒了！我好久没吃到这么浓郁的巧克力美味了……也许他们该投资修修那台生锈的老升降机。
entries.sampleRaw: Amazing! I haven't eaten such chocolatey goodness in a long time...Maybe they should invest in that rusty old lift.

entries.source: I helped you enter the Crystal Hollows so many times! Why won't you return the favor?
entries.translation: 我帮了你那么多次进入水晶洞窟！你为什么不肯还我个人情？
entries.sampleRaw: I helped you enter the Crystal Hollows so many times! Why won't you return the favor?

entries.source: Many treasures await you blah, blah, blah... Get in the Minecart!
entries.translation: 无数宝藏等着你，等等等等……快上矿车！
entries.sampleRaw: Many treasures await you blah, blah, blah... Get in the Minecart!

entries.source: What are you waiting for? Christmas? Get in!
entries.translation: 你还在等什么？圣诞节吗？快进去！
entries.sampleRaw: What are you waiting for? Christmas? Get in!

entries.source: Just get in the heckin Minecart already.
entries.translation: 赶紧给我上矿车吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Just get in the heckin Minecart already.

entries.source: Go on, in you get.
entries.translation: 去吧，进去吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Go on, in you get.

entries.source: The Minecart will leave without you...
entries.translation: 矿车可不会等你……
entries.sampleRaw: The Minecart will leave without you...

entries.source: That Minecart won't wait forever you know.
entries.translation: 那辆矿车可不会永远等下去，你知道的。
entries.sampleRaw: That Minecart won't wait forever you know.

entries.source: According to the legends, this bridge is very big.
entries.translation: 根据传说，这座桥非常大。
entries.sampleRaw: According to the legends, this bridge is very big.
